tr: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina an akhrij qawmaka mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wathakkirhum biayyami Allahi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin

t: And [recall, O Children of Israel], when Moses said to His people, “Remember the favour of God upon you when He saved you from the people of Pharaoh, who were afflicting you with the worst torment and were slaughtering your [newborn] sons and keeping your females alive. And in that was a great trial from your Lord.
tr: Waith qala moosa liqawmihi othkuroo niAAmata Allahi AAalaykum ith anjakum min ali firAAawna yasoomoonakum sooa alAAathabi wayuthabbihoona abnaakum wayastahyoona nisaakum wafee thalikum balaon min rabbikum AAatheemun

t: And [remember] when your Lord proclaimed, ‘If you are grateful, I will surely increase you [in favour]; but if you deny, indeed, My punishment is severe.’”
tr: Waith taaththana rabbukum lain shakartum laazeedannakum walain kafartum inna AAathabee lashadeedun

t: And Moses said, “If you should disbelieve, you and whoever is on the earth entirely - indeed, God is Free of need and Praiseworthy.”
tr: Waqala moosa in takfuroo antum waman fee alardi jameeAAan fainna Allaha laghaniyyun hameedun

t: Has there not reached you the news of those before you - the people of Noah and ‘Aad and Thamūd and those after them? No one knows them [i.e., their number] but God. Their messengers brought them clear proofs, but they returned their hands to their mouths and said, “Indeed, we disbelieve in that with which you have been sent, and indeed we are in doubt about that to which you invite us, causing suspicion.”
tr: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena min qablikum qawmi noohin waAAadin wathamooda waallatheena min baAAdihim la yaAAlamuhum illa Allahu jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati faraddoo aydiyahum fee afwahihim waqaloo inna kafarna bima orsiltum bihi wainna lafee shakkin mimma tadAAoonana ilayhi mureebun

t: Their messengers said, “Can there be doubt about God, Originator of the heavens and earth? He invites you that He may forgive you of your sins, and He delays you [i.e., your death] for a specified term.” They said, You are not but men like us who wish to prevent us from what our fathers were worshipping. So bring us a clear authority [i.e., evidence].”
tr: Qalat rusuluhum afee Allahi shakkun fatiri alssamawati waalardi yadAAookum liyaghfira lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirakum ila ajalin musamman qaloo in antum illa basharun mithluna tureedoona an tasuddoona AAamma kana yaAAbudu abaona fatoona bisultanin mubeenin

t: Their messengers said to them, “We are only men like you, but God confers favour upon whom He wills of His servants. It has never been for us to bring you evidence except by permission of God. And upon God let the Believers rely.
tr: Qalat lahum rusuluhum in nahnu illa basharun mithlukum walakinna Allaha yamunnu AAala man yashao min AAibadihi wama kana lana an natiyakum bisultanin illa biithni Allahi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona

t: And why should we not rely upon God while He has guided us to our [good] ways. And we will surely be patient against whatever harm you should cause us. And upon God let those who would rely [indeed] rely.”
tr: Wama lana alla natawakkala AAala Allahi waqad hadana subulana walanasbiranna AAala ma athaytumoona waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almutawakkiloona

t: And those who disbelieved said to their messengers, “We will surely drive you out of our land, or you must return to our religion.” So their Lord inspired to them, “We will surely destroy the wrongdoers.
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lirusulihim lanukhrijannakum min ardina aw lataAAoodunna fee millatina faawha ilayhim rabbuhum lanuhlikanna alththalimeena

t: And We will surely cause you to dwell in the land after them. That is for he who fears My position and fears My threat.”
tr: Walanuskinannakumu alarda min baAAdihim thalika liman khafa maqamee wakhafa waAAeedi

t: And they requested decision [i.e., victory from God], and disappointed, [therefore], was every obstinate tyrant.
tr: Waistaftahoo wakhaba kullu jabbarin AAaneedin

t: Before him is Hell, and he will be given a drink of purulent water.
tr: Min waraihi jahannamu wayusqa min main sadeedin

t: He will gulp it but will hardly [be able to] swallow it. And death will come to him from everywhere, but he is not to die. And before him is a massive punishment.
tr: YatajarraAAuhu wala yakadu yuseeghuhu wayateehi almawtu min kulli makanin wama huwa bimayyitin wamin waraihi AAathabun ghaleethun

t: The example of those who disbelieve in their Lord is [that] their deeds are like ashes which the wind blows forcefully on a stormy day; they are unable [to keep] from what they earned a [single] thing. That is what is extreme error.
tr: Mathalu allatheena kafaroo birabbihim aAAmaluhum karamadin ishtaddat bihi alrreehu fee yawmin AAasifin la yaqdiroona mimma kasaboo AAala shayin thalika huwa alddalalu albaAAeedu

t: Have you not seen [i.e., considered] that God created the heavens and the earth in truth? If He wills, He can do away with you and produce a new creation.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi in yasha yuthhibkum wayati bikhalqin jadeedin

t: And that is not difficult for God.
tr: Wama thalika AAala Allahi biAAazeezin

t: And they will come out [for judgement] before God all together, and the weak will say to those who were arrogant, “Indeed, we were your followers, so can you avail us anything against the punishment of God?” They will say, “If God had guided us, we would have guided you. It is all the same for us whether we show intolerance or are patient: there is for us no place of escape.”
tr: Wabarazoo lillahi jameeAAan faqala aldduAAafao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum tabaAAan fahal antum mughnoona AAanna min AAathabi Allahi min shayin qaloo law hadana Allahu lahadaynakum sawaon AAalayna ajaziAAna am sabarna ma lana min maheesin

t: And Satan will say when the matter has been concluded, “Indeed, God had promised you the promise of truth. And I promised you, but I betrayed you. But I had no authority over you except that I invited you, and you responded to me. So do not blame me; but blame yourselves. I cannot be called to your aid, nor can you be called to my aid. Indeed, I deny your association of me [with God] before. Indeed, for the wrongdoers is a painful punishment.”
tr: Waqala alshshaytanu lamma qudiya alamru inna Allaha waAAadakum waAAda alhaqqi wawaAAadtukum faakhlaftukum wama kana liya AAalaykum min sultanin illa an daAAawtukum faistajabtum lee fala taloomoonee waloomoo anfusakum ma ana bimusrikhikum wama antum bimusrikhiyya innee kafartu bima ashraktumooni min qablu inna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun

t: And those who believed and did righteous deeds will be admitted to gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein by permission of their Lord; and their greeting therein will be, “Peace!”
tr: Waodkhila allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha biithni rabbihim tahiyyatuhum feeha salamun

t: Have you not considered how God presents an example, [making] a good word like a good tree, whose root is firmly fixed and its branches [high] in the sky?
tr: Alam tara kayfa daraba Allahu mathalan kalimatan tayyibatan kashajaratin tayyibatin asluha thabitun wafarAAuha fee alssamai

t: It produces its fruit all the time, by permission of its Lord. And God presents examples for the people that perhaps they will be reminded.
tr: Tutee okulaha kulla heenin biithni rabbiha wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

t: And the example of a bad word is like a bad tree, uprooted from the surface of the earth, not having any stability.
tr: Wamathalu kalimatin khabeethatin kashajaratin khabeethatin ijtuththat min fawqi alardi ma laha min qararin

t: God keeps firm those who believe, with the firm word, in worldly life and in the Hereafter. And God sends astray the wrongdoers. And God does what He wills.
tr: Yuthabbitu Allahu allatheena amanoo bialqawli alththabiti fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati wayudillu Allahu alththalimeena wayafAAalu Allahu ma yashao

t: Have you not considered those who exchanged the favour of God for disbelief and settled their people [in] the home of ruin?
tr: Alam tara ila allatheena baddaloo niAAmata Allahi kufran waahalloo qawmahum dara albawari

t: [It is] Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the settlement.
tr: Jahannama yaslawnaha wabisa alqararu

t: And they have attributed to God equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, “Enjoy yourselves, for indeed, your destination is the Fire.”
tr: WajaAAaloo lillahi andadan liyudilloo AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAAoo fainna maseerakum ila alnnari

t: [O Muhammad], tell My servants who have believed to establish prayer and spend from what We have provided them, secretly and publicly, before a Day comes in which there will be no exchange [i.e., ransom], nor any friendships.
tr: Qul liAAibadiya allatheena amanoo yuqeemoo alssalata wayunfiqoo mimma razaqnahum sirran waAAalaniyatan min qabli an yatiya yawmun la bayAAun feehi wala khilalun

t: It is God who created the heavens and the earth and sent down rain from the sky and produced thereby some fruits as provision for you and subjected for you the ships to sail through the sea by His command and subjected for you the rivers.
tr: Allahu allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhraja bihi mina alththamarati rizqan lakum wasakhkhara lakumu alfulka litajriya fee albahri biamrihi wasakhkhara lakumu alanhara

t: And He subjected for you the sun and the moon, continuous [in orbit], and subjected for you the night and the day.
tr: Wasakhkhara lakumu alshshamsa waalqamara daibayni wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara

t: And He gave you from all you asked of Him. And if you should count the favour [i.e., blessings] of God, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, mankind is [generally] most unjust and ungrateful.
tr: Waatakum min kulli ma saaltumoohu wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna alinsana lathaloomun kaffarun

t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said, “My Lord, make this city [i.e., Makkah] secure and keep me and my sons away from worshipping idols.
tr: Waith qala ibraheemu rabbi ijAAal hatha albalada aminan waojnubnee wabaniyya an naAAbuda alasnama

t: My Lord, indeed they have led astray many among the people. So whoever follows me - then he is of me; and whoever disobeys me - indeed, You are [yet] Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Rabbi innahunna adlalna katheeran mina alnnasi faman tabiAAanee fainnahu minnee waman AAasanee fainnaka ghafoorun raheemun

t: Our Lord, I have settled some of my descendants in an uncultivated valley near Your sacred House, our Lord, that they may establish prayer. So make hearts among the people incline toward them and provide for them from the fruits that they might be grateful.
tr: Rabbana innee askantu min thurriyyatee biwadin ghayri thee zarAAin AAinda baytika almuharrami rabbana liyuqeemoo alssalata faijAAal afidatan mina alnnasi tahwee ilayhim waorzuqhum mina alththamarati laAAallahum yashkuroona

t: Our Lord, indeed You know what we conceal and what we declare, and nothing is hidden from God on the earth or in the heaven.
tr: Rabbana innaka taAAlamu ma nukhfee wama nuAAlinu wama yakhfa AAala Allahi min shayin fee alardi wala fee alssamai

t: Praise to God, who has granted to me in old age Ishmael and Isaac. Indeed, my Lord is the Hearer of supplication.
tr: Alhamdu lillahi allathee wahaba lee AAala alkibari ismaAAeela waishaqa inna rabbee lasameeAAu aldduAAai

t: My Lord, make me an establisher of prayer, and [many] from my descendants. Our Lord, and accept my supplication.
tr: Rabbi ijAAalnee muqeema alssalati wamin thurriyyatee rabbana wtaqabbal duAAai

t: Our Lord, forgive me and my parents and the Believers the Day the account is established.”
tr: Rabbana ighfir lee waliwalidayya walilmumineena yawma yaqoomu alhisabu

t: And never think that God is unaware of what the wrongdoers do. He only delays them [i.e., their account] for a Day when eyes will stare [in horror].
tr: Wala tahsabanna Allaha ghafilan AAamma yaAAmalu alththalimoona innama yuakhkhiruhum liyawmin tashkhasu feehi alabsaru

t: Racing ahead, their heads raised up, their glance does not come back to them, and their hearts are void.
tr: MuhtiAAeena muqniAAee ruoosihim la yartaddu ilayhim tarfuhum waafidatuhum hawaon

t: And, [O Muhammad], warn the people of a Day when the punishment will come to them and those who did wrong will say, “Our Lord, delay us for a short term; we will answer Your call and follow the messengers.” [But it will be said], “Had you not sworn, before, that for you there would be no cessation?
tr: Waanthiri alnnasa yawma yateehimu alAAathabu fayaqoolu allatheena thalamoo rabbana akhkhirna ila ajalin qareebin nujib daAAwataka wanattabiAAi alrrusula awalam takoonoo aqsamtum min qablu ma lakum min zawalin

t: And you lived among the dwellings of those who wronged themselves, and it had become clear to you how We dealt with them. And We presented for you [many] examples.”
tr: Wasakantum fee masakini allatheena thalamoo anfusahum watabayyana lakum kayfa faAAalna bihim wadarabna lakumu alamthala

t: And they had planned their plan, but with God is [recorded] their plan, even if their plan had been [sufficient] to do away with the mountains.
tr: Waqad makaroo makrahum waAAinda Allahi makruhum wain kana makruhum litazoola minhu aljibalu

t: So never think that God will fail in His promise to His messengers. Indeed, God is Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution.
tr: Fala tahsabanna Allaha mukhlifa waAAdihi rusulahu inna Allaha AAazeezun thoo intiqamin

t: [It will be] on the Day the earth will be replaced by another earth, and the heavens [as well], and they [i.e., all creatures] will come out before God, the One, the Prevailing,
tr: Yawma tubaddalu alardu ghayra alardi waalssamawatu wabarazoo lillahi alwahidi alqahhari

t: And you will see the criminals that Day bound together in shackles,
tr: Watara almujrimeena yawmaithin muqarraneena fee alasfadi

t: Their garments of liquid pitch and their faces covered by the Fire
tr: Sarabeeluhum min qatranin wataghsha wujoohahumu alnnaru

t: So that God will recompense every soul for what it earned. Indeed, God is swift in account.
tr: Liyajziya Allahu kulla nafsin ma kasabat inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi

t: This [Qur’ān] is a message for the people that they may be warned thereby and that they may know that He is but one God and that those of understanding will be reminded.
tr: Hatha balaghun lilnnasi waliyuntharoo bihi waliyaAAlamoo annama huwa ilahun wahidun waliyaththakkara oloo alalbabi

t: Alif, Lām, Rā. These are the verses of the Book and a clear Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
tr: Aliflamra tilka ayatu alkitabi waquranin mubeenin

t: Perhaps those who disbelieve will wish that they had been Muslims.
tr: Rubama yawaddu allatheena kafaroo law kanoo muslimeena

t: Let them eat and enjoy themselves and be diverted by [false] hope, for they are going to know.
tr: Tharhum yakuloo wayatamattaAAoo wayulhihimu alamalu fasawfa yaAAlamoona

t: And We did not destroy any city but that for it was a known decree.
tr: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa walaha kitabun maAAloomun

t: No nation will precede its term, nor will they remain thereafter.
tr: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona

t: And they say, “O you upon whom the message has been sent down, indeed you are mad.
tr: Waqaloo ya ayyuha allathee nuzzila AAalayhi alththikru innaka lamajnoonun

t: Why do you not bring us the angels, if you should be among the truthful?”
tr: Law ma tateena bialmalaikati in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t: We do not send down the angels except with truth; and they [i.e., the disbelievers] would not then be reprieved.
tr: Ma nunazzilu almalaikata illa bialhaqqi wama kanoo ithan munthareena

t: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder [i.e., the Qur’ān], and indeed, We will be its guardian.
tr: Inna nahnu nazzalna alththikra wainna lahu lahafithoona

t: And We had certainly sent [messengers] before you, [O Muhammad], among the sects of the former peoples.
tr: Walaqad arsalna min qablika fee shiyaAAi alawwaleena

t: And no messenger would come to them except that they ridiculed him.
tr: Wama yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: Thus do We insert it [i.e., denial] into the hearts of the criminals.
tr: Kathalika naslukuhu fee quloobi almujrimeena

t: They will not believe in it, while there has already occurred the precedent of the former peoples.
tr: La yuminoona bihi waqad khalat sunnatu alawwaleena

t: And [even] if We opened to them a gate from the heaven and they continued therein to ascend,
tr: Walaw fatahna AAalayhim baban mina alssamai fathalloo feehi yaAArujoona

t: They would say, “Our eyes have only been dazzled. Rather, we are a people affected by magic.”
tr: Laqaloo innama sukkirat absaruna bal nahnu qawmun mashooroona

t: And We have placed within the heaven great stars and have beautified it for the observers.
tr: Walaqad jaAAalna fee alssamai buroojan wazayyannaha lilnnathireena

t: And We have protected it from every devil expelled [from the mercy of God]
tr: Wahafithnaha min kulli shaytanin rajeemin

t: Except one who steals a hearing and is pursued by a clear burning flame.
tr: Illa mani istaraqa alssamAAa faatbaAAahu shihabun mubeenun

t: And the earth - We have spread it and cast therein firmly set mountains and caused to grow therein [something] of every well-balanced thing.
tr: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli shayin mawzoonin

t: And We have made for you therein means of living and [for] those for whom you are not providers.
tr: WajaAAalna lakum feeha maAAayisha waman lastum lahu biraziqeena

t: And there is not a thing but that with Us are its depositories, and We do not send it down except according to a known [i.e., specified] measure.
tr: Wain min shayin illa AAindana khazainuhu wama nunazziluhu illa biqadarin maAAloomin

t: And We have sent the fertilizing winds and sent down water from the sky and given you drink from it. And you are not its retainers.
tr: Waarsalna alrriyaha lawaqiha faanzalna mina alssamai maan faasqaynakumoohu wama antum lahu bikhazineena

t: And indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and We are the Inheritor.
tr: Wainna lanahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wanahnu alwarithoona

t: And We have already known the preceding [generations] among you, and We have already known the later [ones to come].
tr: Walaqad AAalimna almustaqdimeena minkum walaqad AAalimna almustakhireena

t: And indeed, your Lord will gather them; indeed, He is Wise and Knowing.
tr: Wainna rabbaka huwa yahshuruhum innahu hakeemun AAaleemun

t: And We did certainly create the human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

t: And the jinn We created before from scorching fire.
tr: Waaljanna khalaqnahu min qablu min nari alssamoomi

t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when your Lord said to the angels, “I will create a human being out of clay from an altered black mud.
tr: Waith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

t: And when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration.”
tr: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

t: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely,
tr: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

t: Except Iblees; he refused to be with those who prostrated.
tr: Illa ibleesa aba an yakoona maAAa alssajideena

t: [God] said, “O Iblees, what is [the matter] with you that you are not with those who prostrate?”
tr: Qala ya ibleesu ma laka alla takoona maAAa alssajideena

t: He said, “Never would I prostrate to a human whom You created out of clay from an altered black mud.”
tr: Qala lam akun liasjuda libasharin khalaqtahu min salsalin min hamain masnoonin

t: [God] said, “Then get out of it, for indeed, you are expelled.
tr: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

t: And indeed, upon you is the curse until the Day of Recompense.”
tr: Wainna AAalayka allaAAnata ila yawmi alddeeni

t: He said, “My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected.”
tr: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

t: [God] said, “So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

t: Until the Day of the time well-known.”
tr: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

t: [Iblees] said, “My Lord, because You have put me in error, I will surely make [disobedience] attractive to them [i.e., mankind] on earth, and I will mislead them all
tr: Qala rabbi bima aghwaytanee laozayyinanna lahum fee alardi walaoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

t: Except, among them, Your chosen servants.”
tr: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

t: [God] said, “This is a path [of return] to Me [that is] straight.
tr: Qala hatha siratun AAalayya mustaqeemun

t: Indeed, My servants - no authority will you have over them, except those who follow you of the deviators.
tr: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun illa mani ittabaAAaka mina alghaweena

t: And indeed, Hell is the promised place for them all.
tr: Wainna jahannama lamawAAiduhum ajmaAAeena

t: It has seven gates; for every gate is of them [i.e., Satan’s followers] a portion designated.”
tr: Laha sabAAatu abwabin likulli babin minhum juzon maqsoomun

t: Indeed, the righteous will be within gardens and springs,
tr: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

t: [Having been told], “Enter it in peace, safe [and secure].”
tr: Odkhulooha bisalamin amineena

t: And We will remove whatever is in their breasts of resentment, [so they will be] brothers, on thrones facing each other.
tr: WanazaAAna ma fee sudoorihim min ghillin ikhwanan AAala sururin mutaqabileena

t: No fatigue will touch them therein, nor from it will they [ever] be removed.
tr: La yamassuhum feeha nasabun wama hum minha bimukhrajeena

t: [O Muhammad], inform My servants that it is I who am the Forgiving, the Merciful,
tr: Nabbi AAibadee annee ana alghafooru alrraheemu

t: And that it is My punishment which is the painful punishment.
tr: Wa anna AAathabee huwa alAAathabu alaleemu

t: And inform them about the guests of Abraham,
tr: Wanabbihum AAan dayfi ibraheema

t: When they entered upon him and said, “Peace.” [Abraham] said, “Indeed, we are fearful [i.e., apprehensive] of you.”
tr: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala inna minkum wajiloona

t: [The angels] said, “Fear not. Indeed, we give you good tidings of a learned boy.”
tr: Qaloo la tawjal inna nubashshiruka bighulamin AAaleemin

t: He said, “Have you given me good tidings although old age has come upon me? Then of what [wonder] do you inform?”
tr: Qala abashshartumoonee AAala an massaniya alkibaru fabima tubashshirooni

t: They said, “We have given you good tidings in truth, so do not be of the despairing.”
tr: Qaloo bashsharnaka bialhaqqi fala takun mina alqaniteena

t: He said, “And who despairs of the mercy of his Lord except for those astray?”
tr: Qala waman yaqnatu min rahmati rabbihi illa alddalloona

t: [Abraham] said, “Then what is your business [here], O messengers?”
tr: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

t: They said, “Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals,
tr: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

t: Except the family of Lot; indeed, we will save them all
tr: Illa ala lootin inna lamunajjoohum ajmaAAeena

t: Except his wife.” We [i.e., God] decreed that she is of those who remain behind.
tr: Illa imraatahu qaddarna innaha lamina alghabireena

t: And when the messengers came to the family of Lot,
tr: Falamma jaa ala lootin almursaloona

t: He said, “Indeed, you are people unknown.”
tr: Qala innakum qawmun munkaroona

t: They said, “But we have come to you with that about which they were disputing,
tr: Qaloo bal jinaka bima kanoo feehi yamtaroona

t: And we have come to you with truth, and indeed, we are truthful.
tr: Waataynaka bialhaqqi wainna lasadiqoona

t: So set out with your family during a portion of the night and follow behind them and let not anyone among you look back and continue on to where you are commanded.”
tr: Faasri biahlika biqitAAin mina allayli waittabiAA adbarahum wala yaltafit minkum ahadun waimdoo haythu tumaroona

t: And We conveyed to him [the decree] of that matter: that those [sinners] would be eliminated by early morning.
tr: Waqadayna ilayhi thalika alamra anna dabira haolai maqtooAAun musbiheena

t: And the people of the city came rejoicing.
tr: Wajaa ahlu almadeenati yastabshiroona

t: [Lot] said, “Indeed, these are my guests, so do not shame me.
tr: Qala inna haolai dayfee fala tafdahooni

t: And fear God and do not disgrace me.”
tr: Waittaqoo Allaha wala tukhzooni

t: They said, “Have we not forbidden you from [protecting] people?”
tr: Qaloo awalam nanhaka AAani alAAalameena

t: [Lot] said, “These are my daughters if you would be doers [of lawful marriage].”
tr: Qala haolai banatee in kuntum faAAileena

t: By your life, [O Muhammad], indeed they were, in their intoxication, wandering blindly.
tr: LaAAamruka innahum lafee sakratihim yaAAmahoona

t: So the shriek seized them at sunrise.
tr: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu mushriqeena

t: And We made the highest part [of the city] its lowest and rained upon them stones of hard clay.
tr: FajaAAalna AAaliyaha safilaha waamtarna AAalayhim hijaratan min sijjeelin

t: Indeed in that are signs for those who discern.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatin lilmutawassimeena

t: And indeed, they [i.e., those cities] are [situated] on an established road.
tr: Wainnaha labisabeelin muqeemin

t: Indeed in that is a sign for the Believers.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena

t: And the companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] were [also] wrongdoers,
tr: Wain kana ashabu alaykati lathalimeena

t: So We took retribution from them, and indeed, both [cities] are on a clear highway.
tr: Faintaqamna minhum wainnahuma labiimamin mubeenin

t: And certainly did the companions of al- Hijr [i.e., the Thamūd] deny the messengers.
tr: Walaqad kaththaba ashabu alhijri almursaleena

t: And We gave them Our signs, but from them they were turning away.
tr: Waataynahum ayatina fakanoo AAanha muAArideena

t: And they used to carve from the mountains, houses, feeling secure.
tr: Wakanoo yanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan amineena

t: But the shriek seized them at early morning,
tr: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu musbiheena

t: So nothing availed them [from] what they used to earn.
tr: Fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona

t: And We have not created the heavens and earth and that between them except in truth. And indeed, the Hour is coming; so overlook with gracious forgiveness.
tr: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi wainna alssaAAata laatiyatun faisfahi alssafha aljameela

t: Indeed, your Lord - He is the Knowing Creator.
tr: Inna rabbaka huwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

t: And We have certainly given you, [O Muhammad], seven of the often repeated [verses] and the great Qur’ān.
tr: Walaqad ataynaka sabAAan mina almathanee waalqurana alAAatheema

t: Do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [certain] categories of them [i.e., the disbelievers], and do not grieve over them. And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to the Believers
tr: La tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum wala tahzan AAalayhim waikhfid janahaka lilmumineena

t: And say, “Indeed, I am the clear warner” -
tr: Waqul innee ana alnnatheeru almubeenu

t: Just as We had revealed to the dividers
tr: Kama anzalna AAala almuqtasimeena

t: Who have made the Qur’ān into portions.
tr: Allatheena jaAAaloo alqurana AAideena

t: So by your Lord, We will surely question them all
tr: Fawarabbika lanasalannahum ajmaAAeena

t: About what they used to do.
tr: AAamma kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: Then declare what you are commanded and turn away from the polytheists.
tr: FaisdaAA bima tumaru waaAArid AAani almushrikeena

t: Indeed, We are sufficient for you against the mockers
tr: Inna kafaynaka almustahzieena

t: Who make [equal] with God another deity. But they are going to know.
tr: Allatheena yajAAaloona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fasawfa yaAAlamoona

t: And We already know that your breast is constrained by what they say.
tr: Walaqad naAAlamu annaka yadeequ sadruka bima yaqooloona

t: So exalt [God] with praise of your Lord and be of those who prostrate [to Him].
tr: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika wakun mina alssajideena

t: And worship your Lord until there comes to you the certainty [i.e., death].
tr: WaoAAbud rabbaka hatta yatiyaka alyaqeenu

t: The command of God is coming, so do not seek to hasten it. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
tr: Ata amru Allahi fala tastaAAjiloohu subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

t: He sends down the angels, with the inspiration [i.e., revelation] of His command, upon whom He wills of His servants, [telling them], “Warn that there is no deity except Me; so fear Me.”
tr: Yunazzilu almalaikata bialrroohi min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi an anthiroo annahu la ilaha illa ana faittaqooni

t: He created the heavens and earth in truth. High is He above what they associate with Him.
tr: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi taAAala AAamma yushrikoona

t: He created the human being from a sperm-drop; then at once he is a clear adversary.
tr: Khalaqa alinsana min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

t: And the grazing livestock He has created for you; in them is warmth and [numerous] benefits, and from them you eat.
tr: WaalanAAama khalaqaha lakum feeha difon wamanafiAAu waminha takuloona

t: And for you in them is [the enjoyment of] beauty when you bring them in [for the evening] and when you send them out [to pasture].
tr: Walakum feeha jamalun heena tureehoona waheena tasrahoona

t: And they carry your loads to a land you could not have reached except with difficulty to yourselves. Indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
tr: Watahmilu athqalakum ila baladin lam takoonoo baligheehi illa bishiqqi alanfusi inna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun

t: And [He created] the horses, mules and donkeys for you to ride and [as] adornment. And He creates that which you do not know.
tr: Waalkhayla waalbighala waalhameera litarkabooha wazeenatan wayakhluqu ma la taAAlamoona

t: And upon God is the direction of the [right] way, and among them [i.e., the various paths] are those deviating. And if He willed, He could have guided you all.
tr: WaAAala Allahi qasdu alssabeeli waminha jairun walaw shaa lahadakum ajmaAAeena

t: It is He who sends down rain from the sky; from it is drink and from it is foliage in which you pasture [animals].
tr: Huwa allathee anzala mina alssamai maan lakum minhu sharabun waminhu shajarun feehi tuseemoona

t: He causes to grow for you thereby the crops, olives, palm trees, grapevines, and from all the fruits. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
tr: Yunbitu lakum bihi alzzarAAa waalzzaytoona waalnnakheela waalaAAnaba wamin kulli alththamarati inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona

t: And He has subjected for you the night and day and the sun and moon, and the stars are subjected by His command. Indeed in that are signs for a people who reason.
tr: Wasakhkhara lakumu allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara waalnnujoomu musakhkharatun biamrihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona

t: And [He has subjected] whatever He multiplied for you on the earth of varying colours. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who remember.
tr: Wama tharaa lakum fee alardi mukhtalifan alwanuhu inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaththakkaroona

t: And it is He who subjected the sea for you to eat from it tender meat and to extract from it ornaments which you wear. And you see the ships ploughing through it, and [He subjected it] that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
tr: Wahuwa allathee sakhkhara albahra litakuloo minhu lahman tariyyan watastakhrijoo minhu hilyatan talbasoonaha watara alfulka mawakhira feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona

t: And He has cast into the earth firmly set mountains, lest it shift with you, and [made] rivers and roads, that you may be guided,
tr: Waalqa fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bikum waanharan wasubulan laAAallakum tahtadoona

t: And landmarks. And by the stars they are [also] guided.
tr: WaAAalamatin wabialnnajmi hum yahtadoona

t: Then is He who creates like one who does not create? So will you not be reminded?
tr: Afaman yakhluqu kaman la yakhluqu afala tathakkaroona

t: And if you should count the favours of God, you could not enumerate them. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Wain taAAuddoo niAAmata Allahi la tuhsooha inna Allaha laghafoorun raheemun

t: And God knows what you conceal and what you declare.
tr: WaAllahu yaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona

t: And those they invoke other than God create nothing, and they [themselves] are created.
tr: Waallatheena yadAAoona min dooni Allahi la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona

t: They are, [in fact], dead, not alive, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.
tr: Amwatun ghayru ahyain wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona

t: Your god is one God. But those who do not believe in the Hereafter - their hearts are disapproving, and they are arrogant.
tr: Ilahukum ilahun wahidun faallatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati quloobuhum munkiratun wahum mustakbiroona

t: Assuredly, God knows what they conceal and what they declare. Indeed, He does not like the arrogant.
tr: La jarama anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona innahu la yuhibbu almustakbireena

t: And when it is said to them, “What has your Lord sent down?” they say, “Legends of the former peoples,”
tr: Waitha qeela lahum matha anzala rabbukum qaloo asateeru alawwaleena

t: That they may bear their own burdens [i.e., sins] in full on the Day of Resurrection and some of the burdens of those whom they misguide without [i.e., by lack of] knowledge. Surely, evil is that which they bear.
tr: Liyahmiloo awzarahum kamilatan yawma alqiyamati wamin awzari allatheena yudilloonahum bighayri AAilmin ala saa ma yaziroona

t: Those before them had already plotted, but God came at [i.e., uprooted] their building from the foundations, so the roof fell upon them from above them, and the punishment came to them from where they did not perceive.
tr: Qad makara allatheena min qablihim faata Allahu bunyanahum mina alqawaAAidi fakharra AAalayhimu alssaqfu min fawqihim waatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

t: Then on the Day of Resurrection He will disgrace them and say, “Where are My ‘partners’ for whom you used to oppose [the believers]?” Those who were given knowledge will say, “Indeed disgrace, this Day, and evil are upon the disbelievers” -
tr: Thumma yawma alqiyamati yukhzeehim wayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tushaqqoona feehim qala allatheena ootoo alAAilma inna alkhizya alyawma waalssooa AAala alkafireena

t: The ones whom the angels take in death [while] wronging themselves, and [who] then offer submission, [saying], “We were not doing any evil.” But, yes! Indeed, God is Knowing of what you used to do.
tr: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu thalimee anfusihim faalqawoo alssalama ma kunna naAAmalu min sooin bala inna Allaha AAaleemun bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t: So enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and how wretched is the residence of the arrogant.
tr: Faodkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha falabisa mathwa almutakabbireena

t: And it will be said to those who feared God, “What did your Lord send down?” They will say, “[That which is] good.” For those who strive for excellence in this world is good; and the home of the Hereafter is better. And how excellent is the home of the righteous -
tr: Waqeela lillatheena ittaqaw matha anzala rabbukum qaloo khayran lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waladaru alakhirati khayrun walaniAAma daru almuttaqeena

t: Gardens of perpetual residence, which they will enter, beneath which rivers flow. They will have therein whatever they wish. Thus does God reward the righteous -
tr: Jannatu AAadnin yadkhuloonaha tajree min tahtiha alanharu lahum feeha ma yashaoona kathalika yajzee Allahu almuttaqeena

t: The ones whom the angels take in death, [being] good and pure; [the angels] will say, “Peace be upon you. Enter Paradise for what you used to do.”
tr: Allatheena tatawaffahumu almalaikatu tayyibeena yaqooloona salamun AAalaykumu odkhuloo aljannata bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t: Do they [i.e., the disbelievers] await [anything] except that the angels should come to them or there comes the command of your Lord? Thus did those do before them. And God wronged them not, but they had been wronging themselves.
tr: Hal yanthuroona illa an tatiyahumu almalaikatu aw yatiya amru rabbika kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim wama thalamahumu Allahu walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona

t: So they were struck by the evil consequences of what they did and were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: And those who associate others with God say, “If God had willed, we would not have worshipped anything other than Him, neither we nor our fathers, nor would we have forbidden anything through other than Him.” Thus did those do before them. So is there upon the messengers except [the duty to] convey clearly?
tr: Waqala allatheena ashrakoo law shaa Allahu ma AAabadna min doonihi min shayin nahnu wala abaona wala harramna min doonihi min shayin kathalika faAAala allatheena min qablihim fahal AAala alrrusuli illa albalaghu almubeenu

t: And We certainly sent into every nation a messenger, [saying], “Worship God and avoid tāghūt.” And among them were those whom God guided, and among them were those upon whom error was [deservedly] decreed. So proceed [i.e., travel] through the earth and observe how was the end of the deniers.
tr: Walaqad baAAathna fee kulli ommatin rasoolan ani oAAbudoo Allaha waijtaniboo alttaghoota faminhum man hada Allahu waminhum man haqqat AAalayhi alddalalatu faseeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena

t: [Even] if you should strive for their guidance, [O Muhammad], indeed, God does not guide those He sends astray, and they will have no helpers.
tr: In tahris AAala hudahum fainna Allaha la yahdee man yudillu wama lahum min nasireena

t: And they swear by God their strongest oaths [that] God will not resurrect one who dies. But yes - [it is] a true promise [binding] upon Him, but most of the people do not know.
tr: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim la yabAAathu Allahu man yamootu bala waAAdan AAalayhi haqqan walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona

t: [It is] so He will make clear to them [the truth of] that wherein they differ and so those who have disbelieved may know that they were liars.
tr: Liyubayyina lahumu allathee yakhtalifoona feehi waliyaAAlama allatheena kafaroo annahum kanoo kathibeena

t: Indeed, Our word to a thing when We intend it is but that We say to it, “Be,” and it is.
tr: Innama qawluna lishayin itha aradnahu an naqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

t: And those who emigrated for [the cause of] God after they had been wronged - We will surely settle them in this world in a good place; but the reward of the Hereafter is greater, if only they could know.
tr: Waallatheena hajaroo fee Allahi min baAAdi ma thulimoo lanubawwiannahum fee alddunya hasanatan walaajru alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

t: [They are] those who endured patiently and upon their Lord relied.
tr: Allatheena sabaroo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona

t: And We sent not before you except men to whom We revealed [Our message]. So ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
tr: Wama arsalna min qablika illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona

t: [We sent them] with clear proofs and written ordinances. And We revealed to you the message [i.e., the Qur’ān] that you may make clear to the people what was sent down to them and that they might give thought.
tr: Bialbayyinati waalzzuburi waanzalna ilayka alththikra litubayyina lilnnasi ma nuzzila ilayhim walaAAallahum yatafakkaroona

t: Then, do those who have planned evil deeds feel secure that God will not cause the earth to swallow them or that the punishment will not come upon them from where they do not perceive?
tr: Afaamina allatheena makaroo alssayyiati an yakhsifa Allahu bihimu alarda aw yatiyahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

t: Or that He would not seize them during their [usual] activity, and they could not frustrate [i.e., escape from Him]?
tr: Aw yakhuthahum fee taqallubihim fama hum bimuAAjizeena

t: Or that He would not seize them gradually [in a state of dread]? But indeed, your Lord is Kind and Merciful.
tr: Aw yakhuthahum AAala takhawwufin fainna rabbakum laraoofun raheemun

t: Have they not considered what things God has created? Their shadows incline to the right and to the left, prostrating to God, while they [i.e., those creations] are humble.
tr: Awa lam yaraw ila ma khalaqa Allahu min shayin yatafayyao thilaluhu AAani alyameeni waalshshamaili sujjadan lillahi wahum dakhiroona

t: And to God prostrates whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth of creatures, and the angels [as well], and they are not arrogant.
tr: Walillahi yasjudu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi min dabbatin waalmalaikatu wahum la yastakbiroona

t: They fear their Lord above them, and they do what they are commanded.
tr: Yakhafoona rabbahum min fawqihim wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona

t: And God has said, “Do not take for yourselves two deities. He [i.e., God] is but one God, so fear only Me.”
tr: Waqala Allahu la tattakhithoo ilahayni ithnayni innama huwa ilahun wahidun faiyyaya fairhabooni

t: And to Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and the earth, and to Him is [due] worship constantly. Then is it other than God that you fear?
tr: Walahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi walahu alddeenu wasiban afaghayra Allahi tattaqoona

t: And whatever you have of favour - it is from God. Then when adversity touches you, to Him you cry for help.
tr: Wama bikum min niAAmatin famina Allahi thumma itha massakumu alddurru failayhi tajaroona

t: Then when He removes the adversity from you, at once a party of you associates others with their Lord
tr: Thumma itha kashafa alddurra AAankum itha fareequn minkum birabbihim yushrikoona

t: So they will deny what We have given them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
tr: Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum fatamattaAAoo fasawfa taAAlamoona

t: And they assign to what they do not know [i.e., false deities] a portion of that which We have provided them. By God, you will surely be questioned about what you used to invent.
tr: WayajAAaloona lima la yaAAlamoona naseeban mimma razaqnahum taAllahi latusalunna AAamma kuntum taftaroona

t: And they attribute to God daughters exalted is He - and for them is what they desire [i.e., sons].
tr: WayajAAaloona lillahi albanati subhanahu walahum ma yashtahoona

t: And when one of them is informed of [the birth of] a female, his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
tr: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bialontha thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun

t: He hides himself from the people because of the ill of which he has been informed. Should he keep it in humiliation or bury it in the ground? Surely, evil is what they decide.
tr: Yatawara mina alqawmi min sooi ma bushshira bihi ayumsikuhu AAala hoonin am yadussuhu fee altturabi ala saa ma yahkumoona

t: For those who do not believe in the Hereafter is the description [i.e., an attribute] of evil; and for God is the highest attribute. And He is Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Lillatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati mathalu alssawi walillahi almathalu alaAAla wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: And if God were to impose blame on the people for their wrongdoing, He would not have left upon it [i.e., the earth] any creature, but He defers them for a specified term. And when their term has come, they will not remain behind an hour, nor will they precede [it].
tr: Walaw yuakhithu Allahu alnnasa bithulmihim ma taraka AAalayha min dabbatin walakin yuakhkhiruhum ila ajalin musamman faitha jaa ajaluhum la yastakhiroona saAAatan wala yastaqdimoona

t: And they attribute to God that which they dislike [i.e., daughters], and their tongues assert the lie that they will have the best [from Him]. Assuredly, they will have the Fire, and they will be [therein] neglected.
tr: WayajAAaloona lillahi ma yakrahoona watasifu alsinatuhumu alkathiba anna lahumu alhusna la jarama anna lahumu alnnara waannahum mufratoona

t: By God, We did certainly send [messengers] to nations before you, but Satan made their deeds attractive to them. And he is their [i.e., the disbelievers] ally today [as well], and they will have a painful punishment.
tr: TaAllahi laqad arsalna ila omamin min qablika fazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fahuwa waliyyuhumu alyawma walahum AAathabun aleemun

t: And We have not revealed to you the Book, [O Muhammad], except for you to make clear to them that wherein they have differed and as guidance and mercy for a people who believe.
tr: Wama anzalna AAalayka alkitaba illa litubayyina lahumu allathee ikhtalafoo feehi wahudan warahmatan liqawmin yuminoona

t: And God has sent down rain from the sky and given life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who listen.
tr: WaAllahu anzala mina alssamai maan faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yasmaAAoona

t: And indeed, for you in grazing livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from what is in their bellies - between excretion and blood - pure milk, palatable to drinkers.
tr: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butoonihi min bayni farthin wadamin labanan khalisan saighan lilshsharibeena

t: And from the fruits of the palm trees and grapevines you take intoxicant and good provision. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who reason.
tr: Wamin thamarati alnnakheeli waalaAAnabi tattakhithoona minhu sakaran warizqan hasanan inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaAAqiloona

t: And your Lord inspired to the bee, “Take for yourself among the mountains, houses [i.e., hives], and among the trees and [in] that which they construct.
tr: Waawha rabbuka ila alnnahli ani ittakhithee mina aljibali buyootan wamina alshshajari wamimma yaAArishoona

t: Then eat from all the fruits and follow the ways of your Lord laid down [for you].” There emerges from their bellies a drink, varying in colours, in which there is healing for people. Indeed in that is a sign for a people who give thought.
tr: Thumma kulee min kulli alththamarati faoslukee subula rabbiki thululan yakhruju min butooniha sharabun mukhtalifun alwanuhu feehi shifaon lilnnasi inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yatafakkaroona

t: And God created you; then He will take you in death. And among you is he who is reversed to the most decrepit [old] age so that he will not know, after [having had] knowledge, a thing. Indeed, God is Knowing and Competent.
tr: WaAllahu khalaqakum thumma yatawaffakum waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali alAAumuri likay la yaAAlama baAAda AAilmin shayan inna Allaha AAaleemun qadeerun

t: And God has favoured some of you over others in provision. But those who were favoured [i.e., given more] would not hand over their provision to those whom their right hands possess [i.e., slaves] so they would be equal to them therein. Then is it the favour of God they reject?
tr: WaAllahu faddala baAAdakum AAala baAAdin fee alrrizqi fama allatheena fuddiloo biraddee rizqihim AAala ma malakat aymanuhum fahum feehi sawaon afabiniAAmati Allahi yajhadoona

t: And God has made for you from yourselves mates and has made for you from your mates sons and grandchildren and has provided for you from the good things. Then in falsehood do they believe and in the favour of God they disbelieve?
tr: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wajaAAala lakum min azwajikum baneena wahafadatan warazaqakum mina alttayyibati afabialbatili yuminoona wabiniAAmati Allahi hum yakfuroona

t: And they worship besides God that which does not possess for them [the power of] provision from the heavens and the earth at all, and [in fact], they are unable.
tr: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yamliku lahum rizqan mina alssamawati waalardi shayan wala yastateeAAoona

t: So do not assert similarities to God. Indeed, God knows and you do not know.
tr: Fala tadriboo lillahi alamthala inna Allaha yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona

t: God presents an example: a slave [who is] owned and unable to do a thing and he to whom We have provided from Us good provision, so he spends from it secretly and publicly. Can they be equal? Praise to God! But most of them do not know.
tr: Daraba Allahu mathalan AAabdan mamlookan la yaqdiru AAala shayin waman razaqnahu minna rizqan hasanan fahuwa yunfiqu minhu sirran wajahran hal yastawoona alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

t: And God presents an example of two men, one of them dumb and unable to do a thing, while he is a burden to his guardian. Wherever he directs him, he brings no good. Is he equal to one who commands justice, while he is on a straight path?
tr: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan rajulayni ahaduhuma abkamu la yaqdiru AAala shayin wahuwa kallun AAala mawlahu aynama yuwajjihhu la yati bikhayrin hal yastawee huwa waman yamuru bialAAadli wahuwa AAala siratin mustaqeemin

t: And to God belongs the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And the command for the Hour is not but as a glance of the eye or even nearer. Indeed, God is over all things competent.
tr: Walillahi ghaybu alssamawati waalardi wama amru alssaAAati illa kalamhi albasari aw huwa aqrabu inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: And God has extracted you from the wombs of your mothers not knowing a thing, and He made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect] that perhaps you would be grateful.
tr: WaAllahu akhrajakum min butooni ommahatikum la taAAlamoona shayan wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata laAAallakum tashkuroona

t: Do they not see the birds controlled in the atmosphere of the sky? None holds them up except God. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Alam yaraw ila alttayri musakhkharatin fee jawwi alssamai ma yumsikuhunna illa Allahu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

t: And God has made for you from your homes a place of rest and made for you from the hides of the animals tents which you find light on your day of travel and your day of encampment; and from their wool, fur and hair is furnishing and enjoyment [i.e., provision] for a time.
tr: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum min buyootikum sakanan wajaAAala lakum min juloodi alanAAami buyootan tastakhiffoonaha yawma thaAAnikum wayawma iqamatikum wamin aswafiha waawbariha waashAAariha athathan wamataAAan ila heenin

t: And God has made for you, from that which He has created, shadows [i.e., shade] and has made for you from the mountains, shelters and has made for you garments which protect you from the heat and garments [i.e., coats of mail] which protect you from your [enemy in] battle. Thus does He complete His favour upon you that you might submit [to Him].
tr: WaAllahu jaAAala lakum mimma khalaqa thilalan wajaAAala lakum mina aljibali aknanan wajaAAala lakum sarabeela taqeekumu alharra wasarabeela taqeekum basakum kathalika yutimmu niAAmatahu AAalaykum laAAallakum tuslimoona

t: But if they turn away, [O Muhammad] then only upon you is [the responsibility to] convey clearly.
tr: Fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayka albalaghu almubeenu

t: They recognize the favour of God; then they deny it. And most of them are disbelievers.
tr: YaAArifoona niAAmata Allahi thumma yunkiroonaha waaktharuhumu alkafiroona

t: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect from every nation a witness [i.e., their prophet]. Then it will not be permitted to the disbelievers [to apologize or make excuses], nor will they be asked to appease [God].
tr: Wayawma nabAAathu min kulli ommatin shaheedan thumma la yuthanu lillatheena kafaroo wala hum yustaAAtaboona

t: And when those who wronged see the punishment, it will not be lightened for them, nor will they be reprieved.
tr: Waitha raa allatheena thalamoo alAAathaba fala yukhaffafu AAanhum wala hum yuntharoona

t: And when those who associated others with God see their “partners,” they will say, “Our Lord, these are our partners [to You] whom we used to invoke besides You.” But they will throw at them the statement, “Indeed, you are liars.”
tr: Waitha raa allatheena ashrakoo shurakaahum qaloo rabbana haolai shurakaona allatheena kunna nadAAoo min doonika faalqaw ilayhimu alqawla innakum lakathiboona

t: And they will impart to God that Day [their] submission, and lost from them is what they used to invent.
tr: Waalqaw ila Allahi yawmaithin alssalama wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona

t: Those who disbelieved and prevented [others] from the way of God - We will increase them in punishment over [their] punishment for what corruption they were causing.
tr: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi zidnahum AAathaban fawqa alAAathabi bima kanoo yufsidoona

t: And [mention] the Day when We will resurrect among every nation a witness over them from themselves [i.e., their prophet]. And We will bring you, [O Muhammad], as a witness over these [i.e., your nation]. And We have sent down to you the Book as clarification for all things and as guidance and mercy and good tidings for the Muslims.
tr: Wayawma nabAAathu fee kulli ommatin shaheedan AAalayhim min anfusihim wajina bika shaheedan AAala haolai wanazzalna AAalayka alkitaba tibyanan likulli shayin wahudan warahmatan wabushra lilmuslimeena

t: Indeed, God orders justice and best conduct and giving to relatives and forbids immorality and bad conduct and oppression. He admonishes you that perhaps you will be reminded.
tr: Inna Allaha yamuru bialAAadli waalihsani waeetai thee alqurba wayanha AAani alfahshai waalmunkari waalbaghyi yaAAithukum laAAallakum tathakkaroona

t: And fulfill the covenant of God when you have taken it, [O believers], and do not break oaths after their confirmation while you have made God, over you, a security [i.e., witness]. Indeed, God knows what you do.
tr: Waawfoo biAAahdi Allahi itha AAahadtum wala tanqudoo alaymana baAAda tawkeediha waqad jaAAaltumu Allaha AAalaykum kafeelan inna Allaha yaAAlamu ma tafAAaloona

t: And do not be like she who untwisted her spun thread after it was strong [by] taking your oaths as [means of] deceit between you because one community is more plentiful [in number or wealth] than another community. God only tries you thereby. And He will surely make clear to you on the Day of Resurrection that over which you used to differ.
tr: Wala takoonoo kaallatee naqadat ghazlaha min baAAdi quwwatin ankathan tattakhithoona aymanakum dakhalan baynakum an takoona ommatun hiya arba min ommatin innama yablookumu Allahu bihi walayubayyinanna lakum yawma alqiyamati ma kuntum feehi takhtalifoona

t: And if God had willed, He could have made you [of] one religion, but He causes to stray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And you will surely be questioned about what you used to do.
tr: Walaw shaa Allahu lajaAAalakum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudillu man yashao wayahdee man yashao walatusalunna AAamma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: And do not take your oaths as [means of] deceit between you, lest a foot slip after it was [once] firm, and you would taste evil [in this world] for what [people] you prevented from the way of God, and you would have [in the Hereafter] a great punishment.
tr: Wala tattakhithoo aymanakum dakhalan baynakum fatazilla qadamun baAAda thubootiha watathooqoo alssooa bima sadadtum AAan sabeeli Allahi walakum AAathabun AAatheemun

t: And do not exchange the covenant of God for a small price. Indeed, what is with God is best for you, if only you could know.
tr: Wala tashtaroo biAAahdi Allahi thamanan qaleelan innama AAinda Allahi huwa khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona

t: Whatever you have will end, but what God has is lasting. And We will surely give those who were patient their reward according to the best of what they used to do.
tr: Ma AAindakum yanfadu wama AAinda Allahi baqin walanajziyanna allatheena sabaroo ajrahum biahsani ma kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: Whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a Believer - We will surely cause him to live a good life, and We will surely give them their reward [in the Hereafter] according to the best of what they used to do.
tr: Man AAamila salihan min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun falanuhyiyannahu hayatan tayyibatan walanajziyannahum ajrahum biahsani ma kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: So when you recite the Qur’ān, [first] seek refuge in God from Satan, the expelled [from His mercy].
tr: Faitha qarata alqurana faistaAAith biAllahi mina alshshaytani alrrajeemi

t: Indeed, there is for him no authority over those who have believed and rely upon their Lord.
tr: Innahu laysa lahu sultanun AAala allatheena amanoo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona

t: His authority is only over those who take him as an ally and those who through him associate others with God.
tr: Innama sultanuhu AAala allatheena yatawallawnahu waallatheena hum bihi mushrikoona

t: And when We substitute a verse in place of a verse - and God is most knowing of what He sends down - they say, “You, [O Muhammad], are but an inventor [of lies].” But most of them do not know.
tr: Waitha baddalna ayatan makana ayatin waAllahu aAAlamu bima yunazzilu qaloo innama anta muftarin bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “The Pure Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down from your Lord in truth to make firm those who believe and as guidance and good tidings to the Muslims.”
tr: Qul nazzalahu roohu alqudusi min rabbika bialhaqqi liyuthabbita allatheena amanoo wahudan wabushra lilmuslimeena

t: And We certainly know that they say, “It is only a human being who teaches him [i.e., the Prophet].” The tongue of the one they refer to is foreign, and this [recitation i.e., Qur’ān] is [in] a clear Arabic language.
tr: Walaqad naAAlamu annahum yaqooloona innama yuAAallimuhu basharun lisanu allathee yulhidoona ilayhi aAAjamiyyun wahatha lisanun AAarabiyyun mubeenun

t: Indeed, those who do not believe in the verses of God - God will not guide them, and for them is a painful punishment.
tr: Inna allatheena la yuminoona biayati Allahi la yahdeehimu Allahu walahum AAathabun aleemun

t: They only invent falsehood who do not believe in the verses of God, and it is those who are the liars.
tr: Innama yaftaree alkathiba allatheena la yuminoona biayati Allahi waolaika humu alkathiboona

t: Whoever disbelieves in [i.e., denies] God after his belief… except for one who is forced [to renounce his religion] while his heart is secure in faith. But those who [willingly] open their breasts to disbelief, upon them is wrath from God, and for them is a great punishment;
tr: Man kafara biAllahi min baAAdi eemanihi illa man okriha waqalbuhu mutmainnun bialeemani walakin man sharaha bialkufri sadran faAAalayhim ghadabun mina Allahi walahum AAathabun AAatheemun

t: That is because they preferred the worldly life over the Hereafter and that God does not guide the disbelieving people.
tr: Thalika biannahumu istahabboo alhayata alddunya AAala alakhirati waanna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alkafireena

t: Those are the ones over whose hearts and hearing and vision God has sealed, and it is those who are the heedless.
tr: Olaika allatheena tabaAAa Allahu AAala quloobihim wasamAAihim waabsarihim waolaika humu alghafiloona

t: Assuredly, it is they, in the Hereafter, who will be the losers.
tr: La jarama annahum fee alakhirati humu alkhasiroona

t: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who emigrated after they had been compelled [to renounce their religion] and thereafter fought [for the cause of God] and were patient - indeed, your Lord, after that, is Forgiving and Merciful
tr: Thumma inna rabbaka lillatheena hajaroo min baAAdi ma futinoo thumma jahadoo wasabaroo inna rabbaka min baAAdiha laghafoorun raheemun

t: On the Day when every soul will come disputing [i.e., pleading] for itself, and every soul will be fully compensated for what it did, and they will not be wronged [i.e., treated unjustly].
tr: Yawma tatee kullu nafsin tujadilu AAan nafsiha watuwaffa kullu nafsin ma AAamilat wahum la yuthlamoona

t: And God presents an example: a city [i.e., Makkah] which was safe and secure, its provision coming to it in abundance from every location, but it denied the favours of God. So God made it taste the envelopment of hunger and fear for what they had been doing.
tr: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan qaryatan kanat aminatan mutmainnatan yateeha rizquha raghadan min kulli makanin fakafarat bianAAumi Allahi faathaqaha Allahu libasa aljooAAi waalkhawfi bima kanoo yasnaAAoona

t: And there had certainly come to them a Messenger from among themselves, but they denied him; so punishment overtook them while they were wrongdoers.
tr: Walaqad jaahum rasoolun minhum fakaththaboohu faakhathahumu alAAathabu wahum thalimoona

t: Then eat of what God has provided for you [which is] lawful and good. And be grateful for the favour of God, if it is [indeed] Him that you worship.
tr: Fakuloo mimma razaqakumu Allahu halalan tayyiban waoshkuroo niAAmata Allahi in kuntum iyyahu taAAbudoona

t: He has only forbidden to you dead animals, blood, the flesh of swine, and that which has been dedicated to other than God. But whoever is forced [by necessity], neither desiring [it] nor transgressing [its limit] - then indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Innama harrama AAalaykumu almaytata waalddama walahma alkhinzeeri wama ohilla lighayri Allahi bihi famani idturra ghayra baghin wala AAadin fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: And do not say about what your tongues assert of untruth, “This is lawful and this is unlawful,” to invent falsehood about God. Indeed, those who invent falsehood about God will not succeed.
tr: Wala taqooloo lima tasifu alsinatukumu alkathiba hatha halalun wahatha haramun litaftaroo AAala Allahi alkathiba inna allatheena yaftaroona AAala Allahi alkathiba la yuflihoona

t: [It is but] a brief enjoyment, and they will have a painful punishment.
tr: MataAAun qaleelun walahum AAathabun aleemun

t: And to those who are Jews We have prohibited that which We related to you before. And We did not wrong them [thereby], but they were wronging themselves.
tr: WaAAala allatheena hadoo harramna ma qasasna AAalayka min qablu wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona

t: Then, indeed your Lord, to those who have done wrong out of ignorance and then repent after that and correct themselves - indeed, your Lord, thereafter, is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Thumma inna rabbaka lillatheena AAamiloo alssooa bijahalatin thumma taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo inna rabbaka min baAAdiha laghafoorun raheemun

t: Indeed, Abraham was a [comprehensive] leader, devoutly obedient to God, inclining toward truth, and he was not of those who associate others with God.
tr: Inna ibraheema kana ommatan qanitan lillahi haneefan walam yaku mina almushrikeena

t: [He was] grateful for His favours. He [i.e., God] chose him and guided him to a straight path.
tr: Shakiran lianAAumihi ijtabahu wahadahu ila siratin mustaqeemin

t: And We gave him good in this world, and indeed, in the Hereafter he will be among the righteous.
tr: Waataynahu fee alddunya hasanatan wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina alssaliheena

t: Then We revealed to you, [O Muhammad], to follow the religion of Abraham, inclining toward truth; and he was not of those who associate with God.
tr: Thumma awhayna ilayka ani ittabiAA millata ibraheema haneefan wama kana mina almushrikeena

t: The Sabbath was only appointed for those who differed over it. And indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
tr: Innama juAAila alssabtu AAala allatheena ikhtalafoo feehi wainna rabbaka layahkumu baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona

t: Invite to the way of your Lord with wisdom and good admonition, and argue with them in a way that is best. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has strayed from His way, and He is most knowing of who is [rightly] guided.
tr: OdAAu ila sabeeli rabbika bialhikmati waalmawAAithati alhasanati wajadilhum biallatee hiya ahsanu inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena

t: And if you punish [an enemy, O believers], punish with an equivalent of that with which you were harmed. But if you are patient - it is better for those who are patient.
tr: Wain AAaqabtum faAAaqiboo bimithli ma AAooqibtum bihi walain sabartum lahuwa khayrun lilssabireena

t: And be patient, [O Muhammad], and your patience is not but through God. And do not grieve over them and do not be in distress over what they conspire.
tr: Waisbir wama sabruka illa biAllahi wala tahzan AAalayhim wala taku fee dayqin mimma yamkuroona

t: Indeed, God is with those who fear Him and those who strive for excellence.
tr: Inna Allaha maAAa allatheena ittaqaw waallatheena hum muhsinoona

t: Exalted is He who took His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muhammad] by night from al-Masjid al-Harām to al-Masjid al- Aqsā, whose surroundings We have blessed, to show him of Our signs. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
tr: Subhana allathee asra biAAabdihi laylan mina almasjidi alharami ila almasjidi alaqsa allathee barakna hawlahu linuriyahu min ayatina innahu huwa alssameeAAu albaseeru

t: And We gave Moses the Book and made it a guidance for the Children of Israel that you not take other than Me as Disposer of affairs,
tr: Waatayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalnahu hudan libanee israeela alla tattakhithoo min doonee wakeelan

t: O descendants of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah. Indeed, he was a grateful servant.
tr: Thurriyyata man hamalna maAAa noohin innahu kana AAabdan shakooran

t: And We conveyed to the Children of Israel in the Book that, “You will surely cause corruption on the earth twice, and you will surely reach [a degree of] great haughtiness.”
tr: Waqadayna ila banee israeela fee alkitabi latufsidunna fee alardi marratayni walataAAlunna AAuluwwan kabeeran

t: So when the [time of] promise came for the first of them, We sent against you servants of Ours - those of great military might, and they probed [even] into the homes, and it was a promise fulfilled.
tr: Faitha jaa waAAdu oolahuma baAAathna AAalaykum AAibadan lana olee basin shadeedin fajasoo khilala alddiyari wakana waAAdan mafAAoolan

t: Then We gave back to you a return victory over them. And We reinforced you with wealth and sons and made you more numerous in manpower
tr: Thumma radadna lakumu alkarrata AAalayhim waamdadnakum biamwalin wabaneena wajaAAalnakum akthara nafeeran

t: [And said], “If you do good, you do good for yourselves; and if you do evil, [you do it] to them [i.e., yourselves].” Then when the final [i.e., second] promise came, [We sent your enemies] to sadden your faces and to enter the masjid [i.e., the temple in Jerusalem], as they entered it the first time, and to destroy what they had taken over with [total] destruction.
tr: In ahsantum ahsantum lianfusikum wain asatum falaha faitha jaa waAAdu alakhirati liyasoooo wujoohakum waliyadkhuloo almasjida kama dakhaloohu awwala marratin waliyutabbiroo ma AAalaw tatbeeran

t: [Then God said], “Maybe your Lord will have mercy upon you. But if you return [to sin], We will return [to punishment]. And We have made Hell, for the disbelievers, a prison.”
tr: AAasa rabbukum an yarhamakum wain AAudtum AAudna wajaAAalna jahannama lilkafireena haseeran

t: Indeed, this Qur’ān guides to that which is most upright and gives good tidings to the Believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a great reward.
tr: Inna hatha alqurana yahdee lillatee hiya aqwamu wayubashshiru almumineena allatheena yaAAmaloona alssalihati anna lahum ajran kabeeran

t: And that those who do not believe in the Hereafter - We have prepared for them a painful punishment.
tr: Waanna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati aAAtadna lahum AAathaban aleeman

t: And the human supplicates for evil [when angry] as he supplicates for good, and the human being is ever hasty.
tr: WayadAAu alinsanu bialshsharri duAAaahu bialkhayri wakana alinsanu AAajoolan

t: And We have made the night and day two signs, and We erased the sign of the night and made the sign of the day visible that you may seek bounty from your Lord and may know the number of years and the account [of time]. And everything We have set out in detail.
tr: WajaAAalna allayla waalnnahara ayatayni famahawna ayata allayli wajaAAalna ayata alnnahari mubsiratan litabtaghoo fadlan min rabbikum walitaAAlamoo AAadada alssineena waalhisaba wakulla shayin fassalnahu tafseelan

t: And [for] every human being We have imposed his fate upon his neck, and We will produce for him on the Day of Resurrection a record which he will encounter spread open.
tr: Wakulla insanin alzamnahu tairahu fee AAunuqihi wanukhriju lahu yawma alqiyamati kitaban yalqahu manshooran

t: [It will be said], “Read your record. Today your own self is enough to calculate your account.”
tr: Iqra kitabaka kafa binafsika alyawma AAalayka haseeban

t: Whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] his soul. And whoever errs only errs against it. And no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. And never would We punish until We sent a messenger.
tr: Mani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra wama kunna muAAaththibeena hatta nabAAatha rasoolan

t: And when We intend to destroy a city, We command its affluent but they defiantly disobey therein; so the word [i.e., deserved decree] comes into effect upon it, and We destroy it with [complete] destruction.
tr: Waitha aradna an nuhlika qaryatan amarna mutrafeeha fafasaqoo feeha fahaqqa AAalayha alqawlu fadammarnaha tadmeeran

t: And how many have We destroyed from the generations after Noah. And sufficient is your Lord, concerning the sins of His servants, as Acquainted and Seeing.
tr: Wakam ahlakna mina alqurooni min baAAdi noohin wakafa birabbika bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran baseeran

t: Whoever should desire the immediate - We hasten for him from it what We will to whom We intend. Then We have made for him Hell, which he will [enter to] burn, censured and banished.
tr: Man kana yureedu alAAajilata AAajjalna lahu feeha ma nashao liman nureedu thumma jaAAalna lahu jahannama yaslaha mathmooman madhooran

t: But whoever desires the Hereafter and exerts the effort due to it while he is a Believer - it is those whose effort is ever appreciated [by God].
tr: Waman arada alakhirata wasaAAa laha saAAyaha wahuwa muminun faolaika kana saAAyuhum mashkooran

t: To each [category] We extend - to these and to those - from the gift of your Lord. And never has the gift of your Lord been restricted.
tr: Kullan numiddu haolai wahaolai min AAatai rabbika wama kana AAatao rabbika mahthooran

t: Look how We have favoured [in provision] some of them over others. But the Hereafter is greater in degrees [of difference] and greater in distinction.
tr: Onthur kayfa faddalna baAAdahum AAala baAAdin walalakhiratu akbaru darajatin waakbaru tafdeelan

t: Do not make [as equal] with God another deity and [thereby] become censured and forsaken.
tr: La tajAAal maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fataqAAuda mathmooman makhthoolan

t: And your Lord has decreed that you not worship except Him, and to parents the best [treatment]. Whether one or both of them reach old age [while] with you, say not to them [so much as], “uff,” and do not repel them but speak to them a noble word.
tr: Waqada rabbuka alla taAAbudoo illa iyyahu wabialwalidayni ihsanan imma yablughanna AAindaka alkibara ahaduhuma aw kilahuma fala taqul lahuma offin wala tanharhuma waqul lahuma qawlan kareeman

t: And lower to them the wing of humility out of mercy and say, “My Lord, have mercy upon them as they brought me up [when I was] small.”
tr: Waikhfid lahuma janaha alththulli mina alrrahmati waqul rabbi irhamhuma kama rabbayanee sagheeran

t: Your Lord is most knowing of what is within yourselves. If you should be righteous [in intention] - then indeed He is ever, to the often returning [to Him], Forgiving.
tr: Rabbukum aAAlamu bima fee nufoosikum in takoonoo saliheena fainnahu kana lilawwabeena ghafooran

t: And give the relative his right, and [also] the poor and the traveller, and do not spend wastefully.
tr: Waati tha alqurba haqqahu waalmiskeena waibna alssabeeli wala tubaththir tabtheeran

t: Indeed, the wasteful are brothers of the devils, and ever has Satan been to his Lord ungrateful.
tr: Inna almubaththireena kanoo ikhwana alshshayateeni wakana alshshaytanu lirabbihi kafooran

t: And if you [must] turn away from them [i.e., the needy] awaiting mercy from your Lord which you expect, then speak to them a gentle word.
tr: Waimma tuAAridanna AAanhumu ibtighaa rahmatin min rabbika tarjooha faqul lahum qawlan maysooran

t: And do not make your hand [as] chained to your neck or extend it completely and [thereby] become blamed and insolvent.
tr: Wala tajAAal yadaka maghloolatan ila AAunuqika wala tabsutha kulla albasti fataqAAuda malooman mahsooran

t: Indeed, your Lord extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.
tr: Inna rabbaka yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru innahu kana biAAibadihi khabeeran baseeran

t: And do not kill your children for fear of poverty. We provide for them and for you. Indeed, their killing is ever a great sin.
tr: Wala taqtuloo awladakum khashyata imlaqin nahnu narzuquhum waiyyakum inna qatlahum kana khitan kabeeran

t: And do not go near unlawful sexual intercourse. Indeed, it is ever an immorality and is evil as a way.
tr: Wala taqraboo alzzina innahu kana fahishatan wasaa sabeelan

t: And do not kill the soul [i.e., person] which God has forbidden, except by right. And whoever is killed unjustly - We have given his heir authority, but let him not exceed limits in [the matter of] taking life. Indeed, he has been supported [by the law].
tr: Wala taqtuloo alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi waman qutila mathlooman faqad jaAAalna liwaliyyihi sultanan fala yusrif fee alqatli innahu kana mansooran

t: And do not go near the wealth of an orphan, except in the way that is best, until he reaches maturity. And fulfill [every] commitment. Indeed, the commitment is ever [that about which one will be] questioned.
tr: Wala taqraboo mala alyateemi illa biallatee hiya ahsanu hatta yablugha ashuddahu waawfoo bialAAahdi inna alAAahda kana masoolan

t: And give full measure when you measure, and weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance. That is the best [way] and best in result.
tr: Waawfoo alkayla itha kiltum wazinoo bialqistasi almustaqeemi thalika khayrun waahsanu taweelan

t: And do not pursue that of which you have no knowledge. Indeed, the hearing, the sight and the heart - about all those [one] will be questioned.
tr: Wala taqfu ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun inna alssamAAa waalbasara waalfuada kullu olaika kana AAanhu masoolan

t: And do not walk upon the earth exultantly. Indeed, you will never tear the earth [apart], and you will never reach the mountains in height.
tr: Wala tamshi fee alardi marahan innaka lan takhriqa alarda walan tablugha aljibala toolan

t: All that [i.e., the aforementioned] - its evil is ever, in the sight of your Lord, detested.
tr: Kullu thalika kana sayyiohu AAinda rabbika makroohan

t: That is from what your Lord has revealed to you, [O Muhammad], of wisdom. And, [O mankind], do not make [as equal] with God another deity, lest you be thrown into Hell, blamed and banished.
tr: Thalika mimma awha ilayka rabbuka mina alhikmati wala tajAAal maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatulqa fee jahannama malooman madhooran

t: Then, has your Lord chosen you for [having] sons and taken [i.e., adopted] from among the angels daughters? Indeed, you say a grave saying.
tr: Afaasfakum rabbukum bialbaneena waittakhatha mina almalaikati inathan innakum lataqooloona qawlan AAatheeman

t: And We have certainly diversified [the contents] in this Qur’ān that they [i.e., mankind] may be reminded, but it does not increase them [i.e., the disbelievers] except in aversion.
tr: Walaqad sarrafna fee hatha alqurani liyaththakkaroo wama yazeeduhum illa nufooran

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “If there had been with Him [other] gods, as they say, then they [each] would have sought to the Owner of the Throne a way.”
tr: Qul law kana maAAahu alihatun kama yaqooloona ithan laibtaghaw ila thee alAAarshi sabeelan

t: Exalted is He and high above what they say by great sublimity.
tr: Subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yaqooloona AAuluwwan kabeeran

t: The seven heavens and the earth and whatever is in them exalt Him. And there is not a thing except that it exalts [God] by His praise, but you do not understand their [way of] exalting. Indeed, He is ever Forbearing and Forgiving.
tr: Tusabbihu lahu alssamawatu alssabAAu waalardu waman feehinna wain min shayin illa yusabbihu bihamdihi walakin la tafqahoona tasbeehahum innahu kana haleeman ghafooran

t: And when you recite the Qur’ān, We put between you and those who do not believe in the Hereafter a concealed partition.
tr: Waitha qarata alqurana jaAAalna baynaka wabayna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati hijaban mastooran

t: And We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And when you mention your Lord alone in the Qur’ān, they turn back in aversion.
tr: WajaAAalna AAala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran waitha thakarta rabbaka fee alqurani wahdahu wallaw AAala adbarihim nufooran

t: We are most knowing of how they listen to it when they listen to you and [of] when they are in private conversation, when the wrongdoers say, “You follow not but a man affected by magic.”
tr: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yastamiAAoona bihi ith yastamiAAoona ilayka waith hum najwa ith yaqoolu alththalimoona in tattabiAAoona illa rajulan mashooran

t: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
tr: Onthur kayfa daraboo laka alamthala fadalloo fala yastateeAAoona sabeelan

t: And they say, “When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected as a new creation?”
tr: Waqaloo aitha kunna AAithaman warufatan ainna lamabAAoothoona khalqan jadeedan

t: Say, “Be you stones or iron
tr: Qul koonoo hijaratan aw hadeedan

t: Or [any] creation of that which is great within your breasts.” And they will say, “Who will restore us?” Say, “He who brought you forth the first time.” Then they will nod their heads toward you and say, “When is that?” Say, “Perhaps it will be soon -
tr: Aw khalqan mimma yakburu fee sudoorikum fasayaqooloona man yuAAeeduna quli allathee fatarakum awwala marratin fasayunghidoona ilayka ruoosahum wayaqooloona mata huwa qul AAasa an yakoona qareeban

t: On the Day He will call you and you will respond with praise of Him and think that you had not remained [in the world] except for a little.”
tr: Yawma yadAAookum fatastajeeboona bihamdihi watathunnoona in labithtum illa qaleelan

t: And tell My servants to say that which is best. Indeed, Satan induces [dissension] among them. Indeed Satan is ever, to the human being, a clear enemy.
