tr: Waqul liAAibadee yaqooloo allatee hiya ahsanu inna alshshaytana yanzaghu baynahum inna alshshaytana kana lilinsani AAaduwwan mubeenan

t: Your Lord is most knowing of you. If He wills, He will have mercy upon you; or if He wills, He will punish you. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], to be responsible over them.
tr: Rabbukum aAAlamu bikum in yasha yarhamkum aw in yasha yuAAaththibkum wama arsalnaka AAalayhim wakeelan

t: And your Lord is most knowing of whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And We have made some of the prophets exceed others [in various ways], and to David We gave the Book.
tr: Warabbuka aAAlamu biman fee alssamawati waalardi walaqad faddalna baAAda alnnabiyyeena AAala baAAdin waatayna dawooda zabooran

t: Say, “Invoke those you have claimed [as gods] besides Him, for they do not possess the [ability for] removal of adversity from you or [for its] transfer [to someone else].”
tr: Quli odAAu allatheena zaAAamtum min doonihi fala yamlikoona kashfa alddurri AAankum wala tahweelan

t: Those whom they invoke seek means of access to their Lord, [striving as to] which of them would be nearest, and they hope for His mercy and fear His punishment. Indeed, the punishment of your Lord is ever feared.
tr: Olaika allatheena yadAAoona yabtaghoona ila rabbihimu alwaseelata ayyuhum aqrabu wayarjoona rahmatahu wayakhafoona AAathabahu inna AAathaba rabbika kana mahthooran

t: And there is no city but that We will destroy it before the Day of Resurrection or punish it with a severe punishment. That has ever been in the Register inscribed.
tr: Wain min qaryatin illa nahnu muhlikooha qabla yawmi alqiyamati aw muAAaththibooha AAathaban shadeedan kana thalika fee alkitabi mastooran

t: And nothing has prevented Us from sending signs [i.e., miracles] except that the former peoples denied them. And We gave Thamūd the she-camel as a visible sign, but they wronged her. And We send not the signs except as a warning.
tr: Wama manaAAana an nursila bialayati illa an kaththaba biha alawwaloona waatayna thamooda alnnaqata mubsiratan fathalamoo biha wama nursilu bialayati illa takhweefan

t: And [remember, O Muhammad], when We told you, “Indeed, your Lord has encompassed the people.” And We did not make the sight which We showed you except as a trial for the people, as was the accursed tree [mentioned] in the Qur’ān. And We threaten [i.e., warn] them, but it increases them not except in great transgression.
tr: Waith qulna laka inna rabbaka ahata bialnnasi wama jaAAalna alrruya allatee araynaka illa fitnatan lilnnasi waalshshajarata almalAAoonata fee alqurani wanukhawwifuhum fama yazeeduhum illa tughyanan kabeeran

t: And [mention] when We said to the angles, “Prostrate to Adam,” and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He said, “Should I prostrate to one You created from clay?”
tr: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa qala aasjudu liman khalaqta teenan

t: [Iblees] said, “Do You see this one whom You have honoured above me? If You delay me [i.e., my death] until the Day of Resurrection, I will surely destroy his descendants, except for a few.”
tr: Qala araaytaka hatha allathee karramta AAalayya lain akhkhartani ila yawmi alqiyamati laahtanikanna thurriyyatahu illa qaleelan

t: [God] said, “Go, for whoever of them follows you, indeed Hell will be the recompense of [all of] you - an ample recompense.
tr: Qala ithhab faman tabiAAaka minhum fainna jahannama jazaokum jazaan mawfooran

t: And incite whoever you can among them with your voice and assault them with your horses and foot soldiers and become a partner in their wealth and their children and promise them.” But Satan does not promise them except delusion.
tr: Waistafziz mani istataAAta minhum bisawtika waajlib AAalayhim bikhaylika warajlika washarikhum fee alamwali waalawladi waAAidhum wama yaAAiduhumu alshshaytanu illa ghurooran

t: Indeed, over My servants there is for you no authority. And sufficient is your Lord as Disposer of affairs.
tr: Inna AAibadee laysa laka AAalayhim sultanun wakafa birabbika wakeelan

t: It is your Lord who drives the ship for you through the sea that you may seek of His bounty. Indeed, He is ever, to you, Merciful.
tr: Rabbukumu allathee yuzjee lakumu alfulka fee albahri litabtaghoo min fadlihi innahu kana bikum raheeman

t: And when adversity touches you at sea, lost are [all] those you invoke except for Him. But when He delivers you to the land, you turn away [from Him]. And ever is the human being ungrateful.
tr: Waitha massakumu alddurru fee albahri dalla man tadAAoona illa iyyahu falamma najjakum ila albarri aAAradtum wakana alinsanu kafooran

t: Then do you feel secure that [instead] He will not cause a part of the land to swallow you or send against you a storm of stones? Then you would not find for yourselves an advocate.
tr: Afaamintum an yakhsifa bikum janiba albarri aw yursila AAalaykum hasiban thumma la tajidoo lakum wakeelan

t: Or do you feel secure that He will not send you back into it [i.e., the sea] another time and send upon you a hurricane of wind and drown you for what you denied? Then you would not find for yourselves against Us an avenger.
tr: Am amintum an yuAAeedakum feehi taratan okhra fayursila AAalaykum qasifan mina alrreehi fayughriqakum bima kafartum thumma la tajidoo lakum AAalayna bihi tabeeAAan

t: And We have certainly honoured the children of Adam and carried them on the land and sea and provided for them of the good things and preferred them over much of what We have created, with [definite] preference.
tr: Walaqad karramna banee adama wahamalnahum fee albarri waalbahri warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum AAala katheerin mimman khalaqna tafdeelan

t: [Mention, O Muhammad], the Day We will call forth every people with their record [of deeds]. Then whoever is given his record in his right hand - those will read their records, and injustice will not be done to them, [even] as much as a thread [inside the date seed].
tr: Yawma nadAAoo kulla onasin biimamihim faman ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi faolaika yaqraoona kitabahum wala yuthlamoona fateelan

t: And whoever is blind in this [life] will be blind in the Hereafter and more astray from the path.
tr: Waman kana fee hathihi aAAma fahuwa fee alakhirati aAAma waadallu sabeelan

t: And indeed, they were about to tempt you away from that which We revealed to you in order to [make] you invent about Us something else; and then they would have taken you as a friend.
tr: Wain kadoo layaftinoonaka AAani allathee awhayna ilayka litaftariya AAalayna ghayrahu waithan laittakhathooka khaleelan

t: And if We had not strengthened you, you would have almost inclined to them a little.
tr: Walawla an thabbatnaka laqad kidta tarkanu ilayhim shayan qaleelan

t: Then [if you had], We would have made you taste double [punishment in] life and double [after] death. Then you would not find for yourself against Us a helper.
tr: Ithan laathaqnaka diAAfa alhayati wadiAAfa almamati thumma la tajidu laka AAalayna naseeran

t: And indeed, they were about to provoke [i.e., drive] you from the land [i.e., Makkah] to evict you therefrom. And then [when they do], they will not remain [there] after you, except for a little.
tr: Wain kadoo layastafizzoonaka mina alardi liyukhrijooka minha waithan la yalbathoona khilafaka illa qaleelan

t: [That is Our] established way for those We had sent before you of Our messengers; and you will not find in Our way any alteration.
tr: Sunnata man qad arsalna qablaka min rusulina wala tajidu lisunnatina tahweelan

t: Establish prayer at the decline of the sun [from its meridian] until the darkness of the night and [also] the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] of dawn. Indeed, the recitation of dawn is ever witnessed.
tr: Aqimi alssalata lidulooki alshshamsi ila ghasaqi allayli waqurana alfajri inna qurana alfajri kana mashhoodan

t: And from [part of] the night, pray with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān] as additional [worship] for you; it is expected that your Lord will resurrect you to a praised station.
tr: Wamina allayli fatahajjad bihi nafilatan laka AAasa an yabAAathaka rabbuka maqaman mahmoodan

t: And say, “My Lord, cause me to enter a sound entrance and to exit a sound exit and grant me from Yourself a supporting authority.”
tr: Waqul rabbi adkhilnee mudkhala sidqin waakhrijnee mukhraja sidqin waijAAal lee min ladunka sultanan naseeran

t: And say, “Truth has come, and falsehood has departed. Indeed is falsehood, [by nature], ever bound to depart.”
tr: Waqul jaa alhaqqu wazahaqa albatilu inna albatila kana zahooqan

t: And We send down of the Qur’ān that which is healing and mercy for the Believers, but it does not increase the wrongdoers except in loss.
tr: Wanunazzilu mina alqurani ma huwa shifaon warahmatun lilmumineena wala yazeedu alththalimeena illa khasaran

t: And when We bestow favour upon the human being, he turns away and distances himself; and when evil touches him, he is ever despairing.
tr: Waitha anAAamna AAala alinsani aAArada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu alshsharru kana yaoosan

t: Say, “Each works according to his manner, but your Lord is most knowing of who is best guided in way.”
tr: Qul kullun yaAAmalu AAala shakilatihi farabbukum aAAlamu biman huwa ahda sabeelan

t: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about the soul. Say, “The soul is of the affair [i.e., concern] of my Lord. And you [i.e., mankind] have not been given of knowledge except a little.”
tr: Wayasaloonaka AAani alrroohi quli alrroohu min amri rabbee wama ooteetum mina alAAilmi illa qaleelan

t: And if We willed, We could surely do away with that which We revealed to you. Then you would not find for yourself concerning it an advocate against Us.
tr: Walain shina lanathhabanna biallathee awhayna ilayka thumma la tajidu laka bihi AAalayna wakeelan

t: Except [We have left it with you] as a mercy from your Lord. Indeed, His favour upon you has ever been great.
tr: Illa rahmatan min rabbika inna fadlahu kana AAalayka kabeeran

t: Say, “If mankind and the jinn gathered in order to produce the like of this Qur’ān, they could not produce the like of it, even if they were to each other assistants.”
tr: Qul laini ijtamaAAati alinsu waaljinnu AAala an yatoo bimithli hatha alqurani la yatoona bimithlihi walaw kana baAAduhum libaAAdin thaheeran

t: And We have certainly diversified for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example, but most of the people refused [anything] except disbelief.
tr: Walaqad sarrafna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran

t: And they say, “We will not believe you until you break open for us from the ground a spring
tr: Waqaloo lan numina laka hatta tafjura lana mina alardi yanbooAAan

t: Or [until] you have a garden of palm trees and grapes and make rivers gush forth within them in force [and abundance]
tr: Aw takoona laka jannatun min nakheelin waAAinabin fatufajjira alanhara khilalaha tafjeeran

t: Or you make the heaven fall upon us in fragments as you have claimed or you bring God and the angels before [us]
tr: Aw tusqita alssamaa kama zaAAamta AAalayna kisafan aw tatiya biAllahi waalmalaikati qabeelan

t: Or you have a house of ornament [i.e., gold] or you ascend into the sky. And [even then], we will not believe in your ascension until you bring down to us a book we may read.” Say, “Exalted is my Lord! Was I ever but a human messenger?”
tr: Aw yakoona laka baytun min zukhrufin aw tarqa fee alssamai walan numina liruqiyyika hatta tunazzila AAalayna kitaban naqraohu qul subhana rabbee hal kuntu illa basharan rasoolan

t: And what prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them except that they said, “Has God sent a human messenger?”
tr: Wama manaAAa alnnasa an yuminoo ith jaahumu alhuda illa an qaloo abaAAatha Allahu basharan rasoolan

t: Say, “If there were upon the earth angels walking securely, We would have sent down to them from the heaven an angel [as a] messenger.”
tr: Qul law kana fee alardi malaikatun yamshoona mutmainneena lanazzalna AAalayhim mina alssamai malakan rasoolan

t: Say, “Sufficient is God as Witness between me and you. Indeed he is ever, concerning His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.”
tr: Qul kafa biAllahi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum innahu kana biAAibadihi khabeeran baseeran

t: And whoever God guides - he is the [rightly] guided; and whoever He sends astray - you will never find for them protectors besides Him, and We will gather them on the Day of Resurrection [fallen] on their faces - blind, dumb and deaf. Their refuge is Hell; every time it subsides We increase them in blazing fire.
tr: Waman yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadi waman yudlil falan tajida lahum awliyaa min doonihi wanahshuruhum yawma alqiyamati AAala wujoohihim AAumyan wabukman wasumman mawahum jahannamu kullama khabat zidnahum saAAeeran

t: That is their recompense because they disbelieved in Our verses and said, “When we are bones and crumbled particles, will we [truly] be resurrected [in] a new creation?”
tr: Thalika jazaohum biannahum kafaroo biayatina waqaloo aitha kunna AAithaman warufatan ainna lamabAAoothoona khalqan jadeedan

t: Do they not see that God, who created the heavens and earth, is [the one] Able to create the likes of them? And He has appointed for them a term, about which there is no doubt. But the wrongdoers refuse [anything] except disbelief.
tr: Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda qadirun AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum wajaAAala lahum ajalan la rayba feehi faaba alththalimoona illa kufooran

t: Say [to them], “If you possessed the depositories of the mercy of my Lord, then you would withhold out of fear of spending.” And ever has the human being been stingy.
tr: Qul law antum tamlikoona khazaina rahmati rabbee ithan laamsaktum khashyata alinfaqi wakana alinsanu qatooran

t: And We had certainly given Moses nine evident signs, so ask the Children of Israel [about] when he came to them and Pharaoh said to him, “Indeed I think, O Moses, that you are affected by magic.”
tr: Walaqad atayna moosa tisAAa ayatin bayyinatin faisal banee israeela ith jaahum faqala lahu firAAawnu innee laathunnuka ya moosa mashooran

t: [Moses] said, “You have already known that none has sent down these [signs] except the Lord of the heavens and the earth as evidence, and indeed I think, O Pharaoh, that you are destroyed.”
tr: Qala laqad AAalimta ma anzala haolai illa rabbu alssamawati waalardi basaira wainnee laathunnuka ya firAAawnu mathbooran

t: So he intended to drive them from the land, but We drowned him and those with him all together.
tr: Faarada an yastafizzahum mina alardi faaghraqnahu waman maAAahu jameeAAan

t: And We said after him [i.e., Pharaoh] to the Children of Israel, “Dwell in the land, and when there comes the promise [i.e., appointment] of the Hereafter, We will bring you forth in [one] gathering.”
tr: Waqulna min baAAdihi libanee israeela oskunoo alarda faitha jaa waAAdu alakhirati jina bikum lafeefan

t: And with the truth We have sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down, and with the truth it has descended. And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
tr: Wabialhaqqi anzalnahu wabialhaqqi nazala wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran

t: And [it is] a Qur’ān which We have separated [by intervals] that you might recite it to the people over a prolonged period. And We have sent it down progressively.
tr: Waquranan faraqnahu litaqraahu AAala alnnasi AAala mukthin wanazzalnahu tanzeelan

t: Say, “Believe in it or do not believe. Indeed, those who were given knowledge before it - when it is recited to them, they fall upon their faces in prostration,
tr: Qul aminoo bihi aw la tuminoo inna allatheena ootoo alAAilma min qablihi itha yutla AAalayhim yakhirroona lilathqani sujjadan

t: And they say, “Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, the promise of our Lord has been fulfilled.”
tr: Wayaqooloona subhana rabbina in kana waAAdu rabbina lamafAAoolan

t: And they fall upon their faces weeping, and it [i.e., the Qur’ān] increases them in humble submission.
tr: Wayakhirroona lilathqani yabkoona wayazeeduhum khushooAAan

t: Say, “Call upon God or call upon the Most Merciful. [al-Rahmān]. Whichever [name] you call - to Him belong the best names.” And do not recite [too] loudly in your prayer or [too] quietly but seek between that an [intermediate] way.
tr: Quli odAAoo Allaha awi odAAoo alrrahmana ayyan ma tadAAoo falahu alasmao alhusna wala tajhar bisalatika wala tukhafit biha waibtaghi bayna thalika sabeelan

t: And say, “Praise to God, who has not taken a son and has had no partner in [His] dominion and has no [need of a] protector out of weakness; and glorify Him with [great] glorification.”
tr: Waquli alhamdu lillahi allathee lam yattakhith waladan walam yakun lahu shareekun fee almulki walam yakun lahu waliyyun mina alththulli wakabbirhu takbeeran

t: Who were ‘The Sleepers of the Cave?’
tr: Alhamdu lillahi allathee anzala AAala AAabdihi alkitaba walam yajAAal lahu AAiwajan

t: What is the real story of Khidr? 3. What do you know about Dhul-Qarnain? These three questions and their stories related to the history of the Christians and the Jews and were unknown in the Arabian Peninsula (Hijaz), so they were being used to test the divine knowledge revealed to the Prophet. However, God informed the Prophet of the complete answer to these questions and also employed the stories in the conflict between Islām and unbelief. The questioners were told that the ‘Sleepers of the Cave’ believed in the same doctrine of Monotheism (Tawhid) which was being put forward in the Qur’ān and that their condition was similar to that of the persecuted Muslims of Makkah. Also, the persecutors of the Sleepers of the Cave behaved in the same way as the disbelievers of Quraysh towards the Muslims. This particular story was a warning to the chiefs of Makkah, who were persecuting the small newly formed Muslim community. Additionally, the Prophet was instructed not to compromise with the persecutors nor consider the chiefs to be more important than his own followers. Likewise, the chiefs too were admonished and informed not to be distracted by the temporary life of this world but seek the eternal life of the hereafter. In the Name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful 1. All praise be to God, who has sent down upon His Servant [Muhammad] the Book and has not made therein any deviance. 2. [He has made it] straight, to warn of severe punishment from Him and to give good tidings to the Believers who do righteous deeds that they will have a good reward [i.e., Paradise]
tr: Qayyiman liyunthira basan shadeedan min ladunhu wayubashshira almumineena allatheena yaAAmaloona alssalihati anna lahum ajran hasanan

t: In which they will remain forever
tr: Makitheena feehi abadan

t: And to warn those who say, “God has taken a son.”
tr: Wayunthira allatheena qaloo ittakhatha Allahu waladan

t: They have no knowledge of it, nor had their fathers. Grave is the word that comes out of their mouths; what they say is nothing but lies.
tr: Ma lahum bihi min AAilmin wala liabaihim kaburat kalimatan takhruju min afwahihim in yaqooloona illa kathiban

t: Then perhaps you are going to worry yourself to death over them, [O Muhammad], if they do not believe in this message.
tr: FalaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka AAala atharihim in lam yuminoo bihatha alhadeethi asafan

t: Indeed, We have made that which is on the earth adornment for it that We may test them [as to] which of them is best in deed.
tr: Inna jaAAalna ma AAala alardi zeenatan laha linabluwahum ayyuhum ahsanu AAamalan

t: And indeed, We will make that which is upon it [into] a barren ground.
tr: Wainna lajaAAiloona ma AAalayha saAAeedan juruzan

t: Or have you thought that the companions of the cave and the inscription were, among Our signs, a wonder?
tr: Am hasibta anna ashaba alkahfi waalrraqeemi kanoo min ayatina AAajaban

t: [Mention] when the youths retreated to the cave and said, “Our Lord, grant us from Yourself mercy and prepare for us from our affair right guidance.”
tr: Ith awa alfityatu ila alkahfi faqaloo rabbana atina min ladunka rahmatan wahayyi lana min amrina rashadan

t: So We cast [a cover of sleep] over their ears within the cave for a number of years.
tr: Fadarabna AAala athanihim fee alkahfi sineena AAadadan

t: Then We awakened them that We might show which of the two factions was most precise in calculating what [extent] they had remained in time.
tr: Thumma baAAathnahum linaAAlama ayyu alhizbayni ahsa lima labithoo amadan

t: It is We who relate to you, [O Muhammad], their story in truth. Indeed, they were youths who believed in their Lord, and We increased them in guidance.
tr: Nahnu naqussu AAalayka nabaahum bialhaqqi innahum fityatun amanoo birabbihim wazidnahum hudan

t: And We bound [i.e., made firm] their hearts when they stood up and said, “Our Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth. Never will we invoke besides Him any deity. We would have certainly spoken, then, an excessive transgression.
tr: Warabatna AAala quloobihim ith qamoo faqaloo rabbuna rabbu alssamawati waalardi lan nadAAuwa min doonihi ilahan laqad qulna ithan shatatan

t: These, our people, have taken besides Him deities. Why do they not bring for [worship of] them a clear authority? And who is more unjust than one who invents about God a lie?”
tr: Haolai qawmuna ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan lawla yatoona AAalayhim bisultanin bayyinin faman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban

t: [The youths said to one another], “And when you have withdrawn from them and that which they worship other than God, retreat to the cave. Your Lord will spread out for you of His mercy and will prepare for you from your affair facility.”
tr: Waithi iAAtazaltumoohum wama yaAAbudoona illa Allaha fawoo ila alkahfi yanshur lakum rabbukum min rahmatihi wayuhayyi lakum min amrikum mirfaqan

t: And [had you been present], you would see the sun when it rose, inclining away from their cave on the right, and when it set, passing away from them on the left, while they were [laying] within an open space thereof. That was from the signs of God. He whom God guides is the [rightly] guided, but he whom He leaves astray - never will you find for him a protecting guide.
tr: Watara alshshamsa itha talaAAat tazawaru AAan kahfihim thata alyameeni waitha gharabat taqriduhum thata alshshimali wahum fee fajwatin minhu thalika min ayati Allahi man yahdi Allahu fahuwa almuhtadi waman yudlil falan tajida lahu waliyyan murshidan

t: And you would think them awake, while they were asleep. And We turned them to the right and to the left, while their dog stretched his forelegs at the entrance. If you had looked at them, you would have turned from them in flight and been filled by them with terror.
tr: Watahsabuhum ayqathan wahum ruqoodun wanuqallibuhum thata alyameeni wathata alshshimali wakalbuhum basitun thiraAAayhi bialwaseedi lawi ittalaAAta AAalayhim lawallayta minhum firaran walamulita minhum ruAAban

t: And similarly, We awakened them that they might question one another. Said a speaker from among them, “How long have you remained [here]?” They said, “We have remained a day or part of a day.” They said, “Your Lord is most knowing of how long you remained. So send one of you with this silver coin of yours to the city and let him look to which is the best of food and bring you provision from it and let him be cautious. And let no one be aware of you.
tr: Wakathalika baAAathnahum liyatasaaloo baynahum qala qailun minhum kam labithtum qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin qaloo rabbukum aAAlamu bima labithtum faibAAathoo ahadakum biwariqikum hathihi ila almadeenati falyanthur ayyuha azka taAAaman falyatikum birizqin minhu walyatalattaf wala yushAAiranna bikum ahadan

t: Indeed, if they come to know of you, they will stone you or return you to their religion. And never would you succeed, then - ever.”
tr: Innahum in yathharoo AAalaykum yarjumookum aw yuAAeedookum fee millatihim walan tuflihoo ithan abadan

t: And similarly, We caused them to be found that they [who found them] would know that the promise of God is true and that of the Hour there is no doubt. [That was] when they disputed among themselves about their affair and [then] said, “Construct over them a structure. Their Lord is most knowing about them.” Said those who prevailed in the matter, “We will surely take [for ourselves] over them a masjid.”
tr: Wakathalika aAAtharna AAalayhim liyaAAlamoo anna waAAda Allahi haqqun waanna alsaAAata la rayba feeha ith yatanazaAAoona baynahum amrahum faqaloo ibnoo AAalayhim bunyanan rabbuhum aAAlamu bihim qala allatheena ghalaboo AAala amrihim lanattakhithanna AAalayhim masjidan

t: They [i.e., people] will say there were three, the fourth of them being their dog; and they will say there were five, the sixth of them being their dog - guessing at the unseen; and they will say there were seven, and the eighth of them was their dog. Say, [O Muhammad], “My Lord is most knowing of their number. None knows them except a few. So do not argue about them except with an obvious argument and do not inquire about them among [the speculators] from anyone.”
tr: Sayaqooloona thalathatun rabiAAuhum kalbuhum wayaqooloona khamsatun sadisuhum kalbuhum rajman bialghaybi wayaqooloona sabAAatun wathaminuhum kalbuhum qul rabbee aAAlamu biAAiddatihim ma yaAAlamuhum illa qaleelun fala tumari feehim illa miraan thahiran wala tastafti feehim minhum ahadan

t: And never say of anything, “Indeed, I will do that tomorrow,”
tr: Wala taqoolanna lishayin innee faAAilun thalika ghadan

t: Except [when adding], “If God wills.” And remember your Lord when you forget [it] and say, “Perhaps my Lord will guide me to what is nearer than this to right conduct.”
tr: Illa an yashaa Allahu waothkur rabbaka itha naseeta waqul AAasa an yahdiyani rabbee liaqraba min hatha rashadan

t: And they remained in their cave for three hundred years and exceeded by nine.
tr: Walabithoo fee kahfihim thalatha miatin sineena waizdadoo tisAAan

t: Say, “God is most knowing of how long they remained. He has [knowledge of] the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. How Seeing is He and how Hearing! They have not besides Him any protector, and He does not allow anyone to share His rule.”
tr: Quli Allahu aAAlamu bima labithoo lahu ghaybu alssamawati waalardi absir bihi waasmiAA ma lahum min doonihi min waliyyin wala yushriku fee hukmihi ahadan

t: And recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book of your Lord. There is no changer of His words, and never will you find in other than Him a refuge.
tr: Waotlu ma oohiya ilayka min kitabi rabbika la mubaddila likalimatihi walan tajida min doonihi multahadan

t: And keep yourself patient [by being] with those who call upon their Lord in the morning and the evening, seeking His countenance. And let not your eyes pass beyond them, desiring adornments of the worldly life, and do not obey one whose heart We have made heedless of Our remembrance and who follows his desire and whose affair has transgressed all bounds.
tr: Waisbir nafsaka maAAa allatheena yadAAoona rabbahum bialghadati waalAAashiyyi yureedoona wajhahu wala taAAdu AAaynaka AAanhum tureedu zeenata alhayati alddunya wala tutiAA man aghfalna qalbahu AAan thikrina waittabaAAa hawahu wakana amruhu furutan

t: And say, “The truth is from your Lord, so whoever wills - let him believe; and whoever wills - let him disbelieve.” Indeed, We have prepared for the wrongdoers a fire whose walls will surround them. And if they call for relief, they will be relieved with water like murky oil, which scalds [their] faces. Wretched is the drink, and evil is the resting place.
tr: Waquli alhaqqu min rabbikum faman shaa falyumin waman shaa falyakfur inna aAAtadna lilththalimeena naran ahata bihim suradiquha wain yastagheethoo yughathoo bimain kaalmuhli yashwee alwujooha bisa alshsharabu wasaat murtafaqan

t: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - indeed, We will not allow to be lost the reward of any who was excellent in deeds.
tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati inna la nudeeAAu ajra man ahsana AAamalan

t: Those will have gardens of perpetual residence; beneath them rivers will flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and will wear green garments of fine silk and brocade, reclining therein on adorned couches. Excellent is the reward, and good is the resting place.
tr: Olaika lahum jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtihimu alanharu yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin wayalbasoona thiyaban khudran min sundusin waistabraqin muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki niAAma alththawabu wahasunat murtafaqan

t: And present to them an example of two men: We granted to one of them two gardens of grapevines, and We bordered them with palm trees and placed between them [fields of] crops.
tr: Waidrib lahum mathalan rajulayni jaAAalna liahadihima jannatayni min aAAnabin wahafafnahuma binakhlin wajaAAalna baynahuma zarAAan

t: Each of the two gardens produced its fruit and did not fall short thereof in anything. And We caused to gush forth within them a river.
tr: Kilta aljannatayni atat okulaha walam tathlim minhu shayan wafajjarna khilalahuma naharan

t: And he had fruit, so he said to his companion while he was conversing with him, “I am greater than you in wealth and mightier in [numbers of] men.”
tr: Wakana lahu thamarun faqala lisahibihi wahuwa yuhawiruhu ana aktharu minka malan waaAAazzu nafaran

t: And he entered his garden while he was unjust to himself. He said, “I do not think that this will perish - ever.
tr: Wadakhala jannatahu wahuwa thalimun linafsihi qala ma athunnu an tabeeda hathihi abadan

t: And I do not think the Hour will occur. And even if I should be brought back to my Lord, I will surely find better than this as a return.”
tr: Wama athunnu alssaAAata qaimatan walain rudidtu ila rabbee laajidanna khayran minha munqalaban

t: His companion said to him while he was conversing with him, “Have you disbelieved in He who created you from dust and then from a sperm-drop and then proportioned you [as] a man?
tr: Qala lahu sahibuhu wahuwa yuhawiruhu akafarta biallathee khalaqaka min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma sawwaka rajulan

t: But as for me, He is God, my Lord, and I do not associate with my Lord anyone.
tr: Lakinna huwa Allahu rabbee wala oshriku birabbee ahadan

t: And why did you, when you entered your garden, not say, ‘What God willed [has occurred]; there is no power except in God’? Although you see me less than you in wealth and children,
tr: Walawla ith dakhalta jannataka qulta ma shaa Allahu la quwwata illa biAllahi in tarani ana aqalla minka malan wawaladan

t: It may be that my Lord will give me [something] better than your garden and will send upon it a calamity from the sky, and it will become a smooth, dusty ground,
tr: FaAAasa rabbee an yutiyani khayran min jannatika wayursila AAalayha husbanan mina alssamai fatusbiha saAAeedan zalaqan

t: Or its water will become sunken [into the earth], so you would never be able to seek it.”
tr: Aw yusbiha maoha ghawran falan tastateeAAa lahu talaban

t: And his fruits were encompassed [by ruin], so he began to turn his hands about [in dismay] over what he had spent on it, while it had collapsed upon its trellises, and said, “Oh, I wish I had not associated with my Lord anyone.”
tr: Waoheeta bithamarihi faasbaha yuqallibu kaffayhi AAala ma anfaqa feeha wahiya khawiyatun AAala AAurooshiha wayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oshrik birabbee ahadan

t: And there was for him no company to aid him other than God, nor could he defend himself.
tr: Walam takun lahu fiatun yansuroonahu min dooni Allahi wama kana muntasiran

t: There the authority is [completely] for God, the Truth. He is best in reward and best in outcome.
tr: Hunalika alwalayatu lillahi alhaqqi huwa khayrun thawaban wakhayrun AAuqban

t: And present to them the example of the life of this world, [its being] like rain which We send down from the sky, and the vegetation of the earth mingles with it and [then] it becomes dry remnants, scattered by the winds. And God is ever, over all things, Perfect in Ability.
tr: Waidrib lahum mathala alhayati alddunya kamain anzalnahu mina alssamai faikhtalata bihi nabatu alardi faasbaha hasheeman tathroohu alrriyahu wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin muqtadiran

t: Wealth and children are [but] adornment of the worldly life. But the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for [one’s] hope.
tr: Almalu waalbanoona zeenatu alhayati alddunya waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun amalan

t: And [warn of] the Day when We will remove the mountains and you will see the earth as an open plain, and We will gather them and not leave behind from them anyone.
tr: Wayawma nusayyiru aljibala watara alarda barizatan wahasharnahum falam nughadir minhum ahadan

t: And they will be presented before your Lord in rows, [and He will say], “You have certainly come to Us just as We created you the first time. But you claimed that We would never make for you an appointment.”
tr: WaAAuridoo AAala rabbika saffan laqad jitumoona kama khalaqnakum awwala marratin bal zaAAamtum allan najAAala lakum mawAAidan

t: And the record [of deeds] will be placed [open], and you will see the criminals fearful of that within it, and they will say, “Oh, woe to us! What is this book that leaves nothing small or great except that it has enumerated it?” And they will find what they did present [before them]. And your Lord does injustice to no one.
tr: WawudiAAa alkitabu fatara almujrimeena mushfiqeena mimma feehi wayaqooloona ya waylatana ma lihatha alkitabi la yughadiru sagheeratan wala kabeeratan illa ahsaha wawajadoo ma AAamiloo hadiran wala yathlimu rabbuka ahadan

t: And [mention] when We said to the angels, “Prostrate to Adam,” and they prostrated, except for Iblees. He was of the jinn and departed from [i.e., disobeyed] the command of his Lord. Then will you take him and his descendants as allies other than Me while they are enemies to you? Wretched it is for the wrongdoers as an exchange.
tr: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa kana mina aljinni fafasaqa AAan amri rabbihi afatattakhithoonahu wathurriyyatahu awliyaa min doonee wahum lakum AAaduwwun bisa lilththalimeena badalan

t: I did not make them witness to the creation of the heavens and the earth or to the creation of themselves, and I do not take as My supporters those who lead others astray.
tr: Ma ashhadtuhum khalqa alssamawati waalardi wala khalqa anfusihim wama kuntu muttakhitha almudilleena AAadudan

t: And [warn of] the Day when He will say, “Call ‘My partners’ whom you claimed,” and they will invoke them, but they will not respond to them. And We will put between them [a valley of] destruction.
tr: Wayawma yaqoolu nadoo shurakaiya allatheena zaAAamtum fadaAAawhum falam yastajeeboo lahum wajaAAalna baynahum mawbiqan

t: And the criminals will see the Fire and will be certain that they are to fall therein. And they will not find from it a way elsewhere.
tr: Waraa almujrimoona alnnara fathannoo annahum muwaqiAAooha walam yajidoo AAanha masrifan

t: And We have certainly diversified in this Qur’ān for the people from every [kind of] example; and more than anything else, the human being is the most argumentative.
tr: Walaqad sarrafna fee hatha alqurani lilnnasi min kulli mathalin wakana alinsanu akthara shayin jadalan

t: And nothing has prevented the people from believing when guidance came to them and from asking forgiveness of their Lord except that there [must] befall them the [accustomed] precedent of the former peoples or that the punishment should come [directly] before them.
tr: Wama manaAAa alnnasa an yuminoo ith jaahumu alhuda wayastaghfiroo rabbahum illa an tatiyahum sunnatu alawwaleena aw yatiyahumu alAAathabu qubulan

t: And We send not the messengers except as bringers of good tidings and warners. And those who disbelieve dispute by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth and have taken My verses, and that of which they are warned, in ridicule.
tr: Wama nursilu almursaleena illa mubashshireena wamunthireena wayujadilu allatheena kafaroo bialbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa waittakhathoo ayatee wama onthiroo huzuwan

t: And who is more unjust than one who is reminded of the verses of his Lord but turns away from them and forgets what his hands have put forth? Indeed, We have placed over their hearts coverings, lest they understand it, and in their ears deafness. And if you invite them to guidance - they will never be guided, then - ever.
tr: Waman athlamu mimman thukkira biayati rabbihi faaAArada AAanha wanasiya ma qaddamat yadahu inna jaAAalna AAala quloobihim akinnatan an yafqahoohu wafee athanihim waqran wain tadAAuhum ila alhuda falan yahtadoo ithan abadan

t: And your Lord is the Forgiving, full of mercy. If He were to impose blame upon them for what they earned, He would have hastened for them the punishment. Rather, for them is an appointment from which they will never find an escape.
tr: Warabbuka alghafooru thoo alrrahmati law yuakhithuhum bima kasaboo laAAajjala lahumu alAAathaba bal lahum mawAAidun lan yajidoo min doonihi mawilan

t: And those cities - We destroyed them when they wronged, and We made for their destruction an appointed time.
tr: Watilka alqura ahlaknahum lamma thalamoo wajaAAalna limahlikihim mawAAidan

t: And [mention] when Moses said to his boy [i.e., servant], “I will not cease [traveling] until I reach the junction of the two seas even if it takes me years!”
tr: Waith qala moosa lifatahu la abrahu hatta ablugha majmaAAa albahrayni aw amdiya huquban

t: But when they reached the junction between them, they forgot their fish, and it took its course into the sea, slipping away.
tr: Falamma balagha majmaAAa baynihima nasiya hootahuma faittakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri saraban

t: So when they had passed beyond it, [Moses] said to his boy, “Bring us our morning meal. We have certainly suffered in this, our journey, [much] fatigue.”
tr: Falamma jawaza qala lifatahu atina ghadaana laqad laqeena min safarina hatha nasaban

t: He said, “Do you see when we had taken shelter at the rock? Indeed, I forgot [there] the fish. And none but Satan made me to forget to mention it. And it took its course into the sea amazingly.”
tr: Qala araayta ith awayna ila alssakhrati fainnee naseetu alhoota wama ansaneehu illa alshshaytanu an athkurahu waittakhatha sabeelahu fee albahri AAajaban

t: [Moses] said, “Then that was the place we were looking for.” So the two turned back retracing their footsteps.
tr: Qala thalika ma kunna nabghi fairtadda AAala atharihima qasasan

t: Then they found a servant from among Our servants [i.e., al-Khidhr] to whom We had given mercy from Us and had taught him from Us a [certain] knowledge.
tr: Fawajada AAabdan min AAibadina ataynahu rahmatan min AAindina waAAallamnahu min ladunna AAilman

t: Moses said to him, “May I follow you on [the condition] that you teach me from what you have been taught of sound judgement?”
tr: Qala lahu moosa hal attabiAAuka AAala an tuAAallimani mimma AAullimta rushdan

t: He said, “Indeed, with me you will never be able to have patience.
tr: Qala innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran

t: And how can you have patience for what you do not encompass in knowledge?”
tr: Wakayfa tasbiru AAala ma lam tuhit bihi khubran

t: [Moses] said, “You will find me, if God wills, patient, and I will not disobey you in [any] order.”
tr: Qala satajidunee in shaa Allahu sabiran wala aAAsee laka amran

t: He said, “Then if you follow me, do not ask me about anything until I make to you about it mention [i.e., explanation].”
tr: Qala faini ittabaAAtanee fala tasalnee AAan shayin hatta ohditha laka minhu thikran

t: So they set out, until when they had embarked on the ship, he [i.e., al- Khidhr] tore it open. [Moses] said, “Have you torn it open to drown its people? You have certainly done a grave thing.”
tr: Faintalaqa hatta itha rakiba fee alssafeenati kharaqaha qala akharaqtaha litughriqa ahlaha laqad jita shayan imran

t: [Al-Khidhr] said, “Did I not say that with me you would never be able to have patience?”
tr: Qala alam aqul innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran

t: [Moses] said, “Do not blame me for what I forgot and do not cover me in my matter with difficulty.”
tr: Qala la tuakhithnee bima naseetu wala turhiqnee min amree AAusran

t: So they set out, until when they met a boy, he [i.e., al-Khidhr] killed him. [Moses] said, “Have you killed a pure soul for other than [having killed] a soul? You have certainly done a deplorable thing.”
tr: Faintalaqa hatta itha laqiya ghulaman faqatalahu qala aqatalta nafsan zakiyyatan bighayri nafsin laqad jita shayan nukran

t: [Al-Khidhr] said, “Did I not tell you that with me you would never be able to have patience?”
tr: Qala alam aqul laka innaka lan tastateeAAa maAAiya sabran

t: [Moses] said, “If I should ask you about anything after this, then do not keep me as a companion. You have obtained from me an excuse.”
tr: Qala in saaltuka AAan shayin baAAdaha fala tusahibnee qad balaghta min ladunnee AAuthran

t: So they set out, until when they came to the people of a town, they asked its people for food, but they refused to offer them hospitality. And they found therein a wall about to collapse, so he [i.e., al-Khidhr] restored it. [Moses] said, “If you wished, you could have taken for it a payment.”
tr: Faintalaqa hatta itha ataya ahla qaryatin istatAAama ahlaha faabaw an yudayyifoohuma fawajada feeha jidaran yureedu an yanqadda faaqamahu qala law shita laittakhathta AAalayhi ajran

t: [Al-Khidhr] said, “This is parting between me and you. I will inform you of the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.
tr: Qala hatha firaqu baynee wabaynika saonabbioka bitaweeli ma lam tastatiAA AAalayhi sabran

t: As for the ship, it belonged to poor people working at sea. So I intended to cause defect in it as there was after them a king who seized every [good] ship by force.
tr: Amma alssafeenatu fakanat limasakeena yaAAmaloona fee albahri faaradtu an aAAeebaha wakana waraahum malikun yakhuthu kulla safeenatin ghasban

t: And as for the boy, his parents were Believers, and we feared that he would overburden them by transgression and disbelief.
tr: Waamma alghulamu fakana abawahu muminayni fakhasheena an yurhiqahuma tughyanan wakufran

t: So we intended that their Lord should substitute for them one better than him in purity and nearer to mercy.
tr: Faaradna an yubdilahuma rabbuhuma khayran minhu zakatan waaqraba ruhman

t: And as for the wall, it belonged to two orphan boys in the city, and there was beneath it a treasure for them, and their father had been righteous. So your Lord intended that they reach maturity and extract their treasure, as a mercy from your Lord. And I did it not of my own accord. That is the interpretation of that about which you could not have patience.”
tr: Waamma aljidaru fakana lighulamayni yateemayni fee almadeenati wakana tahtahu kanzun lahuma wakana aboohuma salihan faarada rabbuka an yablugha ashuddahuma wayastakhrija kanzahuma rahmatan min rabbika wama faAAaltuhu AAan amree thalika taweelu ma lam tastiAA AAalayhi sabran

t: And they ask you, [O Muhammad], about Dhul-Qarnayn. Say, “I will tell you something about him.”
tr: Wayasaloonaka AAan thee alqarnayni qul saatloo AAalaykum minhu thikran

t: Indeed, We established him upon the earth, and We gave him to everything a way [i.e., means].
tr: Inna makkanna lahu fee alardi waataynahu min kulli shayin sababan

t: So he followed a way
tr: FaatbaAAa sababan

t: Until, when he reached the setting of the sun [i.e., the west], he found it [as if] setting in a spring of dark mud, and he found near it a people. We [i.e., God] said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, either you punish [them] or else adopt among them [a way of] goodness.”
tr: Hatta itha balagha maghriba alshshamsi wajadaha taghrubu fee AAaynin hamiatin wawajada AAindaha qawman qulna ya tha alqarnayni imma an tuAAaththiba waimma an tattakhitha feehim husnan

t: He said, “As for one who wrongs, we will punish him. Then he will be returned to his Lord, and He will punish him with a terrible punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
tr: Qala amma man thalama fasawfa nuAAaththibuhu thumma yuraddu ila rabbihi fayuAAaththibuhu AAathaban nukran

t: But as for one who believes and does righteousness, he will have a reward of the best [i.e., Paradise], and we [i.e., Dhul-Qarnayn] will speak to him from our command with ease.”
tr: Waamma man amana waAAamila salihan falahu jazaan alhusna wasanaqoolu lahu min amrina yusran

t: Then he followed a way
tr: Thumma atbaAAa sababan

t: Until, when he came to the rising of the sun [i.e., the east], he found it rising on a people for whom We had not made against it any shield.
tr: Hatta itha balagha matliAAa alshshamsi wajadaha tatluAAu AAala qawmin lam najAAal lahum min dooniha sitran

t: Thus. Our knowledge encompassed all that happened to him.
tr: Kathalika waqad ahatna bima ladayhi khubran

t: Then he followed a way
tr: Thumma atbaAAa sababan

t: Until, when he reached [a pass] between two mountains, he found beside them a people who could hardly understand [his] speech.
tr: Hatta itha balagha bayna alssaddayni wajada min doonihima qawman la yakadoona yafqahoona qawlan

t: They said, “O Dhul-Qarnayn, indeed Gog and Magog are [great] corrupters in the land. So may we assign for you an expenditure that you might make between us and them a barrier?”
tr: Qaloo ya tha alqarnayni inna yajooja wamajooja mufsidoona fee alardi fahal najAAalu laka kharjan AAala an tajAAala baynana wabaynahum saddan

t: He said, “That in which my Lord has established me is better [than what you offer], but assist me with strength [i.e., manpower]; I will make between you and them a dam.
tr: Qala ma makkannee feehi rabbee khayrun faaAAeenoonee biquwwatin ajAAal baynakum wabaynahum radman

t: Bring me sheets of iron” - until, when he had levelled [them] between the two mountain walls, he said, “Blow [with bellows],” until when he had made it [like] fire, he said, “Bring me, that I may pour over it molten copper.”
tr: Atoonee zubara alhadeedi hatta itha sawa bayna alsadafayni qala onfukhoo hatta itha jaAAalahu naran qala atoonee ofrigh AAalayhi qitran

t: So they [i.e., Gog and Magog] were unable to pass over it, nor were they able [to effect] in it any penetration.
tr: Fama istaAAoo an yathharoohu wama istataAAoo lahu naqban

t: [Dhul-Qarnayn] said, “This is a mercy from my Lord; but when the promise of my Lord comes [i.e., approaches], He will make it level, and ever is the promise of my Lord true.”
tr: Qala hatha rahmatun min rabbee faitha jaa waAAdu rabbee jaAAalahu dakkaa wakana waAAdu rabbee haqqan

t: And We will leave them that day surging over each other, and the Horn will be blown, and We will assemble them in [one] assembly.
tr: Watarakna baAAdahum yawmaithin yamooju fee baAAdin wanufikha fee alssoori fajamaAAnahum jamAAan

t: On that Day We will display Hell clearly for the disbelievers -
tr: WaAAaradna jahannama yawmaithin lilkafireena AAardan

t: Those whose eyes had been within a cover [removed] from My remembrance, and they were not able to hear.
tr: Allatheena kanat aAAyunuhum fee ghitain AAan thikree wakanoo la yastateeAAoona samAAan

t: Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell as hospitality for the disbelievers.
tr: Afahasiba allatheena kafaroo an yattakhithoo AAibadee min doonee awliyaa inna aAAtadna jahannama lilkafireena nuzulan

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Shall we inform you of the greatest losers as to [their] deeds?
tr: Qul hal nunabbiokum bialakhsareena aAAmalan

t: [They are] those whose effort is lost in worldly life, while they think that they are doing well in work.”
tr: Allatheena dalla saAAyuhum fee alhayati alddunya wahum yahsaboona annahum yuhsinoona sunAAan

t: Those are the ones who disbelieve in the verses of their Lord and in [their] meeting Him, so their deeds have become worthless; and We will not assign to them on the Day of Resurrection any weight [i.e., importance].
tr: Olaika allatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim waliqaihi fahabitat aAAmaluhum fala nuqeemu lahum yawma alqiyamati waznan

t: That is their recompense - Hell - for what they denied and [because] they took My signs and My messengers in ridicule.
tr: Thalika jazaohum jahannamu bima kafaroo waittakhathoo ayatee warusulee huzuwan

t: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a hospitality,
tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kanat lahum jannatu alfirdawsi nuzulan

t: Wherein they abide eternally. They will not desire from it any transfer.
tr: Khalideena feeha la yabghoona AAanha hiwalan

t: Say, “If the whole ocean were ink for writing the words of my Lord, it would run dry before the words of my Lord are exhausted - even if We were to add another ocean to it.”
tr: Qul law kana albahru midadan likalimati rabbee lanafida albahru qabla an tanfada kalimatu rabbee walaw jina bimithlihi madadan

t: Say, “I am only a man like you. It has been revealed to me that your god is one God. So whoever hopes for the meeting with their Lord, then let him do righteous work and not associate anyone in the worship of his Lord.”
tr: Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun faman kana yarjoo liqaa rabbihi falyaAAmal AAamalan salihan wala yushrik biAAibadati rabbihi ahadan

t: Kāf, Hā, Yā, ‘Ayn, Sād.
tr: KafhayaAAaynsad

t: [This is] a mention of the mercy of your Lord to His servant Zechariah
tr: Thikru rahmati rabbika AAabdahu zakariyya

t: When he called to his Lord a private call [i.e., supplication].
tr: Ith nada rabbahu nidaan khafiyyan

t: He said, “My Lord, indeed my bones have weakened, and my head has filled with white, and never have I been in my supplication to You, my Lord, unhappy [i.e., disappointed].
tr: Qala rabbi innee wahana alAAathmu minnee waishtaAAala alrrasu shayban walam akun biduAAaika rabbi shaqiyyan

t: And indeed, I fear the successors after me, and my wife has been barren, so give me from Yourself an heir
tr: Wainnee khiftu almawaliya min waraee wakanati imraatee AAaqiran fahab lee min ladunka waliyyan

t: Who will inherit me and inherit from the family of Jacob. And make him, my Lord, pleasing [to You].”
tr: Yarithunee wayarithu min ali yaAAqooba waijAAalhu rabbi radiyyan

t: [He was told], “O Zechariah, indeed We give you good tidings of a boy whose name will be John. We have not assigned to any before [this] name.”
tr: Ya zakariyya inna nubashshiruka bighulamin ismuhu yahya lam najAAal lahu min qablu samiyyan

t: He said, “My Lord, how will I have a boy when my wife has been barren and I have reached extreme old age?”
tr: Qala rabbi anna yakoonu lee ghulamun wakanati imraatee AAaqiran waqad balaghtu mina alkibari AAitiyyan

t: [An angel] said, “Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, for I created you before, while you were nothing.’ ”
tr: Qala kathalika qala rabbuka huwa AAalayya hayyinun waqad khalaqtuka min qablu walam taku shayan

t: [Zechariah] said, “My Lord, make for me a sign.” He said, “Your sign is that you will not speak to the people for three nights, [being] sound.”
tr: Qala rabbi ijAAal lee ayatan qala ayatuka alla tukallima alnnasa thalatha layalin sawiyyan

t: So he came out to his people from the prayer chamber and signalled to them to exalt [God] in the morning and afternoon.
tr: Fakharaja AAala qawmihi mina almihrabi faawha ilayhim an sabbihoo bukratan waAAashiyyan

t: [God said], “O John, take the Book with strength.” And We gave him judgement [while yet] a boy
tr: Ya yahya khuthi alkitaba biquwwatin waataynahu alhukma sabiyyan

t: And affection from Us and purity, and he was fearing of God
tr: Wahananan min ladunna wazakatan wakana taqiyyan

t: And dutiful to his parents, and he was not a disobedient tyrant.
tr: Wabarran biwalidayhi walam yakun jabbaran AAasiyyan

t: And peace be upon him the day he was born and the day he dies and the day he is raised alive.
tr: Wasalamun AAalayhi yawma wulida wayawma yamootu wayawma yubAAathu hayyan

t: And mention, [O Muhammad], in the Book [the story of] Mary, when she withdrew from her family to a place toward the east.
tr: Waothkur fee alkitabi maryama ithi intabathat min ahliha makanan sharqiyyan

t: And she took, in seclusion from them, a screen. Then We sent to her Our Angel [i.e., Gabriel], and he represented himself to her as a well-proportioned man.
tr: Faittakhathat min doonihim hijaban faarsalna ilayha roohana fatamaththala laha basharan sawiyyan

t: She said, “Indeed, I seek refuge in the Most Merciful from you, [so leave me], if you should be fearing of God.”
tr: Qalat innee aAAoothu bialrrahmani minka in kunta taqiyyan

t: He said, “I am only the messenger of your Lord to give you [news of] a pure boy [i.e., son].”
tr: Qala innama ana rasoolu rabbiki liahaba laki ghulaman zakiyyan

t: She said, “How can I have a boy while no man has touched me and I have not been unchaste?”
tr: Qalat anna yakoonu lee ghulamun walam yamsasnee basharun walam aku baghiyyan

t: He said, “Thus [it will be]; your Lord says, ‘It is easy for Me, and We will make him a sign to the people and a mercy from Us. And it is a matter [already] decreed.’ ”
tr: Qala kathaliki qala rabbuki huwa AAalayya hayyinun walinajAAalahu ayatan lilnnasi warahmatan minna wakana amran maqdiyyan

t: So she conceived him, and she withdrew with him to a remote place.
tr: Fahamalathu faintabathat bihi makanan qasiyyan

t: And the pains of childbirth drove her to the trunk of a palm tree. She said, “Oh, I wish I had died before this and was in oblivion, forgotten.”
tr: Faajaaha almakhadu ila jithAAi alnnakhlati qalat ya laytanee mittu qabla hatha wakuntu nasyan mansiyyan

t: But he called her from below her, “Do not grieve; your Lord has provided beneath you a stream.
tr: Fanadaha min tahtiha alla tahzanee qad jaAAala rabbuki tahtaki sariyyan

t: And shake toward you the trunk of the palm tree; it will drop upon you ripe, fresh dates.
tr: Wahuzzee ilayki bijithAAi alnnakhlati tusaqit AAalayki rutaban janiyyan

t: So eat and drink and be contented. And if you see from among humanity anyone, say, ‘Indeed, I have vowed to the Most Merciful abstention, so I will not speak today to [any] man.’ ”
tr: Fakulee waishrabee waqarree AAaynan faimma tarayinna mina albashari ahadan faqoolee innee nathartu lilrrahmani sawman falan okallima alyawma insiyyan

t: Then she brought him to her people, carrying him. They said, “O Mary, you have certainly done a thing unprecedented.
tr: Faatat bihi qawmaha tahmiluhu qaloo ya maryamu laqad jiti shayan fariyyan

t: O sister of Aaron, your father was not a man of evil, nor was your mother unchaste.”
tr: Ya okhta haroona ma kana abooki imraa sawin wama kanat ommuki baghiyyan

t: So she pointed to him. They said, “How can we speak to one who is in the cradle a child?”
tr: Faasharat ilayhi qaloo kayfa nukallimu man kana fee almahdi sabiyyan

t: [Jesus] said, “Indeed, I am the servant of God. He has given me the Book and made me a prophet.
tr: Qala innee AAabdu Allahi ataniya alkitaba wajaAAalanee nabiyyan

t: And He has made me blessed wherever I am and has enjoined upon me prayer and zakāh as long as I remain alive
tr: WajaAAalanee mubarakan ayna ma kuntu waawsanee bialssalati waalzzakati ma dumtu hayyan

t: And [made me] dutiful to my mother, and He has not made me a wretched tyrant.
tr: Wabarran biwalidatee walam yajAAalnee jabbaran shaqiyyan

t: And peace is on me the day I was born and the day I will die and the day I am raised alive.”
tr: Waalssalamu AAalayya yawma wulidtu wayawma amootu wayawma obAAathu hayyan

t: That is Jesus, the son of Mary - the word of truth about which they are in dispute.
tr: Thalika AAeesa ibnu maryama qawla alhaqqi allathee feehi yamtaroona

t: It is not [befitting] for God to take a son; exalted is He! When He decrees an affair, He only says to it, “Be,” and it is.
tr: Ma kana lillahi an yattakhitha min waladin subhanahu itha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu

t: [Jesus said], “And indeed, God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. That is a straight path.”
tr: Wainna Allaha rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t: Then the factions differed [concerning Jesus] from among them, so woe to those who disbelieved - from the scene of a tremendous Day.
tr: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min mashhadi yawmin AAatheemin

t: How [clearly] they will hear and see the Day they come to Us, but the wrongdoers today are in clear error.
tr: AsmiAA bihim waabsir yawma yatoonana lakini alththalimoona alyawma fee dalalin mubeenin

t: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Day of Regret, when the matter will be concluded; and [yet], they are in [a state of] heedlessness, and they do not believe.
tr: Waanthirhum yawma alhasrati ith qudiya alamru wahum fee ghaflatin wahum la yuminoona

t: Indeed, it is We who will inherit the earth and whoever is on it, and to Us they will be returned.
tr: Inna nahnu narithu alarda waman AAalayha wailayna yurjaAAoona

t: And mention in the Book [the story of] Abraham. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
tr: Waothkur fee alkitabi ibraheema innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan

t: [Mention] when he said to his father, “O my father, why do you worship that which does not hear and does not see and will not benefit you at all?
tr: Ith qala liabeehi ya abati lima taAAbudu ma la yasmaAAu wala yubsiru wala yughnee AAanka shayan

t: O my father, indeed there has come to me of knowledge that which has not come to you, so follow me; I will guide you to an even path.
tr: Ya abati innee qad jaanee mina alAAilmi ma lam yatika faittabiAAnee ahdika siratan sawiyyan

t: O my father, do not worship [i.e., obey] Satan. Indeed Satan has ever been, to the Most Merciful, disobedient.
tr: Ya abati la taAAbudi alshshaytana inna alshshaytana kana lilrrahmani AAasiyyan

t: O my father, indeed I fear that there will touch you a punishment from the Most Merciful so you would be to Satan a companion [in Hellfire].”
tr: Ya abati innee akhafu an yamassaka AAathabun mina alrrahmani fatakoona lilshshyatani waliyyan

t: [His father] said, “Have you no desire for my gods, O Abraham? If you do not desist, I will surely stone you, so avoid me a prolonged time.”
tr: Qala araghibun anta AAan alihatee ya ibraheemu lain lam tantahi laarjumannaka waohjurnee maliyyan

t: [Abraham] said, “Peace be upon you. I will ask forgiveness for you of my Lord. Indeed, He is ever gracious to me.
tr: Qala salamun AAalayka saastaghfiru laka rabbee innahu kana bee hafiyyan

t: And I will leave you and those you invoke other than God and will invoke my Lord. Perhaps, in my invocation to my Lord, I will not be disappointed.”
tr: WaaAAtazilukum wama tadAAoona min dooni Allahi waadAAoo rabbee AAasa alla akoona biduAAai rabbee shaqiyyan

t: So when he had left them and those they worshipped other than God, We gave him Isaac and Jacob, and each [of them] We made a prophet.
tr: Falamma iAAtazalahum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi wahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wakullan jaAAalna nabiyyan

t: And We gave them of Our mercy, and We made for them a mention [i.e., reputation] of high honour.
tr: Wawahabna lahum min rahmatina wajaAAalna lahum lisana sidqin AAaliyyan

t: And mention in the Book, Moses. Indeed, he was chosen, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
tr: Waothkur fee alkitabi moosa innahu kana mukhlasan wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

t: And We called him from the side of the mount at [his] right and brought him near, confiding [to him].
tr: Wanadaynahu min janibi alttoori alaymani waqarrabnahu najiyyan

t: And We gave him out of Our mercy his brother Aaron as a prophet.
tr: Wawahabna lahu min rahmatina akhahu haroona nabiyyan

t: And mention in the Book, Ishmael. Indeed, he was true to his promise, and he was a messenger and a prophet.
tr: Waothkur fee alkitabi ismaAAeela innahu kana sadiqa alwaAAdi wakana rasoolan nabiyyan

t: And he used to enjoin on his people prayer and zakāh and was to his Lord pleasing [i.e., accepted by Him].
tr: Wakana yamuru ahlahu bialssalati waalzzakati wakana AAinda rabbihi mardiyyan

t: And mention in the Book, Idrees. Indeed, he was a man of truth and a prophet.
tr: Waothkur fee alkitabi idreesa innahu kana siddeeqan nabiyyan

t: And We raised him to a high station.
tr: WarafaAAnahu makanan AAaliyyan

t: Those were the ones upon whom God bestowed favour from among the prophets of the descendants of Adam and of those We carried [in the ship] with Noah, and of the descendants of Abraham and Israel [i.e., Jacob], and of those whom We guided and chose. When the verses of the Most Merciful were recited to them, they fell in prostration and weeping.
tr: Olaika allatheena anAAama Allahu AAalayhim mina alnnabiyyeena min thurriyyati adama wamimman hamalna maAAa noohin wamin thurriyyati ibraheema waisraeela wamimman hadayna waijtabayna itha tutla AAalayhim ayatu alrrahmani kharroo sujjadan wabukiyyan

t: But there came after them successors [i.e., later generations] who neglected prayer and pursued desires; so they are going to meet evil -
tr: Fakhalafa min baAAdihim khalfun adaAAoo alssalata waittabaAAoo alshshahawati fasawfa yalqawna ghayyan

t: Except those who repent, believe and do righteousness; for those will enter Paradise and will not be wronged at all.
tr: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata wala yuthlamoona shayan

t: [Therein are] gardens of perpetual residence which the Most Merciful has promised His servants in the unseen. Indeed, His promise will be fulfilled.
tr: Jannati AAadnin allatee waAAada alrrahmanu AAibadahu bialghaybi innahu kana waAAduhu matiyyan

t: They will not hear therein any ill speech - only [greetings of] peace - and they will have their provision therein, morning and afternoon.
tr: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan illa salaman walahum rizquhum feeha bukratan waAAashiyyan

t: That is Paradise, which We give as inheritance to those of Our servants who were fearing of God.
tr: Tilka aljannatu allatee noorithu min AAibadina man kana taqiyyan

t: [Gabriel said], “And we [angels] descend not except by the order of your Lord. To Him belongs that before us and that behind us and what is in between. And never is your Lord forgetful -
tr: Wama natanazzalu illa biamri rabbika lahu ma bayna aydeena wama khalfana wama bayna thalika wama kana rabbuka nasiyyan

t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them - so worship Him and have patience for His worship. Do you know of any similarity to Him?”
tr: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma faoAAbudhu waistabir liAAibadatihi hal taAAlamu lahu samiyyan

t: And the human being says, “When I have died, am I going to be brought forth alive?”
tr: Wayaqoolu alinsanu aitha ma mittu lasawfa okhraju hayyan

t: Does the human not remember that We created him before, while he was nothing?
tr: Awala yathkuru alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min qablu walam yaku shayan

t: So by your Lord, We will surely gather them and the devils; then We will bring them to be present around Hell upon their knees.
tr: Fawarabbika lanahshurannahum waalshshayateena thumma lanuhdirannahum hawla jahannama jithiyyan

t: Then We will surely extract from every sect those of them who were worst against the Most Merciful in insolence.
tr: Thumma lananziAAanna min kulli sheeAAatin ayyuhum ashaddu AAala alrrahmani AAitiyyan

t: Then, surely it is We who are most knowing of those most worthy of burning therein.
tr: Thumma lanahnu aAAlamu biallatheena hum awla biha siliyyan

t: And there is none of you except he will come to it. This is upon your Lord an inevitability decreed.
tr: Wain minkum illa wariduha kana AAala rabbika hatman maqdiyyan

t: Then We will save those who feared God and leave the wrongdoers within it, on their knees.
tr: Thumma nunajjee allatheena ittaqaw wanatharu alththalimeena feeha jithiyyan

t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Which of [our] two parties is best in position and best in association?”
tr: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ayyu alfareeqayni khayrun maqaman waahsanu nadiyyan

t: And how many a generation have We destroyed before them who were better in possessions and [outward] appearance?
tr: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ahsanu athathan wariyan

t: Say, “Whoever is in error - let the Most Merciful extend for him an extension [in wealth and time] until, when they see that which they were promised - either punishment [in this world] or the Hour [of resurrection] - they will come to know who is worst in position and weaker in soldiers.”
tr: Qul man kana fee alddalalati falyamdud lahu alrrahmanu maddan hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona imma alAAathaba waimma alssaAAata fasayaAAlamoona man huwa sharrun makanan waadAAafu jundan

t: And God increases those who were guided, in guidance, and the enduring good deeds are better to your Lord for reward and better for recourse.
tr: Wayazeedu Allahu allatheena ihtadaw hudan waalbaqiyatu alssalihatu khayrun AAinda rabbika thawaban wakhayrun maraddan

t: Then, have you seen he who disbelieved in Our verses and said, “I will surely be given wealth and children [in the next life]?”
tr: Afaraayta allathee kafara biayatina waqala laootayanna malan wawaladan

t: Has he looked into the unseen, or has he taken from the Most Merciful a promise?
tr: AttalaAAa alghayba ami ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

t: No! We will record what he says and extend [i.e., increase] for him from the punishment extensively.
tr: Kalla sanaktubu ma yaqoolu wanamuddu lahu mina alAAathabi maddan

t: And We will inherit him [in] what he mentions, and he will come to Us alone.
tr: Wanarithuhu ma yaqoolu wayateena fardan

t: And they have taken besides God [false] deities that they would be for them [a source of] honour.
tr: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan liyakoonoo lahum AAizzan

t: No! They [i.e., those “gods”] will deny their worship of them and will be against them opponents [on the Day of Judgement].
tr: Kalla sayakfuroona biAAibadatihim wayakoonoona AAalayhim diddan

t: Do you not see that We have sent the devils upon the disbelievers, inciting them [to evil] with [constant] incitement?
tr: Alam tara anna arsalna alshshayateena AAala alkafireena taozzuhum azzan

t: So be not impatient over them. We are counting down their number [of days].
tr: Fala taAAjal AAalayhim innama naAAuddu lahum AAaddan

t: On the Day We will gather the righteous to the Most Merciful as a delegation
tr: Yawma nahshuru almuttaqeena ila alrrahmani wafdan

t: And will drive the criminals to Hell in thirst
tr: Wanasooqu almujrimeena ila jahannama wirdan

t: None will have [power of] intercession except he who had taken from the Most Merciful a covenant.
tr: La yamlikoona alshshafaAAata illa mani ittakhatha AAinda alrrahmani AAahdan

t: And they say, “The Most Merciful has taken [for Himself] a son.”
tr: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan

t: You have done an atrocious thing.
tr: Laqad jitum shayan iddan

t: The heavens almost rupture therefrom and the earth splits open and the mountains collapse in devastation
tr: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna minhu watanshaqqu alardu watakhirru aljibalu haddan

t: That they attribute to the Most Merciful a son.
tr: An daAAaw lilrrahmani waladan

t: And it is not appropriate for the Most Merciful that He should take a son.
tr: Wama yanbaghee lilrrahmani an yattakhitha waladan

t: There is no one in the heavens and earth but that he comes to the Most Merciful as a servant.
tr: In kullu man fee alssamawati waalardi illa atee alrrahmani AAabdan

t: He has enumerated them all and has counted them, a full counting.
tr: Laqad ahsahum waAAaddahum AAaddan

t: And all of them are coming to Him on the Day of Resurrection alone.
tr: Wakulluhum ateehi yawma alqiyamati fardan

t: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - the Most Compassionate will bestow for them, love.
tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sayajAAalu lahumu alrrahmanu wuddan

t: So, [O Muhammad], We have only made it [i.e., the Qur’ān] easy in your tongue [i.e., the Arabic language] that you may give good tidings thereby to the righteous and warn thereby a hostile people.
tr: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika litubashshira bihi almuttaqeena watunthira bihi qawman luddan

t: And how many have We destroyed before them of generations? Do you perceive a single one of them now, or hear as much as a whisper?
tr: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hal tuhissu minhum min ahadin aw tasmaAAu lahum rikzan

t: Tā, Hā.
tr: Taha

t: We have not sent down to you the Qur’ān that you be distressed
tr: Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa

t: But only as a reminder for those who fear [God] -
tr: Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha

t: A revelation from He who created the earth and highest heavens,
tr: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula

t: The Most Merciful [who is] above the Throne established.
tr: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa

t: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth and what is between them and what is under the soil.
tr: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara

t: And if you speak aloud - then indeed, He knows the secret and what is [even] more hidden.
tr: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa

t: God - there is no deity except Him. To Him belong the best names.
tr: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna

t: And has the story of Moses reached you? -
tr: Wahal ataka hadeethu moosa

t: When he saw a fire and said to his family, “Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire; perhaps I can bring you a torch or find at the fire some guidance.”
tr: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan

t: And when he came to it, he was called, “O Moses,
tr: Falamma ataha noodiya ya moosa

t: Indeed, I am your Lord, so remove your sandals. Indeed, you are in the sacred valley of Tuwā.
tr: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

t: And I have chosen you, so listen to what is revealed [to you].
tr: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha

t: Indeed, I am God. There is no deity except Me, so worship Me and establish prayer for My remembrance.
tr: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree

t: Indeed the Hour is coming, I am almost concealing it - for each soul to be rewarded for that which it strives.
tr: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa

t: So do not let one avert you from it who does not believe in it and follows his desire, for you [then] would perish.
tr: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda

t: And what is that in your right hand, O Moses?”
tr: Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa

t: He said, “It is my staff; I lean upon it, and I bring down leaves for my sheep and I have therein other uses.”
tr: Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra

t: [God] said, “Throw it down, O Moses.”
tr: Qala alqiha ya moosa

t: So he threw it down, and thereupon it was a snake, moving swiftly.
tr: Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa

t: [God] said, “Seize it and fear not; We will return it to its former condition.
tr: Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola

t: And draw in your hand to your side; it will come out white without disease another sign,
tr: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra

t: That We may show you [some] of Our greater signs.
tr: Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra

t: Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed [i.e., tyrannized].”
tr: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha

t: [Moses] said, “My Lord, expand [i.e., relax] for me my breast [with assurance]
tr: Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree

t: And ease for me my task
tr: Wayassir lee amree

t: And untie the knot from my tongue
tr: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee

t: That they may understand my speech.
tr: Yafqahoo qawlee

t: And appoint for me a minister [i.e., assistant] from my family -
tr: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee

t: Aaron, my brother.
tr: Haroona akhee

t: Increase through him my strength
tr: Oshdud bihi azree

t: And let him share my task
tr: Waashrikhu fee amree

t: That we may exalt You much
tr: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran

t: And remember You much.
tr: Wanathkuraka katheeran

t: Indeed, You are of us ever Seeing.”
tr: Innaka kunta bina baseeran

t: [God] said, “You have been granted your request, O Moses.
tr: Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa

t: And We had already conferred favour upon you another time,
tr: Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra

t: When We inspired to your mother what We inspired,
tr: Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha

t: [Saying], ‘Throw him into the chest and then throw him into the river, and the river will lay him onto the shore; there will take him an enemy to Me and an enemy to him.’ And I cast on you love from Me and planned that you should be reared under My watchful eye.
tr: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee

t: [And We favoured you] when your sister went and said, ‘Shall I direct you to someone who will be responsible for him?’ So We restored you to your mother that she might be content and not grieve. And you killed someone, but We saved you from retaliation and tried you with a [severe] trial. And you remained [some] years among the people of Madyan. Then you came [here] at the decreed time, O Moses.
tr: Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa

t: I have specially prepared you for Myself.
tr: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee

t: Go, you and your brother, with My signs and do not slacken in My remembrance.
tr: Ithhab anta waakhooka biayatee wala taniya fee thikree

t: Go, both of you, to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
tr: Ithhaba ila firAAawna innahu tagha

t: And speak to him with gentle speech that perhaps he may be reminded or fear [God].”
tr: Faqoola lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yatathakkaru aw yakhsha

t: They said, “Our Lord, indeed we are afraid that he will hasten [punishment] against us or that he will transgress.”
tr: Qala rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta AAalayna aw an yatgha

t: [God] said, “Fear not. Indeed, I am with you both; I hear and I see.
tr: Qala la takhafa innanee maAAakuma asmaAAu waara

t: So go to him and say, ‘Indeed, we are messengers of your Lord, so send with us the Children of Israel and do not torment them. We have come to you with a sign from your Lord. And peace will be upon he who follows the guidance.
tr: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda

t: Indeed, it has been revealed to us that the punishment will be upon whoever denies and turns away.’ ”
tr: Inna qad oohiya ilayna anna alAAathaba AAala man kaththaba watawalla

t: [Pharaoh] said, “So who is the Lord of you two, O Moses?”
tr: Qala faman rabbukuma ya moosa

t: He said, “Our Lord is He who gave each thing its form and then guided [it].”
tr: Qala rabbuna allathee aAAta kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hada

t: [Pharaoh] said, “Then what is the case of the former generations?”
tr: Qala fama balu alqurooni aloola

t: [Moses] said, “The knowledge thereof is with my Lord in a record. My Lord neither errs nor forgets.”
tr: Qala AAilmuha AAinda rabbee fee kitabin la yadillu rabbee wala yansa

t: [It is He] who has made for you the earth as a bed [spread out] and inserted therein for you roadways and sent down from the sky, rain and produced thereby categories of various plants.
tr: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta

t: Eat [therefrom] and pasture your livestock. Indeed, in that are signs for those of intelligence.
tr: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

t: From it [i.e., the earth] We created you, and into it We will return you, and from it We will extract you another time.
tr: Minha khalaqnakum wafeeha nuAAeedukum waminha nukhrijukum taratan okhra

t: And We certainly showed him [i.e., Pharaoh] Our signs - all of them - but he denied and refused.
tr: Walaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakaththaba waaba

t: He said, “Have you come to us to drive us out of our land with your magic, O Moses?
tr: Qala ajitana litukhrijana min ardina bisihrika ya moosa

t: Then we will surely bring you magic like it, so make between us and you an appointment, which we will not fail to keep and neither will you, in a place assigned.”
tr: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan

t: [Moses] said, “Your appointment is on the day of the festival when the people assemble at mid-morning.”
tr: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan

t: So Pharaoh went away, put together his plan, and then came [to Moses].
tr: Fatawalla firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma ata

t: Moses said to them [i.e., the magicians summoned by Pharaoh], “Woe to you! Do not invent a lie against God or He will exterminate you with a punishment; and he has failed who invents [such falsehood].”
tr: Qala lahum moosa waylakum la taftaroo AAala Allahi kathiban fayushitakum biAAathabin waqad khaba mani iftara

t: So they disputed over their affair among themselves and concealed their private conversation.
tr: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa

t: They said, “Indeed, these are two magicians who want to drive you out of your land with their magic and do away with your most exemplary way [i.e., religion or tradition].
tr: Qaloo in hathani lasahirani yureedani an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima wayathhaba bitareeqatikumu almuthla

t: So resolve upon your plan and then come [forward] in line. And he has succeeded today who overcomes.”
tr: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo saffan waqad aflaha alyawma mani istaAAla

t: They said, “O Moses, either you throw or we will be the first to throw.”
tr: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa

t: He said, “Rather, you throw.” And suddenly their ropes and staffs seemed to him from their magic that they were moving [like snakes].
tr: Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum waAAisiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tasAAa

t: And he sensed within himself fear, did Moses.
tr: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosa

t: We [i.e., God] said, “Fear not. Indeed, it is you who are superior.
tr: Qulna la takhaf innaka anta alaAAla

t: And throw what is in your right hand; it will swallow up what they have crafted. What they have crafted is but the trick of a magician, and the magician will not succeed wherever he is.”
tr: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata

t: So the magicians fell down in prostration. They said, “We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses.”
tr: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa

t: [Pharaoh] said, “You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic.
