So I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will surely know which of us is more severe in [giving] punishment and more enduring.”
tr: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa

t: They said, “Never will we prefer you over what has come to us of clear proofs and [over] He who brought us into being. So decree whatever you are to decree. You can only decree for this worldly life.
tr: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya

t: Indeed, we have believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our sins and what you compelled us [to do] of magic. And God is better and more enduring.”
tr: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa

t: Indeed, whoever comes to his Lord as a criminal - indeed, for him is Hell; he will neither die therein nor live.
tr: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamootu feeha wala yahya

t: But whoever comes to Him as a Believer having done righteous deeds - for those will be the highest degrees [in position]:
tr: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula

t: Gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. And that is the reward of one who purifies himself.
tr: Jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao man tazakka

t: And We had inspired to Moses, “Travel by night with My servants and strike for them a dry path through the sea; you will not fear being overtaken [by Pharaoh] nor be afraid [of drowning].”
tr: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha

t: So Pharaoh pursued them with his soldiers, and there covered them from the sea that which covered them,
tr: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi ma ghashiyahum

t: And Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide [them].
tr: Waadalla firAAawnu qawmahu wama hada

t: O Children of Israel, We delivered you from your enemy, and We made an appointment with you at the right side of the mount, and We sent down to you manna and quails,
tr: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa

t: [Saying], “Eat from the good things with which We have provided you and do not transgress [or oppress others] therein, lest My anger should descend upon you. And he upon whom My anger descends has certainly fallen [i.e., perished].”
tr: Kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wala tatghaw feehi fayahilla AAalaykum ghadabee waman yahlil AAalayhi ghadabee faqad hawa

t: But indeed, I am the Perpetual Forgiver of whoever repents and believes and does righteousness and then continues in guidance.
tr: Wainnee laghaffarun liman taba waamana waAAamila salihan thumma ihtada

t: [God] said, “And what made you hasten from your people, O Moses?”
tr: Wama aAAjalaka AAan qawmika ya moosa

t: He said, “They are following in my tracks, and I hastened to You, my Lord, that You be pleased.”
tr: Qala hum olai AAala atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda

t: [God] said, “But indeed, We have tried your people after you [departed], and the Sāmirī has led them astray.”
tr: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu

t: So Moses returned to his people, angry and grieved. He said, “O my people, did your Lord not make you a good promise? Then, was the time [of its fulfillment] too long for you, or did you wish that wrath from your Lord descend upon you, so you broke your promise [of obedience] to me?”
tr: FarajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala ya qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan hasanan afatala AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an yahilla AAalaykum ghadabun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee

t: They said, “We did not break our promise to you by our will, but we were made to carry burdens from the ornaments of the people [of Pharaoh], so we threw them [into the fire], and thus did the Sāmirī throw.”
tr: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu

t: And he extracted for them [the statue of] a calf which had a lowing sound, and they said, “This is your god and the god of Moses, but he forgot.”
tr: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya

t: Did they not see that it could not return to them any speech [i.e., response] and that it did not possess for them any harm or benefit?
tr: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan

t: And Aaron had already told them before [the return of Moses], “O my people, you are only being tested by it, and indeed, your Lord is the Most Merciful, so follow me and obey my order.”
tr: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree

t: They said, “We will never cease being devoted to it [i.e., the calf] until Moses returns to us.”
tr: Qaloo lan nabraha AAalayhi AAakifeena hatta yarjiAAa ilayna moosa

t: [Moses] said, “O Aaron, what prevented you, when you saw them going astray,
tr: Qala ya haroonu ma manaAAaka ith raaytahum dalloo

t: From following me? Then have you disobeyed my order?”
tr: Alla tattabiAAani afaAAasayta amree

t: [Aaron] said, “O son of my mother, do not seize [me] by my beard or by my head. Indeed, I feared that you would say, ‘You caused division among the Children of Israel, and you did not observe [or await] my word.’ ”
tr: Qala ya bna omma la takhuth bilihyatee wala birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israeela walam tarqub qawlee

t: [Moses] said, “And what is your case, O Sāmirī?”
tr: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu

t: He said, “I saw what they did not see, so I took a handful [of dust] from the track of the messenger and threw it, and thus did my soul entice me.”
tr: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee

t: [Moses] said, “Then go. And indeed, it is [decreed] for you in [this] life to say, ‘No contact.’ And indeed, you have an appointment [in the Hereafter] you will not fail to keep. And look at your ‘god’ to which you remained devoted. We will surely burn it and blow it [i.e., its ashes] into the sea with a blast.
tr: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan

t: Your god is only God, except for whom there is no deity. He has encompassed all things in knowledge.”
tr: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman

t: Thus, [O Muhammad], We relate to you from the news of what has preceded. And We have certainly given you from Us a message [i.e., the Qur’ān.]
tr: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran

t: Whoever turns away from it - then indeed, he will bear on the Day of Resurrection a burden [i.e., great sin],
tr: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran

t: [Abiding] eternally therein, and evil it is for them on the Day of Resurrection as a load -
tr: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan

t: The Day the Horn will be blown. And We will gather the criminals, that Day, blue-eyed.
tr: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan

t: They will murmur among themselves, “You remained not but ten [days in the world].”
tr: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran

t: We are most knowing of what they say when the best of them in manner [i.e., wisdom or speech] will say, “You remained not but one day.”
tr: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman

t: And they ask you about the mountains, so say, “My Lord will blow them away with a blast.
tr: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan

t: And He will leave it [i.e., the earth] a level plain;
tr: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan

t: You will not see therein a depression or an elevation.”
tr: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan

t: That Day, they [i.e., everyone] will follow [the call of] the Caller [with] no deviation therefrom, and [all] voices will be stilled before the Most Merciful, so you will not hear except a whisper [of footsteps].
tr: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan

t: That Day, no intercession will benefit except [that of] one to whom the Most Merciful has given permission and has accepted his word.
tr: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan

t: He [i.e., God] knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, but they do not encompass it [i.e., what He knows] in knowledge.
tr: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman

t: And [all] faces will be humbled before the Ever-Living, the Sustainer of existence. And he will have failed who carries injustice.
tr: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman

t: But he who does of righteous deeds while he is a Believer - he will neither fear injustice nor deprivation.
tr: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman

t: And thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Qur’ān and have diversified therein the warnings that perhaps they will avoid [sin] or it would cause them remembrance.
tr: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran

t: So high [above all] is God, the Sovereign, the Truth. And, [O Muhammad], do not hasten with [recitation of] the Qur’ān before its revelation is completed to you, and say, “My Lord, increase me in knowledge.”
tr: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman

t: And We had already taken a promise from Adam before, but he forgot; and We found not in him determination.
tr: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman

t: And [mention] when We said to the angels, “Prostrate to Adam,” and they prostrated, except Iblees; he refused.
tr: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba

t: So We said, “O Adam, indeed this is an enemy to you and to your wife. Then let him not remove you from Paradise so you would suffer.
tr: Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa

t: Indeed, it is [promised] for you not to be hungry therein or be unclothed.
tr: Inna laka alla tajooAAa feeha wala taAAra

t: And indeed, you will not be thirsty therein or be hot from the sun.”
tr: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha

t: Then Satan whispered to him; he said, “O Adam, shall I direct you to the tree of eternity and possession that will not deteriorate?”
tr: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla

t: And they [i.e., Adam and his wife] ate of it, and their private parts became apparent to them, and they began to fasten over themselves from the leaves of Paradise. And Adam disobeyed his Lord and erred.
tr: Faakala minha fabadat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati waAAasa adamu rabbahu faghawa

t: Then his Lord chose him and turned to him in forgiveness and guided [him].
tr: Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada

t: [God] said, “Descend from it [i.e., Paradise] - all, [your descendants] being enemies to one another. And if there should come to you guidance from Me then whoever follows My guidance will neither go astray [in the world] nor suffer [in the Hereafter].
tr: Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hudaya fala yadillu wala yashqa

t: And whoever turns away from My remembrance - indeed, he will have a depressed [i.e., difficult] life, and We will gather [i.e., raise] him on the Day of Resurrection blind.”
tr: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman

t: He will say, “My Lord, why have you raised me blind while I was [once] seeing?”
tr: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran

t: [God] will say, “Thus did Our signs come to you, and you forgot [i.e., disregarded] them; and thus will you this Day be forgotten.”
tr: Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa

t: And thus do We recompense he who transgressed and did not believe in the signs of his Lord. And the punishment of the Hereafter is more severe and more enduring.
tr: Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yumin biayati rabbihi walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaddu waabqa

t: Then, has it not become clear to them how many generations We destroyed before them as they walk among their dwellings? Indeed in that are signs for those of intelligence.
tr: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

t: And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord, it [i.e., punishment] would have been an obligation [due immediately], and [if not for] a specified term [decreed].
tr: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman

t: So be patient over what they say and exalt [God] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting; and during periods of the night [exalt Him] and at the ends of the day, that you may be satisfied.
tr: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda

t: And do not extend your eyes toward that by which We have given enjoyment to [some] categories of them, [its being but] the splendour of worldly life by which We test them. And the provision of your Lord is better and more enduring.
tr: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa

t: And enjoin prayer upon your family [and people] and be steadfast therein. We ask you not for provision; We provide for you, and the [best] outcome is for [those of] righteousness.
tr: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa

t: And they say, “Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?” Has there not come to them evidence of what was in the former scriptures?
tr: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola

t: And if We had destroyed them with a punishment before him, they would have said, “Our Lord, why did You not send to us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses [i.e., teachings] before we were humiliated and disgraced?”
tr: Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika min qabli an nathilla wanakhza

t: Say, “Each [of us] is waiting; so wait. For you will know who are the companions of the sound path and who is guided.”
tr: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada

t: [The time of] their account has approached for the people, while they are in heedlessness turning away.
tr: Iqtaraba lilnnasi hisabuhum wahum fee ghaflatin muAAridoona

t: No mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from their Lord except that they listen to it while they are at play
tr: Ma yateehim min thikrin min rabbihim muhdathin illa istamaAAoohu wahum yalAAaboona

t: With their hearts distracted. And those who do wrong conceal their private conversation, [saying], “Is this [Prophet] except a human being like you? So would you approach magic while you are aware [of it]?”
tr: Lahiyatan quloobuhum waasarroo alnnajwa allatheena thalamoo hal hatha illa basharun mithlukum afatatoona alssihra waantum tubsiroona

t: He [the Prophet] said, “My Lord knows whatever is said throughout the heaven and earth, and He is the Hearing, the Knowing.”
tr: Qala rabbee yaAAlamu alqawla fee alssamai waalardi wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t: But they say, “[The revelation is but] a mixture of false dreams; rather, he has invented it; rather, he is a poet. So let him bring us a sign just as the previous [messengers] were sent [with miracles].”
tr: Bal qaloo adghathu ahlamin bali iftarahu bal huwa shaAAirun falyatina biayatin kama orsila alawwaloona

t: Not a [single] city which We destroyed believed before them, so will they believe?
tr: Ma amanat qablahum min qaryatin ahlaknaha afahum yuminoona

t: And We sent not before you, [O Muhammad], except men to whom We revealed [the message], so ask the people of the message [i.e., former scriptures] if you do not know.
tr: Wama arsalna qablaka illa rijalan noohee ilayhim faisaloo ahla alththikri in kuntum la taAAlamoona

t: And We did not make them [i.e., the prophets] forms not eating food, nor were they immortal [on earth].
tr: Wama jaAAalnahum jasadan la yakuloona alttaAAama wama kanoo khalideena

t: Then We fulfilled for them the promise, and We saved them and whom We willed and destroyed the transgressors.
tr: Thumma sadaqnahumu alwaAAda faanjaynahum waman nashao waahlakna almusrifeena

t: We have certainly sent down to you a Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] in which is your mention. Then will you not reason?
tr: Laqad anzalna ilaykum kitaban feehi thikrukum afala taAAqiloona

t: And how many a city which was unjust have We shattered and produced after it another people.
tr: Wakam qasamna min qaryatin kanat thalimatan waanshana baAAdaha qawman akhareena

t: And when they [i.e., its inhabitants] perceived Our punishment, at once they fled from it.
tr: Falamma ahassoo basana itha hum minha yarkudoona

t: [Some angels said], “Do not flee but return to where you were given luxury and to your homes so that you will be questioned.”
tr: La tarkudoo wairjiAAoo ila ma otriftum feehi wamasakinikum laAAallakum tusaloona

t: They said, “O woe to us! Indeed, we were wrongdoers.”
tr: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

t: And that their cry did not cease until We made them [as] a harvest [mowed down], extinguished.
tr: Fama zalat tilka daAAwahum hatta jaAAalnahum haseedan khamideena

t: And We did not create the heaven and earth and that between them in play.
tr: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

t: Had We intended to take a diversion, We could have taken it from [what is] with Us - if [indeed] We were to do so.
tr: Law aradna an nattakhitha lahwan laittakhathnahu min ladunna in kunna faAAileena

t: Rather, We hurl the truth upon falsehood, and it destroys it, and thereupon it departs. And for you is destruction from that which you describe.
tr: Bal naqthifu bialhaqqi AAala albatili fayadmaghuhu faitha huwa zahiqun walakumu alwaylu mimma tasifoona

t: To Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and the earth. And those near Him [i.e., the angels] are not prevented by arrogance from His worship, nor do they tire.
tr: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waman AAindahu la yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatihi wala yastahsiroona

t: They exalt [Him] night and day [and] do not slacken.
tr: Yusabbihoona allayla waalnnahara la yafturoona

t: Or have they [i.e., men] taken for themselves gods from the earth who resurrect [the dead]?
tr: Ami ittakhathoo alihatan mina alardi hum yunshiroona

t: Had there been within them [i.e., the heavens and earth] gods besides God, they both would have been ruined. So exalted is God, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
tr: Law kana feehima alihatun illa Allahu lafasadata fasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

t: He is not questioned about what He does, but they will be questioned.
tr: La yusalu AAamma yafAAalu wahum yusaloona

t: Or have they taken gods besides Him? Say, [O Muhammad], “Produce your proof. This [Qur’ān] is the message for those with me and the message of those before me.” But most of them do not know the truth, so they are turning away.
tr: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan qul hatoo burhanakum hatha thikru man maAAiya wathikru man qablee bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona alhaqqa fahum muAAridoona

t: And We sent not before you any messenger except that We revealed to him that, “There is no deity except Me, so worship Me.”
tr: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin illa noohee ilayhi annahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudooni

t: And they say, “The Most Merciful has taken a son.” Exalted is He! Rather, they are [but] honoured servants.
tr: Waqaloo ittakhatha alrrahmanu waladan subhanahu bal AAibadun mukramoona

t: They cannot precede Him in word, and they act by His command.
tr: La yasbiqoonahu bialqawli wahum biamrihi yaAAmaloona

t: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them, and they cannot intercede except on behalf of one whom He approves. And they, from fear of Him, are apprehensive.
tr: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yashfaAAoona illa limani irtada wahum min khashyatihi mushfiqoona

t: And whoever of them should say, “Indeed, I am a god besides Him”— that one We would recompense with Hell. Thus do We recompense the wrongdoers.
tr: Waman yaqul minhum innee ilahun min doonihi fathalika najzeehi jahannama kathalika najzee alththalimeena

t: Have those who disbelieved not considered that the heavens and the earth were a joined entity, and We separated them and made from water every living thing? Then will they not believe?
tr: Awalam yara allatheena kafaroo anna alssamawati waalarda kanata ratqan fafataqnahuma wajaAAalna mina almai kulla shayin hayyin afala yuminoona

t: And We placed within the earth firmly set mountains, lest it should shift with them, and We made therein [mountain] passes [as] roads that they might be guided.
tr: WajaAAalna fee alardi rawasiya an tameeda bihim wajaAAalna feeha fijajan subulan laAAallahum yahtadoona

t: And We made the sky a protected ceiling, but they, from its signs, are turning away.
tr: WajaAAalna alssamaa saqfan mahfoothan wahum AAan ayatiha muAAridoona

t: And it is He who created the night and the day and the sun and the moon; all [heavenly bodies] in an orbit are swimming.
tr: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa allayla waalnnahara waalshshamsa waalqamara kullun fee falakin yasbahoona

t: And We did not grant to any man before you eternity [on earth]; so if you die would they be eternal?
tr: Wama jaAAalna libasharin min qablika alkhulda afain mitta fahumu alkhalidoona

t: Every soul will taste death. And We test you with evil and with good as trial; and to Us you will be returned.
tr: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti wanablookum bialshsharri waalkhayri fitnatan wailayna turjaAAoona

t: And when those who disbelieve see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], “Is this the one who mentions [i.e., insults] your gods?” And they are, at the mention of the Most Merciful, disbelievers.
tr: Waitha raaka allatheena kafaroo in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee yathkuru alihatakum wahum bithikri alrrahmani hum kafiroona

t: Humans were created of haste. I will show you My signs, so do not ask Me to hasten them.
tr: Khuliqa alinsanu min AAajalin saoreekum ayatee fala tastaAAjiloona

t: And they say, “When is this promise, if you should be truthful?”
tr: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

t: If those who disbelieved but knew the time when they will not avert the Fire from their faces or from their backs and they will not be aided...
tr: Law yaAAlamu allatheena kafaroo heena la yakuffoona AAan wujoohihimu alnnara wala AAan thuhoorihim wala hum yunsaroona

t: Rather, it will come to them unexpectedly and bewilder them, and they will not be able to repel it, nor will they be reprieved.
tr: Bal tateehim baghtatan fatabhatuhum fala yastateeAAoona raddaha wala hum yuntharoona

t: And already were messengers ridiculed before you, but those who mocked them were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Walaqadi istuhzia birusulin min qablika fahaqa biallatheena sakhiroo minhum ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: Say, “Who can protect you at night or by day from the Most Merciful?” But they are, from the remembrance of their Lord, turning away.
tr: Qul man yaklaokum biallayli waalnnahari mina alrrahmani bal hum AAan thikri rabbihim muAAridoona

t: Or do they have gods to defend them other than Us? They are unable [even] to help themselves, nor can they be protected from Us.
tr: Am lahum alihatun tamnaAAuhum min doonina la yastateeAAoona nasra anfusihim wala hum minna yushaboona

t: But, [on the contrary], We have provided good things for these [disbelievers] and their fathers until life was prolonged for them. Then do they not see that We set upon the land, reducing it from its borders? So it is they who will overcome?
tr: Bal mattaAAna haolai waabaahum hatta tala AAalayhimu alAAumuru afala yarawna anna natee alarda nanqusuha min atrafiha afahumu alghaliboona

t: Say, “I only warn you by revelation.” But the deaf do not hear the call when they are warned.
tr: Qul innama onthirukum bialwahyi wala yasmaAAu alssummu aldduAAaa itha ma yuntharoona

t: And if [as much as] a whiff of the punishment of your Lord should touch them, they would surely say, “O woe to us! Indeed, we have been wrongdoers.”
tr: Walain massathum nafhatun min AAathabi rabbika layaqoolunna ya waylana inna kunna thalimeena

t: And We place the scales of justice for the Day of Resurrection, so no soul will be treated unjustly at all. And if there is [even] the weight of a mustard seed, We will bring it forth. And sufficient are We as accountant.
tr: WanadaAAu almawazeena alqista liyawmi alqiyamati fala tuthlamu nafsun shayan wain kana mithqala habbatin min khardalin atayna biha wakafa bina hasibeena

t: And We had already given Moses and Aaron the criterion and an illumination and a reminder for the righteous
tr: Walaqad atayna moosa waharoona alfurqana wadiyaan wathikran lilmuttaqeena

t: Who fear their Lord unseen, while they are of the Hour apprehensive.
tr: Allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi wahum mina alssaAAati mushfiqoona

t: And this [Qur’ān] is a blessed message which We have sent down. Then are you with it unacquainted?
tr: Wahatha thikrun mubarakun anzalnahu afaantum lahu munkiroona

t: And We had certainly given Abraham his sound judgement before, and We were of him well-Knowing
tr: Walaqad atayna ibraheema rushdahu min qablu wakunna bihi AAalimeena

t: When he said to his father and his people, “What are these statues to which you are devoted?”
tr: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma hathihi alttamatheelu allatee antum laha AAakifoona

t: They said, “We found our fathers worshippers of them.”
tr: Qaloo wajadna abaana laha AAabideena

t: He said, “You were certainly, you and your fathers, in manifest error.”
tr: Qala laqad kuntum antum waabaokum fee dalalin mubeenin

t: They said, “Have you come to us with truth, or are you of those who jest?”
tr: Qaloo ajitana bialhaqqi am anta mina allaAAibeena

t: He said, “[No], rather, your Lord is the Lord of the heavens and the earth who originated them, and I, to that, am of those who testify.
tr: Qala bal rabbukum rabbu alssamawati waalardi allathee fatarahunna waana AAala thalikum mina alshshahideena

t: And [I swear] by God, I will surely plan against your idols after you have turned and gone away.”
tr: WataAllahi laakeedanna asnamakum baAAda an tuwalloo mudbireena

t: So he made them into fragments, except a large one among them, that they might return to it [and question].
tr: FajaAAalahum juthathan illa kabeeran lahum laAAallahum ilayhi yarjiAAoona

t: They said, “Who has done this to our gods? Indeed, he is of the wrongdoers.”
tr: Qaloo man faAAala hatha bialihatina innahu lamina alththalimeena

t: They said, “We heard a young man mention them who is called Abraham.”
tr: Qaloo samiAAna fatan yathkuruhum yuqalu lahu ibraheemu

t: They said, “Then bring him before the eyes of the people that they may testify.”
tr: Qaloo fatoo bihi AAala aAAyuni alnnasi laAAallahum yashhadoona

t: They said, “Have you done this to our gods, O Abraham?”
tr: Qaloo aanta faAAalta hatha bialihatina ya ibraheemu

t: He said, “Rather, this - the largest of them - did it, so ask them, if they should [be able to] speak.”
tr: Qala bal faAAalahu kabeeruhum hatha faisaloohum in kanoo yantiqoona

t: So they returned to [blaming] themselves and said [to each other], “Indeed, you are the wrongdoers.”
tr: FarajaAAoo ila anfusihim faqaloo innakum antumu alththalimoona

t: Then they reversed themselves, [saying], “You have already known that these do not speak!”
tr: Thumma nukisoo AAala ruoosihim laqad AAalimta ma haolai yantiqoona

t: He said, “Then do you worship instead of God that which does not benefit you at all or harm you?
tr: Qala afataAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAukum shayan wala yadurrukum

t: Uff to you and to what you worship instead of God. Then will you not use reason?”
tr: Offin lakum walima taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi afala taAAqiloona

t: They said, “Burn him and support your gods — if you are to act.”
tr: Qaloo harriqoohu waonsuroo alihatakum in kuntum faAAileena

t: We [i.e., God] said, “O fire, be coolness and safety upon Abraham.”
tr: Qulna ya naru koonee bardan wasalaman AAala ibraheema

t: And they intended for him a plan [i.e., harm], but We made them the greatest losers.
tr: Waaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alakhsareena

t: And We delivered him and Lot to the land which We had blessed for the worlds [i.e., peoples].
tr: Wanajjaynahu walootan ila alardi allatee barakna feeha lilAAalameena

t: And We gave him Isaac and Jacob in addition, and all [of them] We made righteous.
tr: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba nafilatan wakullan jaAAalna saliheena

t: And We made them leaders guiding by Our command. And We inspired to them the doing of good deeds, establishment of prayer, and giving of zakāh; and they were worshippers of Us.
tr: WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yahdoona biamrina waawhayna ilayhim fiAAla alkhayrati waiqama alssalati waeetaa alzzakati wakanoo lana AAabideena

t: And to Lot We gave judgement and knowledge, and We saved him from the city that was committing wicked deeds. Indeed, they were a people of evil, defiantly disobedient.
tr: Walootan ataynahu hukman waAAilman wanajjaynahu mina alqaryati allatee kanat taAAmalu alkhabaitha innahum kanoo qawma sawin fasiqeena

t: And We admitted him into Our mercy. Indeed, he was of the righteous.
tr: Waadkhalnahu fee rahmatina innahu mina alssaliheena

t: And [mention] Noah, when he called [to God] before [that time], so We responded to him and saved him and his family from the great affliction [i.e., the flood].
tr: Wanoohan ith nada min qablu faistajabna lahu fanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

t: And We aided [i.e., saved] him from the people who denied Our signs. Indeed, they were a people of evil, so We drowned them, all together.
tr: Wanasarnahu mina alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina innahum kanoo qawma sawin faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

t: And [mention] David and Solomon, when they judged concerning the field when the sheep of a people overran it [at night], and We were witness to their judgement.
tr: Wadawooda wasulaymana ith yahkumani fee alharthi ith nafashat feehi ghanamu alqawmi wakunna lihukmihim shahideena

t: So We made Solomon understand it, and to each of them We gave judgement and knowledge. And We subjected, along with David, the mountains glorifying, and [also] the birds. And We were doing [that].
tr: Fafahhamnaha sulaymana wakullan atayna hukman waAAilman wasakhkharna maAAa dawooda aljibala yusabbihna waalttayra wakunna faAAileena

t: And We taught him the manufacture of coats of armour to protect you in your wars. So will you then be grateful?
tr: WaAAallamnahu sanAAata laboosin lakum lituhsinakum min basikum fahal antum shakiroona

t: And to Solomon [We subjected] the wind, blowing forcefully, proceeding by his command toward the land which We had blessed. And We are ever, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Walisulaymana alrreeha AAasifatan tajree biamrihi ila alardi allatee barakna feeha wakunna bikulli shayin AAalimeena

t: And of the devils [i.e., jinn] were those who dived for him and did work other than that. And We were of them a guardian.
tr: Wamina alshshayateeni man yaghoosoona lahu wayaAAmaloona AAamalan doona thalika wakunna lahum hafitheena

t: And [mention] Job, when he called to his Lord, “Indeed, adversity has touched me, and you are the Most Merciful of the merciful.”
tr: Waayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alddurru waanta arhamu alrrahimeena

t: So We responded to him and removed what afflicted him of adversity. And We gave him [back] his family and the like thereof with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for the worshippers [of God].
tr: Faistajabna lahu fakashafna ma bihi min durrin waataynahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan min AAindina wathikra lilAAabideena

t: And [mention] Ishmael and Idrees and Dhul-Kifl; all were of the patient.
tr: WaismaAAeela waidreesa watha alkifli kullun mina alssabireena

t: And We admitted them into Our mercy. Indeed, they were of the righteous.
tr: Waadkhalnahum fee rahmatina innahum mina alssaliheena

t: And [mention] the man of the fish [i.e., Jonah], when he went off in anger and thought that We would not decree [anything] upon him. And he called out within the darknesses, “There is no deity except You; exalted are You. Indeed, I have been of the wrongdoers.”
tr: Watha alnnooni ith thahaba mughadiban fathanna an lan naqdira AAalayhi fanada fee alththulumati an la ilaha illa anta subhanaka innee kuntu mina alththalimeena

t: So We responded to him and saved him from the distress. And thus do We save the Believers.
tr: Faistajabna lahu wanajjaynahu mina alghammi wakathalika nunjee almumineena

t: And [mention] Zechariah, when he called to his Lord, “My Lord, do not leave me alone [with no heir], while You are the best of inheritors.”
tr: Wazakariyya ith nada rabbahu rabbi la tatharnee fardan waanta khayru alwaritheena

t: So We responded to him, and We gave to him John, and amended for him his wife. Indeed, they used to hasten to good deeds and supplicate Us in hope and fear, and they were to Us humbly submissive.
tr: Faistajabna lahu wawahabna lahu yahya waaslahna lahu zawjahu innahum kanoo yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wayadAAoonana raghaban warahaban wakanoo lana khashiAAeena

t: And [mention] the one who guarded her chastity [i.e., Mary], so We blew into her [garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and We made her and her son a sign for the worlds.
tr: Waallatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feeha min roohina wajaAAalnaha waibnaha ayatan lilAAalameena

t: Indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so worship Me.
tr: Inna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faoAAbudooni

t: And [yet] they divided their affair [i.e., that of their religion] among themselves, [but] all to Us will return.
tr: WataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum kullun ilayna rajiAAoona

t: So whoever does righteous deeds while he is a Believer — no denial will there be for his effort, and indeed We [i.e., Our angels], of it, are recorders.
tr: Faman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala kufrana lisaAAyihi wainna lahu katiboona

t: And there is prohibition upon [the people of] a city which We have destroyed that they will [ever] return
tr: Waharamun AAala qaryatin ahlaknaha annahum la yarjiAAoona

t: Until when [the dam of] Gog and Magog has been opened and they, from every elevation, descend
tr: Hatta itha futihat yajooju wamajooju wahum min kulli hadabin yansiloona

t: And the true promise approached; and then the eyes of those who disbelieved will be staring [in horror, while they say], “O woe to us; we had been unmindful of this; rather, we were wrongdoers.”
tr: Waiqtaraba alwaAAdu alhaqqu faitha hiya shakhisatun absaru allatheena kafaroo ya waylana qad kunna fee ghaflatin min hatha bal kunna thalimeena

t: Indeed, you [disbelievers] and what you worship other than God are the firewood of Hell. You will be coming to [enter] it.
tr: Innakum wama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi hasabu jahannama antum laha waridoona

t: Had these [false deities] been [actual] gods, they would not have come to it, they will all abide in it for ever.
tr: Law kana haolai alihatan ma waradooha wakullun feeha khalidoona

t: For them therein is heavy sighing, and they therein will not hear.
tr: Lahum feeha zafeerun wahum feeha la yasmaAAoona

t: Indeed, those for whom the best [reward] has preceded from Us — they are from it far removed.
tr: Inna allatheena sabaqat lahum minna alhusna olaika AAanha mubAAadoona

t: They will not hear its sound, while they are, in that which their souls desire, abiding eternally.
tr: La yasmaAAoona haseesaha wahum fee ma ishtahat anfusuhum khalidoona

t: They will not be grieved by the greatest terror, and the angels will meet them, [saying], “This is your Day which you have been promised” -
tr: La yahzunuhumu alfazaAAu alakbaru watatalaqqahumu almalaikatu hatha yawmukumu allathee kuntum tooAAadoona

t: The Day, We shall roll up the heaven like the rolling up of the scroll for books. As We began the first creation, We will repeat it. [That is] a promise binding upon Us. Indeed, We will do it.
tr: Yawma natwee alssamaa katayyi alssijlli lilkutubi kama badana awwala khalqin nuAAeeduhu waAAdan AAalayna inna kunna faAAileena

t: And We have already written in the book [of Psalms] after the [previous] mention that the land [of Paradise] is inherited by My righteous servants.
tr: Walaqad katabna fee alzzaboori min baAAdi alththikri anna alarda yarithuha AAibadiya alssalihoona

t: Indeed, in this [Qur’ān] is a message for a worshipping people.
tr: Inna fee hatha labalaghan liqawmin AAabideena

t: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a mercy to the worlds.
tr: Wama arsalnaka illa rahmatan lilAAalameena

t: Say, “It is only revealed to me that your god is but one God; so will you be Muslims [in submission to Him]?”
tr: Qul innama yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun fahal antum muslimoona

t: But if they turn away, then say, “I have announced to [all of] you equally. And I do not know if what you have been promised is near or far.
tr: Fain tawallaw faqul athantukum AAala sawain wain adree aqareebun am baAAeedun ma tooAAadoona

t: Indeed, He knows what is declared of speech, and He knows what you conceal.
tr: Innahu yaAAlamu aljahra mina alqawli wayaAAlamu ma taktumoona

t: And I know not; perhaps it is a trial for you and enjoyment for a time.”
tr: Wain adree laAAallahu fitnatun lakum wamataAAun ila heenin

t: [The Prophet] has said, “My Lord, judge [between us] in truth. And our Lord is the Most Merciful, the one whose help is sought against that which you describe.” Az-Zabūr
tr: Qala rabbi ohkum bialhaqqi warabbuna alrrahmanu almustaAAanu AAala ma tasifoona

t: The polytheists of Makkah,
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnasu ittaqoo rabbakum inna zalzalata alssaAAati shayon AAatheemun

t: The wavering Muslims and
tr: Yawma tarawnaha tathhalu kullu murdiAAatin AAamma ardaAAat watadaAAu kullu thati hamlin hamlaha watara alnnasa sukara wama hum bisukara walakinna AAathaba Allahi shadeedun

t: And of the people is he who disputes about God without knowledge and follows every rebellious devil.
tr: Wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wayattabiAAu kulla shaytanin mareedin

t: It has been decreed for him [i.e., every devil] that whoever turns to him – he will misguide him and will lead him to the punishment of the Blaze.
tr: Kutiba AAalayhi annahu man tawallahu faannahu yudilluhu wayahdeehi ila AAathabi alssaAAeeri

t: O People, if you should be in doubt about the Resurrection, then [consider that] indeed, We created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot, and then from a lump of flesh, formed and unformed – that We may show you. And We settle in the wombs whom We will for a specified term, then We bring you out as a child, and then [We develop you] that you may reach your [time of] maturity. And among you is he who is taken in [early] death, and among you is he who is returned to the most decrepit [old] age so that he knows, after [once having] knowledge, nothing. And you see the earth barren, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and swells and grows [something] of every beautiful kind.
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnasu in kuntum fee raybin mina albaAAthi fainna khalaqnakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min AAalaqatin thumma min mudghatin mukhallaqatin waghayri mukhallaqatin linubayyina lakum wanuqirru fee alarhami ma nashao ila ajalin musamman thumma nukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum waminkum man yutawaffa waminkum man yuraddu ila arthali alAAumuri likayla yaAAlama min baAAdi AAilmin shayan watara alarda hamidatan faitha anzalna AAalayha almaa ihtazzat warabat waanbatat min kulli zawjin baheejin

t: That is because God is the Truth and because He gives life to the dead and because He is over all things competent
tr: Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waannahu yuhyee almawta waannahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: And [that they may know] that the Hour is coming – no doubt about it – and that God will resurrect those in the graves.
tr: Waanna alssaAAata atiyatun la rayba feeha waanna Allaha yabAAathu man fee alquboori

t: And of the people is he who disputes about God without knowledge or guidance or an enlightening book [from Him],
tr: Wamina alnnasi man yujadilu fee Allahi bighayri AAilmin wala hudan wala kitabin muneerin

t: Turning his neck away to mislead others from the way of God. For him in the world is disgrace, and We will make him taste on the Day of Resurrection the punishment of the Burning Fire [while it is said],
tr: Thaniya AAitfihi liyudilla AAan sabeeli Allahi lahu fee alddunya khizyun wanutheequhu yawma alqiyamati AAathaba alhareeqi

t: “That is for what your hands have put forth and because God is not ever unjust to [His] servants.”
tr: Thalika bima qaddamat yadaka waanna Allaha laysa bithallamin lilAAabeedi

t: And of the people is he who worships God upon the edge. If he is touched by good, he is reassured by it; but if he is struck by trial, he turns on his face [to the other direction]. He has lost [this] world and the Hereafter. That is what is the manifest loss.
tr: Wamina alnnasi man yaAAbudu Allaha AAala harfin fain asabahu khayrun itmaanna bihi wain asabathu fitnatun inqalaba AAala wajhihi khasira alddunya waalakhirata thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu

t: He invokes instead of God that which neither harms him nor benefits him. That is what is the extreme error.
tr: YadAAoo min dooni Allahi ma la yadurruhu wama la yanfaAAuhu thalika huwa alddalalu albaAAeedu

t: He invokes one whose harm is closer than his benefit – how wretched the protector and how wretched the associate.
tr: YadAAoo laman darruhu aqrabu min nafAAihi labisa almawla walabisa alAAasheeru

t: Indeed, God will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. Indeed, God does what He intends.
tr: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu inna Allaha yafAAalu ma yureedu

t: Whoever should think that God will not support him [i.e., Prophet Muhammad] in this world and the Hereafter – let him extend a rope to the sky, then cut it off, and see whether his effort can really remove what enrages [him].
tr: Man kana yathunnu an lan yansurahu Allahu fee alddunya waalakhirati falyamdud bisababin ila alssamai thumma liyaqtaAA falyanthur hal yuthhibanna kayduhu ma yagheethu

t: And thus have We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down as verses of clear evidence and because God guides whom He wills.
tr: Wakathalika anzalnahu ayatin bayyinatin waanna Allaha yahdee man yureedu

t: Indeed, those who have believed and those who were Jews and the Sabeans and the Christians and the Magians and those who associated with God – God will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed God is, over all things, Witness.
tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waallatheena hadoo waalssabieena waalnnasara waalmajoosa waallatheena ashrakoo inna Allaha yafsilu baynahum yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

t: Do you not see [i.e., know] that to God prostrates whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth and the sun, the moon, the stars, the mountains, the trees, the moving creatures and many of the people? But upon many the punishment has been justified. And he whom God humiliates – for him there is no bestower of honour. Indeed, God does what He wills.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha yasjudu lahu man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi waalshshamsu waalqamaru waalnnujoomu waaljibalu waalshshajaru waalddawabbu wakatheerun mina alnnasi wakatheerun haqqa AAalayhi alAAathabu waman yuhini Allahu fama lahu min mukrimin inna Allaha yafAAalu ma yashao

t: These are two adversaries who have disputed over their Lord. But those who disbelieved will have cut out for them garments of fire. Poured upon their heads will be scalding water
tr: Hathani khasmani ikhtasamoo fee rabbihim faallatheena kafaroo quttiAAat lahum thiyabun min narin yusabbu min fawqi ruoosihimu alhameemu

t: By which is melted that within their bellies and [their] skins.
tr: Yusharu bihi ma fee butoonihim waaljuloodu

t: And for [striking] them are maces of iron.
tr: Walahum maqamiAAu min hadeedin

t: Every time they want to get out of it [i.e., Hellfire] from anguish, they will be returned to it, and [it will be said], “Taste the punishment of the Burning Fire!”
tr: Kullama aradoo an yakhrujoo minha min ghammin oAAeedoo feeha wathooqoo AAathaba alhareeqi

t: Indeed, God will admit those who believe and do righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow. They will be adorned therein with bracelets of gold and pearl, and their garments therein will be silk.
tr: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yuhallawna feeha min asawira min thahabin waluluan walibasuhum feeha hareerun

t: And they had been guided [in worldly life] to good speech, and they were guided to the path of the Praiseworthy.
tr: Wahudoo ila alttayyibi mina alqawli wahudoo ila sirati alhameedi

t: Indeed, those who have disbelieved and prevent [people] from the way of God and [from] al-Masjid al-Harām, which We made for the people – equal are the resident therein and one from outside and [also] whoever intends [a deed] therein of deviation [in religion] or wrongdoing – We will make him taste of a painful punishment.
tr: Inna allatheena kafaroo wayasuddoona AAan sabeeli Allahi waalmasjidi alharami allathee jaAAalnahu lilnnasi sawaan alAAakifu feehi waalbadi waman yurid feehi biilhadin bithulmin nuthiqhu min AAathabin aleemin

t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We designated for Abraham the site of the House, [saying], “Do not associate anything with Me and purify My House for those who perform tawāf and those who stand [in prayer] and those who bow and prostrate.
tr: Waith bawwana liibraheema makana albayti an la tushrik bee shayan watahhir baytiya lilttaifeena waalqaimeena waalrrukkaAAi alssujoodi

t: And proclaim to the people the hajj [pilgrimage]; they will come to you on foot and on every lean camel; they will come from every deep path –
tr: Waaththin fee alnnasi bialhajji yatooka rijalan waAAala kulli damirin yateena min kulli fajjin AAameeqin

t: That they may witness benefits for themselves and mention the name of God on known [i.e., specific] days over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. So eat of them and feed the miserable poor.
tr: Liyashhadoo manafiAAa lahum wayathkuroo isma Allahi fee ayyamin maAAloomatin AAala ma razaqahum min baheemati alanAAami fakuloo minha waatAAimoo albaisa alfaqeera

t: Then let them end their untidiness and fulfill their vows and perform tawāf around the ancient House.”
tr: Thumma lyaqdoo tafathahum walyoofoo nuthoorahum walyattawwafoo bialbayti alAAateeqi

t: That [has been commanded], and whoever honours the sacred ordinances of God – it is best for him in the sight of his Lord. And permitted to you are the grazing livestock, except what is recited to you. So avoid the uncleanliness of idols and avoid false statement,
tr: Thalika waman yuAAaththim hurumati Allahi fahuwa khayrun lahu AAinda rabbihi waohillat lakumu alanAAamu illa ma yutla AAalaykum faijtaniboo alrrijsa mina alawthani waijtaniboo qawla alzzoori

t: Inclining [only] to God, not associating [anything] with Him. And he who associates with God – it is as though he had fallen from the sky and was snatched by the birds or the wind carried him down into a remote place.
tr: Hunafaa lillahi ghayra mushrikeena bihi waman yushrik biAllahi fakaannama kharra mina alssamai fatakhtafuhu alttayru aw tahwee bihi alrreehu fee makanin saheeqin

t: That [is so]. And whoever honours the symbols [i.e., rites] of God – indeed, it is from the piety of hearts.
tr: Thalika waman yuAAaththim shaAAaira Allahi fainnaha min taqwa alquloobi

t: For you therein [i.e., the animals marked for sacrifice] are benefits for a specified term; then their place of sacrifice is at the ancient House.
tr: Lakum feeha manafiAAu ila ajalin musamman thumma mahilluha ila albayti alAAateeqi

t: And for all religion We have appointed a rite [of sacrifice] that they may mention the name of God over what He has provided for them of [sacrificial] animals. For your god is one God, so to Him submit. And, [O Muhammad], give good tidings to the humble [before their Lord]
tr: Walikulli ommatin jaAAalna mansakan liyathkuroo isma Allahi AAala ma razaqahum min baheemati alanAAami failahukum ilahun wahidun falahu aslimoo wabashshiri almukhbiteena

t: Who, when God is mentioned, their hearts are fearful, and [to] the patient over what has afflicted them, and the establishers of prayer and those who spend from what We have provided them.
tr: Allatheena itha thukira Allahu wajilat quloobuhum waalssabireena AAala ma asabahum waalmuqeemee alssalati wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona

t: And the camels and cattle We have appointed for you as among the symbols [i.e., rites] of God; for you therein is good. So mention the name of God upon them when lined up [for sacrifice]; and when they are [lifeless] on their sides, then eat from them and feed the needy [who does not seek aid] and the beggar. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may be grateful.
tr: Waalbudna jaAAalnaha lakum min shaAAairi Allahi lakum feeha khayrun faothkuroo isma Allahi AAalayha sawaffa faitha wajabat junoobuha fakuloo minha waatAAimoo alqaniAAa waalmuAAtarra kathalika sakhkharnaha lakum laAAallakum tashkuroona

t: Their meat will not reach God, nor will their blood, but what reaches Him is piety from you. Thus have We subjected them to you that you may glorify God for that [to] which He has guided you; and give good tidings to those who strive for excellence.
tr: Lan yanala Allaha luhoomuha wala dimaoha walakin yanaluhu alttaqwa minkum kathalika sakhkharaha lakum litukabbiroo Allaha AAala ma hadakum wabashshiri almuhsineena

t: Indeed, God defends those who have believed. Indeed, God does not like everyone treacherous and ungrateful.
tr: Inna Allaha yudafiAAu AAani allatheena amanoo inna Allaha la yuhibbu kulla khawwanin kafoorin

t: Permission [to fight] has been given to those who are being fought, because they were wronged. And indeed, God is competent to give them victory.
tr: Othina lillatheena yuqataloona biannahum thulimoo wainna Allaha AAala nasrihim laqadeerun

t: [They are] those who have been evicted from their homes without right – only because they say, “Our Lord is God.” And were it not that God checks the people, some by means of others, there would have been demolished monasteries, churches, synagogues, and mosques in which the name of God is much mentioned [i.e., praised]. And God will surely support those who support Him [i.e., His cause]. Indeed, God is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
tr: Allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim bighayri haqqin illa an yaqooloo rabbuna Allahu walawla dafAAu Allahi alnnasa baAAdahum bibaAAdin lahuddimat sawamiAAu wabiyaAAun wasalawatun wamasajidu yuthkaru feeha ismu Allahi katheeran walayansuranna Allahu man yansuruhu inna Allaha laqawiyyun AAazeezun

t: [And they are] those who, if We give them authority in the land, establish prayer and give zakāh and enjoin what is right and forbid what is wrong. And to God belongs the outcome of [all] matters.
tr: Allatheena in makkannahum fee alardi aqamoo alssalata waatawoo alzzakata waamaroo bialmaAAroofi wanahaw AAani almunkari walillahi AAaqibatu alomoori

t: And if they deny you, [O Muhammad] so, before them, did the people of Noah and ‘Aad and Thamūd deny [their prophets],
tr: Wain yukaththibooka faqad kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wathamoodu

t: And the people of Abraham and the people of Lot
tr: Waqawmu ibraheema waqawmu lootin

t: And the inhabitants of Madyan. And Moses was denied, so I prolonged enjoyment for the disbelievers; then I seized them, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
tr: Waashabu madyana wakuththiba moosa faamlaytu lilkafireena thumma akhathtuhum fakayfa kana nakeeri

t: And how many a city did We destroy while it was committing wrong – so it is [now] fallen into ruin – and [how many] an abandoned well and [how many] a lofty palace.
tr: Fakaayyin min qaryatin ahlaknaha wahiya thalimatun fahiya khawiyatun AAala AAurooshiha wabirin muAAattalatin waqasrin masheedin

t: So have they not travelled through the earth and have hearts by which to reason and ears by which to hear? For indeed, it is not eyes that are blinded, but blinded are the hearts which are within the breasts.
tr: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fatakoona lahum quloobun yaAAqiloona biha aw athanun yasmaAAoona biha fainnaha la taAAma alabsaru walakin taAAma alquloobu allatee fee alssudoori

t: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. But God will never fail in His promise. And indeed, a day with your Lord is like a thousand years of those which you count.
tr: WayastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi walan yukhlifa Allahu waAAdahu wainna yawman AAinda rabbika kaalfi sanatin mimma taAAuddoona

t: And for how many a city did I prolong enjoyment while it was committing wrong. Then I seized it, and to Me is the [final] destination.
tr: Wakaayyin min qaryatin amlaytu laha wahiya thalimatun thumma akhathtuha wailayya almaseeru

t: Say, “O people, I am only to you a clear warner.”
tr: Qul ya ayyuha alnnasu innama ana lakum natheerun mubeenun

t: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds – for them is forgiveness and noble provision.
tr: Faallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun

t: But the ones who strove against Our verses, [seeking] to frustrate [i.e., thwart] them – those are the companions of Hellfire.
tr: Waallatheena saAAaw fee ayatina muAAajizeena olaika ashabu aljaheemi

t: And We did not send before you any messenger or prophet except that when he spoke [or recited], Satan threw into it [some misunderstanding]. But God abolishes that which Satan throws in; then God makes precise His verses. And God is Knowing and Wise.
tr: Wama arsalna min qablika min rasoolin wala nabiyyin illa itha tamanna alqa alshshaytanu fee omniyyatihi fayansakhu Allahu ma yulqee alshshaytanu thumma yuhkimu Allahu ayatihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

t: [That is] so He may make what Satan throws in [i.e., asserts] a trial for those within whose hearts is disease and those hard of heart. And indeed, the wrongdoers are in extreme dissension.
tr: LiyajAAala ma yulqee alshshaytanu fitnatan lillatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalqasiyati quloobuhum wainna alththalimeena lafee shiqaqin baAAeedin

t: And so those who were given knowledge may know that it is the truth from your Lord and [therefore] believe in it, and their hearts humbly submit to it. And indeed is God the Guide of those who have believed to a straight path.
tr: WaliyaAAlama allatheena ootoo alAAilma annahu alhaqqu min rabbika fayuminoo bihi fatukhbita lahu quloobuhum wainna Allaha lahadi allatheena amanoo ila siratin mustaqeemin

t: But those who disbelieve will not cease to be in doubt of it until the Hour comes upon them unexpectedly or there comes to them the punishment of a barren Day.
tr: Wala yazalu allatheena kafaroo fee miryatin minhu hatta tatiyahumu alssaAAatu baghtatan aw yatiyahum AAathabu yawmin AAaqeemin

t: [All] sovereignty that Day is for God; He will judge between them. So they who believed and did righteous deeds will be in the Gardens of Pleasure.
tr: Almulku yawmaithin lillahi yahkumu baynahum faallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fee jannati alnnaAAeemi

t: And they who disbelieved and denied Our signs – for those there will be a humiliating punishment.
tr: Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina faolaika lahum AAathabun muheenun

t: And those who emigrated for the cause of God and then were killed or died – God will surely provide for them a good provision. And indeed, it is God who is the best of providers.
tr: Waallatheena hajaroo fee sabeeli Allahi thumma qutiloo aw matoo layarzuqannahumu Allahu rizqan hasanan wainna Allaha lahuwa khayru alrraziqeena

t: He will surely cause them to enter an entrance with which they will be pleased, and indeed, God is Knowing and Forbearing.
tr: Layudkhilannahum mudkhalan yardawnahu wainna Allaha laAAaleemun haleemun

t: That [is so]. And whoever retaliates with the equivalent of that with which he was harmed and thereafter is oppressed, God will surely help him. Indeed, God is Pardoning and Forgiving.
tr: Thalika waman AAaqaba bimithli ma AAooqiba bihi thumma bughiya AAalayhi layansurannahu Allahu inna Allaha laAAafuwwun ghafoorun

t: That is because God causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night and because God is Hearing and Seeing.
tr: Thalika bianna Allaha yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayli waanna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun

t: That is because God is the Truth, and that which they call upon other than Him is falsehood, and because God is the Most High, the Grand.
tr: Thalika bianna Allaha huwa alhaqqu waanna ma yadAAoona min doonihi huwa albatilu waanna Allaha huwa alAAaliyyu alkabeeru

t: Do you not see that God has sent down rain from the sky and the earth becomes green? Indeed, God is Subtle and Acquainted.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fatusbihu alardu mukhdarratan inna Allaha lateefun khabeerun

t: To Him belongs what is in the heavens and what is on the earth. And indeed, God is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
tr: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wainna Allaha lahuwa alghaniyyu alhameedu

t: Do you not see that God has subjected to you whatever is on the earth and the ships which run through the sea by His command? And He restrains the sky from falling upon the earth, unless by His permission. Indeed God, to the people, is Kind and Merciful.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha sakhkhara lakum ma fee alardi waalfulka tajree fee albahri biamrihi wayumsiku alssamaa an taqaAAa AAala alardi illa biithnihi inna Allaha bialnnasi laraoofun raheemun

t: And He is the one who gave you life; then He causes you to die and then will [again] give you life. Indeed, the human being is ungrateful.
tr: Wahuwa allathee ahyakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum inna alinsana lakafoorun

t: For every religion We have appointed rites which they perform. So, [O Muhammad], let them [i.e., the disbelievers] not contend with you over the matter but invite them to your Lord. Indeed, you are upon straight guidance.
tr: Likulli ommatin jaAAalna mansakan hum nasikoohu fala yunaziAAunnaka fee alamri waodAAu ila rabbika innaka laAAala hudan mustaqeemin

t: And if they dispute with you, then say, “God is most knowing of what you do.
tr: Wain jadalooka faquli Allahu aAAlamu bima taAAmaloona

t: God will judge between you on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which you used to differ.”
tr: Allahu yahkumu baynakum yawma alqiyamati feema kuntum feehi takhtalifoona

t: Do you not know that God knows what is in the heaven and earth? Indeed, that is in a Record. Indeed that, for God, is easy.
tr: Alam taAAlam anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee alssamai waalardi inna thalika fee kitabin inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun

t: And they worship besides God that for which He has not sent down authority and that of which they have no knowledge. And there will not be for the wrongdoers any helper.
tr: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma lam yunazzil bihi sultanan wama laysa lahum bihi AAilmun wama lilththalimeena min naseerin

t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, you recognize in the faces of those who disbelieve disapproval. They are almost on the verge of assaulting those who recite to them Our verses. Say, “Then shall I inform you of [what is] worse than that? [It is] the Fire which God has promised those who disbelieve, and wretched is the destination.”
tr: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin taAArifu fee wujoohi allatheena kafaroo almunkara yakadoona yastoona biallatheena yatloona AAalayhim ayatina qul afaonabbiokum bisharrin min thalikum alnnaru waAAadaha Allahu allatheena kafaroo wabisa almaseeru

t: O people, an example is presented, so listen to it. Indeed, those you invoke besides God will never create [as much as] a fly, even if they gathered together for it [i.e., that purpose]. And if the fly should steal from them a [tiny] thing, they could not recover it from him. Weak are the pursuer and pursued.
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnasu duriba mathalun faistamiAAoo lahu inna allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi lan yakhluqoo thubaban walawi ijtamaAAoo lahu wain yaslubuhumu alththubabu shayan la yastanqithoohu minhu daAAufa alttalibu waalmatloobu

t: And they did not appreciate God as He deserves to be appreciated. Indeed, God is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
tr: Ma qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi inna Allaha laqawiyyun AAazeezun

t: God chooses from the angels messengers and from the people. Indeed, God is Hearing and Seeing.
tr: Allahu yastafee mina almalaikati rusulan wamina alnnasi inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun

t: He knows what is [presently] before them and what will be after them. And to God will be returned [all] matters.
tr: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru

t: O you who have believed, bow and prostrate and worship your Lord and do good – that you may succeed.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo irkaAAoo waosjudoo waoAAbudoo rabbakum waifAAaloo alkhayra laAAallakum tuflihoona

t: And strive for God with the striving due to Him. He has chosen you and has not placed upon you in the religion any difficulty. [It is] the religion of your father, Abraham. He [i.e., God] named you “Muslims” before [in former scriptures] and in this [revelation] that the Messenger may be a witness over you and you may be witnesses over the people. So establish prayer and give zakāh and hold fast to God. He is your protector; and excellent is the protector, and excellent is the helper.
tr: Wajahidoo fee Allahi haqqa jihadihi huwa ijtabakum wama jaAAala AAalaykum fee alddeeni min harajin millata abeekum ibraheema huwa sammakumu almuslimeena min qablu wafee hatha liyakoona alrrasoolu shaheedan AAalaykum watakoonoo shuhadaa AAala alnnasi faaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waiAAtasimoo biAllahi huwa mawlakum faniAAma almawla waniAAma alnnaseeru

t: Certainly will the Believers have succeeded:
tr: Qad aflaha almuminoona

t: They who are during their prayer humbly submissive
tr: Allatheena hum fee salatihim khashiAAoona

t: And they who turn away from ill speech
tr: Waallatheena hum AAani allaghwi muAAridoona

t: And they who are observant of zakāh
tr: Waallatheena hum lilzzakati faAAiloona

t: And they who guard their private parts
tr: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona

t: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they will not be blamed –
tr: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

t: But whoever seeks beyond that, then those are the transgressors –
tr: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

t: And they who are to their trusts and their promises attentive
tr: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona

t: And they who carefully maintain their prayers –
tr: Waallatheena hum AAala salawatihim yuhafithoona

t: Those are the inheritors
tr: Olaika humu alwarithoona

t: Who will inherit al-Firdaus. They will abide therein eternally.
tr: Allatheena yarithoona alfirdawsa hum feeha khalidoona

t: And certainly did We create the human being from an extract of clay.
tr: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana min sulalatin min teenin

t: Then We placed him as a sperm-drop in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb].
tr: Thumma jaAAalnahu nutfatan fee qararin makeenin

t: Then We made the sperm-drop into a clinging clot, and We made the clot into a lump [of flesh], and We made [from] the lump, bones, and We covered the bones with flesh; then We developed him into another creation. So blessed is God, the best of creators.
tr: Thumma khalaqna alnnutfata AAalaqatan fakhalaqna alAAalaqata mudghatan fakhalaqna almudghata AAithaman fakasawna alAAithama lahman thumma anshanahu khalqan akhara fatabaraka Allahu ahsanu alkhaliqeena

t: Then indeed, after that you are to die.
tr: Thumma innakum baAAda thalika lamayyitoona

t: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, will be resurrected.
tr: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati tubAAathoona

t: And We have created above you seven layered heavens, and never have We been of [Our] creation unaware.
tr: Walaqad khalaqna fawqakum sabAAa taraiqa wama kunna AAani alkhalqi ghafileena

t: And We have sent down rain from the sky in a measured amount and settled it in the earth. And indeed, We are Able to take it away.
tr: Waanzalna mina alssamai maan biqadarin faaskannahu fee alardi wainna AAala thahabin bihi laqadiroona

t: And We brought forth for you thereby gardens of palm trees and grapevines in which for you are abundant fruits and from which you eat.
tr: Faanshana lakum bihi jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin lakum feeha fawakihu katheeratun waminha takuloona

t: And [We brought forth] a tree issuing from Mount Sinai which produces oil and food [i.e., olives] for those who eat.
tr: Washajaratan takhruju min toori saynaa tanbutu bialdduhni wasibghin lilakileena

t: And indeed, for you in livestock is a lesson. We give you drink from that which is in their bellies, and for you in them are numerous benefits, and from them you eat.
tr: Wainna lakum fee alanAAami laAAibratan nusqeekum mimma fee butooniha walakum feeha manafiAAu katheeratun waminha takuloona

t: And upon them and on ships you are carried.
tr: WaAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona

t: And We had certainly sent Noah to his people, and he said, “O my people, worship God; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?”
tr: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

t: But the eminent among those who disbelieved from his people said, “This is not but a man like yourselves who wishes to take precedence over you; and if God had willed [to send a messenger], He would have sent down angels. We have not heard of this among our forefathers.
tr: Faqala almalao allatheena kafaroo min qawmihi ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yureedu an yatafaddala AAalaykum walaw shaa Allahu laanzala malaikatan ma samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena

t: He is not but a man possessed with madness, so wait concerning him for a time.”
tr: In huwa illa rajulun bihi jinnatun fatarabbasoo bihi hatta heenin

t: [Noah] said, “My Lord, support me because they have denied me.”
tr: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

t: So We inspired to him, “Construct the ship under Our observation, and Our inspiration, and when Our command comes and the oven overflows, put into it [i.e., the ship] from each [creature] two mates and your family, except those for whom the decree [of destruction] has proceeded. And do not address Me concerning those who have wronged; indeed, they are to be drowned.
tr: Faawhayna ilayhi ani isnaAAi alfulka biaAAyunina wawahyina faitha jaa amruna wafara alttannooru faosluk feeha min kullin zawjayni ithnayni waahlaka illa man sabaqa AAalayhi alqawlu minhum wala tukhatibnee fee allatheena thalamoo innahum mughraqoona

t: And when you have boarded the ship, you and those with you, then say, ‘Praise to God who has saved us form the wrongdoing people.’
tr: Faitha istawayta anta waman maAAaka AAala alfulki faquli alhamdu lillahi allathee najjana mina alqawmi alththalimeena

t: And say, ‘My Lord, let me land at a blessed landing place, and You are the best to accommodate [us].’ ”
tr: Waqul rabbi anzilnee munzalan mubarakan waanta khayru almunzileena

t: Indeed in that are signs, and indeed, We are ever testing [Our servants].
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatin wain kunna lamubtaleena

t: Then We produced after them a generation of others.
tr: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim qarnan akhareena

t: And We sent among them a messenger from themselves, [saying], “Worship God; you have no deity other than Him; then will you not fear Him?”
tr: Faarsalna feehim rasoolan minhum ani oAAbudoo Allaha ma lakum min ilahin ghayruhu afala tattaqoona

t: And the eminent among his people who disbelieved and denied the meeting of the Hereafter while We had given them luxury in the worldly life said, “This is not but a man like yourselves. He eats of that from which you eat and drinks of what you drink.
tr: Waqala almalao min qawmihi allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biliqai alakhirati waatrafnahum fee alhayati alddunya ma hatha illa basharun mithlukum yakulu mimma takuloona minhu wayashrabu mimma tashraboona

t: And if you should obey a man like yourselves, indeed, you would then be losers.
tr: Walain ataAAtum basharan mithlakum innakum ithan lakhasiroona

t: Does he promise you that when you have died and become dust and bones that you will be brought forth [once more]?
tr: AyaAAidukum annakum itha mittum wakuntum turaban waAAithaman annakum mukhrajoona

t: How far, how far, is that which you are promised.
tr: Hayhata hayhata lima tooAAadoona

t: It [i.e., life] is not but our worldly life – we die and live, but we will not be resurrected.
tr: In hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama nahnu bimabAAootheena

t: He is not but a man who has invented a lie about God, and we will not believe him.”
tr: In huwa illa rajulun iftara AAala Allahi kathiban wama nahnu lahu bimumineena

t: He said, “My Lord, support me because they have denied me.”
tr: Qala rabbi onsurnee bima kaththabooni

t: [God] said, “After a little, they will surely become regretful.”
tr: Qala AAamma qaleelin layusbihunna nadimeena

t: So the shriek seized them in truth, and We made them as [plant] stubble. Then away with the wrongdoing people.
tr: Faakhathathumu alssayhatu bialhaqqi fajaAAalnahum ghuthaan fabuAAdan lilqawmi alththalimeena

t: Then We produced after them other generations.
tr: Thumma anshana min baAAdihim quroonan akhareena

t: No nation can advance or delay its term.
tr: Ma tasbiqu min ommatin ajalaha wama yastakhiroona

t: Then We sent Our messengers in succession. Every time there came to a nation its messenger, they denied him, so We made them follow one another [to destruction], and We made them narrations. So away with a people who do not believe.
tr: Thumma arsalna rusulana tatra kulla ma jaa ommatan rasooluha kaththaboohu faatbaAAna baAAdahum baAAdan wajaAAalnahum ahadeetha fabuAAdan liqawmin la yuminoona

t: Then We sent Moses and his brother Aaron with Our signs and a clear authority
tr: Thumma arsalna moosa waakhahu haroona biayatina wasultanin mubeenin

t: To Pharaoh and his establishment, but they were arrogant and were a haughty people.
tr: Ila firAAawna wamalaihi faistakbaroo wakanoo qawman AAaleena

t: They said, “Should we believe two men like ourselves while their people are for us in servitude?”
tr: Faqaloo anuminu libasharayni mithlina waqawmuhuma lana AAabidoona

t: So they denied them and were of those destroyed.
tr: Fakaththaboohuma fakanoo mina almuhlakeena

t: And We certainly gave Moses the Book that perhaps they would be guided.
tr: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba laAAallahum yahtadoona

t: And We made the son of Mary and his mother a sign and sheltered them within a high ground having level [areas] and flowing water.
tr: WajaAAalna ibna maryama waommahu ayatan waawaynahuma ila rabwatin thati qararin wamaAAeenin

t: [God said], “O messengers, eat from the good foods and work righteousness. Indeed I, of what you do, am Knowing.
tr: Ya ayyuha alrrusulu kuloo mina alttayyibati waiAAmaloo salihan innee bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun

t: And indeed this, your religion, is one religion, and I am your Lord, so fear Me.”
tr: Wainna hathihi ommatukum ommatan wahidatan waana rabbukum faittaqooni

t: But they [i.e., the people] divided their religion among them into portions [i.e., sects] – each faction, in what it has, rejoicing.
tr: FataqattaAAoo amrahum baynahum zuburan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona

t: So leave them in their confusion for a time.
tr: Fatharhum fee ghamratihim hatta heenin

t: Do they think that what We extend to them of wealth and children
tr: Ayahsaboona annama numidduhum bihi min malin wabaneena

t: Is [because] We hasten for them good things? Rather, they do not perceive.
tr: NusariAAu lahum fee alkhayrati bal la yashAAuroona

t: Indeed, they who are apprehensive from fear of their Lord
tr: Inna allatheena hum min khashyati rabbihim mushfiqoona

t: And they who believe in the signs of their Lord
tr: Waallatheena hum biayati rabbihim yuminoona

t: And they who do not associate anything with their Lord
tr: Waallatheena hum birabbihim la yushrikoona

t: And they who give what they give while their hearts are fearful because they will be returning to their Lord –
tr: Waallatheena yutoona ma ataw waquloobuhum wajilatun annahum ila rabbihim rajiAAoona

t: It is those who hasten to good deeds, and they outstrip [others] therein.
tr: Olaika yusariAAoona fee alkhayrati wahum laha sabiqoona

t: And We charge no soul except [with that within] its capacity, and with Us is a record which speaks with truth; and they will not be wronged.
tr: Wala nukallifu nafsan illa wusAAaha waladayna kitabun yantiqu bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona

t: But their hearts are covered with confusion over this, and they have [evil] deeds besides that [i.e., disbelief] which they are doing,
tr: Bal quloobuhum fee ghamratin min hatha walahum aAAmalun min dooni thalika hum laha AAamiloona

t: Until when We seize their affluent ones with punishment, at once they are crying [to God] for help.
tr: Hatta itha akhathna mutrafeehim bialAAathabi itha hum yajaroona

t: Do not cry out today. Indeed, by Us you will not be helped.
tr: La tajaroo alyawma innakum minna la tunsaroona

t: My verses had already been recited to you, but you were turning back on your heels
tr: Qad kanat ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum AAala aAAqabikum tankisoona

t: In arrogance regarding it, conversing by night, speaking evil.
tr: Mustakbireena bihi samiran tahjuroona

t: Then have they not reflected over the word [i.e., the Qur’ān], or has there come to them that which had not come to their forefathers?
tr: Afalam yaddabbaroo alqawla am jaahum ma lam yati abaahumu alawwaleena

t: Or did they not know their Messenger, and so they deny him?
tr: Am lam yaAArifoo rasoolahum fahum lahu munkiroona

t: Or do they say, “In him is madness?” Rather, he brought them the truth, but most of them, to the truth, are averse.
tr: Am yaqooloona bihi jinnatun bal jaahum bialhaqqi waaktharuhum lilhaqqi karihoona

t: But if the Truth [i.e., God] had followed their inclinations, the heavens and the earth and whoever is in them would have been ruined. Rather, We have brought them their message, but they, from their message, are turning away.
tr: Walawi ittabaAAa alhaqqu ahwaahum lafasadati alssamawatu waalardu waman feehinna bal ataynahum bithikrihim fahum AAan thikrihim muAAridoona

t: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask them for payment? But the reward of your Lord is best, and He is the best of providers.
tr: Am tasaluhum kharjan fakharaju rabbika khayrun wahuwa khayru alrraziqeena

t: And indeed, you invite them to a straight path.
tr: Wainnaka latadAAoohum ila siratin mustaqeemin

t: But indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter are deviating from the path.
tr: Wainna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati AAani alssirati lanakiboona

t: And even if We gave them mercy and removed what was upon them of affliction, they would persist in their transgression, wandering blindly.
tr: Walaw rahimnahum wakashafna ma bihim min durrin lalajjoo fee tughyanihim yaAAmahoona

t: And We had gripped them with suffering [as a warning], but they did not yield to their Lord, nor did they humbly supplicate, [and will continue thus]
tr: Walaqad akhathnahum bialAAathabi fama istakanoo lirabbihim wama yatadarraAAoona

t: Until when We have opened before them a door of severe punishment, immediately they will be therein in despair.
tr: Hatta itha fatahna AAalayhim baban tha AAathabin shadeedin itha hum feehi mublisoona

t: And it is He who produced for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.
tr: Wahuwa allathee anshaa lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

t: And it is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.
tr: Wahuwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

t: And it is He who gives life and causes death, and His is the alternation of the night and the day. Then will you not reason?
tr: Wahuwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu walahu ikhtilafu allayli waalnnahari afala taAAqiloona

t: Rather, they say like what the former peoples said.
tr: Bal qaloo mithla ma qala alawwaloona

t: They said, “When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr: Qaloo aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

t: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before; this is not but legends of the former peoples.”
tr: Laqad wuAAidna nahnu waabaona hatha min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “To whom belongs the earth and whoever is in it, if you should know?”
tr: Qul limani alardu waman feeha in kuntum taAAlamoona

t: They will say, “To God.” Say, “Then will you not remember?”
tr: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tathakkaroona

t: Say, “Who is Lord of the seven heavens and Lord of the Great Throne?”
tr: Qul man rabbu alssamawati alssabAAi warabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi

t: They will say, “[They belong] to God.” Say, “Then will you not fear Him?”
tr: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul afala tattaqoona

t: Say, “In whose hand is the realm of all things – and He protects while none can protect against Him – if you should know?”
tr: Qul man biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wahuwa yujeeru wala yujaru AAalayhi in kuntum taAAlamoona

t: They will say, “[All belongs] to God.” Say, “Then how are you deluded?”
tr: Sayaqooloona lillahi qul faanna tusharoona

t: Rather, We have brought them the truth, and indeed they are liars.
tr: Bal ataynahum bialhaqqi wainnahum lakathiboona
