t: God has not taken any son, nor has there ever been with Him any deity. [If there had been], then each deity would have taken what it created, and some of them would have sought to overcome others. Exalted is God above what they describe [concerning Him].
tr: Ma ittakhatha Allahu min waladin wama kana maAAahu min ilahin ithan lathahaba kullu ilahin bima khalaqa walaAAala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona

t: [He is] Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, so high is He above what they associate [with Him].
tr: AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “My Lord, if You should show me that which they are promised,
tr: Qul rabbi imma turiyannee ma yooAAadoona

t: My Lord, then do not place me among the wrongdoing people.”
tr: Rabbi fala tajAAalnee fee alqawmi alththalimeena

t: And indeed, We are able to show you what We have promised them.
tr: Wainna AAala an nuriyaka ma naAAiduhum laqadiroona

t: Repel, by [means of] what is best, [their] evil. We are most knowing of what they describe.
tr: IdfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu alssayyiata nahnu aAAlamu bima yasifoona

t: And say, “My Lord, I seek refuge in You from the incitements of the devils,
tr: Waqul rabbi aAAoothu bika min hamazati alshshayateeni

t: And I seek refuge in You, my Lord, lest they be present with me.”
tr: WaaAAoothu bika rabbi an yahdurooni

t: [For such is the state of the disbelievers], until, when death comes to one of them, he says, “My Lord, send me back
tr: Hatta itha jaa ahadahumu almawtu qala rabbi irjiAAooni

t: That I might do righteousness in that which I left behind.” No! It is only a word he is saying; and behind them is a barrier until the Day they are resurrected.
tr: LaAAallee aAAmalu salihan feema taraktu kalla innaha kalimatun huwa qailuha wamin waraihim barzakhun ila yawmi yubAAathoona

t: So when the Horn is blown, no relationship will there be among them that Day, nor will they ask about one another.
tr: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori fala ansaba baynahum yawmaithin wala yatasaaloona

t: And those whose scales are heavy [with good deeds] – it is they who are the successful.
tr: Faman thaqulat mawazeenuhu faolaika humu almuflihoona

t: But those whose scales are light – those are the ones who have lost their souls, [being] in Hell, abiding eternally.
tr: Waman khaffat mawazeenuhu faolaika allatheena khasiroo anfusahum fee jahannama khalidoona

t: The Fire will sear their faces, and they therein will have taut smiles.
tr: Talfahu wujoohahumu alnnaru wahum feeha kalihoona

t: [It will be said]. “Were not My verses recited to you and you used to deny them?”
tr: Alam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum fakuntum biha tukaththiboona

t: They will say, “Our Lord, our wretchedness overcame us, and we were a people astray.
tr: Qaloo rabbana ghalabat AAalayna shiqwatuna wakunna qawman dalleena

t: Our Lord, remove us from it, and if we were to return [to evil], we would indeed be wrongdoers.”
tr: Rabbana akhrijna minha fain AAudna fainna thalimoona

t: He will say, “Remain despised therein and do not speak to Me.
tr: Qala ikhsaoo feeha wala tukallimooni

t: Indeed, there was a party of My servants who said, ‘Our Lord, we have believed, so forgive us and have mercy upon us, and You are the best of the merciful.’
tr: Innahu kana fareequn min AAibadee yaqooloona rabbana amanna faighfir lana wairhamna waanta khayru alrrahimeena

t: But you took them in mockery to the point that they made you forget My remembrance, and you used to laugh at them.
tr: Faittakhathtumoohum sikhriyyan hatta ansawkum thikree wakuntum minhum tadhakoona

t: Indeed, I have rewarded them this Day for their patient endurance – that they are the attainers [of success].”
tr: Innee jazaytuhumu alyawma bima sabaroo annahum humu alfaizoona

t: [God] will say, “How long did you remain on earth in number of years?”
tr: Qala kam labithtum fee alardi AAadada sineena

t: They will say, “We remained a day or part of a day; ask those who enumerate.”
tr: Qaloo labithna yawman aw baAAda yawmin faisali alAAaddeena

t: He will say, “You stayed not but a little – if only you had known.
tr: Qala in labithtum illa qaleelan law annakum kuntum taAAlamoona

t: Then did you think that We created you uselessly and that to Us you would not be returned?”
tr: Afahasibtum annama khalaqnakum AAabathan waannakum ilayna la turjaAAoona

t: So exalted is God, the Sovereign, the Truth; there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Noble Throne.
tr: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alkareemi

t: And whoever invokes besides God another deity for which he has no proof – then his account is only with his Lord. Indeed, the disbelievers will not succeed.
tr: Waman yadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la burhana lahu bihi fainnama hisabuhu AAinda rabbihi innahu la yuflihu alkafiroona

t: And, [O Muhammad], say, “My Lord, forgive and have mercy, and You are the best of the merciful.”
tr: Waqul rabbi ighfir wairham waanta khayru alrrahimeena

t: [This is] a sūrah which We have sent down and made [that within it] obligatory and revealed therein verses of clear evidence that you might remember.
tr: Sooratun anzalnaha wafaradnaha waanzalna feeha ayatin bayyinatin laAAallakum tathakkaroona

t: The [unmarried] woman or [unmarried] man found guilty of sexual intercourse - lash each one of them with a hundred lashes, and do not be taken by pity for them in the religion [i.e., Law] of God, if you should believe in God and the Last Day. And let a group of the Believers witness their punishment.
tr: Alzzaniyatu waalzzanee faijlidoo kulla wahidin minhuma miata jaldatin wala takhuthkum bihima rafatun fee deeni Allahi in kuntum tuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri walyashhad AAathabahuma taifatun mina almumineena

t: The fornicator does not marry except a [female] fornicator or polytheist, and none marries her except a fornicator or a polytheist, and that [i.e., marriage to such persons] has been made unlawful to the Believers.
tr: Alzzanee la yankihu illa zaniyatan aw mushrikatan waalzzaniyatu la yankihuha illa zanin aw mushrikun wahurrima thalika AAala almumineena

t: And those who accuse chaste women and then do not produce four witnesses - lash them with eighty lashes and do not accept from them testimony ever after. And those are the defiantly disobedient,
tr: Waallatheena yarmoona almuhsanati thumma lam yatoo biarbaAAati shuhadaa faijlidoohum thamaneena jaldatan wala taqbaloo lahum shahadatan abadan waolaika humu alfasiqoona

t: Except for those who repent thereafter and reform, for indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful. ū
tr: Illa allatheena taboo min baAAdi thalika waaslahoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: And those who accuse their wives [of adultery] and have no witnesses except them [shall be] four testimonies [swearing] by God that indeed, he is of the truthful.
tr: Waallatheena yarmoona azwajahum walam yakun lahum shuhadao illa anfusuhum fashahadatu ahadihim arbaAAu shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alssadiqeena

t: And the fifth [oath will be] that the curse of God be upon him if he should be among the liars.
tr: Waalkhamisatu anna laAAnata Allahi AAalayhi in kana mina alkathibeena

t: But it will prevent punishment from her if she gives four testimonies [swearing] by God that indeed, he is of the liars.
tr: Wayadrao AAanha alAAathaba an tashhada arbaAAa shahadatin biAllahi innahu lamina alkathibeena

t: And the fifth [oath will be] that the wrath of God be upon her if he was of the truthful.
tr: Waalkhamisata anna ghadaba Allahi AAalayha in kana mina alssadiqeena

t: And if not for the favour of God upon you and His mercy… and because God is Accepting of repentance and Wise.
tr: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha tawwabun hakeemun

t: Indeed, those who came with falsehood are a group among you. Do not think it bad for you; rather it is good for you. For every person among them is what [punishment] he has earned from the sin, and he who took upon himself the greater portion thereof - for him is a great punishment [i.e., Hellfire].
tr: Inna allatheena jaoo bialifki AAusbatun minkum la tahsaboohu sharran lakum bal huwa khayrun lakum likulli imriin minhum ma iktasaba mina alithmi waallathee tawalla kibrahu minhum lahu AAathabun AAatheemun

t: Why, when you heard it, did not the believing men and believing women think good of themselves [i.e., one another] and say, ‘This is an obvious falsehood”?
tr: Lawla ith samiAAtumoohu thanna almuminoona waalmuminatu bianfusihim khayran waqaloo hatha ifkun mubeenun

t: Why did they [who slandered] not produce for it four witnesses? And when they do not produce the witnesses, then it is they, in the sight of God, who are the liars.
tr: Lawla jaoo AAalayhi biarbaAAati shuhadaa faith lam yatoo bialshshuhadai faolaika AAinda Allahi humu alkathiboona

t: And if it had not been for the favour of God upon you and His mercy in this world and the Hereafter, you would have been touched for that [lie] in which you were involved by a great punishment
tr: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu fee alddunya waalakhirati lamassakum fee ma afadtum feehi AAathabun AAatheemun

t: When you received it with your tongues, your mouths uttering something about which you had no knowledge. You considered it to be a trivial matter, while it was, in the sight of God, tremendous.
tr: Ith talaqqawnahu bialsinatikum wataqooloona biafwahikum ma laysa lakum bihi AAilmun watahsaboonahu hayyinan wahuwa AAinda Allahi AAatheemun

t: And why, when you heard it, did you not say, “It is not for us to speak of this. Exalted are You, [O God]; this is a great slander”?
tr: Walawla ith samiAAtumoohu qultum ma yakoonu lana an natakallama bihatha subhanaka hatha buhtanun AAatheemun

t: God warns you against returning to the likes of this [conduct], ever, if you should be Believers.
tr: YaAAithukumu Allahu an taAAoodoo limithlihi abadan in kuntum mumineena

t: And God makes clear to you the verses [i.e., His rulings], and God is Knowing and Wise.
tr: Wayubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

t: Indeed, those who like that immorality should be spread [or publicized] among those who have believed will have a painful punishment in this world and the Hereafter. And God knows and you do not know.
tr: Inna allatheena yuhibboona an tasheeAAa alfahishatu fee allatheena amanoo lahum AAathabun aleemun fee alddunya waalakhirati waAllahu yaAAlamu waantum la taAAlamoona

t: And if it had not been for the favour of God upon you and His mercy… and because God is Kind and Merciful.
tr: Walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu waanna Allaha raoofun raheemun

t: O you who have believed, do not follow the footsteps of Satan. And whoever follows the footsteps of Satan - indeed, he enjoins immorality and wrongdoing. And if not for the favour of God upon you and His mercy, not one of you would have been pure, ever, but God purifies whom He wills, and God is Hearing and Knowing.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattabiAAoo khutuwati alshshaytani waman yattabiAA khutuwati alshshaytani fainnahu yamuru bialfahshai waalmunkari walawla fadlu Allahi AAalaykum warahmatuhu ma zaka minkum min ahadin abadan walakinna Allaha yuzakkee man yashao waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun

t: And let not those of virtue among you and wealth swear not to give [aid] to their relatives and the needy and the emigrants for the cause of God, and let them pardon and overlook. Would you not like that God should forgive you? And God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Wala yatali oloo alfadli minkum waalssaAAati an yutoo olee alqurba waalmasakeena waalmuhajireena fee sabeeli Allahi walyaAAfoo walyasfahoo ala tuhibboona an yaghfira Allahu lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

t: Indeed, those who [falsely] accuse chaste, unaware and believing women are cursed in this world and the Hereafter; and they will have a great punishment
tr: Inna allatheena yarmoona almuhsanati alghafilati almuminati luAAinoo fee alddunya waalakhirati walahum AAathabun AAatheemun

t: On a Day when their tongues, their hands and their feet will bear witness against them as to what they used to do.
tr: Yawma tashhadu AAalayhim alsinatuhum waaydeehim waarjuluhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: That Day, God will pay them in full their true [i.e., deserved] recompense, and they will know that it is God who is the manifest Truth.
tr: Yawmaithin yuwaffeehimu Allahu deenahumu alhaqqa wayaAAlamoona anna Allaha huwa alhaqqu almubeenu

t: Evil words are for evil men, and evil men are [subjected] to evil words. And good words are for good men, and good men are [an object] of good words. Those [good people] are declared innocent of what they [i.e., slanderers] say. For them is forgiveness and noble provision.
tr: Alkhabeethatu lilkhabeetheena waalkhabeethoona lilkhabeethati waalttayyibatu lilttayyibeena waalttayyiboona lilttayyibati olaika mubarraoona mimma yaqooloona lahum maghfiratun warizqun kareemun

t: O you who have believed, do not enter houses other than your own houses until you ascertain welcome and greet their inhabitants. That is best for you; perhaps you will be reminded [i.e., advised].
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra buyootikum hatta tastanisoo watusallimoo AAala ahliha thalikum khayrun lakum laAAallakum tathakkaroona

t: And if you do not find anyone therein, do not enter them until permission has been given you. And if it is said to you, “Go back,” then go back; it is purer for you. And God is Knowing of what you do.
tr: Fain lam tajidoo feeha ahadan fala tadkhulooha hatta yuthana lakum wain qeela lakumu irjiAAoo fairjiAAoo huwa azka lakum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona AAaleemun

t: There is no blame upon you for entering houses not inhabited in which there is convenience for you. And God knows what you reveal and what you conceal.
tr: Laysa AAalaykum junahun an tadkhuloo buyootan ghayra maskoonatin feeha mataAAun lakum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma tubdoona wama taktumoona

t: Tell the believing men to lower their glances and guard their private parts. That is purer for them. Indeed, God is Acquainted with what they do.
tr: Qul lilmumineena yaghuddoo min absarihum wayahfathoo furoojahum thalika azka lahum inna Allaha khabeerun bima yasnaAAoona

t: And tell the believing women to lower their glances and guard their private parts and not expose their adornment except that which [necessarily] appears thereof and to wrap [a portion of] their headcovers over their chests and not expose their adornment [i.e., beauty] except to their husbands, their fathers, their husbands’ fathers, their sons, their husbands’ sons, their brothers, their brothers’ sons, their sisters’ sons, their women, that which their right hands possess [i.e., slaves], or those male attendants having no physical desire, or children who are not yet aware of the private aspects of women. And let them not stamp their feet to make known what they conceal of their adornment. And turn to God in repentance, all of you, O Believers, that you might succeed.
tr: Waqul lilmuminati yaghdudna min absarihinna wayahfathna furoojahunna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa ma thahara minha walyadribna bikhumurihinna AAala juyoobihinna wala yubdeena zeenatahunna illa libuAAoolatihinna aw abaihinna aw abai buAAoolatihinna aw abnaihinna aw abnai buAAoolatihinna aw ikhwanihinna aw banee ikhwanihinna aw banee akhawatihinna aw nisaihinna aw ma malakat aymanuhunna awi alttabiAAeena ghayri olee alirbati mina alrrijali awi alttifli allatheena lam yathharoo AAala AAawrati alnnisai wala yadribna biarjulihinna liyuAAlama ma yukhfeena min zeenatihinna watooboo ila Allahi jameeAAan ayyuha almuminoona laAAallakum tuflihoona

t: And marry the unmarried among you and the righteous among your male slaves and female slaves. If they should be poor, God will enrich them from His bounty, and God is all-Encompassing and Knowing.
tr: Waankihoo alayama minkum waalssaliheena min AAibadikum waimaikum in yakoonoo fuqaraa yughnihimu Allahu min fadlihi waAllahu wasiAAun AAaleemun

t: But let them who find not [the means for] marriage abstain [from sexual relations] until God enriches them from His bounty. And those who seek a contract [for eventual emancipation] from among whom your right hands possess - then make a contract with them if you know there is within them goodness and give them from the wealth of God which He has given you. And do not compel your slave girls to prostitution, if they desire chastity, to seek [thereby] the temporary interests of worldly life. And if someone should compel them, then indeed, God is [to them], after their compulsion, Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: WalyastaAAfifi allatheena la yajidoona nikahan hatta yughniyahumu Allahu min fadlihi waallatheena yabtaghoona alkitaba mimma malakat aymanukum fakatiboohum in AAalimtum feehim khayran waatoohum min mali Allahi allathee atakum wala tukrihoo fatayatikum AAala albighai in aradna tahassunan litabtaghoo AAarada alhayati alddunya waman yukrihhunna fainna Allaha min baAAdi ikrahihinna ghafoorun raheemun

t: And We have certainly sent down to you distinct verses and examples from those who passed on before you and an admonition for those who fear God.
tr: Walaqad anzalna ilaykum ayatin mubayyinatin wamathalan mina allatheena khalaw min qablikum wamawAAithatan lilmuttaqeena

t: God is the Light of the heavens and the earth. The example of His light is like a niche within which is a lamp, the lamp is within glass, the glass as if it were a pearly [white] star lit from [the oil of] a blessed olive tree, neither of the east nor of the west, whose oil would almost glow even if untouched by fire. Light upon light. God guides to His light whom He wills. And God presents examples for the people, and God is Knowing of all things.
tr: Allahu nooru alssamawati waalardi mathalu noorihi kamishkatin feeha misbahun almisbahu fee zujajatin alzzujajatu kaannaha kawkabun durriyyun yooqadu min shajaratin mubarakatin zaytoonatin la sharqiyyatin wala gharbiyyatin yakadu zaytuha yudeeo walaw lam tamsashu narun noorun AAala noorin yahdee Allahu linoorihi man yashao wayadribu Allahu alamthala lilnnasi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: [Such niches are] in houses [i.e., mosques] which God has ordered to be raised and that His name be mentioned therein; exalting Him within them in the morning and the evenings
tr: Fee buyootin athina Allahu an turfaAAa wayuthkara feeha ismuhu yusabbihu lahu feeha bialghuduwwi waalasali

t: [Are] men whom neither commerce nor sale distracts from the remembrance of God and performance of prayer and giving of zakāh. They fear a Day in which the hearts and eyes will [fearfully] turn about -
tr: Rijalun la tulheehim tijaratun wala bayAAun AAan thikri Allahi waiqami alssalati waeetai alzzakati yakhafoona yawman tataqallabu feehi alquloobu waalabsaru

t: That God may reward them [according to] the best of what they did and increase them from His bounty. And God gives provision to whom He wills without account [i.e., limit].
tr: Liyajziyahumu Allahu ahsana ma AAamiloo wayazeedahum min fadlihi waAllahu yarzuqu man yashao bighayri hisabin

t: But those who disbelieved - their deeds are like a mirage in a lowland which a thirsty one thinks is water until, when he comes to it, he finds it is nothing but finds God before Him, and He will pay him in full his due; and God is swift in account.
tr: Waallatheena kafaroo aAAmaluhum kasarabin biqeeAAatin yahsabuhu alththamanu maan hatta itha jaahu lam yajidhu shayan wawajada Allaha AAindahu fawaffahu hisabahu waAllahu sareeAAu alhisabi

t: Or [they are] like darknesses within an unfathomable sea which is covered by waves, upon which are waves, over which are clouds - darknesses, some of them upon others. When one puts out his hand [therein], he can hardly see it. And he to whom God has not granted light - for him there is no light.
tr: Aw kathulumatin fee bahrin lujjiyyin yaghshahu mawjun min fawqihi mawjun min fawqihi sahabun thulumatun baAAduha fawqa baAAdin itha akhraja yadahu lam yakad yaraha waman lam yajAAali Allahu lahu nooran fama lahu min noorin

t: Do you not see that God is exalted by whomever is within the heavens and the earth and [by] the birds with wings spread [in flight]? Each [of them] has known his [means of] prayer and exalting [Him], and God is Knowing of what they do.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha yusabbihu lahu man fee alssamawati waalardi waalttayru saffatin kullun qad AAalima salatahu watasbeehahu waAllahu AAaleemun bima yafAAaloona

t: And to God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth, and to God is the destination.
tr: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi almaseeru

t: Do you not see that God drives clouds? Then He brings them together, then He makes them into a mass, and you see the rain emerge from within it. And He sends down from the sky, mountains [of clouds] within which is hail, and He strikes with it whom He wills and averts it from whom He wills. The flash of its lightening almost takes away the eyesight.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha yuzjee sahaban thumma yuallifu baynahu thumma yajAAaluhu rukaman fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi wayunazzilu mina alssamai min jibalin feeha min baradin fayuseebu bihi man yashao wayasrifuhu AAan man yashao yakadu sana barqihi yathhabu bialabsari

t: God alternates the night and the day. Indeed in that is a lesson for those who have vision.
tr: Yuqallibu Allahu allayla waalnnahara inna fee thalika laAAibratan liolee alabsari

t: God has created every [living] creature from water. And of them are those that move on their bellies, and of them are those that walk on two legs, and of them are those that walk on four. God creates what He wills. Indeed, God is over all things competent.
tr: WaAllahu khalaqa kulla dabbatin min main faminhum man yamshee AAala batnihi waminhum man yamshee AAala rijlayni waminhum man yamshee AAala arbaAAin yakhluqu Allahu ma yashao inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: We have certainly sent down distinct verses. And God guides whom He wills to a straight path.
tr: Laqad anzalna ayatin mubayyinatin waAllahu yahdee man yashao ila siratin mustaqeemin

t: But they [i.e., the hypocrites] say, “We have believed in God and in the Messenger, and we obey”; then a party of them turns away after that. And those are not Believers.
tr: Wayaqooloona amanna biAllahi wabialrrasooli waataAAna thumma yatawalla fareequn minhum min baAAdi thalika wama olaika bialmumineena

t: And when they are called to [the words of] God and His Messenger to judge between them, at once a party of them turns aside [in refusal].
tr: Waitha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum itha fareequn minhum muAAridoona

t: But if the right is theirs, they come to him in prompt obedience.
tr: Wain yakun lahumu alhaqqu yatoo ilayhi muthAAineena

t: Is there disease in their hearts? Or have they doubted? Or do they fear that God will be unjust to them, or His Messenger? Rather, it is they who are the wrongdoers [i.e., the unjust].
tr: Afee quloobihim maradun ami irtaboo am yakhafoona an yaheefa Allahu AAalayhim warasooluhu bal olaika humu alththalimoona

t: The only statement of the [true] Believers when they are called to God and His Messenger to judge between them is that they say, “We hear and we obey.” And those are the successful.
tr: Innama kana qawla almumineena itha duAAoo ila Allahi warasoolihi liyahkuma baynahum an yaqooloo samiAAna waataAAna waolaika humu almuflihoona

t: And whoever obeys God and His Messenger and fears God and is conscious of Him - it is those who are the attainers.
tr: Waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu wayakhsha Allaha wayattaqhi faolaika humu alfaizoona

t: And they swear by God their strongest oaths that if you ordered them, they would go forth [in God’s cause]. Say, “Do not swear. [Such] obedience is known. Indeed, God is Acquainted with that which you do.”
tr: Waaqsamoo biAllahi jahda aymanihim lain amartahum layakhrujunna qul la tuqsimoo taAAatun maAAroofatun inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona

t: Say, “Obey God and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon him is only that [duty] with which he has been charged, and upon you is that with which you have been charged. And if you obey him, you will be [rightly] guided. And there is not upon the Messenger except the [responsibility to] convey clearly.”
tr: Qul ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaw fainnama AAalayhi ma hummila waAAalaykum ma hummiltum wain tuteeAAoohu tahtadoo wama AAala alrrasooli illa albalaghu almubeena

t: God has promised those who have believed among you and done righteous deeds that He will surely grant them succession [to authority] upon the earth just as He granted it to those before them and that He will surely establish for them [therein] their religion which He has preferred for them and that He will surely substitute for them, after their fear, security, [for] they worship Me, not associating anything with Me. But whoever disbelieves after that - then those are the defiantly disobedient.
tr: WaAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum waAAamiloo alssalihati layastakhlifannahum fee alardi kama istakhlafa allatheena min qablihim walayumakkinanna lahum deenahumu allathee irtada lahum walayubaddilannahum min baAAdi khawfihim amnan yaAAbudoonanee la yushrikoona bee shayan waman kafara baAAda thalika faolaika humu alfasiqoona

t: And establish prayer and give zakāh and obey the Messenger - that you may receive mercy.
tr: Waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waateeAAoo alrrasoola laAAallakum turhamoona

t: Never think that the disbelievers are able to frustrate [i.e., His Plan] on the earth. Their refuge will be the Fire - and how wretched the destination.
tr: La tahsabanna allatheena kafaroo muAAjizeena fee alardi wamawahumu alnnaru walabisa almaseeru

t: O you who have believed, let those whom your right hands possess and those who have not [yet] reached puberty among you ask permission of you [before entering] at three times: before the dawn prayer and when you put aside your clothing [for rest] at noon and after the night prayer. [These are] three times of privacy for you. There is no blame upon you nor upon them beyond these [periods], for they continually circulate among you - some of you, among others. Thus does God make clear to you the verses [i.e., His ordinances]; and God is Knowing and Wise.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo liyastathinkumu allatheena malakat aymanukum waallatheena lam yablughoo alhuluma minkum thalatha marratin min qabli salati alfajri waheena tadaAAoona thiyabakum mina alththaheerati wamin baAAdi salati alAAishai thalathu AAawratin lakum laysa AAalaykum wala AAalayhim junahun baAAdahunna tawwafoona AAalaykum baAAdukum AAala baAAdin kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

t: And when the children among you reach puberty, let them ask permission [at all times] as those before them have done. Thus does God make clear to you His verses; and God is Knowing and Wise.
tr: Waitha balagha alatfalu minkumu alhuluma falyastathinoo kama istathana allatheena min qablihim kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakum ayatihi waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

t: And women of post-menstrual age who have no desire for marriage - there is no blame upon them for putting aside their outer garments [but] not displaying adornment. But to modestly refrain [from that] is better for them. And God is Hearing and Knowing.
tr: WaalqawaAAidu mina alnnisai allatee la yarjoona nikahan falaysa AAalayhinna junahun an yadaAAna thiyabahunna ghayra mutabarrijatin bizeenatin waan yastaAAfifna khayrun lahunna waAllahu sameeAAun AAaleemun

t: There is not upon the blind [any] constraint nor upon the lame [any] constraint nor upon the ill [any] constraint nor upon yourselves if you eat from your [own] houses or the houses of your fathers or the houses of your mothers or the houses of your brothers or the houses of your sisters or the houses of your fathers’ brothers or the houses of your fathers’ sisters or the houses of your mothers’ brothers or the houses of your mothers’ sisters or [from houses] whose keys you possess or [from the house] of your friend. There is no blame upon you whether you eat together or separately. But when you enter houses, give greetings of peace upon each other - a greeting from God, blessed and good. Thus does God make clear to you the verses [of ordinance] that you may understand.
tr: Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun wala AAala anfusikum an takuloo min buyootikum aw buyooti abaikum aw buyooti ommahatikum aw buyooti ikhwanikum aw buyooti akhawatikum aw buyooti aAAmamikum aw buyooti AAammatikum aw buyooti akhwalikum aw buyooti khalatikum aw ma malaktum mafatihahu aw sadeeqikum laysa AAalaykum junahun an takuloo jameeAAan aw ashtatan faitha dakhaltum buyootan fasallimoo AAala anfusikum tahiyyatan min AAindi Allahi mubarakatan tayyibatan kathalika yubayyinu Allahu lakumu alayati laAAallakum taAAqiloona

t: The Believers are only those who believe in God and His Messenger and, when they are [meeting] with him for a matter of common interest, do not depart until they have asked his permission. Indeed, those who ask your permission, [O Muhammad] - those are the ones who believe in God and His Messenger. So when they ask your permission for something of their affairs, then give permission to whom you will among them and ask forgiveness for them of God. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi waitha kanoo maAAahu AAala amrin jamiAAin lam yathhaboo hatta yastathinoohu inna allatheena yastathinoonaka olaika allatheena yuminoona biAllahi warasoolihi faitha istathanooka libaAAdi shanihim fathan liman shita minhum waistaghfir lahumu Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: Do not make [your] calling of the Messenger among yourselves as the call of one of you to another. Already God knows those of you who slip away, concealed by others. So let those beware who dissent from his [i.e., the Prophet’s] order, lest fitnah strike them or a painful punishment.
tr: La tajAAaloo duAAaa alrrasooli baynakum kaduAAai baAAdikum baAAdan qad yaAAlamu Allahu allatheena yatasallaloona minkum liwathan falyahthari allatheena yukhalifoona AAan amrihi an tuseebahum fitnatun aw yuseebahum AAathabun aleemun

t: Surely, to God belongs whatever is in the heavens and earth. Already He knows that upon which you [stand] and [knows] the Day when they will be returned to Him and He will inform them of what they have done. And God is Knowing of all things.
tr: Ala inna lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi qad yaAAlamu ma antum AAalayhi wayawma yurjaAAoona ilayhi fayunabbiohum bima AAamiloo waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: Blessed is He who sent down the Criterion upon His Servant that he may be to the worlds a warner -
tr: Tabaraka allathee nazzala alfurqana AAala AAabdihi liyakoona lilAAalameena natheeran

t: He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and who has not taken a son and has not had a partner in dominion and has created each thing and determined it with [precise] determination.
tr: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi walam yattakhith waladan walam yakun lahu shareekun fee almulki wakhalaqa kulla shayin faqaddarahu taqdeeran

t: But they have taken besides Him gods which create nothing, while they are created, and possess not for themselves any harm or benefit and possess not [power to cause] death or life or resurrection.
tr: Waittakhathoo min doonihi alihatan la yakhluqoona shayan wahum yukhlaqoona wala yamlikoona lianfusihim darran wala nafAAan wala yamlikoona mawtan wala hayatan wala nushooran

t: And those who disbelieve say, “This [Qur’ān] is not except a falsehood he invented, and another people assisted him in it.” But they have committed an injustice and a lie.
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo in hatha illa ifkun iftarahu waaAAanahu AAalayhi qawmun akharoona faqad jaoo thulman wazooran

t: And they say, “Legends of the former peoples which he has written down, and they are dictated to him morning and afternoon.”
tr: Waqaloo asateeru alawwaleena iktatabaha fahiya tumla AAalayhi bukratan waaseelan

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “It has been revealed by He who knows [every] secret within the heavens and the earth. Indeed, He is ever Forgiving and Merciful.”
tr: Qul anzalahu allathee yaAAlamu alssirra fee alssamawati waalardi innahu kana ghafooran raheeman

t: And they say, “What is this messenger that eats food and walks in the markets? Why was there not sent down to him an angel so he would be with him a warner?
tr: Waqaloo mali hatha alrrasooli yakulu alttaAAama wayamshee fee alaswaqi lawla onzila ilayhi malakun fayakoona maAAahu natheeran

t: Or [why is not] a treasure presented to him [from heaven], or does he [not] have a garden from which he eats?” And the wrongdoers say, “You follow not but a man affected by magic.”
tr: Aw yulqa ilayhi kanzun aw takoonu lahu jannatun yakulu minha waqala alththalimoona in tattabiAAoona illa rajulan mashooran

t: Look how they strike for you comparisons; but they have strayed, so they cannot [find] a way.
tr: Onthur kayfa daraboo laka alamthala fadalloo fala yastateeAAoona sabeelan

t: Blessed is He who, if He willed, could have made for you [something] better than that - gardens beneath which rivers flow - and could make for you palaces.
tr: Tabaraka allathee in shaa jaAAala laka khayran min thalika jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wayajAAal laka qusooran

t: But they have denied the Hour, and We have prepared for those who deny the Hour a Blaze.
tr: Bal kaththaboo bialssaAAati waaAAtadna liman kaththaba bialssaAAati saAAeeran

t: When it [i.e., the Hellfire] sees them from a distant place, they will hear its fury and roaring.
tr: Itha raathum min makanin baAAeedin samiAAoo laha taghayyuthan wazafeeran

t: And when they are thrown into a narrow place therein bound in chains, they will cry out thereupon for destruction.
tr: Waitha olqoo minha makanan dayyiqan muqarraneena daAAaw hunalika thubooran

t: [They will be told], “Do not cry this Day for one destruction but cry for much destruction.”
tr: La tadAAoo alyawma thubooran wahidan waodAAoo thubooran katheeran

t: Say, “Is that better or the Garden of Eternity which is promised to the righteous? It will be for them a reward and destination.
tr: Qul athalika khayrun am jannatu alkhuldi allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona kanat lahum jazaan wamaseeran

t: For them therein is whatever they wish, [while] abiding eternally. It is ever upon your Lord a promise [worthy to be] requested.
tr: Lahum feeha ma yashaoona khalideena kana AAala rabbika waAAdan masoolan

t: And [mention] the Day He will gather them and that which they worship besides God and will say, “Did you mislead these, My servants, or did they [themselves] stray from the way?”
tr: Wayawma yahshuruhum wama yaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi fayaqoolu aantum adlaltum AAibadee haolai am hum dalloo alssabeela

t: They will say, “Exalted are You! It was not for us to take besides You any allies [i.e., protectors]. But You provided comforts for them and their fathers until they forgot the Reminder and became a people ruined.”
tr: Qaloo subhanaka ma kana yanbaghee lana an nattakhitha min doonika min awliyaa walakin mattaAAtahum waabaahum hatta nasoo alththikra wakanoo qawman booran

t: So they will deny you, [disbelievers], in what you say, and you cannot avert [punishment] or [find] help. And whoever commits injustice among you - We will make him taste a great punishment.
tr: Faqad kaththabookum bima taqooloona fama tastateeAAoona sarfan wala nasran waman yathlim minkum nuthiqhu AAathaban kabeeran

t: And We did not send before you, [O Muhammad], any of the messengers except that they ate food and walked in the markets. And We have made some of you [people] as trial for others - will you have patience? And ever is your Lord, Seeing.
tr: Wama arsalna qablaka mina almursaleena illa innahum layakuloona alttaAAama wayamshoona fee alaswaqi wajaAAalna baAAdakum libaAAdin fitnatan atasbiroona wakana rabbuka baseeran

t: And those who do not expect the meeting with Us say, “Why were not angels sent down to us, or [why] do we [not] see our Lord?” They have certainly become arrogant within themselves and [become] insolent with great insolence.
tr: Waqala allatheena la yarjoona liqaana lawla onzila AAalayna almalaikatu aw nara rabbana laqadi istakbaroo fee anfusihim waAAataw AAutuwwan kabeeran

t: The day they see the angels - no good tidings will there be that day for the criminals, and [the angels] will say, “Prevented and inaccessible.”
tr: Yawma yarawna almalaikata la bushra yawmaithin lilmujrimeena wayaqooloona hijran mahjooran

t: And We will approach [i.e., regard] what they have done of deeds and make them as dust dispersed.
tr: Waqadimna ila ma AAamiloo min AAamalin fajaAAalnahu habaan manthooran

t: The companions of Paradise, that Day, are [in] a better settlement and better resting place.
tr: Ashabu aljannati yawmaithin khayrun mustaqarran waahsanu maqeelan

t: And [mention] the Day when the heaven will split open with [emerging] clouds, and the angels will be sent down in successive descent.
tr: Wayawma tashaqqaqu alssamao bialghamami wanuzzila almalaikatu tanzeelan

t: True sovereignty, that Day, is for the Most Merciful. And it will be upon the disbelievers a difficult Day.
tr: Almulku yawmaithin alhaqqu lilrrahmani wakana yawman AAala alkafireena AAaseeran

t: And the Day the wrongdoer will bite on his hands [in regret] he will say, “Oh, I wish I had taken with the Messenger a way.
tr: Wayawma yaAAaddu alththalimu AAala yadayhi yaqoolu ya laytanee ittakhathtu maAAa alrrasooli sabeelan

t: Oh, woe to me! I wish I had not taken that one as a friend.
tr: Ya waylata laytanee lam attakhith fulanan khaleelan

t: He led me away from the remembrance after it had come to me. ” And ever is Satan, to man, a deserter.
tr: Laqad adallanee AAani alththikri baAAda ith jaanee wakana alshshaytanu lilinsani khathoolan

t: And the Messenger has said, “O my Lord, indeed my people have taken this ” Qur’ān as [a thing] abandoned.
tr: Waqala alrrasoolu ya rabbi inna qawmee ittakhathoo hatha alqurana mahjooran

t: And thus have We made for every prophet an enemy from among the criminals. But sufficient is your Lord as a guide and a helper.
tr: Wakathalika jaAAalna likulli nabiyyin AAaduwwan mina almujrimeena wakafa birabbika hadiyan wanaseeran

t: And those who disbelieve say, “Why was the Qur’ān not revealed to him all at once?” Thus [it is] that We may strengthen thereby your heart. And We have spaced it distinctly.
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lawla nuzzila AAalayhi alquranu jumlatan wahidatan kathalika linuthabbita bihi fuadaka warattalnahu tarteelan

t: And they do not come to you with an example [i.e., argument] except that We bring you the truth and the best explanation.
tr: Wala yatoonaka bimathalin illa jinaka bialhaqqi waahsana tafseeran

t: The ones who are gathered on their faces to Hell - those are the worst in position and farthest astray in [their] way.
tr: Allatheena yuhsharoona AAala wujoohihim ila jahannama olaika sharrun makanan waadallu sabeelan

t: And We had certainly given Moses the Book and appointed with him his brother Aaron as an assistant.
tr: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba wajaAAalna maAAahu akhahu haroona wazeeran

t: And We said, “Go both of you to the ” people who have denied Our signs. Then We destroyed them with [complete] destruction.
tr: Faqulna ithhaba ila alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayatina fadammarnahum tadmeeran

t: And the people of Noah - when they denied the messengers, We drowned them, and We made them for mankind a sign. And We have prepared for the wrongdoers a painful punishment.
tr: Waqawma noohin lamma kaththaboo alrrusula aghraqnahum wajaAAalnahum lilnnasi ayatan waaAAtadna lilththalimeena AAathaban aleeman

t: And [We destroyed] ‘Aad and Thamūd and the companions of the well and many generations between them.
tr: WaAAadan wathamooda waashaba alrrassi waquroonan bayna thalika katheeran

t: And for each We presented examples [as warnings], and each We destroyed with [total] destruction.
tr: Wakullan darabna lahu alamthala wakullan tabbarna tatbeeran

t: And they have already come upon the town which was showered with a rain of evil [i.e., stones]. So have they not seen it? But they are not expecting resurrection.
tr: Walaqad ataw AAala alqaryati allatee omtirat matara alssawi afalam yakoonoo yarawnaha bal kanoo la yarjoona nushooran

t: And when they see you, [O Muhammad], they take you not except in ridicule, [saying], “Is this the one whom God has sent as a messenger?
tr: Waitha raawka in yattakhithoonaka illa huzuwan ahatha allathee baAAatha Allahu rasoolan

t: He almost would have misled us from our gods had we not been steadfast in [worship of] them.” But they are going to know, when they see the punishment, who is farthest astray in [his] way.
tr: In kada layudilluna AAan alihatina lawla an sabarna AAalayha wasawfa yaAAlamoona heena yarawna alAAathaba man adallu sabeelan

t: Have you seen the one who takes as his god his own desire? Then would you be responsible for him?
tr: Araayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu afaanta takoonu AAalayhi wakeelan

t: Or do you think that most of them hear or reason? They are not except like livestock. Rather, they are [even] more astray in [their] way.
tr: Am tahsabu anna aktharahum yasmaAAoona aw yaAAqiloona in hum illa kaalanAAami bal hum adallu sabeelan

t: Have you not considered your Lord how He extends the shadow, and if He willed, He could have made it stationary? Then We made the sun for it an indication.
tr: Alam tara ila rabbika kayfa madda alththilla walaw shaa lajaAAalahu sakinan thumma jaAAalna alshshamsa AAalayhi daleelan

t: Then We hold it in hand for a brief grasp.
tr: Thumma qabadnahu ilayna qabdan yaseeran

t: And it is He who has made the night for you as clothing and sleep [a means for] rest and has made the day a resurrection.
tr: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla libasan waalnnawma subatan wajaAAala alnnahara nushooran

t: And it is He who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy [i.e., rainfall], and We send down from the sky pure water
tr: Wahuwa allathee arsala alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi waanzalna mina alssamai maan tahooran

t: That We may bring to life thereby a dead land and give it as drink to those We created of numerous livestock and men.
tr: Linuhyiya bihi baldatan maytan wanusqiyahu mimma khalaqna anAAaman waanasiyya katheeran

t: And We have certainly distributed it among them that they might be reminded, but most of the people refuse except disbelief.
tr: Walaqad sarrafnahu baynahum liyaththakkaroo faaba aktharu alnnasi illa kufooran

t: And if We had willed, We could have sent into every city a warner.
tr: Walaw shina labaAAathna fee kulli qaryatin natheeran

t: So do not obey the disbelievers, and strive against them with it [i.e., the Qur’ān] a great striving.
tr: Fala tutiAAi alkafireena wajahidhum bihi jihadan kabeeran

t: And it is He who has released [simultaneously] the two seas [i.e., bodies of water], one fresh and sweet and one salty and bitter, and He placed between them a barrier and prohibiting partition.
tr: Wahuwa allathee maraja albahrayni hatha AAathbun furatun wahatha milhun ojajun wajaAAala baynahuma barzakhan wahijran mahjooran

t: And it is He who has created from water [i.e., semen] a human being and made him [a relative by] lineage and marriage. And ever is your Lord competent [concerning creation].
tr: Wahuwa allathee khalaqa mina almai basharan fajaAAalahu nasaban wasihran wakana rabbuka qadeeran

t: But they worship rather than God that which does not benefit them or harm them, and the disbeliever is ever, against his Lord, an assistant [to Satan].
tr: WayaAAbudoona min dooni Allahi ma la yanfaAAuhum wala yadurruhum wakana alkafiru AAala rabbihi thaheeran

t: And We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], except as a bringer of good tidings and a warner.
tr: Wama arsalnaka illa mubashshiran wanatheeran

t: Say, “I do not ask of you for it any payment - only that whoever wills might take to his Lord a way.”
tr: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin illa man shaa an yattakhitha ila rabbihi sabeelan

t: And rely upon the Ever-Living who does not die, and exalt [God] with His praise. And sufficient is He to be, with the sins of His servants, Acquainted -
tr: Watawakkal AAala alhayyi allathee la yamootu wasabbih bihamdihi wakafa bihi bithunoobi AAibadihi khabeeran

t: He who created the heavens and the earth and what is between them in six days and then established Himself above the Throne - the Most Merciful, so ask about Him one well informed [i.e., the Prophet].
tr: Allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi alrrahmanu faisal bihi khabeeran

t: And when it is said to them, “Prostrate to the Most Merciful,” they say, “And what is the Most Merciful? Should we prostrate to that which you order us?” And it increases them in aversion.
tr: Waitha qeela lahumu osjudoo lilrrahmani qaloo wama alrrahmanu anasjudu lima tamuruna wazadahum nufooran

t: Blessed is He who has placed in the sky great stars and placed therein a [burning] lamp and luminous moon.
tr: Tabaraka allathee jaAAala fee alssamai buroojan wajaAAala feeha sirajan waqamaran muneeran

t: And it is He who has made the night and the day in succession for whoever desires to remember or desires gratitude.
tr: Wahuwa allathee jaAAala allayla waalnnahara khilfatan liman arada an yaththakkara aw arada shukooran

t: And the servants of the Most Merciful are those who walk upon the earth easily, and when the ignorant address them [harshly], they say [words of] peace,
tr: WaAAibadu alrrahmani allatheena yamshoona AAala alardi hawnan waitha khatabahumu aljahiloona qaloo salaman

t: And those who spend [part of] the night to their Lord prostrating and standing [in prayer]
tr: Waallatheena yabeetoona lirabbihim sujjadan waqiyaman

t: And those who say, “Our Lord, avert from us the punishment of Hell. Indeed, its punishment is ever adhering;
tr: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana isrif AAanna AAathaba jahannama inna AAathabaha kana gharaman

t: Indeed, it is evil as a settlement and residence.”
tr: Innaha saat mustaqarran wamuqaman

t: And [they are] those who, when they spend, do so not excessively or sparingly but are ever, between that, [justly] moderate
tr: Waallatheena itha anfaqoo lam yusrifoo walam yaqturoo wakana bayna thalika qawaman

t: And those who do not invoke with God another deity or kill the soul which God has forbidden [to be killed], except by right, and do not commit unlawful sexual intercourse. And whoever should do that will meet a penalty.
tr: Waallatheena la yadAAoona maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara wala yaqtuloona alnnafsa allatee harrama Allahu illa bialhaqqi wala yaznoona waman yafAAal thalika yalqa athaman

t: Multiplied for him is the punishment on the Day of Resurrection, and he will abide therein humiliated -
tr: YudaAAaf lahu alAAathabu yawma alqiyamati wayakhlud feehi muhanan

t: Except for those who repent, believe and do righteous work. For them God will replace their evil deeds with good. And ever is God Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Illa man taba waamana waAAamila AAamalan salihan faolaika yubaddilu Allahu sayyiatihim hasanatin wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman

t: And he who repents and does righteousness does indeed turn to God with [accepted] repentance.
tr: Waman taba waAAamila salihan fainnahu yatoobu ila Allahi mataban

t: And [they are] those who do not testify to falsehood, and when they pass near ill speech, they pass by with dignity.
tr: Waallatheena la yashhadoona alzzoora waitha marroo biallaghwi marroo kiraman

t: And those who, when reminded of the verses of their Lord, do not fall upon them deaf and blind.
tr: Waallatheena itha thukkiroo biayati rabbihim lam yakhirroo AAalayha summan waAAumyanan

t: And those who say, “Our Lord, grant us from among our wives and offspring comfort to our eyes and make us a leader [i.e., example] for the righteous.”
tr: Waallatheena yaqooloona rabbana hab lana min azwajina wathurriyyatina qurrata aAAyunin waijAAalna lilmuttaqeena imaman

t: Those will be awarded the Chamber for what they patiently endured, and they will be received therein with greetings and [words of] peace,
tr: Olaika yujzawna alghurfata bima sabaroo wayulaqqawna feeha tahiyyatan wasalaman

t: Abiding eternally therein. Good is the settlement and residence.
tr: Khalideena feeha hasunat mustaqarran wamuqaman

t: Say, “What would my Lord care for you if not for your supplication?” For you [disbelievers] have denied, so it [i.e., your denial] is going to be adherent.
tr: Qul ma yaAAbao bikum rabbee lawla duAAaokum faqad kaththabtum fasawfa yakoonu lizaman

t: Tā, Seen, Meem.
tr: Taseenmeem

t: These are the verses of the clear Book.
tr: Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni

t: Then perhaps you are going to worry yourself to death over them that they will not become Believers.
tr: LaAAallaka bakhiAAun nafsaka alla yakoonoo mumineena

t: If We had wished, We could have sent them down a sign from heaven, at which their necks would stay humbly submissive.
tr: In nasha nunazzil AAalayhim mina alssamai ayatan fathallat aAAnaquhum laha khadiAAeena

t: And no mention [i.e., revelation] comes to them anew from the Most Merciful except that they turn away from it.
tr: Wama yateehim min thikrin mina alrrahmani muhdathin illa kanoo AAanhu muAArideena

t: For they have already denied, but there will come to them the news of that which they used to ridicule.
tr: Faqad kaththaboo fasayateehim anbao ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: Did they not look at the earth - how much We have produced therein from every noble kind?
tr: Awalam yaraw ila alardi kam anbatna feeha min kulli zawjin kareemin

t: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not Believers.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: And [mention] when your Lord called Moses, [saying], “Go to the wrongdoing people -
tr: Waith nada rabbuka moosa ani iti alqawma alththalimeena

t: The people of Pharaoh. Will they not fear God?”
tr: Qawma firAAawna ala yattaqoona

t: He said, “My Lord, indeed I fear that they will deny me
tr: Qala rabbi innee akhafu an yukaththibooni

t: And that my breast will tighten and my tongue will not be fluent, so send for Aaron.
tr: Wayadeequ sadree wala yantaliqu lisanee faarsil ila haroona

t: And they have upon me a [claim due to] sin, so I fear that they will kill me.”
tr: Walahum AAalayya thanbun faakhafu an yaqtulooni

t: [God] said, “No. Go both of you with Our signs; indeed, We are with you, listening.
tr: Qala kalla faithhaba biayatina inna maAAakum mustamiAAoona

t: Go to Pharaoh and say, ‘We are the messengers of the Lord of the worlds,
tr: Fatiya firAAawna faqoola inna rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

t: [Commanded to say], ‘Send with us the Children of Israel.” ’ ”
tr: An arsil maAAana banee israeela

t: [Pharaoh] said, “Did we not raise you among us as a child, and you remained among us for years of your life?
tr: Qala alam nurabbika feena waleedan walabithta feena min AAumurika sineena

t: And [then] you did your deed which you did, and you were of the ungrateful.”
tr: WafaAAalta faAAlataka allatee faAAalta waanta mina alkafireena

t: [Moses] said, “I did it, then, while I was of those astray [i.e., ignorant].
tr: Qala faAAaltuha ithan waana mina alddalleena

t: So I fled from you when I feared you. Then my Lord granted me judgement [i.e., wisdom and prophethood] and appointed me [as one] of the messengers.
tr: Fafarartu minkum lamma khiftukum fawahaba lee rabbee hukman wajaAAalanee mina almursaleena

t: And is this a favour of which you remind me - that you have enslaved the Children of Israel?”
tr: Watilka niAAmatun tamunnuha AAalayya an AAabbadta banee israeela

t: Said Pharaoh, “And what is the Lord of the worlds?”
tr: Qala firAAawnu wama rabbu alAAalameena

t: [Moses] said, “The Lord of the heavens and earth and that between them, if you should be convinced.”
tr: Qala rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

t: [Pharaoh] said to those around him, “Do you not hear?”
tr: Qala liman hawlahu ala tastamiAAoona

t: [Moses] said, “Your Lord and the Lord ” of your first forefathers.
tr: Qala rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

t: [Pharaoh] said, “Indeed, your ‘messenger’ who has been sent to you is mad.”
tr: Qala inna rasoolakumu allathee orsila ilaykum lamajnoonun

t: [Moses] said, “Lord of the east and the west and that between them, if you were to reason.”
tr: Qala rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi wama baynahuma in kuntum taAAqiloona

t: [Pharaoh] said, “If you take a God other than me, I will surely place you among those imprisoned.”
tr: Qala laini ittakhathta ilahan ghayree laajAAalannaka mina almasjooneena

t: [Moses] said, “Even if I brought you ” something [i.e., proof] manifest?
tr: Qala awalaw jituka bishayin mubeenin

t: [Pharaoh] said, “Then bring it, if you should be of the truthful.”
tr: Qala fati bihi in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t: So [Moses] threw his staff, and suddenly it was a serpent manifest.
tr: Faalqa AAasahu faitha hiya thuAAbanun mubeenun

t: And he drew out his hand; thereupon it was white for the observers.
tr: WanazaAAa yadahu faitha hiya baydao lilnnathireena

t: [Pharaoh] said to the eminent ones around him, “Indeed, this is a learned magician.
tr: Qala lilmalai hawlahu inna hatha lasahirun AAaleemun

t: He wants to drive you out of your land by his magic, so what do you advise?”
tr: Yureedu an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihi famatha tamuroona

t: They said, “Postpone [the matter of] him and his brother and send among the cities gatherers
tr: Qaloo arjih waakhahu waibAAath fee almadaini hashireena

t: Who will bring you every learned, skilled magician.”
tr: Yatooka bikulli sahharin AAaleemin

t: So the magicians were assembled for the appointment of a well-known day.
tr: FajumiAAa alssaharatu limeeqati yawmin maAAloomin

t: And it was said to the people, “Will you congregate
tr: Waqeela lilnnasi hal antum mujtamiAAoona

t: That we might follow the magicians if they are the predominant?”
tr: LaAAallana nattabiAAu alssaharata in kanoo humu alghalibeena

t: And when the magicians arrived, they said to Pharaoh, “Is there definitely a reward for us if we are the winners?”
tr: Falamma jaa alssaharatu qaloo lifirAAawna ainna lana laajran in kunna nahnu alghalibeena

t: He said, “Yes, and indeed, you will then be of those near [to me].”
tr: Qala naAAam wainnakum ithan lamina almuqarrabeena

t: Moses said to them, “Throw whatever ” you will throw.
tr: Qala lahum moosa alqoo ma antum mulqoona

t: So they threw their ropes and their staffs and said, “By the might of Pharaoh, indeed it is we who are the winners.”
tr: Faalqaw hibalahum waAAisiyyahum waqaloo biAAizzati firAAawna inna lanahnu alghaliboona

t: Then Moses threw his staff, and at once it devoured what they falsified.
tr: Faalqa moosa AAasahu faitha hiya talqafu ma yafikoona

t: So the magicians fell down in prostration [to God].
tr: Faolqiya alssaharatu sajideena

t: They said, “We have believed in the Lord of the worlds,
tr: Qaloo amanna birabbi alAAalameena

t: The Lord of Moses and Aaron.”
tr: Rabbi moosa waharoona

t: [Pharaoh] said, “You believed him [i.e., Moses] before I gave you permission. Indeed, he is your leader who has taught you magic, but you are going to know. I will surely cut off your hands and your feet on opposite sides, and I will surely crucify you all.”
tr: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falasawfa taAAlamoona laoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum ajmaAAeena

t: They said, “No harm. Indeed, to our Lord we will return.
tr: Qaloo la dayra inna ila rabbina munqaliboona

t: Indeed, we aspire that our Lord will forgive us our sins because we were the first of the Believers.”
tr: Inna natmaAAu an yaghfira lana rabbuna khatayana an kunna awwala almumineena

t: And We inspired to Moses, “Travel by night with My servants; indeed, you will be pursued.”
tr: Waawhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee innakum muttabaAAoona

t: Then Pharaoh sent among the cities gatherers
tr: Faarsala firAAawnu fee almadaini hashireena

t: [And said], “Indeed, those are but a small band,
tr: Inna haolai lashirthimatun qaleeloona

t: And indeed, they are enraging us,
tr: Wainnahum lana laghaithoona

t: And indeed, we are a cautious society…”
tr: Wainna lajameeAAun hathiroona

t: So We removed them from gardens and springs
tr: Faakhrajnahum min jannatin waAAuyoonin

t: And treasures and honourable station -
tr: Wakunoozin wamaqamin kareemin

t: Thus. And We caused to inherit it the Children of Israel.
tr: Kathalika waawrathnaha banee israeela

t: So they pursued them at sunrise.
tr: FaatbaAAoohum mushriqeena

t: And when the two companies saw one another, the companions of Moses said, ” “Indeed, we are to be overtaken!
tr: Falamma taraa aljamAAani qala ashabu moosa inna lamudrakoona

t: [Moses] said, “No! Indeed, with me is my Lord; He will guide me.”
tr: Qala kalla inna maAAiya rabbee sayahdeeni

t: Then We inspired to Moses, “Strike with your staff the sea,” and it parted, and each portion was like a great towering mountain.
tr: Faawhayna ila moosa ani idrib biAAasaka albahra fainfalaqa fakana kullu firqin kaalttawdi alAAatheemi

t: And We advanced thereto the others [i.e., the pursuers].
tr: Waazlafna thamma alakhareena

t: And We saved Moses and those with him, all together.
tr: Waanjayna moosa waman maAAahu ajmaAAeena

t: Then We drowned the others.
tr: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena

t: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not Believers.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: And recite to them the news of Abraham,
tr: Waotlu AAalayhim nabaa ibraheema

t: When he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?”
tr: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi ma taAAbudoona

t: They said, “We worship idols and ” remain to them devoted.
tr: Qaloo naAAbudu asnaman fanathallu laha AAakifeena

t: He said, “Do they hear you when you supplicate?
tr: Qala hal yasmaAAoonakum ith tadAAoona

t: Or do they benefit you, or do they ” harm?
tr: Aw yanfaAAoonakum aw yadurroona

t: They said, “But we found our fathers doing thus.”
tr: Qaloo bal wajadna abaana kathalika yafAAaloona

t: He said, “Then do you see what you have been worshipping,
tr: Qala afaraaytum ma kuntum taAAbudoona

t: You and your ancient forefathers?
tr: Antum waabaokumu alaqdamoona

t: Indeed, they are enemies to me, except the Lord of the worlds,
tr: Fainnahum AAaduwwun lee illa rabba alAAalameena

t: Who created me, and He [it is who] guides me.
tr: Allathee khalaqanee fahuwa yahdeeni

t: And it is He who feeds me and gives me drink.
tr: Waallathee huwa yutAAimunee wayasqeeni

t: And when I am ill, it is He who cures me
tr: Waitha maridtu fahuwa yashfeeni

t: And who will cause me to die and then bring me to life
tr: Waallathee yumeetunee thumma yuhyeeni

t: And who I aspire that He will forgive me my sin on the Day of Recompense.”
tr: Waallathee atmaAAu an yaghfira lee khateeatee yawma alddeeni

t: [And he said], “My Lord, grant me authority and join me with the righteous.
tr: Rabbi hab lee hukman waalhiqnee bialssaliheena

t: And grant me a mention [i.e., reputation] of honour among later generations.
tr: WaijAAal lee lisana sidqin fee alakhireena

t: And place me among the inheritors of the Garden of Pleasure.
tr: WaijAAalnee min warathati jannati alnnaAAeemi

t: And forgive my father. Indeed, he has been of those astray.
tr: Waighfir liabee innahu kana mina alddalleena

t: And do not disgrace me on the Day they are [all] resurrected -
tr: Wala tukhzinee yawma yubAAathoona

t: The Day when there will not benefit [anyone] wealth or children
tr: Yawma la yanfaAAu malun wala banoona

t: But only one who comes to God with a sound heart.”
tr: Illa man ata Allaha biqalbin saleemin

t: And Paradise will be brought near [that Day] to the righteous.
tr: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena

t: And Hellfire will be brought forth for the deviators,
tr: Waburrizati aljaheemu lilghaweena

t: And it will be said to them, “Where are those you used to worship
tr: Waqeela lahum ayna ma kuntum taAAbudoona

t: Other than God? Can they help you or help themselves?”
tr: Min dooni Allahi hal yansuroonakum aw yantasiroona

t: So they will be overturned into it [i.e., Hellfire], they and the deviators
tr: Fakubkiboo feeha hum waalghawoona

t: And the soldiers of Iblees, all together.
tr: Wajunoodu ibleesa ajmaAAoona

t: They will say while they dispute therein,
tr: Qaloo wahum feeha yakhtasimoona

t: “By God, we were indeed in manifest error
tr: TaAllahi in kunna lafee dalalin mubeenin

t: When we equated you with the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Ith nusawweekum birabbi alAAalameena

t: And no one misguided us except the criminals.
tr: Wama adallana illa almujrimoona

t: So now we have no intercessors
tr: Fama lana min shafiAAeena

t: And not a devoted friend.
tr: Wala sadeeqin hameemin

t: Then if we only had a return [to the world] and could be of the Believers...”
tr: Falaw anna lana karratan fanakoona mina almumineena

t: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them are not Believers.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: The people of Noah denied the messengers
tr: Kaththabat qawmu noohin almursaleena

t: When their brother Noah said to them, “Will you not fear God?
tr: Ith qala lahum akhoohum noohun ala tattaqoona

t: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

t: So fear God and obey me.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t: So fear God and obey me.”
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: They said, “Should we believe you while you are followed by the lowest [class of ” people]?
tr: Qaloo anuminu laka waittabaAAaka alarthaloona

t: He said, “And what is my knowledge of what they used to do?
tr: Qala wama AAilmee bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: Their account is only upon my Lord, if you [could] perceive.
tr: In hisabuhum illa AAala rabbee law tashAAuroona

t: And I am not one to drive away the Believers.
tr: Wama ana bitaridi almumineena

t: I am only a clear warner.”
tr: In ana illa natheerun mubeenun

t: They said, “If you do not desist, O Noah, you will surely be of those who are stoned.”
tr: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya noohu latakoonanna mina almarjoomeena

t: He said, “My Lord, indeed my people have denied me.
tr: Qala rabbi inna qawmee kaththabooni

t: Then judge between me and them with decisive judgement and save me and those with me of the Believers.”
tr: Faiftah baynee wabaynahum fathan wanajjinee waman maAAiya mina almumineena

t: So We saved him and those with him in the laden ship.
tr: Faanjaynahu waman maAAahu fee alfulki almashhooni

t: Then We drowned thereafter the remaining ones.
tr: Thumma aghraqna baAAdu albaqeena

t: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not Believers.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: ‘Aad denied the messengers
tr: Kaththabat AAadun almursaleena

t: When their brother Hūd said to them, “Will you not fear God?
tr: Ith qala lahum akhoohum hoodun ala tattaqoona

t: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

t: So fear God and obey me.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t: Do you construct on every elevation a sign, amusing yourselves,
tr: Atabnoona bikulli reeAAin ayatan taAAbathoona

t: And take for yourselves constructions [i.e., places and fortresses] that you might abide eternally?
tr: Watattakhithoona masaniAAa laAAallakum takhludoona

t: And when you strike, you strike as tyrants.
tr: Waitha batashtum batashtum jabbareena

t: So fear God and obey me.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: And fear He who provided you with that which you know,
tr: Waittaqoo allathee amaddakum bima taAAlamoona

t: Provided you with grazing livestock and children
tr: Amaddakum bianAAamin wabaneena

t: And gardens and springs.
tr: Wajannatin waAAuyoonin

t: Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day.”
tr: Innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

t: They said, “It is all the same to us whether you advise or are not of the advisors.
tr: Qaloo sawaon AAalayna awaAAathta am lam takun mina alwaAAitheena

t: This is not but the custom of the former peoples,
tr: In hatha illa khuluqu alawwaleena

t: And we are not to be punished.”
tr: Wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

t: And they denied him, so We destroyed them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not Believers.
tr: Fakaththaboohu faahlaknahum inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: Thamūd denied the messengers
tr: Kaththabat thamoodu almursaleena

t: When their brother Sālih said to them, “Will you not fear God?
tr: Ith qala lahum akhoohum salihun ala tattaqoona

t: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

t: So fear God and obey me.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t: Will you be left in what is here, secure [from death],
tr: Atutrakoona fee ma hahuna amineena

t: Within gardens and springs
tr: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

t: And fields of crops and palm trees with softened fruit?
tr: WazurooAAin wanakhlin talAAuha hadeemun

t: And you carve out of the mountains, homes, with skill.
tr: Watanhitoona mina aljibali buyootan fariheena

t: So fear God and obey me.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: And do not obey the order of the transgressors,
tr: Wala tuteeAAoo amra almusrifeena

t: Who cause corruption in the land and ” do not amend.
tr: Allatheena yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

t: They said, “You are only of those affected by magic.
tr: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareena

t: You are but a man like ourselves, so bring a sign, if you should be of the ” truthful.
tr: Ma anta illa basharun mithluna fati biayatin in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t: He said, “This is a she-camel. For her is a [time of] drink, and for you is a [time of] drink, [each] on a known day.
tr: Qala hathihi naqatun laha shirbun walakum shirbu yawmin maAAloomin

t: And do not touch her with harm, lest you be seized by the punishment of a terrible day.”
tr: Wala tamassooha bisooin fayakhuthakum AAathabu yawmin AAatheemin

t: But they hamstrung her and so became regretful.
tr: FaAAaqarooha faasbahoo nadimeena

t: And the punishment seized them. Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not Believers.
tr: Faakhathahumu alAAathabu inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: The people of Lot denied the messengers
tr: Kaththabat qawmu lootin almursaleena

t: When their brother Lot said to them, “Will you not fear God?
tr: Ith qala lahum akhoohum lootun ala tattaqoona

t: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

t: So fear God and obey me.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t: Do you approach males out of everyone
tr: Atatoona alththukrana mina alAAalameena

t: And leave what your Lord has created for you as mates? But you are a people transgressing.”
tr: Watatharoona ma khalaqa lakum rabbukum min azwajikum bal antum qawmun AAadoona

t: They said, “If you do not desist, O Lot, you will surely be of those evicted.”
tr: Qaloo lain lam tantahi ya lootu latakoonanna mina almukhrajeena

t: He said, “Indeed, I am, toward your deed, of those who detest [it].
tr: Qala innee liAAamalikum mina alqaleena

t: My Lord, save me and my family from [the consequence of] what they do.”
tr: Rabbi najjinee waahlee mimma yaAAmaloona

t: So We saved him and his family, all,
tr: Fanajjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena

t: Except an old woman among those who remained behind.
tr: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena

t: Then We destroyed the others.
tr: Thumma dammarna alakhareena

t: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
tr: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena

t: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not Believers.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: The companions of the thicket [i.e., the people of Madyan] denied the messengers
tr: Kaththaba ashabu alaykati almursaleena

t: When Shu’ayb said to them, “Will you not fear God?
tr: Ith qala lahum shuAAaybun ala tattaqoona

t: Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger.
tr: Innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

t: So fear God and obey me.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: And I do not ask you for it any payment. My payment is only from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wama asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin in ajriya illa AAala rabbi alAAalameena

t: Give full measure and do not be of those who cause loss.
tr: Awfoo alkayla wala takoonoo mina almukhsireena

t: And weigh with an even [i.e., honest] balance.
tr: Wazinoo bialqistasi almustaqeemi

t: And do not deprive people of their due and do not commit abuse on earth, spreading corruption.
tr: Wala tabkhasoo alnnasa ashyaahum wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena

t: And fear He who created you and the former creation.”
tr: Waittaqoo allathee khalaqakum waaljibillata alawwaleena

t: They said, “You are only of those affected by magic.
tr: Qaloo innama anta mina almusahhareena

t: You are but a man like ourselves, and indeed, we think you are among the liars.
tr: Wama anta illa basharun mithluna wain nathunnuka lamina alkathibeena

t: So cause to fall upon us fragments of the sky, if you should be of the truthful.”
tr: Faasqit AAalayna kisafan mina alssamai in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t: He said, “My Lord is most knowing of what you do.”
tr: Qala rabbee aAAlamu bima taAAmaloona

t: And they denied him, so the punishment of the day of the black cloud seized them. Indeed, it was the punishment of a terrible day.
tr: Fakaththaboohu faakhathahum AAathabu yawmi alththullati innahu kana AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

t: Indeed in that is a sign, but most of them were not Believers.
tr: Inna fee thalika laayatan wama kana aktharuhum mumineena

t: And indeed, your Lord - He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Wainna rabbaka lahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the revelation of the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wainnahu latanzeelu rabbi alAAalameena

t: The Trustworthy Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] has brought it down
tr: Nazala bihi alrroohu alameenu

t: Upon your heart, [O Muhammad] - that you may be of the warners -
tr: AAala qalbika litakoona mina almunthireena

t: In a clear Arabic language.
tr: Bilisanin AAarabiyyin mubeenin

t: And indeed, it is [mentioned] in the scriptures of former peoples.
tr: Wainnahu lafee zuburi alawwaleena

t: And has it not been a sign to them that it is recognized by the scholars of the Children of Israel?
tr: Awalam yakun lahum ayatan an yaAAlamahu AAulamao banee israeela

t: And even if We had revealed it to one among the foreigners
tr: Walaw nazzalnahu AAala baAAdi alaAAjameena

t: And he had recited it to them [perfectly], they would [still] not have been Believers in it.
tr: Faqaraahu AAalayhim ma kanoo bihi mumineena

t: Thus have We inserted it [i.e., disbelief] into the hearts of the criminals.
tr: Kathalika salaknahu fee quloobi almujrimeena

t: They will not believe in it until they see the painful punishment.
tr: La yuminoona bihi hatta yarawoo alAAathaba alaleema

t: And it will come to them suddenly while they perceive [it] not.
tr: Fayatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

t: And they will say, “May we be reprieved?”
tr: Fayaqooloo hal nahnu muntharoona

t: So for Our punishment they are trying to hasten?
tr: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona

t: Then have you considered if We gave them enjoyment for years
tr: Afaraayta in mattaAAnahum sineena

t: And then there came to them that which they were promised?
tr: Thumma jaahum ma kanoo yooAAadoona

t: They would not be availed by the enjoyment with which they were provided.
tr: Ma aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yumattaAAoona

t: And We did not destroy any city except that it had warners
tr: Wama ahlakna min qaryatin illa laha munthiroona

t: As a reminder; and never have We been unjust.
tr: Thikra wama kunna thalimeena

t: And the devils have not brought it [i.e., the revelation] down.
tr: Wama tanazzalat bihi alshshayateenu

t: It is not allowable for them, nor would they be able.
tr: Wama yanbaghee lahum wama yastateeAAoona

t: Indeed they, from [its] hearing, are removed.
tr: Innahum AAani alssamAAi lamaAAzooloona

t: So do not invoke with God another deity and [thus] be among the punished.
tr: Fala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara fatakoona mina almuAAaththabeena

t: And warn, [O Muhammad], your closest kindred.
tr: Waanthir AAasheerataka alaqrabeena

t: And lower your wing [i.e., show kindness] to those who follow you of the Believers.
tr: Waikhfid janahaka limani ittabaAAaka mina almumineena

t: And if they disobey you, then say, “Indeed, I am disassociated from what you are doing.”
tr: Fain AAasawka faqul innee bareeon mimma taAAmaloona

t: And rely upon the Exalted in Might, the Merciful,
tr: Watawakkal AAala alAAazeezi alrraheemi

t: Who sees you when you arise
tr: Allathee yaraka heena taqoomu

t: And your movement among those who prostrate.
tr: Wataqallubaka fee alssajideena

t: Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t: Shall I inform you upon whom the devils descend?
tr: Hal onabbiokum AAala man tanazzalu alshshayateenu

t: They descend upon every sinful liar.
tr: Tanazzalu AAala kulli affakin atheemin

t: They pass on what is heard, and most of them are liars.
tr: Yulqoona alssamAAa waaktharuhum kathiboona

t: And the poets - [only] the deviators follow them;
tr: WaalshshuAAarao yattabiAAuhumu alghawoona

t: Do you not see that in every valley they roam
tr: Alam tara annahum fee kulli wadin yaheemoona

t: And that they say what they do not do? -
tr: Waannahum yaqooloona ma la yafAAaloona

t: Except those [poets] who believe and do righteous deeds and remember God often and defend themselves after they were wronged. And those who have wronged are going to know to what [kind of] return they will be returned.
tr: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wathakaroo Allaha katheeran waintasaroo min baAAdi ma thulimoo wasayaAAlamu allatheena thalamoo ayya munqalabin yanqaliboona

t: Tā, Seen. These are the verses of the Qur’ān [i.e., recitation] and a clear Book
tr: Taseen tilka ayatu alqurani wakitabin mubeenin

t: As guidance and good tidings for the Believers
tr: Hudan wabushra lilmumineena

t: Who establish prayer and give zakāh, and of the Hereafter they are certain [in faith].
tr: Allatheena yuqeemoona alssalata wayutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum yooqinoona

t: Indeed, for those who do not believe in the Hereafter, We have made pleasing to them their deeds, so they wander blindly.
tr: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati zayyanna lahum aAAmalahum fahum yaAAmahoona

t: Those are the ones for whom there will be the worst of punishment, and in the Hereafter they are the greatest losers.
tr: Olaika allatheena lahum sooo alAAathabi wahum fee alakhirati humu alakhsaroona

t: And indeed, [O Muhammad], you receive the Qur’ān from one Wise and Knowing.
tr: Wainnaka latulaqqa alqurana min ladun hakeemin AAaleemin

t: [Mention] when Moses said to his family, “Indeed, I have perceived a fire. I will bring you from there information or will bring you a burning torch that you may warm yourselves.”
tr: Ith qala moosa liahlihi innee anastu naran saateekum minha bikhabarin aw ateekum bishihabin qabasin laAAallakum tastaloona

t: But when he came to it, he was called, “Blessed is whoever is at the fire and whoever is around it. And exalted is God, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Falamma jaaha noodiya an boorika man fee alnnari waman hawlaha wasubhana Allahi rabbi alAAalameena

t: O Moses, indeed it is I - God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.”
tr: Ya moosa innahu ana Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: And [he was told], “Throw down your staff.” But when he saw it writhing as if it were a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [God said], “O Moses, fear not. Indeed, in My presence the messengers do not fear.
tr: Waalqi AAasaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yuAAaqqib ya moosa la takhaf innee la yakhafu ladayya almursaloona

t: Otherwise, he who wrongs, then substitutes good after evil - indeed, I am Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Illa man thalama thumma baddala husnan baAAda sooin fainnee ghafoorun raheemun

t: And put your hand into the opening of your garment [at the breast]; it will come out white without disease. [These are] among the nine signs [you will take] to Pharaoh and his people. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient.”
tr: Waadkhil yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin fee tisAAi ayatin ila firAAawna waqawmihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

t: But when there came to them Our visible signs, they said, “This is obvious magic.”
tr: Falamma jaathum ayatuna mubsiratan qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun

t: And they rejected them, while their [inner] selves were convinced thereof, out of injustice and haughtiness. So see how was the end of the corrupters.
tr: Wajahadoo biha waistayqanatha anfusuhum thulman waAAuluwwan faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almufsideena

t: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, “Praise [is due] to God, who has favoured us over many of His believing servants.”
tr: Walaqad atayna dawooda wasulaymana AAilman waqala alhamdu lillahi allathee faddalana AAala katheerin min AAibadihi almumineena

t: And Solomon inherited David. He said, “O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty.”
tr: Wawaritha sulaymanu dawooda waqala ya ayyuha alnnasu AAullimna mantiqa alttayri waooteena min kulli shayin inna hatha lahuwa alfadlu almubeenu

t: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
tr: Wahushira lisulaymana junooduhu mina aljinni waalinsi waalttayri fahum yoozaAAoona

t: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, “O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they ” perceive not.
