tr: Hatta itha ataw AAala wadi alnnamli qalat namlatun ya ayyuha alnnamlu odkhuloo masakinakum la yahtimannakum sulaymanu wajunooduhu wahum la yashAAuroona

t: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, “My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants.”
tr: Fatabassama dahikan min qawliha waqala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waadkhilnee birahmatika fee AAibadika alssaliheena

t: And he took attendance of the birds and said, “Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
tr: Watafaqqada alttayra faqala ma liya la ara alhudhuda am kana mina alghaibeena

t: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization.”
tr: LaoAAaththibannahu AAathaban shadeedan aw laathbahannahu aw layatiyannee bisultanin mubeenin

t: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, “I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
tr: Famakatha ghayra baAAeedin faqala ahattu bima lam tuhit bihi wajituka min sabain binabain yaqeenin

t: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
tr: Innee wajadtu imraatan tamlikuhum waootiyat min kulli shayin walaha AAarshun AAatheemun

t: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of God, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and prevented them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
tr: Wajadtuha waqawmaha yasjudoona lilshshamsi min dooni Allahi wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fasaddahum AAani alssabeeli fahum la yahtadoona

t: [And] so they do not prostrate to God, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
tr: Alla yasjudoo lillahi allathee yukhriju alkhabaa fee alssamawati waalardi wayaAAlamu ma tukhfoona wama tuAAlinoona

t: God - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne.”
tr: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa rabbu alAAarshi alAAatheemi

t: [Solomon] said, “We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
tr: Qala sananthuru asadaqta am kunta mina alkathibeena

t: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what ” [answer] they will return.
tr: Ithhab bikitabee hatha faalqih ilayhim thumma tawalla AAanhum faonthur matha yarjiAAoona

t: She said, “O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
tr: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao innee olqiya ilayya kitabun kareemun

t: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: ‘In the Name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful,
tr: Innahu min sulaymana wainnahu bismi Allahi alrrahmani alrraheemi

t: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].’ ”
tr: Alla taAAloo AAalayya watoonee muslimeena

t: She said, “O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me.”
tr: Qalat ya ayyuha almalao aftoonee fee amree ma kuntu qatiAAatan amran hatta tashhadoona

t: They said, “We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command.”
tr: Qaloo nahnu oloo quwwatin waoloo basin shadeedin waalamru ilayki faonthuree matha tamureena

t: She said, “Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honoured of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
tr: Qalat inna almulooka itha dakhaloo qaryatan afsadooha wajaAAaloo aAAizzata ahliha athillatan wakathalika yafAAaloona

t: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return.”
tr: Wainnee mursilatun ilayhim bihadiyyatin fanathiratun bima yarjiAAu almursaloona

t: So when they came to Solomon, he said, “Do you provide me with wealth? But what God has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
tr: Falamma jaa sulaymana qala atumiddoonani bimalin fama ataniya Allahu khayrun mimma atakum bal antum bihadiyyatikum tafrahoona

t: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased.”
tr: IrjiAA ilayhim falanatiyannahum bijunoodin la qibala lahum biha walanukhrijannahum minha athillatan wahum saghiroona

t: [Solomon] said, “O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?”
tr: Qala ya ayyuha almalao ayyukum yateenee biAAarshiha qabla an yatoonee muslimeena

t: A powerful one from among the jinn said, “I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy.”
tr: Qala AAifreetun mina aljinni ana ateeka bihi qabla an taqooma min maqamika wainne AAalayhi laqawiyyun ameenun

t: Said one who had knowledge from the Book, “I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you.” And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, “This is from the favour of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous.”
tr: Qala allathee AAindahu AAilmun mina alkitabi ana ateeka bihi qabla an yartadda ilayka tarfuka falamma raahu mustaqirran AAindahu qala hatha min fadli rabbee liyabluwanee aashkuru am akfuru waman shakara fainnama yashkuru linafsihi waman kafara fainna rabbee ghaniyyun kareemun

t: He said, “Disguise for her, her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided.”
tr: Qala nakkiroo laha AAarshaha nanthur atahtadee am takoonu mina allatheena la yahtadoona

t: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], “Is your throne like this?” She said, “[It is] as though it was it.” [Solomon said], “And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to God].
tr: Falamma jaat qeela ahakatha AAarshuki qalat kaannahu huwa waooteena alAAilma min qabliha wakunna muslimeena

t: And that which she was worshipping other than God had prevented her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people.”
tr: Wasaddaha ma kanat taAAbudu min dooni Allahi innaha kanat min qawmin kafireena

t: She was told, “Enter the palace.” But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, “Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass.” She said, “My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to God, Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Qeela laha odkhulee alssarha falamma raathu hasibathu lujjatan wakashafat AAan saqayha qala innahu sarhun mumarradun min qawareera qalat rabbi innee thalamtu nafsee waaslamtu maAAa sulaymana lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

t: And We had certainly sent to Thamūd their brother Sālih, [saying], “Worship God,” and at once they were two parties conflicting.
tr: Walaqad arsalna ila thamooda akhahum salihan ani oAAbudoo Allaha faitha hum fareeqani yakhtasimoona

t: He said, “O my people, why do you seek to hasten the evil before [i.e., instead of] the good? Why do you not seek forgiveness of God that you may receive ” mercy?
tr: Qala ya qawmi lima tastaAAjiloona bialssayyiati qabla alhasanati lawla tastaghfiroona Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona

t: They said, “We consider you a bad omen, you and those with you.” He said, “Your omen [i.e., fate] is with God. Rather, you are a people being tested.”
tr: Qaloo ittayyarna bika wabiman maAAaka qala tairukum AAinda Allahi bal antum qawmun tuftanoona

t: And there were in the city nine family heads causing corruption in the land and not amending [its affairs].
tr: Wakana fee almadeenati tisAAatu rahtin yufsidoona fee alardi wala yuslihoona

t: They said, “Take a mutual oath by God that we will kill him by night, he and his family. Then we will say to his executor, ‘We did not witness the destruction of his family, and indeed, we are truthful.’ ”
tr: Qaloo taqasamoo biAllahi lanubayyitannahu waahlahu thumma lanaqoolanna liwaliyyihi ma shahidna mahlika ahlihi wainna lasadiqoona

t: And they planned a plan, and We planned a plan, while they perceived not.
tr: Wamakaroo makran wamakarna makran wahum la yashAAuroona

t: Then look how was the outcome of their plan - that We destroyed them and their people, all.
tr: Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu makrihim anna dammarnahum waqawmahum ajmaAAeena

t: So those are their houses, desolate because of the wrong they had done. Indeed in that is a sign for people who know.
tr: Fatilka buyootuhum khawiyatan bima thalamoo inna fee thalika laayatan liqawmin yaAAlamoona

t: And We saved those who believed and used to fear God.
tr: Waanjayna allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona

t: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, “Do you commit immorality while you are seeing?
tr: Walootan ith qala liqawmihi atatoona alfahishata waantum tubsiroona

t: Do you indeed approach men with desire instead of women? Rather, you are an ignorant people.”
tr: Ainnakum latatoona alrrijala shahwatan min dooni alnnisai bal antum qawmun tajhaloona

t: But the answer of his people was not except that they said, “Expel the family of Lot from your city. Indeed, they are ” people who keep themselves pure.
tr: Fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo akhrijoo ala lootin min qaryatikum innahum onasun yatatahharoona

t: So We saved him and his family, except for his wife; We destined her to be of those who remained behind.
tr: Faanjaynahu waahlahu illa imraatahu qaddarnaha mina alghabireena

t: And We rained upon them a rain [of stones], and evil was the rain of those who were warned.
tr: Waamtarna AAalayhim mataran fasaa mataru almunthareena

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Praise be to God, and peace upon His servants whom He has chosen. Is God better or what they associate with Him?”
tr: Quli alhamdu lillahi wasalamun AAala AAibadihi allatheena istafa allahu khayrun amma yushrikoona

t: [More precisely], is He [not best] who created the heavens and the earth and sent down for you rain from the sky, causing to grow thereby gardens of joyful beauty which you could not [otherwise] have grown the trees thereof? Is there a deity with God? [No], but they are a people who ascribe equals [to Him].
tr: Amman khalaqa alssamawati waalarda waanzala lakum mina alssamai maan faanbatna bihi hadaiqa thata bahjatin ma kana lakum an tunbitoo shajaraha ailahun maAAa Allahi bal hum qawmun yaAAdiloona

t: Is He [not best] who made the earth a stable ground and placed within it rivers and made for it firmly set mountains and placed between the two seas a barrier? Is there a deity with God? [No], but most of them do not know.
tr: Amman jaAAala alarda qararan wajaAAala khilalaha anharan wajaAAala laha rawasiya wajaAAala bayna albahrayni hajizan ailahun maAAa Allahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

t: Is He [not best] who responds to the desperate one when he calls upon Him and removes evil and makes you inheritors of the earth? Is there a deity with God? Little do you remember.
tr: Amman yujeebu almudtarra itha daAAahu wayakshifu alssooa wayajAAalukum khulafaa alardi ailahun maAAa Allahi qaleelan ma tathakkaroona

t: Is He [not best] who guides you through the darknesses of the land and sea and who sends the winds as good tidings before His mercy? Is there a deity with God? High is God above whatever they associate with Him.
tr: Amman yahdeekum fee thulumati albarri waalbahri waman yursilu alrriyaha bushran bayna yaday rahmatihi ailahun maAAa Allahi taAAala Allahu AAamma yushrikoona

t: Is He [not best] who begins creation and then repeats it and who provides for you from the heaven and earth? Is there a deity with God? Say, “Produce your proof, if you should be truthful.”
tr: Amman yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu waman yarzuqukum mina alssamai waalardi ailahun maAAa Allahi qul hatoo burhanakum in kuntum sadiqeena

t: Say, “None in the heavens and earth knows the unseen except God, and they do not perceive when they will be resurrected.”
tr: Qul la yaAAlamu man fee alssamawati waalardi alghayba illa Allahu wama yashAAuroona ayyana yubAAathoona

t: Rather, their knowledge fails consecutively in [comprehending] the Hereafter. Rather, they are in doubt about it. Rather, they are, concerning it, blind.
tr: Bali iddaraka AAilmuhum fee alakhirati bal hum fee shakkin minha bal hum minha AAamoona

t: And those who disbelieve say, “When we have become dust as well as our forefathers, will we indeed be brought out [of the graves]?
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo aitha kunna turaban waabaona ainna lamukhrajoona

t: We have been promised this, we and our forefathers, before. This is not but legends of the former peoples.”
tr: Laqad wuAAidna hatha nahnu waabaona min qablu in hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Proceed [i.e., travel] through the land and observe how was the end of the criminals.”
tr: Qul seeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu almujrimeena

t: And grieve not over them or be in distress from what they conspire.
tr: Wala tahzan AAalayhim wala takun fee dayqin mimma yamkuroona

t: And they say, “When is [the fulfillment of] this promise, if you should be truthful?”
tr: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

t: Say, “Perhaps it is close behind you [i.e., very near] - some of that for which you seek to hasten.
tr: Qul AAasa an yakoona radifa lakum baAAdu allathee tastaAAjiloona

t: And indeed, your Lord is full of bounty for the people, but most of them do not show gratitude.”
tr: Wainna rabbaka lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna aktharahum la yashkuroona

t: And indeed, your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
tr: Wainna rabbaka layaAAlamu ma tukinnu sudooruhum wama yuAAlinoona

t: And there is nothing concealed within the heaven and the earth except that it is in a clear Register.
tr: Wama min ghaibatin fee alssamai waalardi illa fee kitabin mubeenin

t: Indeed, this Qur’ān relates to the Children of Israel most of that over which they disagree.
tr: Inna hatha alqurana yaqussu AAala banee israeela akthara allathee hum feehi yakhtalifoona

t: And indeed, it is guidance and mercy for the Believers.
tr: Wainnahu lahudan warahmatun lilmumineena

t: Indeed, your Lord will judge between them by His [wise] judgement. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
tr: Inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum bihukmihi wahuwa alAAazeezu alAAaleemu

t: So rely upon God; indeed, you are upon the clear truth.
tr: Fatawakkal AAala Allahi innaka AAala alhaqqi almubeeni

t: Indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they have turned their backs retreating.
tr: Innaka la tusmiAAu almawta wala tusmiAAu alssumma aldduAAaa itha wallaw mudbireena

t: And you cannot guide the blind out of their error. You cannot make anyone hear you except those who believe in Our signs and are of the Muslims [those who submit].
tr: Wama anta bihadee alAAumyi AAan dalalatihim in tusmiAAu illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimoona

t: And when the word [i.e., decree] befalls them, We will bring forth for them a creature from the earth speaking to them, [saying] that the people were, of Our verses, not certain [in faith].
tr: Waitha waqaAAa alqawlu AAalayhim akhrajna lahum dabbatan mina alardi tukallimuhum anna alnnasa kanoo biayatina la yooqinoona

t: And [warn of] the Day when We will gather from every nation a company of those who deny Our signs, and they will be [driven] in rows
tr: Wayawma nahshuru min kulli ommatin fawjan mimman yukaththibu biayatina fahum yoozaAAoona

t: Until, when they arrive [at the place of Judgement], He will say, “Did you deny My signs while you did not encompass them in knowledge, or what [was it that] you were doing?”
tr: Hatta itha jaoo qala akaththabtum biayatee walam tuheetoo biha AAilman ammatha kuntum taAAmaloona

t: And the decree will befall them for the wrong they did, and they will not [be able to] speak.
tr: WawaqaAAa alqawlu AAalayhim bima thalamoo fahum la yantiqoona

t: Do they not see that We made the night that they may rest therein and the day giving sight? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Alam yaraw anna jaAAalna allayla liyaskunoo feehi waalnnahara mubsiran inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

t: And [warn of] the Day the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will be terrified except whom God wills. And all will come to Him humbled.
tr: Wayawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fafaziAAa man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu wakullun atawhu dakhireena

t: And you see the mountains, thinking them rigid, while they will pass as the passing of clouds. [It is] the work of God, who perfected all things. Indeed, He is Acquainted with that which you do.
tr: Watara aljibala tahsabuha jamidatan wahiya tamurru marra alssahabi sunAAa Allahi allathee atqana kulla shayin innahu khabeerun bima tafAAaloona

t: Whoever comes [at Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it, and they, from the terror of that Day, will be safe.
tr: Man jaa bialhasanati falahu khayrun minha wahum min fazaAAin yawmaithin aminoona

t: And whoever comes with an evil deed - their faces will be overturned into the Fire, [and it will be said], “Are you recompensed except for what you used to do?”
tr: Waman jaa bialssayyiati fakubbat wujoohuhum fee alnnari hal tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: [Say, O Muhammad], “I have only been commanded to worship the Lord of this city, who made it sacred and to whom [belongs] all things. And I am commanded to be of the Muslims [i.e., those who submit to God]
tr: Innama omirtu an aAAbuda rabba hathihi albaldati allathee harramaha walahu kullu shayin waomirtu an akoona mina almuslimeena

t: And to recite the Qur’ān.” And whoever is guided is only guided for [the benefit of] himself; and whoever strays - say, “I am only [one] of the warners.”
tr: Waan atluwa alqurana famani ihtada fainnama yahtadee linafsihi waman dalla faqul innama ana mina almunthireena

t: And say, “All praise be to God. He will show you His signs, and you will recognize them. And your Lord is not unaware of what you do.”
tr: Waquli alhamdu lillahi sayureekum ayatihi fataAArifoonaha wama rabbuka bighafilin AAamma taAAmaloona

t: Tā, Seen, Meem.
tr: Taseenmeem

t: These are the verses of the clear Book.
tr: Tilka ayatu alkitabi almubeeni

t: We recite to you from the news of Moses and Pharaoh in truth for a people who believe.
tr: Natloo AAalayka min nabai moosa wafirAAawna bialhaqqi liqawmin yuminoona

t: Indeed, Pharaoh exalted himself in the land and made its people into factions, oppressing a sector among them, slaughtering their [newborn] sons and keeping their females alive. Indeed, he was of the corrupters.
tr: Inna firAAawna AAala fee alardi wajaAAala ahlaha shiyaAAan yastadAAifu taifatan minhum yuthabbihu abnaahum wayastahyee nisaahum innahu kana mina almufsideena

t: And We wanted to confer favour upon those who were oppressed in the land and make them leaders and make them inheritors
tr: Wanureedu an namunna AAala allatheena istudAAifoo fee alardi wanajAAalahum aimmatan wanajAAalahumu alwaritheena

t: And establish them in the land and show Pharaoh and [his minister] Hāmān and their soldiers through them that which they had feared.
tr: Wanumakkina lahum fee alardi wanuriya firAAawna wahamana wajunoodahuma minhum ma kanoo yahtharoona

t: And We inspired to the mother of Moses, “Suckle him; but when you fear for him, cast him into the river and do not fear and do not grieve. Indeed, We will return him to you and will make him [one] of the messengers.”
tr: Waawhayna ila ommi moosa an ardiAAeehi faitha khifti AAalayhi faalqeehi fee alyammi wala takhafee wala tahzanee inna raddoohu ilayki wajaAAiloohu mina almursaleena

t: And the family of Pharaoh picked him up [out of the river] so that he would become to them an enemy and a [cause of] grief. Indeed, Pharaoh and Hāmān and their soldiers were deliberate sinners.
tr: Failtaqatahu alu firAAawna liyakoona lahum AAaduwwan wahazanan inna firAAawna wahamana wajunoodahuma kanoo khatieena

t: And the wife of Pharaoh said, “[He will be] a delight of the eye for me and for you. Do not kill him; perhaps he may benefit us, or we may adopt him as a son.” They did not realize what they were doing.
tr: Waqalati imraatu firAAawna qurratu AAaynin lee walaka la taqtuloohu AAasa an yanfaAAana aw nattakhithahu waladan wahum la yashAAuroona

t: And the heart of Moses’ mother became empty [of all else]. She was about to disclose [the matter concerning] him had We not bound fast her heart that she would be of the Believers.
tr: Waasbaha fuadu ommi moosa farighan in kadat latubdee bihi lawla an rabatna AAala qalbiha litakoona mina almumineena

t: And she said to his sister, “Follow him”; so she watched him from a distance while they perceived not.
tr: Waqalat liokhtihi qusseehi fabasurat bihi AAan junubin wahum la yashAAuroona

t: And We had prevented from him [all] wet nurses before, so she said, “Shall I direct you to a household that will be responsible for him for you while they are to him [for his upbringing] sincere?”
tr: Waharramna AAalayhi almaradiAAa min qablu faqalat hal adullukum AAala ahli baytin yakfuloonahu lakum wahum lahu nasihoona

t: So We restored him to his mother that she might be content and not grieve and that she would know that the promise of God is true. But most of them [i.e., the people] do not know.
tr: Faradadnahu ila ommihi kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana walitaAAlama anna waAAda Allahi haqqun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

t: And when he attained his full strength and was [mentally] mature, We bestowed upon him judgement and knowledge. And thus do We reward those who strive for excellence.
tr: Walamma balagha ashuddahu waistawa ataynahu hukman waAAilman wakathalika najzee almuhsineena

t: And he entered the city at a time of inattention by its people and found therein two men fighting: one from his faction and one from among his enemy. And the one from his faction called for help to him against the one from his enemy, so Moses struck him and [unintentionally] killed him. [Moses] said, “This is from the work of Satan. Indeed, he is a manifest, misleading enemy.”
tr: Wadakhala almadeenata AAala heeni ghaflatin min ahliha fawajada feeha rajulayni yaqtatilani hatha min sheeAAatihi wahatha min AAaduwwihi faistaghathahu allathee min sheeAAatihi AAala allathee min AAaduwwihi fawakazahu moosa faqada AAalayhi qala hatha min AAamali alshshaytani innahu AAaduwwun mudillun mubeenun

t: He said, “My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, so forgive me,” and He forgave him. Indeed, He is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
tr: Qala rabbi innee thalamtu nafsee faighfir lee faghafara lahu innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu

t: He said, “My Lord, for the favour You bestowed upon me, I will never be an assistant to the criminals.”
tr: Qala rabbi bima anAAamta AAalayya falan akoona thaheeran lilmujrimeena

t: And he became inside the city fearful and anticipating [exposure], when suddenly the one who sought his help the previous day cried out to him [once again]. Moses said to him, “Indeed, you are an evident, [persistent] deviator.”
tr: Faasbaha fee almadeenati khaifan yataraqqabu faitha allathee istansarahu bialamsi yastasrikhuhu qala lahu moosa innaka laghawiyyun mubeenun

t: And when he wanted to strike the one who was an enemy to both of them, he said, “O Moses, do you intend to kill me as you killed someone yesterday? You want to be a tyrant in the land and you do not want to be of the reconcilers.”
tr: Falamma an arada an yabtisha biallathee huwa AAaduwwun lahuma qala ya moosa atureedu an taqtulanee kama qatalta nafsan bialamsi in tureedu illa an takoona jabbaran fee alardi wama tureedu an takoona mina almusliheena

t: And a man came from the farthest end of the city, running. He said, “O Moses, indeed the eminent ones are conferring over you [intending] to kill you, so leave [the city]; indeed, I am to you of the sincere advisors.”
tr: Wajaa rajulun min aqsa almadeenati yasAAa qala ya moosa inna almalaa yatamiroona bika liyaqtulooka faokhruj innee laka mina alnnasiheena

t: So he left it, fearful and anticipating [apprehension]. He said, “My Lord, save me from the wrongdoing people.”
tr: Fakharaja minha khaifan yataraqqabu qala rabbi najjinee mina alqawmi alththalimeena

t: And when he directed himself toward Madyan, he said, “Perhaps my Lord will ” guide me to the sound way.
tr: Walamma tawajjaha tilqaa madyana qala AAasa rabbee an yahdiyanee sawaa alssabeeli

t: And when he came to the water [i.e., well] of Madyan, he found there a crowd of people watering [their flocks], and he found aside from them two women driving back [their flocks]. He said, “What is your circumstance?” They said, “We do not water until the shepherds dispatch [their flocks]; and our father is an old man.”
tr: Walamma warada maa madyana wajada AAalayhi ommatan mina alnnasi yasqoona wawajada min doonihimu imraatayni tathoodani qala ma khatbukuma qalata la nasqee hatta yusdira alrriAAao waaboona shaykhun kabeerun

t: So he watered [their flocks] for them; then he went back to the shade and said, “My Lord, indeed I am, for whatever good You would send down to me, in need.”
tr: Fasaqa lahuma thumma tawalla ila alththilli faqala rabbi innee lima anzalta ilayya min khayrin faqeerun

t: Then one of the two women came to him walking with shyness. She said, “Indeed, my father invites you that he may reward you for having watered for us.” So when he came to him and related to him the story, he said, “Fear not. You have escaped from the wrongdoing people.”
tr: Fajaathu ihdahuma tamshee AAala istihyain qalat inna abee yadAAooka liyajziyaka ajra ma saqayta lana falamma jaahu waqassa AAalayhi alqasasa qala la takhaf najawta mina alqawmi alththalimeena

t: One of the women said, “O my father, hire him. Indeed, the best one you can hire is the strong and the trustworthy.”
tr: Qalat ihdahuma ya abati istajirhu inna khayra mani istajarta alqawiyyu alameenu

t: He said, “Indeed, I wish to wed you one of these, my two daughters, on [the condition] that you serve me for eight years; but if you complete ten, it will be [as a favour] from you. And I do not wish to put you in difficulty. You will find me, if God wills, from among the righteous.”
tr: Qala innee oreedu an onkihaka ihda ibnatayya hatayni AAala an tajuranee thamaniya hijajin fain atmamta AAashran famin AAindika wama oreedu an ashuqqa AAalayka satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssaliheena

t: [Moses] said, “That is [established] between me and you. Whichever of the two terms I complete - there is no injustice to me, and God, over what we say, is Witness.”
tr: Qala thalika baynee wabaynaka ayyama alajalayni qadaytu fala AAudwana AAalayya waAllahu AAala ma naqoolu wakeelun

t: And when Moses had completed the term and was traveling with his family, he perceived from the direction of the mount a fire. He said to his family, “Stay here; indeed, I have perceived a fire. Perhaps I will bring you from there [some] information or burning wood from the fire that you may warm yourselves.”
tr: Falamma qada moosaalajala wasara biahlihi anasa min janibi alttoori naran qala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha bikhabarin aw jathwatin mina alnnari laAAallakum tastaloona

t: But when he came to it, he was called from the right side of the valley in a blessed spot - from the tree, “O Moses, indeed I am God, Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Falamma ataha noodiya min shatii alwadi alaymani fee albuqAAati almubarakati mina alshshajarati an ya moosa innee ana Allahu rabbu alAAalameena

t: And [he was told], “Throw down your staff.” But when he saw it writhing as if it was a snake, he turned in flight and did not return. [God said], “O Moses, approach and fear not. Indeed, you are of the secure.
tr: Waan alqi AAasaka falamma raaha tahtazzu kaannaha jannun walla mudbiran walam yuAAaqqib ya moosa aqbil wala takhaf innaka mina alamineena

t: Insert your hand into the opening of your garment; it will come out white, without disease. And draw in your arm close to you [as prevention] from fear, for those are two proofs from your Lord to Pharaoh and his establishment. Indeed, they have been a people defiantly disobedient.”
tr: Osluk yadaka fee jaybika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin waodmum ilayka janahaka mina alrrahbi fathanika burhanani min rabbika ila firAAawna wamalaihi innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

t: He said, “My Lord, indeed, I killed from among them someone, and I fear they will kill me.
tr: Qala rabbi innee qataltu minhum nafsan faakhafu an yaqtulooni

t: And my brother Aaron is more fluent than me in tongue, so send him with me as support, verifying me. Indeed, I fear that they will deny me.”
tr: Waakhee haroonu huwa afsahu minnee lisanan faarsilhu maAAiya ridan yusaddiqunee innee akhafu an yukaththibooni

t: [God] said, “We will strengthen your arm through your brother and grant you both authority so they will not reach you. [It will be] through Our signs; you and those who follow you will be victorious.”
tr: Qala sanashuddu AAadudaka biakheeka wanajAAalu lakuma sultanan fala yasiloona ilaykuma biayatina antuma wamani ittabaAAakuma alghaliboona

t: But when Moses came to them with Our signs as clear evidences, they said, “This is not except invented magic, and we have not heard of this [religion] among ” our forefathers.
tr: Falamma jaahum moosa biayatina bayyinatin qaloo ma hatha illa sihrun muftaran wama samiAAna bihatha fee abaina alawwaleena

t: And Moses said, “My Lord is more knowing [than we or you] of who has come with guidance from Him and to whom will be succession in the home. Indeed, wrongdoers do not succeed.”
tr: Waqala moosa rabbee aAAlamu biman jaa bialhuda min AAindihi waman takoonu lahu AAaqibatu alddari innahu la yuflihu alththalimoona

t: And Pharaoh said, “O eminent ones, I have not known you to have a god other than me. Then ignite for me, O Hāmān, [a fire] upon the clay and make for me a tower that I may look at the God of Moses. And indeed, I do think he is among the liars.”
tr: Waqala firAAawnu ya ayyuha almalao ma AAalimtu lakum min ilahin ghayree faawqid lee ya hamanu AAala altteeni faijAAal lee sarhan laAAallee attaliAAu ila ilahi moosa wainnee laathunnuhu mina alkathibeena

t: And he was arrogant, he and his soldiers, in the land, without right, and they thought that they would not be returned to Us.
tr: Waistakbara huwa wajunooduhu fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wathannoo annahum ilayna la yurjaAAoona

t: So We took him and his soldiers and threw them into the sea. So see how was the end of the wrongdoers.
tr: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu alththalimeena

t: And We made them leaders inviting to the Fire, and on the Day of Resurrection they will not be helped.
tr: WajaAAalnahum aimmatan yadAAoona ila alnnari wayawma alqiyamati la yunsaroona

t: We pursued them with a curse in this world, and on the Day of Resurrection they will be of the despised.
tr: WaatbaAAnahum fee hathihi alddunya laAAnatan wayawma alqiyamati hum mina almaqbooheena

t: And We gave Moses the Book, after We had destroyed the former generations, as enlightenment for the people and guidance and mercy that they might be reminded.
tr: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba min baAAdi ma ahlakna alquroona aloola basaira lilnnasi wahudan warahmatan laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

t: And you, [O Muhammad], were not on the western side [of the mount] when We revealed to Moses the command, and you were not among the witnesses [to that].
tr: Wama kunta bijanibi algharbiyyi ith qadayna ila moosa alamra wama kunta mina alshshahideena

t: But We produced [many] generations [after Moses], and prolonged was their duration. And you were not a resident among the people of Madyan, reciting to them Our verses, but We were senders [of this message].
tr: Walakinna anshana quroonan fatatawala AAalayhimu alAAumuru wama kunta thawiyan fee ahli madyana tatloo AAalayhim ayatina walakinna kunna mursileena

t: And you were not at the side of the mount when We called [Moses] but [were sent] as a mercy from your Lord to warn a people to whom no warner had come before you that they might be reminded.
tr: Wama kunta bijanibi alttoori ith nadayna walakin rahmatan min rabbika litunthira qawman ma atahum min natheerin min qablika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

t: And if not that a disaster should strike them for what their hands put forth [of sins] and they would say, “Our Lord, why did You not send us a messenger so we could have followed Your verses and been among the Believers?”...
tr: Walawla an tuseebahum museebatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fayaqooloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika wanakoona mina almumineena

t: But when the truth came to them from Us, they said, “Why was he not given like that which was given to Moses?” Did they not disbelieve in that which was given to Moses before? They said, “[They are but] two works of magic supporting each other, and indeed we are, in both, disbelievers.”
tr: Falamma jaahumu alhaqqu min AAindina qaloo lawla ootiya mithla ma ootiya moosa awalam yakfuroo bima ootiya moosa min qablu qaloo sihrani tathahara waqaloo inna bikullin kafiroona

t: Say, “Then bring a Book from God which is more guiding than either of them that I may follow it, if you should be truthful.”
tr: Qul fatoo bikitabin min AAindi Allahi huwa ahda minhuma attabiAAhu in kuntum sadiqeena

t: But if they do not respond to you - then know that they only follow their [own] desires. And who is more astray than one who follows his desire without guidance from God? Indeed, God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
tr: Fain lam yastajeeboo laka faiAAlam annama yattabiAAoona ahwaahum waman adallu mimmani ittabaAAa hawahu bighayri hudan mina Allahi inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena

t: And We have [repeatedly] conveyed to them the word [i.e., the Qur’ān] that they might be reminded.
tr: Walaqad wassalna lahumu alqawla laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

t: Those to whom We gave the Book before it - they are Believers in it.
tr: Allatheena ataynahumu alkitaba min qablihi hum bihi yuminoona

t: And when it is recited to them, they say, “We have believed in it; indeed, it is the truth from our Lord. Indeed we were, [even] before it, Muslims [i.e., ” submitting to God].
tr: Waitha yutla AAalayhim qaloo amanna bihi innahu alhaqqu min rabbina inna kunna min qablihi muslimeena

t: Those will be given their reward twice for what they patiently endured and [because] they avert evil through good, and from what We have provided them they spend.
tr: Olaika yutawna ajrahum marratayni bima sabaroo wayadraoona bialhasanati alssayyiata wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona

t: And when they hear ill speech, they turn away from it and say, “For us are our deeds, and for you are your deeds. Peace will be upon you; we seek not [the company of] the ignorant.”
tr: Waitha samiAAoo allaghwa aAAradoo AAanhu waqaloo lana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum salamun AAalaykum la nabtaghee aljahileena

t: Indeed, [O Muhammad], you do not guide whom you like, but God guides whom He wills. And He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
tr: Innaka la tahdee man ahbabta walakinna Allaha yahdee man yashao wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena

t: And they [i.e., the Quraysh] say, “If we were to follow the guidance with you, we would be swept from our land.” Have We not established for them a safe sanctuary to which are brought the fruits of all things as provision from Us? But most of them do not know.
tr: Waqaloo in nattabiAAi alhuda maAAaka nutakhattaf min ardina awalam numakkin lahum haraman aminan yujba ilayhi thamaratu kulli shayin rizqan min ladunna walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

t: And how many a city have We destroyed that was insolent in its [way of] living, and those are their dwellings which have not been inhabited after them except briefly. And it is We who were the inheritors.
tr: Wakam ahlakna min qaryatin batirat maAAeeshataha fatilka masakinuhum lam tuskan min baAAdihim illa qaleelan wakunna nahnu alwaritheena

t: And never would your Lord have destroyed the cities until He had sent to their mother [i.e., principal city] a messenger reciting to them Our verses. And We would not destroy the cities except while their people were wrongdoers.
tr: Wama kana rabbuka muhlika alqura hatta yabAAatha fee ommiha rasoolan yatloo AAalayhim ayatina wama kunna muhlikee alqura illa waahluha thalimoona

t: And whatever thing you [people] have been given - it is [only for] the enjoyment of worldly life and its adornment. And what is with God is better and more lasting; so will you not use reason?
tr: Wama ooteetum min shayin famataAAu alhayati alddunya wazeenatuha wama AAinda Allahi khayrun waabqa afala taAAqiloona

t: Then is he whom We have promised a good promise which he will meet [i.e., obtain] like he for whom We provided enjoyment of worldly life [but] then he is, on the Day of Resurrection, among those presented [for punishment in Hell]?
tr: Afaman waAAadnahu waAAdan hasanan fahuwa laqeehi kaman mattaAAnahu mataAAa alhayati alddunya thumma huwa yawma alqiyamati mina almuhdareena

t: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, “Where are My ‘partners’ which you used to claim?”
tr: Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tazAAumoona

t: Those upon whom the word will have come into effect will say, “Our Lord, these are the ones we led to error. We led them to error just as we were in error. We declare our disassociation [from them] to You. They did not used to worship [i.e., obey] us.”
tr: Qala allatheena haqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu rabbana haolai allatheena aghwayna aghwaynahum kama ghawayna tabarrana ilayka ma kanoo iyyana yaAAbudoona

t: And it will be said, “Invoke your ‘partners,’ ” and they will invoke them; but they will not respond to them, and they will see the punishment. If only they had followed guidance!
tr: Waqeela odAAoo shurakaakum fadaAAawhum falam yastajeeboo lahum waraawoo alAAathaba law annahum kanoo yahtadoona

t: And [mention] the Day He will call them and say, “What did you answer the messengers?”
tr: Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu matha ajabtumu almursaleena

t: So they were blinded to the news that Day, so they will not ask one another.
tr: FaAAamiyat AAalayhimu alanbao yawmaithin fahum la yatasaaloona

t: But as for one who had repented, believed, and done righteousness, hopefully he will be among the successful.
tr: Faamma man taba waamana waAAamila salihan faAAasa an yakoona mina almufliheena

t: And your Lord creates what He wills and chooses; not for them was the choice. Exalted is God and high above what they associate with Him.
tr: Warabbuka yakhluqu ma yashao wayakhtaru ma kana lahumu alkhiyaratu subhana Allahi wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

t: And your Lord knows what their breasts conceal and what they declare.
tr: Warabbuka yaAAlamu ma tukinnu sudooruhum wama yuAAlinoona

t: And He is God; there is no deity except Him. To Him is [due all] praise in the first [life] and the Hereafter. And His is the [final] decision, and to Him you will be returned.
tr: Wahuwa Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alhamdu fee aloola waalakhirati walahu alhukmu wailayhi turjaAAoona

t: Say, “Have you considered: if God should make for you the night continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than God could bring you light [illumination]? Then will you not hear?”
tr: Qul araaytum in jaAAala Allahu AAalaykumu allayla sarmadan ila yawmi alqiyamati man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bidiyain afala tasmaAAoona

t: Say, “Have you considered: if God should make for you the day continuous until the Day of Resurrection, what deity other than God could bring you a night in which you may rest? Then will you not see?”
tr: Qul araaytum in jaAAala Allahu AAalaykumu alnnahara sarmadan ila yawmi alqiyamati man ilahun ghayru Allahi yateekum bilaylin taskunoona feehi afala tubsiroona

t: And out of His mercy He made for you the night and the day that you may rest therein and [by day] seek from His bounty and [that] perhaps you will be grateful.
tr: Wamin rahmatihi jaAAala lakumu allayla waalnnahara litaskunoo feehi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona

t: And [warn of] the Day He will call them and say, “Where are my ‘partners’ which you used to claim?”
tr: Wayawma yunadeehim fayaqoolu ayna shurakaiya allatheena kuntum tazAAumoona

t: And We will extract from every nation a witness and say, “Produce your proof,” and they will know that the truth belongs to God, and lost from them is that which they used to invent.
tr: WanazaAAna min kulli ommatin shaheedan faqulna hatoo burhanakum faAAalimoo anna alhaqqa lillahi wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yaftaroona

t: Indeed, Qārūn was from the people of Moses, but he tyrannized them. And We gave him of treasures whose keys would burden a band of strong men; thereupon his people said to him, “Do not exult. Indeed, God does not like the exultant.
tr: Inna qaroona kana min qawmi moosa fabagha AAalayhim waataynahu mina alkunoozi ma inna mafatihahu latanooo bialAAusbati olee alquwwati ith qala lahu qawmuhu la tafrah inna Allaha la yuhibbu alfariheena

t: But seek, through that which God has given you, the home of the Hereafter; and [yet], do not forget your share of the world. And be excellent as God has been excellent to you. And desire not corruption in the land. Indeed, God does not like corrupters.”
tr: Waibtaghi feema ataka Allahu alddara alakhirata wala tansa naseebaka mina alddunya waahsin kama ahsana Allahu ilayka wala tabghi alfasada fee alardi inna Allaha la yuhibbu almufsideena

t: He said, “I was only given it because of knowledge I have.” Did he not know that God had destroyed before him of generations those who were greater than him in power and greater in accumulation [of wealth]? But the criminals, about their sins, will not be asked.
tr: Qala innama ooteetuhu AAala AAilmin AAindee awalam yaAAlam anna Allaha qad ahlaka min qablihi mina alqurooni man huwa ashaddu minhu quwwatan waaktharu jamAAan wala yusalu AAan thunoobihimu almujrimoona

t: So he came out before his people in his adornment. Those who desired the worldly life said, “Oh, would that we had like what was given to Qārūn. Indeed, he is one of great fortune.”
tr: Fakharaja AAala qawmihi fee zeenatihi qala allatheena yureedoona alhayata alddunya ya layta lana mithla ma ootiya qaroonu innahu lathoo haththin AAatheemin

t: But those who had been given knowledge said, “Woe to you! The reward of God is better for he who believes and does righteousness. And none are granted it except the patient.”
tr: Waqala allatheena ootoo alAAilma waylakum thawabu Allahi khayrun liman amana waAAamila salihan wala yulaqqaha illa alssabiroona

t: And We caused the earth to swallow him and his home. And there was for him no company to aid him other than God, nor was he of those who [could] defend themselves.
tr: Fakhasafna bihi wabidarihi alarda fama kana lahu min fiatin yansuroonahu min dooni Allahi wama kana mina almuntasireena

t: And those who had wished for his position the previous day began to say, “Oh, how God extends provision to whom He wills of His servants and restricts it! If not that God had conferred favour on us, He would have caused it to swallow us. Oh, how the disbelievers do not succeed!”
tr: Waasbaha allatheena tamannaw makanahu bialamsi yaqooloona waykaanna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao min AAibadihi wayaqdiru lawla an manna Allahu AAalayna lakhasafa bina waykaannahu la yuflihu alkafiroona

t: That home of the Hereafter We assign to those who do not desire exaltedness upon the earth or corruption. And the [best] outcome is for the righteous.
tr: Tilka alddaru alakhiratu najAAaluha lillatheena la yureedoona AAuluwwan fee alardi wala fasadan waalAAaqibatu lilmuttaqeena

t: Whoever comes [on the Day of Judgement] with a good deed will have better than it; and whoever comes with an evil deed - then those who did evil deeds will not be recompensed except [as much as] what they used to do.
tr: Man jaa bialhasanati falahu khayrun minha waman jaa bialssayyiati fala yujza allatheena AAamiloo alssayyiati illa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: He who has imposed the Qur’ān upon you will most certainly bring you back home again. Say, “My Lord is most knowing of who brings guidance and who is in clear error.”
tr: Inna allathee farada AAalayka alqurana laradduka ila maAAadin qul rabbee aAAlamu man jaa bialhuda waman huwa fee dalalin mubeenin

t: And you were not expecting that the Book would be conveyed to you, but it is a mercy from your Lord. So do not lend support to the disbelievers.
tr: Wama kunta tarjoo an yulqa ilayka alkitabu illa rahmatan min rabbika fala takoonanna thaheeran lilkafireena

t: And never let them prevent you from the verses of God after they have been revealed to you. And invite [people] to your Lord. And never be of those who associate others with God.
tr: Wala yasuddunnaka AAan ayati Allahi baAAda ith onzilat ilayka waodAAu ila rabbika wala takoonanna mina almushrikeena

t: And do not invoke with God another deity. There is no deity except Him. Everything will be destroyed except His Face. His is the judgement, and to Him you will be returned.
tr: Wala tadAAu maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara la ilaha illa huwa kullu shayin halikun illa wajhahu lahu alhukmu wailayhi turjaAAoona

t: Alif, Lām, Meem
tr: Aliflammeem

t: Do the people think that they will be left to say, “We believe” and they will not be tested?
tr: Ahasiba alnnasu an yutrakoo an yaqooloo amanna wahum la yuftanoona

t: But We have certainly tried those before them, and God will surely make evident those who are truthful, and He will surely make evident the liars.
tr: Walaqad fatanna allatheena min qablihim falayaAAlamanna Allahu allatheena sadaqoo walayaAAlamanna alkathibeena

t: Or do those who do evil deeds think they can escape from Us? Evil is what they judge.
tr: Am hasiba allatheena yaAAmaloona alssayyiati an yasbiqoona saa ma yahkumoona

t: Whoever should hope for the meeting with God - indeed, the term [decreed] by God is coming. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Man kana yarjoo liqaa Allahi fainna ajala Allahi laatin wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t: And whoever strives only strives for [the benefit of] himself. Indeed, God is free from need of the worlds.
tr: Waman jahada fainnama yujahidu linafsihi inna Allaha laghaniyyun AAani alAAalameena

t: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely remove from them their misdeeds and will surely reward them according to the best of what they used to do.
tr: Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lanukaffiranna AAanhum sayyiatihim walanajziyannahum ahsana allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: And We have enjoined upon the human being goodness to parents. But if they endeavour to make you associate with Me that of which you have no knowledge, do not obey them. To Me is your return, and I will inform you about what you used to do.
tr: Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi husnan wain jahadaka litushrika bee ma laysa laka bihi AAilmun fala tutiAAhuma ilayya marjiAAukum faonabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t: And those who believe and do righteous deeds - We will surely admit them among the righteous [into Paradise].
tr: Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lanudkhilannahum fee alssaliheena

t: And of the people are some who say, “We believe in God,” but when one [of them] is harmed for [the cause of] God, they consider the trial [i.e., harm] of the people as [if it were] the punishment of God. But if victory comes from your Lord, they say, “Indeed, We were with you.” Is not God most knowing of what is within the breasts of all worlds [i.e., all creatures]?
tr: Wamina alnnasi man yaqoolu amanna biAllahi faitha oothiya fee Allahi jaAAala fitnata alnnasi kaAAathabi Allahi walain jaa nasrun min rabbika layaqoolunna inna kunna maAAakum awalaysa Allahu biaAAlama bima fee sudoori alAAalameena

t: And God will surely make evident those who believe, and He will surely make evident the hypocrites.
tr: WalayaAAlamanna Allahu allatheena amanoo walayaAAlamanna almunafiqeena

t: And those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Follow our way, and we will carry your sins.” But they will not carry anything of their sins. Indeed, they are liars.
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo ittabiAAoo sabeelana walnahmil khatayakum wama hum bihamileena min khatayahum min shayin innahum lakathiboona

t: But they will surely carry their [own] burdens and [other] burdens along with their burdens, and they will surely be questioned on the Day of Resurrection about what they used to invent.
tr: Walayahmilunna athqalahum waathqalan maAAa athqalihim walayusalunna yawma alqiyamati AAamma kanoo yaftaroona

t: And We certainly sent Noah to his people, and he remained among them a thousand years minus fifty years, and the flood seized them while they were wrongdoers.
tr: Walaqad arsalna noohan ila qawmihi falabitha feehim alfa sanatin illa khamseena AAaman faakhathahumu alttoofanu wahum thalimoona

t: But We saved him and the companions of the ship, and We made it a sign for the worlds.
tr: Faanjaynahu waashaba alssafeenati wajaAAalnaha ayatan lilAAalameena

t: And [We sent] Abraham, when he said to his people, “Worship God and fear Him. That is best for you, if you should know.
tr: Waibraheema ith qala liqawmihi oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona

t: You only worship, besides God, idols, and you produce a falsehood. Indeed, those you worship besides God do not possess for you [the power of] provision. So seek from God provision and worship Him and be grateful to Him. To Him you will be returned.”
tr: Innama taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi awthanan watakhluqoona ifkan inna allatheena taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi la yamlikoona lakum rizqan faibtaghoo AAinda Allahi alrrizqa waoAAbudoohu waoshkuroo lahu ilayhi turjaAAoona

t: And if you [people] deny [the message] already nations before you have denied. And there is not upon the Messenger except [the duty to] convey clearly.
tr: Wain tukaththiboo faqad kaththaba omamun min qablikum wama AAala alrrasooli illa albalaghu almubeenu

t: Have they not considered how God begins creation and then repeats it? Indeed that, for God, is easy.
tr: Awalam yaraw kayfa yubdio Allahu alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Travel through the land and observe how He began creation. Then God will bring the Hereafter into being. Indeed God, over all things, is competent.”
tr: Qul seeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa badaa alkhalqa thumma Allahu yunshio alnnashata alakhirata inna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: He punishes whom He wills and has mercy upon whom He wills, and to Him you will be returned.
tr: YuAAaththibu man yashao wayarhamu man yashao wailayhi tuqlaboona

t: You cannot frustrate [i.e., His Plan] on earth or in the heavens; you will have no one to protect or help you besides God.
tr: Wama antum bimuAAjizeena fee alardi wala fee alssamai wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin

t: And the ones who disbelieve in the signs of God and the meeting with Him those have despaired of My mercy, and they will have a painful punishment.
tr: Waallatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi waliqaihi olaika yaisoo min rahmatee waolaika lahum AAathabun aleemun

t: And the answer of his [i.e., Abraham’s] people was not but that they said, “Kill him or burn him,” but God saved him from the fire. Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo oqtuloohu aw harriqoohu faanjahu Allahu mina alnnari inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

t: And [Abraham] said, “You have only taken, other than God, idols as [a bond of] affection among you in worldly life. Then on the Day of Resurrection you will deny one another and curse one another, and your refuge will be the Fire, and you will not have any helpers.”
tr: Waqala innama ittakhathtum min dooni Allahi awthanan mawaddata baynikum fee alhayati alddunya thumma yawma alqiyamati yakfuru baAAdukum bibaAAdin wayalAAanu baAAdukum baAAdan wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena

t: And Lot believed him. [Abraham] said, “Indeed, I will emigrate to [the service of] my Lord. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.”
tr: Faamana lahu lootun waqala innee muhajirun ila rabbee innahu huwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: And We gave to Him Isaac and Jacob and placed in his descendants prophethood and the Book. And We gave him his reward in this world, and indeed, he is in the Hereafter among the righteous.
tr: Wawahabna lahu ishaqa wayaAAqooba wajaAAalna fee thurriyyatihi alnnubuwwata waalkitaba waataynahu ajrahu fee alddunya wainnahu fee alakhirati lamina alssaliheena

t: And [mention] Lot, when he said to his people, “Indeed, you commit such immorality as no one has preceded you with from among the worlds.
tr: Walootan ith qala liqawmihi innakum latatoona alfahishata ma sabaqakum biha min ahadin mina alAAalameena

t: Indeed, you approach men and obstruct the road and commit in your meetings evil.” And the answer of his people was not but they said, “Bring us the punishment of God, if you should be of the truthful.”
tr: Ainnakum latatoona alrrijala wataqtaAAoona alssabeela watatoona fee nadeekumu almunkara fama kana jawaba qawmihi illa an qaloo itina biAAathabi Allahi in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t: He said, “My Lord, support me against the people of corruption.”
tr: Qala rabbi onsurnee AAala alqawmi almufsideena

t: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Abraham with the good tidings, they said, “Indeed, we will destroy the people of that [i.e., Lot’s] city. Indeed, its people have been wrongdoers.”
tr: Walamma jaat rusuluna ibraheema bialbushra qaloo inna muhlikoo ahli hathihi alqaryati inna ahlaha kanoo thalimeena

t: [Abraham] said, “Indeed, within it is Lot.” They said, “We are more knowing of who is within it. We will surely save him and his family, except his wife. She is to be of those who remain behind.”
tr: Qala inna feeha lootan qaloo nahnu aAAlamu biman feeha lanunajjiyannahu waahlahu illa imraatahu kanat mina alghabireena

t: And when Our messengers [i.e., angels] came to Lot, he was distressed for them and felt for them great discomfort. They said, “Fear not, nor grieve. Indeed, we will save you and your family, except your wife; she is to be of those who remain behind.
tr: Walamma an jaat rusuluna lootan seea bihim wadaqa bihim tharAAan waqaloo la takhaf wala tahzan inna munajjooka waahlaka illa imraataka kanat mina alghabireena

t: Indeed, we will bring down on the people of this city punishment from the sky because they have been defiantly disobedient.”
tr: Inna munziloona AAala ahli hathihi alqaryati rijzan mina alssamai bima kanoo yafsuqoona

t: And We have certainly left of it a sign as clear evidence for a people who use reason.
tr: Walaqad tarakna minha ayatan bayyinatan liqawmin yaAAqiloona

t: And to Madyan [We sent] their brother Shu’ayb, and he said, “O my people, worship God and expect the Last Day and do not commit abuse on the earth, spreading corruption.”
tr: Waila madyana akhahum shuAAayban faqala ya qawmi oAAbudoo Allaha waorjoo alyawma alakhira wala taAAthaw fee alardi mufsideena

t: But they denied him, so the earthquake seized them, and they became within their home [corpses] fallen prone.
tr: Fakaththaboohu faakhathathumu alrrajfatu faasbahoo fee darihim jathimeena

t: And [We destroyed] ‘Aad and Thamūd, and it has become clear to you from their [ruined] dwellings. And Satan had made pleasing to them their deeds and prevented them from the path, and they were endowed with perception.
tr: WaAAadan wathamooda waqad tabayyana lakum min masakinihim wazayyana lahumu alshshaytanu aAAmalahum fasaddahum AAani alssabeeli wakanoo mustabsireena

t: And [We destroyed] Qārūn and Pharaoh and Hāmān. And Moses had already come to them with clear evidences, and they were arrogant in the land, but they were not outrun [i.e. escape] Us.
tr: Waqaroona wafirAAawna wahamana walaqad jaahum moosa bialbayyinati faistakbaroo fee alardi wama kanoo sabiqeena

t: So each We seized for his sin; and among them were those upon whom We sent a storm of stones, and among them were those who were seized by the blast [from the sky], and among them were those whom We caused the earth to swallow, and among them were those whom We drowned. And God would not have wronged them, but it was they who were wronging themselves.
tr: Fakullan akhathna bithanbihi faminhum man arsalna AAalayhi hasiban waminhum man akhathathu alssayhatu waminhum man khasafna bihi alarda waminhum man aghraqna wama kana Allahu liyathlimahum walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona

t: The example of those who take allies other than God is like that of the spider who takes [i.e., constructs] a home. And indeed, the weakest of homes is the home of the spider, if they only knew.
tr: Mathalu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa kamathali alAAankabooti ittakhathat baytan wainna awhana albuyooti labaytu alAAankabooti law kanoo yaAAlamoona

t: Indeed, God knows whatever thing they call upon other than Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ma yadAAoona min doonihi min shayin wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: And these examples We present to the people, but none will understand them except those of knowledge.
tr: Watilka alamthalu nadribuha lilnnasi wama yaAAqiluha illa alAAalimoona

t: God created the heavens and the earth in truth. Indeed in that is a sign for the Believers.
tr: Khalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi inna fee thalika laayatan lilmumineena

t: Recite, [O Muhammad], what has been revealed to you of the Book and establish prayer. Indeed, prayer prohibits immorality and wrongdoing, and the remembrance of God is greater. And God knows that which you do.
tr: Otlu ma oohiya ilayka mina alkitabi waaqimi alssalata inna alssalata tanha AAani alfahshai waalmunkari walathikru Allahi akbaru waAllahu yaAAlamu ma tasnaAAoona

t: And do not argue with the People of the Book except in a way that is best, except for those who commit injustice among them, and say, “We believe in that which has been revealed to us and revealed to you. And our God and your God is one; and we are Muslims [in submission] to Him.”
tr: Wala tujadiloo ahla alkitabi illa biallatee hiya ahsanu illa allatheena thalamoo minhum waqooloo amanna biallathee onzila ilayna waonzila ilaykum wailahuna wailahukum wahidun wanahnu lahu muslimoona

t: And thus We have sent down to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān]. And those to whom We [previously] gave the Book believe in it. And among these [people of Makkah] are those who believe in it. And none reject Our verses except the disbelievers.
tr: Wakathalika anzalna ilayka alkitaba faallatheena ataynahumu alkitaba yuminoona bihi wamin haolai man yuminu bihi wama yajhadu biayatina illa alkafiroona

t: And you did not recite before it any Book, nor did you inscribe one with your right hand. Then [i.e., otherwise] the falsifiers would have had [cause for] doubt.
tr: Wama kunta tatloo min qablihi min kitabin wala takhuttuhu biyameenika ithan lairtaba almubtiloona

t: Rather, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is distinct verses [preserved] within the breasts of those who have been given knowledge. And none reject Our verses except the wrongdoers.
tr: Bal huwa ayatun bayyinatun fee sudoori allatheena ootoo alAAilma wama yajhadu biayatina illa alththalimoona

t: But they say, “Why are not signs sent down to him from his Lord?” Say, “The signs are only with God, and I am only a clear warner.”
tr: Waqaloo lawla onzila AAalayhi ayatun min rabbihi qul innama alayatu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun

t: And is it not sufficient for them that We revealed to you the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] which is recited to them? Indeed in that is a mercy and reminder for a people who believe.
tr: Awalam yakfihim anna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba yutla AAalayhim inna fee thalika larahmatan wathikra liqawmin yuminoona

t: Say, “Sufficient is God between me and you as Witness. He knows what is in the heavens and earth. And they who have believed in falsehood and disbelieved in God - it is those who are the losers.”
tr: Qul kafa biAllahi baynee wabaynakum shaheedan yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati waalardi waallatheena amanoo bialbatili wakafaroo biAllahi olaika humu alkhasiroona

t: And they urge you to hasten the punishment. And if not for [the decree of] a specified term, punishment would have reached them. But it will surely come to them suddenly while they perceive not.
tr: WayastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi walawla ajalun musamman lajaahumu alAAathabu walayatiyannahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

t: They urge you to hasten the punishment. And indeed, Hell will be encompassing of the disbelievers
tr: YastaAAjiloonaka bialAAathabi wainna jahannama lamuheetatun bialkafireena

t: On the Day the punishment will cover them from above them and from below their feet and it is said, “Taste [the result ” of] what you used to do.
tr: Yawma yaghshahumu alAAathabu min fawqihim wamin tahti arjulihim wayaqoolu thooqoo ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: O My servants who have believed, indeed My earth is spacious, so worship only Me.
tr: Ya AAibadiya allatheena amanoo inna ardee wasiAAatun faiyyaya faoAAbudooni

t: Every soul will taste death. Then to Us will you be returned.
tr: Kullu nafsin thaiqatu almawti thumma ilayna turjaAAoona

t: And those who have believed and done righteous deeds - We will surely assign to them of Paradise [elevated] chambers beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. Excellent is the reward of the [righteous] workers
tr: Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lanubawwiannahum mina aljannati ghurafan tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha niAAma ajru alAAamileena

t: Who have been patient and upon their Lord rely.
tr: Allatheena sabaroo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona

t: And how many a creature carries not its [own] provision. God provides for it and for you. And He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Wakaayyin min dabbatin la tahmilu rizqaha Allahu yarzuquha waiyyakum wahuwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t: If you asked them, “Who created the heavens and earth and subjected the sun and the moon?” they would surely say, “God.” Then how are they deluded?
tr: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona

t: God extends provision for whom He wills of His servants and restricts for him. Indeed God is, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Allahu yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao min AAibadihi wayaqdiru lahu inna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: And if you asked them, “Who sends down rain from the sky and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness?” they would surely say “God.” Say, “Praise to God”; but most of them do not reason.
tr: Walain saaltahum man nazzala mina alssamai maan faahya bihi alarda min baAAdi mawtiha layaqoolunna Allahu quli alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona

t: And this worldly life is not but diversion and amusement. And indeed, the home of the Hereafter - that is the [eternal] life, if only they knew.
tr: Wama hathihi alhayatu alddunya illa lahwun walaAAibun wainna alddara alakhirata lahiya alhayawanu law kanoo yaAAlamoona

t: And when they board a ship, they supplicate God, sincere to Him in religion [i.e., faith and hope]. But when He delivers them to the land, at once they associate others with Him
tr: Faitha rakiboo fee alfulki daAAawoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena falamma najjahum ila albarri itha hum yushrikoona

t: So that they will deny what We have granted them, and they will enjoy themselves. But they are going to know.
tr: Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum waliyatamattaAAoo fasawfa yaAAlamoona

t: Have they not seen that We made [Makkah] a safe sanctuary, while people are being taken away all around them? Then in falsehood do they believe, and in the favour of God they disbelieve?
tr: Awalam yaraw anna jaAAalna haraman aminan wayutakhattafu alnnasu min hawlihim afabialbatili yuminoona wabiniAAmati Allahi yakfuroona

t: And who is more unjust than one who invents a lie about God or denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a [sufficient] residence for the disbelievers?
tr: Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi kathiban aw kaththaba bialhaqqi lamma jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena

t: And those who strive for Us - We will surely guide them to Our ways. And indeed, God is with those who strive for excellence.
tr: Waallatheena jahadoo feena lanahdiyannahum subulana wainna Allaha lamaAAa almuhsineena

t: Alif, Lām, Meem.
tr: Aliflammeem

t: The Romans have been defeated
tr: Ghulibati alrroomu

t: In the nearest land. But they, after their defeat, will overcome
tr: Fee adna alardi wahum min baAAdi ghalabihim sayaghliboona

t: Within three to nine years. To God belongs the command [i.e., decree] before and after. And that day the Believers will rejoice
tr: Fee bidAAi sineena lillahi alamru min qablu wamin baAAdu wayawmaithin yafrahu almuminoona

t: In the victory of God. He gives victory to whom He wills, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Binasri Allahi yansuru man yashao wahuwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: [It is] the promise of God. God does not fail in His promise, but most of the people do not know.
tr: WaAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu waAAdahu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona

t: They know what is apparent of the worldly life, but they, of the Hereafter, are unaware.
tr: YaAAlamoona thahiran mina alhayati alddunya wahum AAani alakhirati hum ghafiloona

t: Do they not contemplate within themselves? God has not created the heavens and the earth and what is between them except in truth and for a specified term. And indeed, many of the people, in [the matter of] the meeting with their Lord, are disbelievers.
tr: Awalam yatafakkaroo fee anfusihim ma khalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman wainna katheeran mina alnnasi biliqai rabbihim lakafiroona

t: Have they not travelled through the earth and observed how was the end of those before them? They were greater than them in power, and they ploughed [or excavated] the earth and built it up more than they [i.e., the Makkans] have built it up, and their messengers came to them with clear evidences. And God would not ever have wronged them, but they were wronging themselves.
tr: Awalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim kanoo ashadda minhum quwwatan waatharoo alarda waAAamarooha akthara mimma AAamarooha wajaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati fama kana Allahu liyathlimahum walakin kanoo anfusahum yathlimoona

t: Then the end of those who did evil was the worst [consequence] because they denied the signs of God and used to ridicule them.
tr: Thumma kana AAaqibata allatheena asaoo alssooa an kaththaboo biayati Allahi wakanoo biha yastahzioona

t: God begins creation; then He will repeat it; then to Him you will be returned.
tr: Allahu yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona

t: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will be in despair.
tr: Wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yublisu almujrimoona

t: And there will not be for them among their [alleged] partners any intercessors, and they will [then] be disbelievers in their partners.
tr: Walam yakun lahum min shurakaihim shufaAAao wakanoo bishurakaihim kafireena

t: And the Day the Hour appears - that Day they will become separated.
tr: Wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yawmaithin yatafarraqoona

t: And as for those who had believed and done righteous deeds, they will be in a garden [of Paradise], delighted.
tr: Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fahum fee rawdatin yuhbaroona

t: But as for those who disbelieved and denied Our verses and the meeting of the Hereafter, those will be brought into the punishment [to remain].
tr: Waamma allatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina waliqai alakhirati faolaika fee alAAathabi muhdaroona

t: So exalted is God when you reach the evening and when you reach the morning.
tr: Fasubhana Allahi heena tumsoona waheena tusbihoona

t: And to Him is [due all] praise throughout the heavens and the earth. And [exalted is He] at night and when you are at noon.
tr: Walahu alhamdu fee alssamawati waalardi waAAashiyyan waheena tuthhiroona

t: He brings the living out of the dead and brings the dead out of the living and brings to life the earth after its lifelessness. And thus will you be brought out.
tr: Yukhriju alhayya mina almayyiti wayukhriju almayyita mina alhayyi wayuhyee alarda baAAda mawtiha wakathalika tukhrajoona

t: And of His signs is that He created you from dust; then, suddenly you were human beings dispersing [throughout the earth].
tr: Wamin ayatihi an khalaqakum min turabin thumma itha antum basharun tantashiroona

t: And of His signs is that He created for you from yourselves mates that you may find tranquillity in them; and He placed between you love and mercy. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
tr: Wamin ayatihi an khalaqa lakum min anfusikum azwajan litaskunoo ilayha wajaAAala baynakum mawaddatan warahmatan inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona

t: And of His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and the diversity of your languages and your colours. Indeed in that are signs for those of knowledge.
tr: Wamin ayatihi khalqu alssamawati waalardi waikhtilafu alsinatikum waalwanikum inna fee thalika laayatin lilAAalimeena

t: And of His signs is your sleep by night and day and your seeking of His bounty. Indeed in that are signs for a people who listen.
tr: Wamin ayatihi manamukum biallayli waalnnahari waibtighaokum min fadlihi inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yasmaAAoona

t: And of His signs is [that] He shows you the lightening [causing] fear and aspiration, and He sends down rain from the sky by which He brings to life the earth after its death. Indeed in that are signs for a people who use reason.
tr: Wamin ayatihi yureekumu albarqa khawfan watamaAAan wayunazzilu mina alssamai maan fayuhyee bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yaAAqiloona

t: And of His signs is that the heaven and earth stand [i.e., remain] by His command. Then when He calls you with a [single] call from the earth, immediately you will come forth.
tr: Wamin ayatihi an taqooma alssamao waalardu biamrihi thumma itha daAAakum daAAwatan mina alardi itha antum takhrujoona

t: And to Him belongs whoever is in the heavens and earth. All are to Him devoutly obedient.
tr: Walahu man fee alssamawati waalardi kullun lahu qanitoona

t: And it is He who begins creation; then He repeats it, and that is [even] easier for Him. To Him belongs the highest description [i.e., attribute] in the heavens and earth. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Wahuwa allathee yabdao alkhalqa thumma yuAAeeduhu wahuwa ahwanu AAalayhi walahu almathalu alaAAla fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: He presents to you an example from yourselves. Do you have among those whom your right hands possess [i.e., slaves] any partners in what We have provided for you so that you are equal therein [and] would fear them as your fear of one another [within a partnership]? Thus do We detail the verses for a people who use reason.
tr: Daraba lakum mathalan min anfusikum hal lakum mi mma malakat aymanukum min shurakaa fee ma razaqnakum faantum feehi sawaon takhafoonahum kakheefatikum anfusakum kathalika nufassilu alayati liqawmin yaAAqiloona

t: But those who wrong follow their [own] desires without knowledge. Then who can guide one whom God has sent astray? And for them there are no helpers.
tr: Bali ittabaAAa allatheena thalamoo ahwaahum bighayri AAilmin faman yahdee man adalla Allahu wama lahum min nasireena

t: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the religion, inclining to truth. [Adhere to] the fitrah of God upon which He has created [all] people. No change should there be in the creation of God. That is the correct religion, but most of the people do not know.
tr: Faaqim wajhaka lilddeeni haneefan fitrata Allahi allatee fatara alnnasa AAalayha la tabdeela likhalqi Allahi thalika alddeenu alqayyimu walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona

t: [Adhere to it], turning in repentance to Him, and fear Him and establish prayer and do not be of those who associate others with God
tr: Muneebeena ilayhi waittaqoohu waaqeemoo alssalata wala takoonoo mina almushrikeena

t: [Or] of those who have divided their religion and become sects, every faction rejoicing in what it has.
tr: Mina allatheena farraqoo deenahum wakanoo shiyaAAan kullu hizbin bima ladayhim farihoona

t: And when adversity touches the people, they call upon their Lord, turning in repentance to Him. Then when He lets them taste mercy from Him, at once a party of them associate others with their Lord,
tr: Waitha massa alnnasa durrun daAAaw rabbahum muneebeena ilayhi thumma itha athaqahum minhu rahmatan itha fareequn minhum birabbihim yushrikoona

t: So that they will deny what We have granted them. Then enjoy yourselves, for you are going to know.
tr: Liyakfuroo bima ataynahum fatamattaAAoo fasawfa taAAlamoona

t: Or have We sent down to them an authority, and it speaks of what they were associating with Him?
tr: Am anzalna AAalayhim sultanan fahuwa yatakallamu bima kanoo bihi yushrikoona

t: And when We let the people taste mercy, they rejoice therein, but if evil afflicts them for what their hands have put forth, immediately they despair.
tr: Waitha athaqna alnnasa rahmatan farihoo biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim itha hum yaqnatoona

t: Do they not see that God extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed, in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Awalam yaraw anna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

t: So give the relative his right, as well as the needy and the traveller. That is best for those who desire the countenance of God, and it is they who will be the successful.
tr: Faati tha alqurba haqqahu waalmiskeena waibna alssabeeli thalika khayrun lillatheena yureedoona wajha Allahi waolaika humu almuflihoona

t: And whatever you give for interest [i.e., advantage] to increase within the wealth of people will not increase with God. But what you give in zakāh, desiring the countenance of God - those are the ones who shall get manifold [reward].
tr: Wama ataytum min riban liyarbuwa fee amwali alnnasi fala yarboo AAinda Allahi wama ataytum min zakatin tureedoona wajha Allahi faolaika humu almudAAifoona

t: God is the one who created you, then provided for you, then will cause you to die, and then will give you life. Are there any of your “partners” who does anything of that? Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
tr: Allahu allathee khalaqakum thumma razaqakum thumma yumeetukum thumma yuhyeekum hal min shurakaikum man yafAAalu min thalikum min shayin subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

t: Corruption has appeared throughout the land and sea by [reason of] what the hands of people have earned so He [i.e., God] may let them taste part of [the consequence of] what they have done that perhaps they will return [to righteousness].
tr: Thahara alfasadu fee albarri waalbahri bima kasabat aydee alnnasi liyutheeqahum baAAda allathee AAamiloo laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Travel through the land and observe how was the end of those before. Most of them were associators [of others with God].
tr: Qul seeroo fee alardi faonthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablu kana aktharuhum mushrikeena

t: So direct your face [i.e., self] toward the correct religion before a Day comes from God of which there is no repelling. That Day, they will be divided.
tr: Faaqim wajhaka lilddeeni alqayyimi min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi yawmaithin yassaddaAAoona

t: Whoever disbelieves - upon him is [the consequence of] his disbelief. And whoever does righteousness - they are for themselves preparing,
tr: Man kafara faAAalayhi kufruhu waman AAamila salihan falianfusihim yamhadoona

t: That He may reward those who have believed and done righteous deeds out of His bounty. Indeed, He does not like the disbelievers.
tr: Liyajziya allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati min fadlihi innahu la yuhibbu alkafireena

t: And of His signs is that He sends the winds as bringers of good tidings and to let you taste His mercy [i.e., rain] and so the ships may sail at His command and so you may seek of His bounty, and perhaps you will be grateful.
tr: Wamin ayatihi an yursila alrriyaha mubashshiratin waliyutheeqakum min rahmatihi walitajriya alfulku biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona

t: And We have already sent messengers before you to their peoples, and they came to them with clear evidences; then We took retribution from those who committed crimes, and incumbent upon Us was to help the Believers.
tr: Walaqad arsalna min qablika rusulan ila qawmihim fajaoohum bialbayyinati faintaqamna mina allatheena ajramoo wakana haqqan AAalayna nasru almumineena

t: It is God who sends the winds, and they stir the clouds and spread them in the sky however He wills, and He makes them fragments so you see the rain emerge from within them. And when He causes it to fall upon whom He wills of His servants, immediately they rejoice
tr: Allahu allathee yursilu alrriyaha fatutheeru sahaban fayabsutuhu fee alssamai kayfa yashao wayajAAaluhu kisafan fatara alwadqa yakhruju min khilalihi faitha asaba bihi man yashao min AAibadihi itha hum yastabshiroona

t: Although they were, before it was sent down upon them - before that, in despair.
tr: Wain kanoo min qabli an yunazzala AAalayhim min qablihi lamubliseena

t: So observe the effects of the mercy of God - how He gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. Indeed, that [same one] will give life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
tr: Faonthur ila athari rahmati Allahi kayfa yuhyee alarda baAAda mawtiha inna thalika lamuhyee almawta wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: But if We should send a [bad] wind and they saw [their crops] turned yellow, they would remain thereafter disbelievers.
tr: Walain arsalna reehan faraawhu musfarran lathalloo min baAAdihi yakfuroona

t: So indeed, you will not make the dead hear, nor will you make the deaf hear the call when they turn their backs, retreating.
tr: Fainnaka la tusmiAAu almawta wala tusmiAAu alssumma aldduAAaa itha wallaw mudbireena

t: And you cannot guide the blind away from their error. You will only make hear those who believe in Our verses so they are Muslims [in submission to God].
tr: Wama anta bihadi alAAumyi AAan dalalatihim in tusmiAAu illa man yuminu biayatina fahum muslimoona

t: God is the one who created you from weakness, then made after weakness strength, then made after strength weakness and white hair. He creates what He wills, and He is the Knowing, the Competent.
tr: Allahu allathee khalaqakum min daAAfin thumma jaAAala min baAAdi daAAfin quwwatan thumma jaAAala min baAAdi quwwatin daAAfan washaybatan yakhluqu ma yashao wahuwa alAAaleemu alqadeeru

t: And the Day the Hour appears the criminals will swear they had remained but an hour. Thus they were deluded.
tr: Wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yuqsimu almujrimoona ma labithoo ghayra saAAatin kathalika kanoo yufakoona
