t: Indeed, I would then be in manifest error.
tr: Innee ithan lafee dalalin mubeenin

t: Indeed, I have believed in your Lord, so listen to me.”
tr: Innee amantu birabbikum faismaAAooni

t: It was said, “Enter Paradise.” He said, “I wish my people could know
tr: Qeela odkhuli aljannata qala ya layta qawmee yaAAlamoona

t: Of how my Lord has forgiven me and placed me among the honoured.”
tr: Bima ghafara lee rabbee wajaAAalanee mina almukrameena

t: And We did not send down upon his people after him any soldiers from the heaven, nor would We have done so.
tr: Wama anzalna AAala qawmihi min baAAdihi min jundin mina alssamai wama kunna munzileena

t: It was not but one shout, and immediately they were extinguished.
tr: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum khamidoona

t: How regretful for the servants. There did not come to them any messenger except that they used to ridicule him.
tr: Ya hasratan AAala alAAibadi ma yateehim min rasoolin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: Have they not considered how many generations We destroyed before them that they to them will not return?
tr: Alam yaraw kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni annahum ilayhim la yarjiAAoona

t: And indeed, all of them will yet be brought present before Us.
tr: Wain kullun lamma jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

t: And a sign for them is the dead earth. We have brought it to life and brought forth from it grain, and from it they eat.
tr: Waayatun lahumu alardu almaytatu ahyaynaha waakhrajna minha habban faminhu yakuloona

t: And We placed therein gardens of palm trees and grapevines and caused to burst forth therefrom some springs -
tr: WajaAAalna feeha jannatin min nakheelin waaAAnabin wafajjarna feeha mina alAAuyooni

t: That they may eat of His fruit. And their hands have not produced it, so will they not be grateful?
tr: Liyakuloo min thamarihi wama AAamilathu aydeehim afala yashkuroona

t: Exalted is He who created all pairs from what the earth grows and from themselves and from that which they do not know.
tr: Subhana allathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha mimma tunbitu alardu wamin anfusihim wamimma la yaAAlamoona

t: And a sign for them is the night. We remove from it the [light of] day, so they are [left] in darkness.
tr: Waayatun lahumu allaylu naslakhu minhu alnnahara faitha hum muthlimoona

t: And the sun runs on to a destination for it. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
tr: Waalshshamsu tajree limustaqarrin laha thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

t: And the moon - We have determined for it phases, until it returns [appearing] like the old date stalk.
tr: Waalqamara qaddarnahu manazila hatta AAada kaalAAurjooni alqadeemi

t: It is not for the sun to overtake the moon nor for the night to outstrip the day, but each, in an orbit, is swimming.
tr: La alshshamsu yanbaghee laha an tudrika alqamara wala allaylu sabiqu alnnahari wakullun fee falakin yasbahoona

t: And a sign for them is that We carried their forefathers in a laden ship.
tr: Waayatun lahum anna hamalna thurriyyatahum fee alfulki almashhooni

t: And We created for them from the likes of it that which they ride.
tr: Wakhalaqna lahum min mithlihi ma yarkaboona

t: And if We should will, We could drown them; then no one responding to a cry would there be for them, nor would they be saved
tr: Wain nasha nughriqhum fala sareekha lahum wala hum yunqathoona

t: Except as a mercy from Us and provision for a time.
tr: Illa rahmatan minna wamataAAan ila heenin

t: But when it is said to them, “Beware of what is before you and what is behind you; perhaps you will receive mercy…”
tr: Waitha qeela lahumu ittaqoo ma bayna aydeekum wama khalfakum laAAallakum turhamoona

t: And no sign comes to them from the signs of their Lord except that they are from it turning away.
tr: Wama tateehim min ayatin min ayati rabbihim illa kanoo AAanha muAArideena

t: And when it is said to them, “Spend from that which God has provided for you,” those who disbelieve say to those who believe, “Should we feed one whom, if God had willed, He would have fed? You are not but in clear error.”
tr: Waitha qeela lahum anfiqoo mimma razaqakumu Allahu qala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo anutAAimu man law yashao Allahu atAAamahu in antum illa fee dalalin mubeenin

t: And they say, “When is this promise, if you should be truthful?”
tr: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

t: They do not await except one blast which will seize them while they are disputing.
tr: Ma yanthuroona illa sayhatan wahidatan takhuthuhum wahum yakhissimoona

t: And they will not be able [to give] any instruction, nor to their people can they return.
tr: Fala yastateeAAoona tawsiyatan wala ila ahlihim yarjiAAoona

t: And the Horn will be blown; and at once from the graves to their Lord they will hasten.
tr: Wanufikha fee alssoori faitha hum mina alajdathi ila rabbihim yansiloona

t: They will say, “O woe to us! Who has raised us up from our sleeping place?” [The reply will be], “This is what the Most Merciful had promised, and the messengers told the truth.”
tr: Qaloo ya waylana man baAAathana min marqadina hatha ma waAAada alrrahmanu wasadaqa almursaloona

t: It will not be but one blast, and at once they are all brought present before Us.
tr: In kanat illa sayhatan wahidatan faitha hum jameeAAun ladayna muhdaroona

t: So today [i.e., the Day of Judgement] no soul will be wronged at all, and you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do.
tr: Faalyawma la tuthlamu nafsun shayan wala tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: Indeed the companions of Paradise, that Day, will be busy enjoying themselves -
tr: Inna ashaba aljannati alyawma fee shughulin fakihoona

t: They and their spouses - in shade, reclining on adorned couches.
tr: Hum waazwajuhum fee thilalin AAala alaraiki muttakioona

t: For them therein is fruit, and for them is whatever they request [or wish]
tr: Lahum feeha fakihatun walahum ma yaddaAAoona

t: [And] “Peace,” a word from a Merciful Lord.
tr: Salamun qawlan min rabbin raheemin

t: [Then He will say], “But stand apart today, you criminals.
tr: Waimtazoo alyawma ayyuha almujrimoona

t: Did I not enjoin upon you, O children of Adam, that you not worship Satan - [for] indeed, he is to you a clear enemy -
tr: Alam aAAhad ilaykum ya banee adama an la taAAbudoo alshshaytana innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

t: And that you worship [only] Me? This is a straight path.
tr: Waani oAAbudoonee hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t: And he had already led astray from among you much of creation, so did you not use reason?
tr: Walaqad adalla minkum jibillan katheeran afalam takoonoo taAAqiloona

t: This is the Hellfire which you were promised.
tr: Hathihi jahannamu allatee kuntum tooAAadoona

t: [Enter to] burn therein today for what you used to deny.”
tr: Islawha alyawma bima kuntum takfuroona

t: That Day, We will seal over their mouths, and their hands will speak to Us, and their feet will testify about what they used to earn.
tr: Alyawma nakhtimu AAala afwahihim watukallimuna aydeehim watashhadu arjuluhum bima kanoo yaksiboona

t: And if We willed, We could have obliterated their eyes, and they would race to [find] the path, and how could they see?
tr: Walaw nashao latamasna AAala aAAyunihim faistabaqoo alssirata faanna yubsiroona

t: And if We willed, We could have deformed them, [paralyzing them] in their places so they would not be able to proceed, nor could they return.
tr: Walaw nashao lamasakhnahum AAala makanatihim fama istataAAoo mudiyyan wala yarjiAAoona

t: And he to whom We grant long life We reverse in creation; so will they not understand?
tr: Waman nuAAammirhu nunakkishu fee alkhalqi afala yaAAqiloona

t: And We have not taught him [i.e., Prophet Muhammad] poetry, nor is it appropriate for him. It is only a reminder and a clear Qur’ān
tr: Wama AAallamnahu alshshiAAra wama yanbaghee lahu in huwa illa thikrun waquranun mubeenun

t: To warn whoever is alive and justify the word [i.e., decree] against the disbelievers.
tr: Liyunthira man kana hayyan wayahiqqa alqawlu AAala alkafireena

t: Do they not see that We have created for them from what Our hands have made, grazing livestock, and [then] they are their owners?
tr: Awalam yaraw anna khalaqna lahum mimma AAamilat aydeena anAAaman fahum laha malikoona

t: And We have tamed them for them, so some of them they ride, and some of them they eat.
tr: Wathallalnaha lahum faminha rakoobuhum waminha yakuloona

t: And for them therein are [other] benefits and drinks, so will they not be grateful?
tr: Walahum feeha manafiAAu wamasharibu afala yashkuroona

t: But they have taken besides God [false] deities that perhaps they would be helped.
tr: Waittakhathoo min dooni Allahi alihatan laAAallahum yunsaroona

t: They are not able to help them, and they [themselves] are for them soldiers in attendance.
tr: La yastateeAAoona nasrahum wahum lahum jundun muhdaroona

t: So let not their speech grieve you. Indeed, We know what they conceal and what they declare.
tr: Fala yahzunka qawluhum inna naAAlamu ma yusirroona wama yuAAlinoona

t: Does the human being not consider that We created him from a [mere] spermdrop - then at once he is a clear adversary?
tr: Awalam yara alinsanu anna khalaqnahu min nutfatin faitha huwa khaseemun mubeenun

t: And he presents for Us an example and forgets his [own] creation. He says, “Who will give life to bones while they are disintegrated?”
tr: Wadaraba lana mathalan wanasiya khalqahu qala man yuhyee alAAithama wahiya rameemun

t: Say, “He will give them life who produced them the first time; and He is, of all creation, Knowing.”
tr: Qul yuhyeeha allathee anshaaha awwala marratin wahuwa bikulli khalqin AAaleemun

t: [It is] He who made for you from the green tree, fire, and then from it you ignite.
tr: Allathee jaAAala lakum mina alshshajari alakhdari naran faitha antum minhu tooqidoona

t: Is not He who created the heavens and the earth Able to create the likes of them? Yes, [it is so]; and He is the Knowing Creator.
tr: Awalaysa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda biqadirin AAala an yakhluqa mithlahum bala wahuwa alkhallaqu alAAaleemu

t: His command is only when He intends a thing that He says to it, “Be,” and it is.
tr: Innama amruhu itha arada shayan an yaqoola lahu kun fayakoonu

t: So exalted is He in whose hand is the realm of all things, and to Him you will be returned.
tr: Fasubhana allathee biyadihi malakootu kulli shayin wailayhi turjaAAoona

t: By those [angels] lined up in rows
tr: Waalssaffati saffan

t: And those who drive [the clouds]
tr: Faalzzajirati zajran

t: And those who recite the Reminder,
tr: Faalttaliyati thikran

t: Indeed, your God is One,
tr: Inna ilahakum lawahidun

t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them and Lord of the sunrises.
tr: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma warabbu almashariqi

t: Indeed, We have adorned the nearest heaven with an adornment of stars
tr: Inna zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bizeenatin alkawakibi

t: And as protection against every rebellious devil
tr: Wahifthan min kulli shaytanin maridin

t: [So] they may not listen to the exalted assembly [of angels] and are pelted from every side,
tr: La yassammaAAoona ila almalai alaAAla wayuqthafoona min kulli janibin

t: Repelled; and for them is a constant punishment,
tr: Duhooran walahum AAathabun wasibun

t: Except one who snatches [some words] by theft, but they are pursued by a burning flame, piercing [in brightness].
tr: Illa man khatifa alkhatfata faatbaAAahu shihabun thaqibun

t: Then inquire of them, [O Muhammad], “Are they a stronger [or more difficult] creation or those [others] We have created?” Indeed, We created them [i.e., men] from sticky clay.
tr: Faistaftihim ahum ashaddu khalqan am man khalaqna inna khalaqnahum min teenin lazibin

t: But you wonder, while they mock,
tr: Bal AAajibta wayaskharoona

t: And when they are reminded, they remember not.
tr: Waitha thukkiroo la yathkuroona

t: And when they see a sign, they ridicule
tr: Waitha raaw ayatan yastaskhiroona

t: And say, “This is not but obvious magic.
tr: Waqaloo in hatha illa sihrun mubeenun

t: When we have died and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

t: And our forefathers [as well]?”
tr: Awaabaona alawwaloona

t: Say, “Yes, and you will be [rendered] contemptible.”
tr: Qul naAAam waantum dakhiroona

t: It will be only one shout, and at once they will be observing.
tr: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun faitha hum yanthuroona

t: They will say, “O woe to us! This is the Day of Recompense.”
tr: Waqaloo ya waylana hatha yawmu alddeeni

t: [They will be told], “This is the Day of Judgement which you used to deny.”
tr: Hatha yawmu alfasli allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

t: [The angels will be ordered], “Gather those who committed wrong, their kinds, and what they used to worship
tr: Ohshuroo allatheena thalamoo waazwajahum wama kanoo yaAAbudoona

t: Other than God, and guide them to the path of Hellfire
tr: Min dooni Allahi faihdoohum ila sirati aljaheemi

t: And stop them; indeed, they are to be questioned.”
tr: Waqifoohum innahum masooloona

t: [They will be asked], “What is [wrong] with you? Why do you not help each other?”
tr: Ma lakum la tanasaroona

t: But they, that Day, are in surrender.
tr: Bal humu alyawma mustaslimoona

t: And they will approach one another asking [i.e., blaming] each other.
tr: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

t: They will say, “Indeed, you used to come at us from the right.”
tr: Qaloo innakum kuntum tatoonana AAani alyameeni

t: They [i.e., the oppressors] will say, “Rather, you [yourselves] were not Believers,
tr: Qaloo bal lam takoonoo mumineena

t: And we had over you no authority, but you were a transgressing people.
tr: Wama kana lana AAalaykum min sultanin bal kuntum qawman tagheena

t: So the word [i.e., decree] of our Lord has come into effect upon us; indeed, we will taste [punishment].
tr: Fahaqqa AAalayna qawlu rabbina inna lathaiqoona

t: And we led you to deviation; indeed, we were deviators.”
tr: Faaghwaynakum inna kunna ghaweena

t: So indeed they, that Day, will be sharing in the punishment.
tr: Fainnahum yawmaithin fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

t: Indeed, that is how We deal with the criminals.
tr: Inna kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena

t: Indeed they, when it was said to them, “There is no deity but God,” were arrogant
tr: Innahum kanoo itha qeela lahum la ilaha illa Allahu yastakbiroona

t: And were saying, “Are we to leave our gods for a mad poet?”
tr: Wayaqooloona ainna latarikoo alihatina lishaAAirin majnoonin

t: Rather, he [i.e., the Prophet] has come with the truth and confirmed the [previous] messengers.
tr: Bal jaa bialhaqqi wasaddaqa almursaleena

t: Indeed, you [disbelievers] will be tasters of the painful punishment,
tr: Innakum lathaiqoo alAAathabi alaleemi

t: And you will not be recompensed except for what you used to do -
tr: Wama tujzawna illa ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: But not the chosen servants of God.
tr: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

t: Those will have a provision determined -
tr: Olaika lahum rizqun maAAloomun

t: Fruits; and they will be honoured
tr: Fawakihu wahum mukramoona

t: In gardens of pleasure
tr: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi

t: On thrones facing one another.
tr: AAala sururin mutaqabileena

t: There will be circulated among them a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring,
tr: Yutafu AAalayhim bikasin min maAAeenin

t: White and delicious to the drinkers;
tr: Baydaa laththatin lilshsharibeena

t: No bad effect is there in it, nor from it will they be intoxicated.
tr: La feeha ghawlun wala hum AAanha yunzafoona

t: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances, with large, [beautiful] eyes,
tr: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi AAeenun

t: As if they were [delicate] eggs, wellprotected.
tr: Kaannahunna baydun maknoonun

t: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
tr: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

t: A speaker among them will say, “Indeed, I had a companion [on earth]
tr: Qala qailun minhum innee kana lee qareenun

t: Who would say, ‘Are you indeed of those who believe
tr: Yaqoolu ainnaka lamina almusaddiqeena

t: That when we have died and become dust and bones, we will indeed be recompensed?’ ”
tr: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamadeenoona

t: He will say, “Would you [care to] look?”
tr: Qala hal antum muttaliAAoona

t: And he will look and see him in the midst of the Hellfire.
tr: FaittalaAAa faraahu fee sawai aljaheemi

t: He will say, “By God, you almost ruined me.
tr: Qala taAllahi in kidta laturdeeni

t: If not for the favour of my Lord, I would have been of those brought in [to Hell].
tr: Walawla niAAmatu rabbee lakuntu mina almuhdareena

t: Then, are we not to die
tr: Afama nahnu bimayyiteena

t: Except for our first death, and we will not be punished?”
tr: Illa mawtatana aloola wama nahnu bimuAAaththabeena

t: Indeed, this is the great attainment.
tr: Inna hatha lahuwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

t: For the like of this let the workers [on earth] work.
tr: Limithli hatha falyaAAmali alAAamiloona

t: Is that [i.e., Paradise] better as hospitality or the tree of zaqqūm?
tr: Athalika khayrun nuzulan am shajaratu alzzaqqoomi

t: Indeed, We have made it a torment for the wrongdoers.
tr: Inna jaAAalnaha fitnatan lilththalimeena

t: Indeed, it is a tree issuing from the bottom of the Hellfire,
tr: Innaha shajaratun takhruju fee asli aljaheemi

t: Its emerging fruit as if it was heads of the devils.
tr: TalAAuha kaannahu ruoosu alshshayateeni

t: And indeed, they will eat from it and fill with it their bellies.
tr: Fainnahum laakiloona minha famalioona minha albutoona

t: Then indeed, they will have after it a mixture of scalding water.
tr: Thumma inna lahum AAalayha lashawban min hameemin

t: Then indeed, their return will be to the Hellfire.
tr: Thumma inna marjiAAahum laila aljaheemi

t: Indeed they found their fathers astray.
tr: Innahum alfaw abaahum dalleena

t: So they hastened [to follow] in their footsteps.
tr: Fahum AAala atharihim yuhraAAoona

t: And there had already strayed before them most of the former peoples,
tr: Walaqad dalla qablahum aktharu alawwaleena

t: And We had already sent among them warners.
tr: Walaqad arsalna feehim munthireena

t: Then look how was the end of those who were warned -
tr: Faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almunthareena

t: But not the chosen servants of God.
tr: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

t: And Noah had certainly called Us, and [We are] the best of responders.
tr: Walaqad nadana noohun falaniAAma almujeeboona

t: And We saved him and his family from the great affliction.
tr: Wanajjaynahu waahlahu mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

t: And We made his descendants those remaining [on the earth]
tr: WajaAAalna thurriyyatahu humu albaqeena

t: And left for him [favourable mention] among later generations:
tr: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

t: “Peace upon Noah among the worlds.”
tr: Salamun AAala noohin fee alAAalameena

t: Indeed, We thus reward those who strive for excellence.
tr: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

t: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

t: Then We drowned the others [i.e., disbelievers].
tr: Thumma aghraqna alakhareena

t: And indeed, among his kind was Abraham,
tr: Wainna min sheeAAatihi laibraheema

t: When he came to his Lord with a sound heart
tr: Ith jaa rabbahu biqalbin saleemin

t: [And] when he said to his father and his people, “What do you worship?
tr: Ith qala liabeehi waqawmihi matha taAAbudoona

t: Is it falsehood [as] gods other than God you desire?
tr: Aifkan alihatan doona Allahi tureedoona

t: Then what is your thought about the Lord of the worlds?”
tr: Fama thannukum birabbi alAAalameena

t: And he cast a look at the stars
tr: Fanathara nathratan fee alnnujoomi

t: And said, “Indeed, I am [about to be] ill.”
tr: Faqala innee saqeemun

t: So they turned away from him, departing.
tr: Fatawallaw AAanhu mudbireena

t: Then he turned to their gods and said, “Do you not eat?
tr: Faragha ila alihatihim faqala ala takuloona

t: What is [wrong] with you that you do not speak?”
tr: Ma lakum la tantiqoona

t: And he turned upon them a blow with [his] right hand.
tr: Faragha AAalayhim darban bialyameeni

t: Then they [i.e., the people] came toward him, hastening.
tr: Faaqbaloo ilayhi yaziffoona

t: He said, “Do you worship that which you [yourselves] carve,
tr: Qala ataAAbudoona ma tanhitoona

t: While God created you and that which you do?”
tr: WaAllahu khalaqakum wama taAAmaloona

t: They said, “Construct for him a structure [i.e., furnace] and throw him into the burning fire.”
tr: Qaloo ibnoo lahu bunyanan faalqoohu fee aljaheemi

t: And they intended for him a plan, [i.e., harm] but We made them the most debased.
tr: Faaradoo bihi kaydan fajaAAalnahumu alasfaleena

t: And [then] he said, “Indeed, I will go to [where I am ordered by] my Lord; He will guide me.
tr: Waqala innee thahibun ila rabbee sayahdeeni

t: My Lord, grant me [a child] from among the righteous.”
tr: Rabbi hab lee mina alssaliheena

t: So We gave him good tidings of a forbearing boy.
tr: Fabashsharnahu bighulamin haleemin

t: And when he reached with him [the age of] exertion, he said, “O my son, indeed I have seen in a dream that I [must] sacrifice you, so see what you think.” He said, “O my father, do as you are commanded. You will find me, if God wills, of the steadfast.”
tr: Falamma balagha maAAahu alssaAAya qala ya bunayya innee ara fee almanami annee athbahuka faonthur matha tara qala ya abati ifAAal ma tumaru satajidunee in shaa Allahu mina alssabireena

t: And when they had both submitted and he put him down upon his forehead,
tr: Falamma aslama watallahu liljabeeni

t: We called to him, “O Abraham,
tr: Wanadaynahu an ya ibraheemu

t: You have fulfilled the vision.” Indeed, We thus reward those who strive for excellence.
tr: Qad saddaqta alrruya inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

t: Indeed, this was the clear trial.
tr: Inna hatha lahuwa albalao almubeenu

t: And We ransomed him with a great sacrifice,
tr: Wafadaynahu bithibhin AAatheemin

t: And We left for him [favourable mention] among later generations:
tr: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

t: “Peace upon Abraham.”
tr: Salamun AAala ibraheema

t: Indeed, We thus reward those who strive for excellence.
tr: Kathalika najzee almuhsineena

t: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

t: And We gave him good tidings of Isaac, a prophet from among the righteous.
tr: Wabashsharnahu biishaqa nabiyyan mina alssaliheena

t: And We blessed him and Isaac. But among their descendants are those who strive for excellence and those who are clearly unjust to themselves.
tr: Wabarakna AAalayhi waAAala ishaqa wamin thurriyyatihima muhsinun wathalimun linafsihi mubeenun

t: And We did certainly confer favour upon Moses and Aaron.
tr: Walaqad mananna AAala moosa waharoona

t: And We saved them and their people from the great affliction,
tr: Wanajjaynahuma waqawmahuma mina alkarbi alAAatheemi

t: And We supported them so it was they who overcame.
tr: Wanasarnahum fakanoo humu alghalibeena

t: And We gave them the explicit Book [i.e., the Torah],
tr: Waataynahuma alkitaba almustabeena

t: And We guided them on the straight path.
tr: Wahadaynahuma alssirata almustaqeema

t: And We left for them [favourable mention] among later generations:
tr: Watarakna AAalayhima fee alakhireena

t: “Peace upon Moses and Aaron.”
tr: Salamun AAala moosa waharoona

t: Indeed, We thus reward those who strive for excellence.
tr: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

t: Indeed, they were of Our believing servants.
tr: Innahuma min AAibadina almumineena

t: And indeed, Elias was from among the messengers,
tr: Wainna ilyasa lamina almursaleena

t: When he said to his people, “Will you not fear God?
tr: Ith qala liqawmihi ala tattaqoona

t: Do you call upon Ba’l and leave the best of creators -
tr: AtadAAoona baAAlan watatharoona ahsana alkhaliqeena

t: God, your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers?”
tr: Allaha rabbakum warabba abaikumu alawwaleena

t: And they denied him, so indeed, they will be brought [for punishment],
tr: Fakaththaboohu fainnahum lamuhdaroona

t: Except the chosen servants of God.
tr: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

t: And We left for him [favourable mention] among later generations:
tr: Watarakna AAalayhi fee alakhireena

t: “Peace upon Elias.”
tr: Salamun AAala il yaseena

t: Indeed, We thus reward those who strive for excellence.
tr: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

t: Indeed, he was of Our believing servants.
tr: Innahu min AAibadina almumineena

t: And indeed, Lot was among the messengers.
tr: Wainna lootan lamina almursaleena

t: [So mention] when We saved him and his family, all,
tr: Ith najjaynahu waahlahu ajmaAAeena

t: Except an old woman [i.e., his wife] among those who remained [with the evildoers].
tr: Illa AAajoozan fee alghabireena

t: Then We destroyed the others.
tr: Thumma dammarna alakhareena

t: And indeed, you pass by them in the morning
tr: Wainnakum latamurroona AAalayhim musbiheena

t: And at night. Then will you not use reason?
tr: Wabiallayli afala taAAqiloona

t: And indeed, Jonah was among the messengers.
tr: Wainna yoonusa lamina almursaleena

t: [Mention] when he ran away to the laden ship.
tr: Ith abaqa ila alfulki almashhooni

t: And he drew lots and was among the losers.
tr: Fasahama fakana mina almudhadeena

t: Then the fish swallowed him, while he was blameworthy.
tr: Failtaqamahu alhootu wahuwa muleemun

t: And had he not been of those who exalt God,
tr: Falawla annahu kana mina almusabbiheena

t: He would have remained inside its belly until the Day they are resurrected.
tr: Lalabitha fee batnihi ila yawmi yubAAathoona

t: But We threw him onto the open shore while he was ill.
tr: Fanabathnahu bialAAarai wahuwa saqeemun

t: And We caused to grow over him a gourd vine.
tr: Waanbatna AAalayhi shajaratan min yaqteenin

t: And We sent him to [his people of] a hundred thousand or more.
tr: Waarsalnahu ila miati alfin aw yazeedoona

t: And they believed, so We gave them enjoyment [of life] for a time.
tr: Faamanoo famattaAAnahum ila heenin

t: So inquire of them, [O Muhammad], “Does your Lord have daughters while they have sons?
tr: Faistaftihim alirabbika albanatu walahumu albanoona

t: Or did We create the angels as females while they were witnesses?”
tr: Am khalaqna almalaikata inathan wahum shahidoona

t: Surely, it is out of their [invented] falsehood that they say,
tr: Ala innahum min ifkihim layaqooloona

t: “God has begotten,” and indeed, they are liars.
tr: Walada Allahu wainnahum lakathiboona

t: Has He chosen daughters over sons?
tr: Astafa albanati AAala albaneena

t: What is [wrong] with you? How do you make judgement?
tr: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona

t: Then will you not be reminded?
tr: Afala tathakkaroona

t: Or do you have a clear authority?
tr: Am lakum sultanun mubeenun

t: Then produce your Book, if you should be truthful.
tr: Fatoo bikitabikum in kuntum sadiqeena

t: And they have made [i.e., claimed] between Him and the jinn a lineage, but the jinn have already known that they [who made such claims] will be brought [to punishment].
tr: WajaAAaloo baynahu wabayna aljinnati nasaban walaqad AAalimati aljinnatu innahum lamuhdaroona

t: Exalted is God above what they describe,
tr: Subhana Allahi AAamma yasifoona

t: Except the chosen servants of God [who do not share in that sin].
tr: Illa AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

t: So indeed, you [disbelievers] and whatever you worship,
tr: Fainnakum wama taAAbudoona

t: You cannot tempt [anyone] away from Him
tr: Ma antum AAalayhi bifatineena

t: Except he who is to [enter and] burn in the Hellfire.
tr: Illa man huwa sali aljaheemi

t: [The angels say], “There is not among us any except that he has a known position.
tr: Wama minna illa lahu maqamun maAAloomun

t: And indeed, we are those who line up [for prayer].
tr: Wainna lanahnu alssaffoona

t: And indeed, we are those who exalt God.”
tr: Wainna lanahnu almusabbihoona

t: And indeed, they [i.e., the disbelievers] used to say,
tr: Wain kanoo layaqooloona

t: “If we had a message from [those of] the former peoples,
tr: Law anna AAindana thikran mina alawwaleena

t: We would have been the chosen servants of God.”
tr: Lakunna AAibada Allahi almukhlaseena

t: But they disbelieved in it, so they are going to know.
tr: Fakafaroo bihi fasawfa yaAAlamoona

t: And Our word [i.e., decree] has already preceded for Our servants, the messengers,
tr: Walaqad sabaqat kalimatuna liAAibadina almursaleena

t: [That] indeed, they would be those given victory
tr: Innahum lahumu almansooroona

t: And [that] indeed, Our soldiers will be victorious.
tr: Wainna jundana lahumu alghaliboona

t: So, [O Muhammad], leave them for a time.
tr: Fatawalla AAanhum hatta heenin

t: And see [what will befall] them, for they are going to see.
tr: Waabsirhum fasawfa yubsiroona

t: Then for Our punishment they are trying to hasten?
tr: AfabiAAathabina yastaAAjiloona

t: But when it descends in their territory, then evil is the morning of those who were warned.
tr: Faitha nazala bisahatihim fasaa sabahu almunthareena

t: And leave them for a time.
tr: Watawalla AAanhum hatta heenin

t: And see, for they are going to see.
tr: Waabsir fasawfa yubsiroona

t: Exalted is your Lord, the Lord of might, above what they describe.
tr: Subhana rabbika rabbi alAAizzati AAamma yasifoona

t: And peace upon the messengers.
tr: Wasalamun AAala almursaleena

t: And praise to God, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Waalhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

t: Sād. By the Qur’ān containing reminder...
tr: Sad waalqurani thee alththikri

t: But those who disbelieve are in pride and dissension.
tr: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee AAizzatin washiqaqin

t: How many a generation have We destroyed before them, and they [then] called out; but it was not a time for escape.
tr: Kam ahlakna min qablihim min qarnin fanadaw walata heena manasin

t: And they wonder that there has come to them a warner [i.e., Prophet Muhammad] from among themselves. And the disbelievers say, “This is a magician and a liar.
tr: WaAAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum waqala alkafiroona hatha sahirun kaththabun

t: Has he made the gods [only] one God? Indeed, this is really something extremely strange.”
tr: AjaAAala alalihata ilahan wahidan inna hatha lashayon AAujabun

t: And the eminent among them went forth, [saying], “Continue, and be patient over [the defence of] your gods. Indeed, this is a thing intended.
tr: Waintalaqa almalao minhum ani imshoo waisbiroo AAala alihatikum inna hatha lashayon yuradu

t: We have not heard of this in the latest religion. This is not but a fabrication.
tr: Ma samiAAna bihatha fee almillati alakhirati in hatha illa ikhtilaqun

t: Has the Reminder been revealed to him out of [all of] us?” Rather, they are in doubt about My Reminder. Rather, they have not yet tasted My punishment.
tr: Aonzila AAalayhi alththikru min baynina bal hum fee shakkin min thikree bal lamma yathooqoo AAathabi

t: Or do they have the depositories of the mercy of your Lord, the Exalted in Might, the Bestower?
tr: Am AAindahum khazainu rahmati rabbika alAAazeezi alwahhabi

t: Or is theirs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and what is between them? Then let them ascend through [any] ways of access.
tr: Am lahum mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma falyartaqoo fee alasbabi

t: [They are but] soldiers [who will be] defeated there among the companies [of disbelievers].
tr: Jundun ma hunalika mahzoomun mina alahzabi

t: The people of Noah denied before them, and [the tribe of] ‘Aad and Pharaoh, the owner of stakes,
tr: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waAAadun wafirAAawnu thoo alawtadi

t: And [the tribe of] Thamūd and the people of Lot and the companions of the thicket [i.e., people of Madyan]. Those are the companies.
tr: Wathamoodu waqawmu lootin waashabu alaykati olaika alahzabu

t: Each of them denied the messengers, so My retribution was justified.
tr: In kullun illa kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa AAiqabi

t: And these [disbelievers] await not but one blast [of the Horn]; for it there will be no delay.
tr: Wama yanthuru haolai illa sayhatan wahidatan ma laha min fawaqin

t: And they say, “Our Lord, hasten for us our share [of the punishment] before the Day of Account.”
tr: Waqaloo rabbana AAajjil lana qittana qabla yawmi alhisabi

t: Be patient over what they say and remember Our servant, David, the possessor of strength; indeed, he was one who repeatedly turned back [to God].
tr: Isbir AAala ma yaqooloona waothkur AAabdana dawooda tha alaydi innahu awwabun

t: Indeed, We subjected the mountains [to praise] with him, exalting [God] in the [late] afternoon and [after] sunrise.
tr: Inna sakhkharna aljibala maAAahu yusabbihna bialAAashiyyi waalishraqi

t: And the birds were assembled, all with him repeating [praises].
tr: Waalttayra mahshooratan kullun lahu awwabun

t: And We strengthened his kingdom and gave him wisdom and discernment in speech.
tr: Washadadna mulkahu waataynahu alhikmata wafasla alkhitabi

t: And has there come to you the news of the adversaries, when they climbed over the wall of [his] prayer chamber -
tr: Wahal ataka nabao alkhasmi ith tasawwaroo almihraba

t: When they entered upon David and he was alarmed by them? They said, “Fear not. [We are] two adversaries, one of whom has wronged the other, so judge between us with truth and do not exceed [it] and guide us to the sound path.
tr: Ith dakhaloo AAala dawooda fafaziAAa minhum qaloo la takhaf khasmani bagha baAAduna AAala baAAdin faohkum baynana bialhaqqi wala tushtit waihdina ila sawai alssirati

t: Indeed this, my brother, has ninety-nine ewes, and I have one ewe; so he said, ‘Entrust her to me,’ and he overpowered me in speech.”
tr: Inna hatha akhee lahu tisAAun watisAAoona naAAjatan waliya naAAjatun wahidatun faqala akfilneeha waAAazzanee fee alkhitabi

t: [David] said, “He has certainly wronged you in demanding your ewe [in addition] to his ewes. And indeed, many associates oppress one another, except for those who believe and do righteous deeds - and few are they.” And David became certain that We had tried him, and he asked forgiveness of his Lord and fell down bowing [in prostration] and turned in repentance [to God].
tr: Qala laqad thalamaka bisuali naAAjatika ila niAAajihi wainna katheeran mina alkhulatai layabghee baAAduhum AAala baAAdin illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waqaleelun ma hum wathanna dawoodu annama fatannahu faistaghfara rabbahu wakharra rakiAAan waanaba

t: So We forgave him that; and indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr: Faghafarna lahu thalika wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

t: [We said], “O David, indeed We have made you a successor upon the earth, so judge between the people in truth and do not follow [your own] desire, as it will lead you astray from the way of God.” Indeed, those who go astray from the way of God will have a severe punishment for having forgotten the Day of Account.
tr: Ya dawoodu inna jaAAalnaka khaleefatan fee alardi faohkum bayna alnnasi bialhaqqi wala tattabiAAi alhawa fayudillaka AAan sabeeli Allahi inna allatheena yadilloona AAan sabeeli Allahi lahum AAathabun shadeedun bima nasoo yawma alhisabi

t: And We did not create the heaven and the earth and that between them with no purpose. That is the assumption of those who disbelieve, so woe to those who disbelieve from the Fire.
tr: Wama khalaqna alssamaa waalarda wama baynahuma batilan thalika thannu allatheena kafaroo fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo mina alnnari

t: Or should We treat those who believe and do righteous deeds like corrupters in the land? Or should We treat those who fear God like the wicked?
tr: Am najAAalu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati kaalmufsideena fee alardi am najAAalu almuttaqeena kaalfujjari

t: [This is] a blessed Book which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], that they might reflect upon its verses and that those of understanding would be reminded.
tr: Kitabun anzalnahu ilayka mubarakun liyaddabbaroo ayatihi waliyatathakkara oloo alalbabi

t: And to David We gave Solomon. An excellent servant, indeed he was one repeatedly turning back [to God].
tr: Wawahabna lidawooda sulaymana niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

t: [Mention] when there were exhibited before him in the afternoon the poised [standing] racehorses.
tr: Ith AAurida AAalayhi bialAAashiyyi alssafinatu aljiyadu

t: And he said, “Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness].”
tr: Faqala innee ahbabtu hubba alkhayri AAan thikri rabbee hatta tawarat bialhijabi

t: [He said], “Return them to me,” and set about striking [their] legs and necks.
tr: Ruddooha AAalayya fatafiqa mashan bialssooqi waalaAAnaqi

t: And We certainly tried Solomon and placed on his throne a body; then he returned.
tr: Walaqad fatanna sulaymana waalqayna AAala kursiyyihi jasadan thumma anaba

t: He said, “My Lord, forgive me and grant me a kingdom such as will not belong to anyone after me. Indeed, You are the Bestower.”
tr: Qala rabbi ighfir lee wahab lee mulkan la yanbaghee liahadin min baAAdee innaka anta alwahhabu

t: So We subjected to him the wind blowing by his command, gently, wherever he directed,
tr: Fasakhkharna lahu alrreeha tajree biamrihi rukhaan haythu asaba

t: And [also] the devils [of jinn] - every builder and diver
tr: Waalshshayateena kulla bannain waghawwasin

t: And others bound together in shackles.
tr: Waakhareena muqarraneena fee alasfadi

t: [We said], “This is Our gift, so grant or withhold without account.”
tr: Hatha AAataona faomnun aw amsik bighayri hisabin

t: And indeed, for him is nearness to Us and a good place of return.
tr: Wainna lahu AAindana lazulfa wahusna maabin

t: And remember Our servant Job, when he called to his Lord, “Indeed, Satan has touched me with hardship and torment.”
tr: Waothkur AAabdana ayyooba ith nada rabbahu annee massaniya alshshaytanu binusbin waAAathabin

t: [So he was told], “Strike [the ground] with your foot; this is a [spring for a] cool bath and drink.”
tr: Orkud birijlika hatha mughtasalun baridun washarabun

t: And We granted him his family and a like [number] with them as mercy from Us and a reminder for those of understanding.
tr: Wawahabna lahu ahlahu wamithlahum maAAahum rahmatan minna wathikra liolee alalbabi

t: [We said], “And take in your hand a bunch [of grass] and strike with it and do not break your oath.” Indeed, We found him patient, an excellent servant. Indeed, he was one repeatedly turning back [to God].
tr: Wakhuth biyadika dighthan faidrib bihi wala tahnath inna wajadnahu sabiran niAAma alAAabdu innahu awwabun

t: And remember Our servants, Abraham, Isaac and Jacob - those of strength and [religious] vision.
tr: Waothkur AAibadana ibraheema waishaqa wayaAAqooba olee alaydee waalabsari

t: Indeed, We chose them for an exclusive quality: remembrance of the home [of the Hereafter].
tr: Inna akhlasnahum bikhalisatin thikra alddari

t: And indeed they are, to Us, among the chosen and outstanding.
tr: Wainnahum AAindana lamina almustafayna alakhyari

t: And remember Ishmael, Elisha and Dhul-Kifl, and all are among the outstanding.
tr: Waothkur ismaAAeela wailyasaAAa watha alkifli wakullun mina alakhyari

t: This is a reminder. And indeed, for the righteous is a good place of return -
tr: Hatha thikrun wainna lilmuttaqeena lahusna maabin

t: Gardens of perpetual residence, whose doors will be opened to them.
tr: Jannati AAadnin mufattahatan lahumu alabwabu

t: Reclining within them, they will call therein for abundant fruit and drink.
tr: Muttakieena feeha yadAAoona feeha bifakihatin katheeratin washarabin

t: And with them will be women limiting [their] glances and of equal age.
tr: WaAAindahum qasiratu alttarfi atrabun

t: This is what you, [the righteous], are promised for the Day of Account.
tr: Hatha ma tooAAadoona liyawmi alhisabi

t: Indeed, this is Our provision; for it there is no depletion.
tr: Inna hatha larizquna ma lahu min nafadin

t: This [is so]. But indeed, for the transgressors is an evil place of return -
tr: Hatha wainna lilttagheena lasharra maabin

t: Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the resting place.
tr: Jahannama yaslawnaha fabisa almihadu

t: This - so let them taste it - is scalding water and [foul] purulence
tr: Hatha falyathooqoohu hameemun waghassaqun

t: And other [punishments] of its type [in various] kinds.
tr: Waakharu min shaklihi azwajun

t: [Its inhabitants will say], “This is a company bursting in with you. No welcome for them. Indeed, they will burn in the Fire.”
tr: Hatha fawjun muqtahimun maAAakum la marhaban bihim innahum saloo alnnari

t: They will say, “Nor you! No welcome for you. You, [our leaders], brought this upon us, and wretched is the settlement.”
tr: Qaloo bal antum la marhaban bikum antum qaddamtumoohu lana fabisa alqararu

t: They will say, “Our Lord, whoever brought this upon us - increase for him double punishment in the Fire.”
tr: Qaloo rabbana man qaddama lana hatha fazidhu AAathaban diAAfan fee alnnari

t: And they will say, “Why do we not see men whom we used to count among the worst?
tr: Waqaloo ma lana la nara rijalan kunna naAAudduhum mina alashrari

t: Is it [because] we took them in ridicule, or has [our] vision turned away from them?”
tr: Attakhathnahum sikhriyyan am zaghat AAanhumu alabsaru

t: Indeed, that is truth [i.e., reality] - the quarrelling of the people of the Fire.
tr: Inna thalika lahaqqun takhasumu ahli alnnari

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “I am only a warner, and there is not any deity except God, the One, the Prevailing,
tr: Qul innama ana munthirun wama min ilahin illa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.”
tr: Rabbu alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alAAazeezu alghaffaru

t: Say, “It is great news
tr: Qul huwa nabaon AAatheemun

t: From which you turn away.
tr: Antum AAanhu muAAridoona

t: I had no knowledge of the exalted assembly [of angels] when they were disputing [the creation of Adam].
tr: Ma kana liya min AAilmin bialmalai alaAAla ith yakhtasimoona

t: It has not been revealed to me except that I am a clear warner.”
tr: In yooha ilayya illa annama ana natheerun mubeenun

t: [So mention] when your Lord said to the angels, “Indeed, I am going to create a human being from clay.
tr: Ith qala rabbuka lilmalaikati innee khaliqun basharan min teenin

t: So when I have proportioned him and breathed into him of My [created] soul, then fall down to him in prostration.”
tr: Faitha sawwaytuhu wanafakhtu feehi min roohee faqaAAoo lahu sajideena

t: So the angels prostrated - all of them entirely.
tr: Fasajada almalaikatu kulluhum ajmaAAoona

t: Except Iblees; he was arrogant and became among the disbelievers.
tr: Illa ibleesa istakbara wakana mina alkafireena

t: [God] said, “O Iblees, what prevented you from prostrating to that which I created with My hands? Were you arrogant [then], or were you [already] among the haughty?”
tr: Qala ya ibleesu ma manaAAaka an tasjuda lima khalaqtu biyadayya astakbarta am kunta mina alAAaleena

t: He said, “I am better than him. You created me from fire and created him from clay.”
tr: Qala ana khayrun minhu khalaqtanee min narin wakhalaqtahu min teenin

t: [God] said, “Then get out of it [i.e., Paradise], for indeed, you are expelled.
tr: Qala faokhruj minha fainnaka rajeemun

t: And indeed, upon you is My curse until the Day of Recompense.”
tr: Wainna AAalayka laAAnatee ila yawmi alddeeni

t: He said, “My Lord, then reprieve me until the Day they are resurrected.”
tr: Qala rabbi faanthirnee ila yawmi yubAAathoona

t: [God] said, “So indeed, you are of those reprieved
tr: Qala fainnaka mina almunthareena

t: Until the Day of the time well-known.”
tr: Ila yawmi alwaqti almaAAloomi

t: [Iblees] said, “By your might, I will surely mislead them all
tr: Qala fabiAAizzatika laoghwiyannahum ajmaAAeena

t: Except, among them, Your chosen servants.”
tr: Illa AAibadaka minhumu almukhlaseena

t: [God] said, “The truth [is My oath], and the truth I say -
tr: Qala faalhaqqu waalhaqqa aqoolu

t: [That] I will surely fill Hell with you and those of them that follow you all together.”
tr: Laamlaanna jahannama minka wamimman tabiAAaka minhum ajmaAAeena

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “I do not ask you for it [i.e., the Qur’ān] any payment, and I am not of the pretentious.
tr: Qul ma asalukum AAalayhi min ajrin wama ana mina almutakallifeena

t: It is but a reminder to the worlds.
tr: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

t: And you will surely know [the truth of] its information after a while.”
tr: WalataAAlamunna nabaahu baAAda heenin

t: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

t: Indeed, We have sent down to you the Book, [O Muhammad], in truth. So worship God, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
tr: Inna anzalna ilayka alkitaba bialhaqqi faoAAbudi Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

t: Surely, for God is the pure religion. And those who take protectors besides Him [say], “We only worship them that they may bring us nearer to God in position.” Indeed, God will judge between them concerning that over which they differ. Indeed, God does not guide he who is a liar and [confirmed] disbeliever.
tr: Ala lillahi alddeenu alkhalisu waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa ma naAAbuduhum illa liyuqarriboona ila Allahi zulfa inna Allaha yahkumu baynahum fee ma hum feehi yakhtalifoona inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa kathibun kaffarun

t: If God had intended to take a son, He could have chosen from what He creates whatever He willed. Exalted is He; He is God, the One, the Prevailing.
tr: Law arada Allahu an yattakhitha waladan laistafa mimma yakhluqu ma yashao subhanahu huwa Allahu alwahidu alqahharu

t: He created the heavens and earth in truth. He wraps the night over the day and wraps the day over the night and has subjected the sun and the moon, each running [its course] for a specified term. Surely, He is the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
tr: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi yukawwiru allayla AAala alnnahari wayukawwiru alnnahara AAala allayli wasakhkhara alshshamsa waalqamara kullun yajree liajalin musamman ala huwa alAAazeezu alghaffaru

t: He created you from one soul. Then He made from it its mate, and He produced for you from the grazing livestock eight mates. He creates you in the wombs of your mothers, creation after creation, within three darknesses. That is God, your Lord; to Him belongs dominion. There is no deity except Him, so how are you averted?
tr: Khalaqakum min nafsin wahidatin thumma jaAAala minha zawjaha waanzala lakum mina alanAAami thamaniyata azwajin yakhluqukum fee butooni ommahatikum khalqan min baAAdi khalqin fee thulumatin thalathin thalikumu Allahu rabbukum lahu almulku la ilaha illa huwa faanna tusrafoona

t: If you disbelieve - indeed, God is Free from need of you. And He does not approve for His servants disbelief. And if you are grateful, He approves [i.e., likes] it for you; and no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another. Then to your Lord is your return, and He will inform you about what you used to do. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: In takfuroo fainna Allaha ghaniyyun AAankum wala yarda liAAibadihi alkufra wain tashkuroo yardahu lakum wala taziru waziratun wizra okhra thumma ila rabbikum marjiAAukum fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

t: And when adversity touches the human being, he calls upon his Lord, turning to Him [alone]; then when He bestows on him a favour from Himself, he forgets Him whom he called upon before, and he attributes to God equals to mislead [people] from His way. Say, “Enjoy your disbelief for a little; indeed, you are of the companions of the Fire.”
tr: Waitha massa alinsana durrun daAAa rabbahu muneeban ilayhi thumma itha khawwalahu niAAmatan minhu nasiya ma kana yadAAoo ilayhi min qablu wajaAAala lillahi andadan liyudilla AAan sabeelihi qul tamattaAA bikufrika qaleelan innaka min ashabi alnnari

t: Is one who is devoutly obedient during periods of the night, prostrating and standing [in prayer], fearing the Hereafter and hoping for the mercy of his Lord, [like one who does not]? Say, “Are those who know equal to those who do not know?” Only they will remember [who are] people of understanding.
tr: Amman huwa qanitun anaa allayli sajidan waqaiman yahtharu alakhirata wayarjoo rahmata rabbihi qul hal yastawee allatheena yaAAlamoona waallatheena la yaAAlamoona innama yatathakkaru oloo alalbabi

t: Say, “O My servants who have believed, fear your Lord. For those who do good in this world is good, and the earth of God is spacious. Indeed, the patient will be given their reward without account [i.e., limit].”
tr: Qul ya AAibadi allatheena amanoo ittaqoo rabbakum lillatheena ahsanoo fee hathihi alddunya hasanatun waardu Allahi wasiAAatun innama yuwaffa alssabiroona ajrahum bighayri hisabin

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Indeed, I have been commanded to worship God, [being] sincere to Him in religion.
tr: Qul innee omirtu an aAAbuda Allaha mukhlisan lahu alddeena

t: And I have been commanded to be the first [among you] of the Muslims.”
tr: Waomirtu lian akoona awwala almuslimeena

t: Say, “Indeed I fear, if I should disobey my Lord, the punishment of a tremendous Day.”
tr: Qul innee akhafu in AAasaytu rabbee AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

t: Say, “God [alone] do I worship, sincere to Him in my religion,
tr: Quli Allaha aAAbudu mukhlisan lahu deenee

t: So worship what you will besides Him.” Say, “Indeed, the losers are the ones who will lose themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Surely, that is the manifest loss.”
tr: FaoAAbudoo ma shitum min doonihi qul inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala thalika huwa alkhusranu almubeenu

t: They will have canopies [i.e., layers] of fire above them and below them, canopies. By that God threatens [i.e., warms] His servants. O My servants, then fear Me.
tr: Lahum min fawqihim thulalun mina alnnari wamin tahtihim thulalun thalika yukhawwifu Allahu bihi AAibadahu ya AAibadi faittaqooni

t: But those who have avoided tāghūt, lest they worship it, and turned back to God - for them are good tidings. So give good tidings to My servants
tr: Waallatheena ijtanaboo alttaghoota an yaAAbudooha waanaboo ila Allahi lahumu albushra fabashshir AAibadi

t: Who listen to speech and follow the best of it. Those are the ones God has guided, and those are people of understanding.
tr: Allatheena yastamiAAoona alqawla fayattabiAAoona ahsanahu olaika allatheena hadahumu Allahu waolaika hum oloo alalbabi

t: Then, is one who has deserved the decree of punishment [to be guided]? Then, can you save one who is in the Fire?
tr: Afaman haqqa AAalayhi kalimatu alAAathabi afaanta tunqithu man fee alnnari

t: But those who have feared their Lord for them are chambers, above them chambers built high, beneath which rivers flow. [This is] the promise of God. God does not fail in [His] promise.
tr: Lakini allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum lahum ghurafun min fawqiha ghurafun mabniyyatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu waAAda Allahi la yukhlifu Allahu almeeAAada

t: Do you not see that God sends down rain from the sky and makes it flow as springs [and rivers] in the earth; then He produces thereby crops of varying colours; then they dry and you see them turned yellow; then He makes them [scattered] debris. Indeed in that is a reminder for those of understanding.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha anzala mina alssamai maan fasalakahu yanabeeAAa fee alardi thumma yukhriju bihi zarAAan mukhtalifan alwanuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yajAAaluhu hutaman inna fee thalika lathikra liolee alalbabi

t: So is one whose breast God has expanded to [accept] Islām and he is upon [i.e., guided by] a light from his Lord [like one whose heart rejects it]? Then woe to those whose hearts are hardened against the remembrance of God. Those are in manifest error.
tr: Afaman sharaha Allahu sadrahu lilislami fahuwa AAala noorin min rabbihi fawaylun lilqasiyati quloobuhum min thikri Allahi olaika fee dalalin mubeenin

t: God has sent down the best statement: a consistent Book wherein is reiteration. The skins shiver therefrom of those who fear their Lord; then their skins and their hearts relax at the remembrance of God. That is the guidance of God by which He guides whom He wills. And one whom God leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
tr: Allahu nazzala ahsana alhadeethi kitaban mutashabihan mathaniya taqshaAAirru minhu juloodu allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum thumma taleenu julooduhum waquloobuhum ila thikri Allahi thalika huda Allahi yahdee bihi man yashao waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

t: Then is he who will shield with his face the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection [like one secure from it]? And it will be said to the wrongdoers, “Taste what you used to earn.”
tr: Afaman yattaqee biwajhihi sooa alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati waqeela lilththalimeena thooqoo ma kuntum taksiboona

t: Those before them denied, and punishment came upon them from where they did not perceive.
tr: Kaththaba allatheena min qablihim faatahumu alAAathabu min haythu la yashAAuroona

t: So God made them taste disgrace in worldly life. But the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
tr: Faathaqahumu Allahu alkhizya fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

t: And We have certainly presented for the people in this Qur’ān from every [kind of] example - that they might remember.
tr: Walaqad darabna lilnnasi fee hatha alqurani min kulli mathalin laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

t: [It is] an Arabic Qur’ān, without any deviance that they might become righteous.
tr: Quranan AAarabiyyan ghayra thee AAiwajin laAAallahum yattaqoona

t: God presents an example: a man [i.e., slave] owned by quarrelling partners and another belonging exclusively to one man - are they equal in comparison? Praise be to God! But most of them do not know.
tr: Daraba Allahu mathalan rajulan feehi shurakao mutashakisoona warajulan salaman lirajulin hal yastawiyani mathalan alhamdu lillahi bal aktharuhum la yaAAlamoona

t: Indeed, you are to die, and indeed, they are to die.
tr: Innaka mayyitun wainnahum mayyitoona

t: Then indeed you, on the Day of Resurrection, before your Lord, will dispute.
tr: Thumma innakum yawma alqiyamati AAinda rabbikum takhtasimoona

t: So who is more unjust than one who lies about God and denies the truth when it has come to him? Is there not in Hell a residence for the disbelievers?
tr: Faman athlamu mimman kathaba AAala Allahi wakaththaba bialssidqi ith jaahu alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilkafireena

t: And the one who has brought the truth [i.e., the Prophet] and [they who] believed in it - those are the righteous.
tr: Waallathee jaa bialssidqi wasaddaqa bihi olaika humu almuttaqoona

t: They will have whatever they desire with their Lord. That is the reward of those who strive for excellence -
tr: Lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika jazao almuhsineena

t: That God may remove from them the worst of what they did and reward them their due for the best of what they used to do.
tr: Liyukaffira Allahu AAanhum aswaa allathee AAamiloo wayajziyahum ajrahum biahsani allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: Is not God sufficient for His Servant [i.e., Prophet Muhammad]? And [yet], they threaten you with those [they worship] other than Him. And whoever God leaves astray - for him there is no guide.
tr: Alaysa Allahu bikafin AAabdahu wayukhawwifoonaka biallatheena min doonihi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

t: And whoever God guides - for him there is no misleader. Is not God Exalted in Might and Owner of Retribution?
tr: Waman yahdi Allahu fama lahu min mudillin alaysa Allahu biAAazeezin thee intiqamin

t: And if you asked them, “Who created the heavens and the earth?” they would surely say, “God.” Say, “Then have you considered what you invoke besides God? If God intended me harm, are they removers of His harm; or if He intended me mercy, are they withholders of His mercy?” Say, “Sufficient for me is God; upon Him [alone] rely the [wise] reliers.”
tr: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna Allahu qul afaraaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi in aradaniya Allahu bidurrin hal hunna kashifatu durrihi aw aradanee birahmatin hal hunna mumsikatu rahmatihi qul hasbiya Allahu AAalayhi yatawakkalu almutawakkiloona

t: Say, “O my people, work according to your position, [for] indeed, I am working; and you are going to know
tr: Qul ya qawmi iAAmaloo AAala makanatikum innee AAamilun fasawfa taAAlamoona

t: To whom will come a torment disgracing him and on whom will descend an enduring punishment.”
tr: Man yateehi AAathabun yukhzeehi wayahillu AAalayhi AAathabun muqeemun

t: Indeed, We sent down to you the Book for the people in truth. So whoever is guided - it is for [the benefit of] his soul; and whoever goes astray only goes astray to its detriment. And you are not a guardian over them.
tr: Inna anzalna AAalayka alkitaba lilnnasi bialhaqqi famani ihtada falinafsihi waman dalla fainnama yadillu AAalayha wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin

t: God takes the souls at the time of their death, and those that do not die [He takes] during their sleep. Then He keeps those for which He has decreed death and releases the others for a specified term. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
tr: Allahu yatawaffa alanfusa heena mawtiha waallatee lam tamut fee manamiha fayumsiku allatee qada AAalayha almawta wayursilu alokhra ila ajalin musamman inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona

t: Or have they taken other than God as intercessors? Say, “Even though they do not possess [power over] anything, nor do they reason?”
tr: Ami ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi shufaAAaa qul awalaw kanoo la yamlikoona shayan wala yaAAqiloona

t: Say, “To God belongs [the right to allow] intercession entirely. To Him belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. Then to Him you will be returned.”
tr: Qul lillahi alshshafaAAatu jameeAAan lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi thumma ilayhi turjaAAoona

t: And when God is mentioned alone, the hearts of those who do not believe in the Hereafter shrink with aversion, but when those [worshipped] other than Him are mentioned, immediately they rejoice.
tr: Waitha thukira Allahu wahdahu ishmaazzat quloobu allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati waitha thukira allatheena min doonihi itha hum yastabshiroona

t: Say, “O God, Originator of the heavens and the earth, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, You will judge between your servants concerning that over which they used to differ.”
tr: Quli allahumma fatira alssamawati waalardi AAalima alghaybi waalshshahadati anta tahkumu bayna AAibadika fee ma kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona

t: And if those who did wrong had all that is in the earth entirely and the like of it with it, they would [attempt to] ransom themselves thereby from the worst of the punishment on the Day of Resurrection. And there will appear to them from God that which they had not taken into account.
tr: Walaw anna lillatheena thalamoo ma fee alardi jameeAAan wamithlahu maAAahu laiftadaw bihi min sooi alAAathabi yawma alqiyamati wabada lahum mina Allahi ma lam yakoonoo yahtasiboona

t: And there will appear to them the evils they had earned, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: And when adversity touches the human being, he calls upon Us; then when We bestow on him a favour from Us, he says, “I have only been given it because of [my] knowledge.” Rather, it is a trial, but most of them do not know.
tr: Faitha massa alinsana durrun daAAana thumma itha khawwalnahu niAAmatan minna qala innama ooteetuhu AAala AAilmin bal hiya fitnatun walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

t: Those before them had already said it, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
tr: Qad qalaha allatheena min qablihim fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona

t: And the evil consequences of what they earned struck them. And those who have wronged of these [people] will be struck [i.e., afflicted] by the evil consequences of what they earned; and they will not be able to frustrate [Our Plan].
tr: Faasabahum sayyiatu ma kasaboo waallatheena thalamoo min haolai sayuseebuhum sayyiatu ma kasaboo wama hum bimuAAjizeena

t: Do they not know that God extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]? Indeed in that are signs for a people who believe.
tr: Awalam yaAAlamoo anna Allaha yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yuminoona

t: Say, “O My servants who have transgressed against themselves [by sinning], do not despair of the mercy of God. Indeed, God forgives all sins. Indeed, it is He who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.”
tr: Qul ya AAibadiya allatheena asrafoo AAala anfusihim la taqnatoo min rahmati Allahi inna Allaha yaghfiru alththunooba jameeAAan innahu huwa alghafooru alrraheemu

t: And return [in repentance] to your Lord and submit to Him before the punishment comes upon you; then you will not be helped.
tr: Waaneeboo ila rabbikum waaslimoo lahu min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu thumma la tunsaroona

t: And follow the best of what was revealed to you from your Lord [i.e., the Qur’ān] before the punishment comes upon you suddenly while you do not perceive,
tr: WaittabiAAoo ahsana ma onzila ilaykum min rabbikum min qabli an yatiyakumu alAAathabu baghtatan waantum la tashAAuroona

t: Lest a soul should say, “Oh [how great is] my regret over what I neglected in regard to God and that I was among the mockers.”
tr: An taqoola nafsun ya hasrata AAala ma farrattu fee janbi Allahi wain kuntu lamina alssakhireena

t: Or [lest] it say, “If only God had guided me, I would have been among the righteous.”
tr: Aw taqoola law anna Allaha hadanee lakuntu mina almuttaqeena

t: Or [lest] it say when it sees the punishment, “If only I had another turn so I could be among those who strive for excellence.”
tr: Aw taqoola heena tara alAAathaba law anna lee karratan faakoona mina almuhsineena

t: But yes, there had come to you My verses, but you denied them and were arrogant, and you were among the disbelievers.
tr: Bala qad jaatka ayatee fakaththabta biha waistakbarta wakunta mina alkafireena

t: And on the Day of Resurrection you will see those who lied about God [with] their faces blackened. Is there not in Hell a residence for the arrogant?
tr: Wayawma alqiyamati tara allatheena kathaboo AAala Allahi wujoohuhum muswaddatun alaysa fee jahannama mathwan lilmutakabbireena

t: And God will save those who feared Him by their attainment; no evil will touch them, nor will they grieve.
tr: Wayunajjee Allahu allatheena ittaqaw bimafazatihim la yamassuhumu alssooo wala hum yahzanoona

t: God is the Creator of all things, and He is, over all things, Disposer of affairs.
tr: Allahu khaliqu kulli shayin wahuwa AAala kulli shayin wakeelun

t: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. And they who disbelieve in the verses of God - it is those who are the losers.
tr: Lahu maqaleedu alssamawati waalardi waallatheena kafaroo biayati Allahi olaika humu alkhasiroona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Is it other than God that you order me to worship, O ignorant ones?”
tr: Qul afaghayra Allahi tamuroonnee aAAbudu ayyuha aljahiloona

t: And it was already revealed to you and to those before you that if you should associate [anything] with God, your work would surely become worthless, and you would surely be among the losers.”
tr: Walaqad oohiya ilayka waila allatheena min qablika lain ashrakta layahbatanna AAamaluka walatakoonanna mina alkhasireena

t: Rather, worship [only] God and be among the grateful.
tr: Bali Allaha faoAAbud wakun mina alshshakireena

t: And they did not appreciate God as He deserves to be appreciated, while the earth entirely will be [within] His grip on the Day of Resurrection, and the heavens will be folded in His right hand. Exalted is He and high above what they associate with Him.
tr: Wama qadaroo Allaha haqqa qadrihi waalardu jameeAAan qabdatuhu yawma alqiyamati waalssamawatu matwiyyatun biyameenihi subhanahu wataAAala AAamma yushrikoona

t: And the Horn will be blown, and whoever is in the heavens and whoever is on the earth will fall dead except whom God wills. Then it will be blown again, and at once they will be standing, looking on.
tr: Wanufikha fee alssoori fasaAAiqa man fee alssamawati waman fee alardi illa man shaa Allahu thumma nufikha feehi okhra faitha hum qiyamun yanthuroona

t: And the earth will shine with the light of its Lord, and the record [of deeds] will be placed, and the prophets and the witnesses will be brought, and it will be judged between them in truth, and they will not be wronged.
tr: Waashraqati alardu binoori rabbiha wawudiAAa alkitabu wajeea bialnnabiyyeena waalshshuhadai waqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi wahum la yuthlamoona

t: And every soul will be fully compensated [for] what it did; and He is most knowing of what they do.
tr: Wawuffiyat kullu nafsin ma AAamilat wahuwa aAAlamu bima yafAAaloona

t: And those who disbelieved will be driven to Hell in groups until, when they reach it, its gates are opened and its keepers will say, “Did there not come to you messengers from yourselves, reciting to you the verses of your Lord and warning you of the meeting of this Day of yours?” They will say, “Yes, but the word [i.e., decree] of punishment has come into effect upon the disbelievers.”
tr: Waseeqa allatheena kafaroo ila jahannama zumaran hatta itha jaooha futihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha alam yatikum rusulun minkum yatloona AAalaykum ayati rabbikum wayunthiroonakum liqaa yawmikum hatha qaloo bala walakin haqqat kalimatu alAAathabi AAala alkafireena

t: [To them] it will be said, “Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant.”
tr: Qeela odkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha fabisa mathwa almutakabbireena

t: But those who feared their Lord will be driven to Paradise in groups until, when they reach it while its gates have been opened and its keepers say, “Peace be upon you; you have become pure; so enter it to abide eternally therein,” [they will enter].
tr: Waseeqa allatheena ittaqaw rabbahum ila aljannati zumaran hatta itha jaooha wafutihat abwabuha waqala lahum khazanatuha salamun AAalaykum tibtum faodkhulooha khalideena

t: And they will say, “Praise to God, who has fulfilled for us His promise and made us inherit the earth [so] we may settle in Paradise wherever we will. And excellent is the reward of [righteous] workers.”
tr: Waqaloo alhamdu lillahi allathee sadaqana waAAdahu waawrathana alarda natabawwao mina aljannati haythu nashao faniAAma ajru alAAamileena

t: And you will see the angels surrounding the Throne, exalting [God] with praise of their Lord. And it will be judged between them in truth, and it will be said, “All praise to God, Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Watara almalaikata haffeena min hawli alAAarshi yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim waqudiya baynahum bialhaqqi waqeela alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

t: Hā, Meem.
tr: Hameem

t: The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
tr: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

t: The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in retribution, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
tr: Ghafiri alththanbi waqabili alttawbi shadeedi alAAiqabi thee alttawli la ilaha illa huwa ilayhi almaseeru

t: No one disputes concerning the signs of God except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.
tr: Ma yujadilu fee ayati Allahi illa allatheena kafaroo fala yaghrurka taqallubuhum fee albiladi

t: The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My retribution.
tr: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waalahzabu min baAAdihim wahammat kullu ommatin birasoolihim liyakhuthoohu wajadaloo bialbatili liyudhidoo bihi alhaqqa faakhathtuhum fakayfa kana AAiqabi

t: And thus has the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
tr: Wakathalika haqqat kalimatu rabbika AAala allatheena kafaroo annahum ashabu alnnari

t: Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [God] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], “Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
tr: Allatheena yahmiloona alAAarsha waman hawlahu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayuminoona bihi wayastaghfiroona lillatheena amanoo rabbana wasiAAta kulla shayin rahmatan waAAilman faighfir lillatheena taboo waittabaAAoo sabeelaka waqihim AAathaba aljaheemi

t: Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their fathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Rabbana waadkhilhum jannati AAadnin allatee waAAadtahum waman salaha min abaihim waazwajihim wathurriyyatihim innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment.”
tr: Waqihimu alssayyiati waman taqi alssayyiati yawmaithin faqad rahimtahu wathalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

t: Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, “The hatred of God for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused].”
tr: Inna allatheena kafaroo yunadawna lamaqtu Allahi akbaru min maqtikum anfusakum ith tudAAawna ila aleemani fatakfuroona

t: They will say, “Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?”
tr: Qaloo rabbana amattana ithnatayni waahyaytana ithnatayni faiAAtarafna bithunoobina fahal ila khuroojin min sabeelin

t: [They will be told], “That is because, when God was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with God, the Most High, the Grand.”
tr: Thalikum biannahu itha duAAiya Allahu wahdahu kafartum wain yushrak bihi tuminoo faalhukmu lillahi alAAaliyyi alkabeeri

t: It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
tr: Huwa allathee yureekum ayatihi wayunazzilu lakum mina alssamai rizqan wama yatathakkaru illa man yuneebu

t: So invoke God, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
tr: FaodAAoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena walaw kariha alkafiroona

t: [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command [i.e., revelation] upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
tr: RafeeAAu alddarajati thoo alAAarshi yulqee alrrooha min amrihi AAala man yashao min AAibadihi liyunthira yawma alttalaqi

t: The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from God. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To God, the One, the Prevailing.
tr: Yawma hum barizoona la yakhfa AAala Allahi minhum shayon limani almulku alyawma lillahi alwahidi alqahhari

t: This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, God is swift in account.
tr: Alyawma tujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat la thulma alyawma inna Allaha sareeAAu alhisabi

t: And warn them, [O Muhammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
tr: Waanthirhum yawma alazifati ithi alquloobu lada alhanajiri kathimeena ma lilththalimeena min hameemin wala shafeeAAin yutaAAu

t: He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
tr: YaAAlamu khainata alaAAyuni wama tukhfee alssudooru

t: And God judges with truth, while those they invoke besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, God - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
tr: WaAllahu yaqdee bialhaqqi waallatheena yadAAoona min doonihi la yaqdoona bishayin inna Allaha huwa alssameeAAu albaseeru

t: Have they not travelled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but God seized them for their sins. And they had not from God any protector.
tr: Awa lam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena kanoo min qablihim kanoo hum ashadda minhum quwwatan waatharan fee alardi faakhathahumu Allahu bithunoobihim wama kana lahum mina Allahi min waqin

t: That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so God seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in retribution.
tr: Thalika biannahum kanat tateehim rusuluhum bialbayyinati fakafaroo faakhathahumu Allahu innahu qawiyyun shadeedu alAAiqabi

t: And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority
tr: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina wasultanin mubeenin

t: To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, “[He is] a magician and a liar.”
tr: Ila firAAawna wahamana waqaroona faqaloo sahirun kaththabun

t: And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, “Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive.” But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.
tr: Falamma jaahum bialhaqqi min AAindina qaloo oqtuloo abnaa allatheena amanoo maAAahu waistahyoo nisaahum wama kaydu alkafireena illa fee dalalin

t: And Pharaoh said, “Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption in the land.”
tr: Waqala firAAawnu tharoonee aqtul moosa walyadAAu rabbahu innee akhafu an yubaddila deenakum aw an yuthhira fee alardi alfasada

t: But Moses said, “Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account.”
tr: Waqala moosa innee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum min kulli mutakabbirin la yuminu biyawmi alhisabi

t: And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, “Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, ‘My Lord is God’ while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, God does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.
tr: Waqala rajulun muminun min ali firAAawna yaktumu eemanahu ataqtuloona rajulan an yaqoola rabbiyya Allahu waqad jaakum bialbayyinati min rabbikum wain yaku kathiban faAAalayhi kathibuhu wain yaku sadiqan yusibkum baAAdu allathee yaAAidukum inna Allaha la yahdee man huwa musrifun kaththabun

t: O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of God if it came to us?” Pharaoh said, “I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct.”
tr: Ya qawmi lakumu almulku alyawma thahireena fee alardi faman yansuruna min basi Allahi in jaana qala firAAawnu ma oreekum illa ma ara wama ahdeekum illa sabeela alrrashadi

t: And he who believed said, “O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the Confederates -
tr: Waqala allathee amana ya qawmi innee akhafu AAalaykum mithla yawmi alahzabi

t: Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ‘Aad and Thamūd and those after them. And God wants no injustice for [His] servants.
tr: Mithla dabi qawmi noohin waAAadin wathamooda waallatheena min baAAdihim wama Allahu yureedu thulman lilAAibadi

t: And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling -
tr: Waya qawmi innee akhafu AAalaykum yawma alttanadi

t: The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from God any protector. And whoever God leaves astray - there is not for him any guide.
tr: Yawma tuwalloona mudbireena ma lakum mina Allahi min AAasimin waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min hadin

t: And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, ‘Never will God send a messenger after him.’ Thus does God leave astray he who is a transgressor and sceptic.”
tr: Walaqad jaakum yoosufu min qablu bialbayyinati fama ziltum fee shakkin mimma jaakum bihi hatta itha halaka qultum lan yabAAatha Allahu min baAAdihi rasoolan kathalika yudillu Allahu man huwa musrifun murtabun

t: Those who dispute concerning the signs of God without an authority having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of God and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does God seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
tr: Allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi bighayri sultanin atahum kabura maqtan AAinda Allahi waAAinda allatheena amanoo kathalika yatbaAAu Allahu AAala kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbarin

t: And Pharaoh said, “O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways -
tr: Waqala firAAawnu ya hamanu ibni lee sarhan laAAallee ablughu alasbaba

t: The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar.” And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was prevented from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.
tr: Asbaba alssamawati faattaliAAa ila ilahi moosa wainnee laathunnuhu kathiban wakathalika zuyyina lifirAAawna sooo AAamalihi wasudda AAani alssabeeli wama kaydu firAAawna illa fee tababin

t: And he who believed said, “O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
tr: Waqala allathee amana ya qawmi ittabiAAooni ahdikum sabeela alrrashadi

t: O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
tr: Ya qawmi innama hathihi alhayatu alddunya mataAAun wainna alakhirata hiya daru alqarari

t: Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a Believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.
tr: Man AAamila sayyiatan fala yujza illa mithlaha waman AAamila salihan min thakarin aw ontha wahuwa muminun faolaika yadkhuloona aljannata yurzaqoona feeha bighayri hisabin

t: And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
tr: Waya qawmi ma lee adAAookum ila alnnajati watadAAoonanee ila alnnari

t: You invite me to disbelieve in God and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.
tr: TadAAoonanee liakfura biAllahi waoshrika bihi ma laysa lee bihi AAilmun waana adAAookum ila alAAazeezi alghaffari
