t: Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to God, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.
tr: La jarama annama tadAAoonanee ilayhi laysa lahu daAAwatun fee alddunya wala fee alakhirati waanna maraddana ila Allahi waanna almusrifeena hum ashabu alnnari

t: And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to God. Indeed, God is Seeing of [His] servants.”
tr: Fasatathkuroona ma aqoolu lakum waofawwidu amree ila Allahi inna Allaha baseerun bialAAibadi

t: So God protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
tr: Fawaqahu Allahu sayyiati ma makaroo wahaqa biali firAAawna sooo alAAathabi

t: The Fire, they are exposed to it morning and evening. And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], “Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment.”
tr: Alnnaru yuAAradoona AAalayha ghuduwwan waAAashiyyan wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu adkhiloo ala firAAawna ashadda alAAathabi

t: And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, “Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?”
tr: Waith yatahajjoona fee alnnari fayaqoolu aldduAAafao lillatheena istakbaroo inna kunna lakum tabaAAan fahal antum mughnoona AAanna naseeban mina alnnari

t: Those who had been arrogant will say, “Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, God has judged between the servants.”
tr: Qala allatheena istakbaroo inna kullun feeha inna Allaha qad hakama bayna alAAibadi

t: And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, “Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment.”
tr: Waqala allatheena fee alnnari likhazanati jahannama odAAoo rabbakum yukhaffif AAanna yawman mina alAAathabi

t: They will say, “Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?” They will say, “Yes.” They will reply, “Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility].”
tr: Qaloo awalam taku tateekum rusulukum bialbayyinati qaloo bala qaloo faodAAoo wama duAAao alkafireena illa fee dalalin

t: Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -
tr: Inna lanansuru rusulana waallatheena amanoo fee alhayati alddunya wayawma yaqoomu alashhadu

t: The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home [i.e., Hell].
tr: Yawma la yanfaAAu alththalimeena maAAthiratuhum walahumu allaAAnatu walahum sooo alddari

t: And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Book
tr: Walaqad atayna moosa alhuda waawrathna banee israeela alkitaba

t: As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.
tr: Hudan wathikra liolee alalbabi

t: So be patient, [O Muhammad]. Indeed, the promise of God is true. And ask forgiveness for your sin and exalt [God] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
tr: Faisbir inna waAAda Allahi haqqun waistaghfir lithanbika wasabbih bihamdi rabbika bialAAashiyyi waalibkari

t: Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of God without [any] authority having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in God. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.
tr: Inna allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi bighayri sultanin atahum in fee sudoorihim illa kibrun ma hum bibaligheehi faistaAAith biAllahi innahu huwa alssameeAAu albaseeru

t: The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.
tr: Lakhalqu alssamawati waalardi akbaru min khalqi alnnasi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona

t: And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.
tr: Wama yastawee alaAAma waalbaseeru waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wala almuseeo qaleelan ma tatathakkaroona

t: Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.
tr: Inna alssaAAata laatiyatun la rayba feeha walakinna akthara alnnasi la yuminoona

t: And your Lord says, “Call upon Me; I will respond to you.” Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.
tr: Waqala rabbukumu odAAoonee astajib lakum inna allatheena yastakbiroona AAan AAibadatee sayadkhuloona jahannama dakhireena

t: It is God who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight. Indeed, God is full of bounty to the people, but most of the people are not grateful.
tr: Allahu allathee jaAAala lakumu allayla litaskunoo feehi waalnnahara mubsiran inna Allaha lathoo fadlin AAala alnnasi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yashkuroona

t: That is God, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
tr: Thalikumu Allahu rabbukum khaliqu kulli shayin la ilaha illa huwa faanna tufakoona

t: Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of God.
tr: Kathalika yufaku allatheena kanoo biayati Allahi yajhadoona

t: It is God who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure [i.e., ceiling] and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is God, your Lord; then blessed is God, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Allahu allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda qararan waalssamaa binaan wasawwarakum faahsana suwarakum warazaqakum mina alttayyibati thalikumu Allahu rabbukum fatabaraka Allahu rabbu alAAalameena

t: He is the Ever-Living; there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. All praise be to God, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Huwa alhayyu la ilaha illa huwa faodAAoohu mukhliseena lahu alddeena alhamdu lillahi rabbi alAAalameena

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides God once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Qul innee nuheetu an aAAbuda allatheena tadAAoona min dooni Allahi lamma jaaniya albayyinatu min rabbee waomirtu an oslima lirabbi alAAalameena

t: It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term; and perhaps you will use reason.
tr: Huwa allathee khalaqakum min turabin thumma min nutfatin thumma min AAalaqatin thumma yukhrijukum tiflan thumma litablughoo ashuddakum thumma litakoonoo shuyookhan waminkum man yutawaffa min qablu walitablughoo ajalan musamman walaAAallakum taAAqiloona

t: He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, “Be,” and it is.
tr: Huwa allathee yuhyee wayumeetu faitha qada amran fainnama yaqoolu lahu kun fayakoonu

t: Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of God - how are they averted?
tr: Alam tara ila allatheena yujadiloona fee ayati Allahi anna yusrafoona

t: Those who deny the Book [i.e., the ] and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,
tr: Allatheena kaththaboo bialkitabi wabima arsalna bihi rusulana fasawfa yaAAlamoona

t: When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged
tr: Ithi alaghlalu fee aAAnaqihim waalssalasilu yushaboona

t: In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].
tr: Fee alhameemi thumma fee alnnari yusjaroona

t: Then it will be said to them, “Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]
tr: Thumma qeela lahum ayna ma kuntum tushrikoona

t: Other than God?” They will say, “They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything.” Thus does God put astray the disbelievers.
tr: Min dooni Allahi qaloo dalloo AAanna bal lam nakun nadAAoo min qablu shayan kathalika yudillu Allahu alkafireena

t: [The angels will say], “That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.
tr: Thalikum bima kuntum tafrahoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tamrahoona

t: Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant.”
tr: Odkhuloo abwaba jahannama khalideena feeha fabisa mathwa almutakabbireena

t: So be patient, [O Muhammad]; indeed, the promise of God is true. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.
tr: Faisbir inna waAAda Allahi haqqun faimma nuriyannaka baAAda allathee naAAiduhum aw natawaffayannaka failayna yurjaAAoona

t: And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of God. So when the command of God comes, it will be concluded [i.e., judged] in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].
tr: Walaqad arsalna rusulan min qablika minhum man qasasna AAalayka waminhum man lam naqsus AAalayka wama kana lirasoolin an yatiya biayatin illa biithni Allahi faitha jaa amru Allahi qudiya bialhaqqi wakhasira hunalika almubtiloona

t: It is God who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.
tr: Allahu allathee jaAAala lakumu alanAAama litarkaboo minha waminha takuloona

t: And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts; and upon them and upon ships you are carried.
tr: Walakum feeha manafiAAu walitablughoo AAalayha hajatan fee sudoorikum waAAalayha waAAala alfulki tuhmaloona

t: And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of God do you deny?
tr: Wayureekum ayatihi faayya ayati Allahi tunkiroona

t: Have they not travelled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
tr: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim kanoo akthara minhum waashadda quwwatan waatharan fee alardi fama aghna AAanhum ma kanoo yaksiboona

t: And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Falamma jaathum rusuluhum bialbayyinati farihoo bima AAindahum mina alAAilmi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: And when they saw Our punishment, they said, “We believe in God alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him.”
tr: Falamma raaw basana qaloo amanna biAllahi wahdahu wakafarna bima kunna bihi mushrikeena

t: But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of God which has preceded among His servants. There and then the disbelievers were lost.
tr: Falam yaku yanfaAAuhum eemanuhum lamma raaw basana sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat fee AAibadihi wakhasira hunalika alkafiroona

t: Hā, Meem.
tr: Hameem

t: [This is] a revelation from the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful –
tr: Tanzeelun mina alrrahmani alrraheemi

t: A Book whose verses have been detailed, an Arabic Qur’ān for a people who know,
tr: Kitabun fussilat ayatuhu quranan AAarabiyyan liqawmin yaAAlamoona

t: As a giver of good tidings and a warner; but most of them turn away, so they do not hear.
tr: Basheeran wanatheeran faaAArada aktharuhum fahum la yasmaAAoona

t: And they say, “Our hearts are within coverings [i.e., screened] from that to which you invite us, and in our ears is deafness, and between us and you is a partition, so work; indeed, we are working.”
tr: Waqaloo quloobuna fee akinnatin mimma tadAAoona ilayhi wafee athanina waqrun wamin baynina wabaynika hijabun faiAAmal innana AAamiloona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “I am only a man like you to whom it has been revealed that your god is but one God; so take a straight course to Him and seek His forgiveness.” And woe to those who associate others with God –
tr: Qul innama ana basharun mithlukum yooha ilayya annama ilahukum ilahun wahidun faistaqeemoo ilayhi waistaghfiroohu wawaylun lilmushrikeena

t: Those who do not give zakāh, and in the Hereafter they are disbelievers.
tr: Allatheena la yutoona alzzakata wahum bialakhirati hum kafiroona

t: Indeed, those who believe and do righteous deeds – for them is a reward uninterrupted. Hā Meem as-Sajdah
tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

t: Say, “Do you indeed disbelieve in He who created the earth in two days and attribute to Him equals? That is the Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Qul ainnakum latakfuroona biallathee khalaqa alarda fee yawmayni watajAAaloona lahu andadan thalika rabbu alAAalameena

t: And He placed on it [i.e., the earth] firmly set mountains over its surface, and He blessed it and determined therein its [creatures’] sustenance in four days without distinction – for [the information of] those who ask.
tr: WajaAAala feeha rawasiya min fawqiha wabaraka feeha waqaddara feeha aqwataha fee arbaAAati ayyamin sawaan lilssaileena

t: Then He directed Himself to the heaven while it was smoke and said to it and to the earth, “Come [into being], willingly or by compulsion.” They said, “We have come willingly.”
tr: Thumma istawa ila alssamai wahiya dukhanun faqala laha walilardi itiya tawAAan aw karhan qalata atayna taiAAeena

t: And He completed them as seven heavens within two days and inspired [i.e., made known] in each heaven its command. And We adorned the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars, for beauty] and as protection. That is the determination of the Exalted in Might, the Knowing.
tr: Faqadahunna sabAAa samawatin fee yawmayni waawha fee kulli samain amraha wazayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wahifthan thalika taqdeeru alAAazeezi alAAaleemi

t: But if they turn away, then say, “I have warned you of a thunderbolt like the thunderbolt [that struck] ‘Aad and Thamūd.
tr: Fain aAAradoo fuqul anthartukum saAAiqatan mithla saAAiqati AAadin wathamooda

t: [That occurred] when the messengers had come to them before them and after them, [saying], “Worship not except God.” They said, “If our Lord had willed, He would have sent down the angels, so indeed we, in that with which you have been sent, are disbelievers.”
tr: Ith jaathumu alrrusulu min bayni aydeehim wamin khalfihim alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha qaloo law shaa rabbuna laanzala malaikatan fainna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona

t: As for ‘Aad, they were arrogant upon the earth without right and said, “Who is greater than us in strength?” Did they not consider that God who created them was greater than them in strength? But they were rejecting Our signs.
tr: Faamma AAadun faistakbaroo fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi waqaloo man ashaddu minna quwwatan awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqahum huwa ashaddu minhum quwwatan wakanoo biayatina yajhadoona

t: So We sent upon them a screaming wind during days of misfortune to make them taste the punishment of disgrace in the worldly life; but the punishment of the Hereafter is more disgracing, and they will not be helped.
tr: Faarsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee ayyamin nahisatin linutheeqahum AAathaba alkhizyi fee alhayati alddunya walaAAathabu alakhirati akhza wahum la yunsaroona

t: And as for Thamūd, We guided them, but they preferred blindness over guidance, so the thunderbolt of humiliating punishment seized them for what they used to earn.
tr: Waamma thamoodu fahadaynahum faistahabboo alAAama AAala alhuda faakhathathum saAAiqatu alAAathabi alhooni bima kanoo yaksiboona

t: And We saved those who believed and used to fear God.
tr: Wanajjayna allatheena amanoo wakanoo yattaqoona

t: And [mention, O Muhammad], the Day when the enemies of God will be gathered to the Fire while they are [driven], assembled in rows,
tr: Wayawma yuhsharu aAAdao Allahi ila alnnari fahum yoozaAAoona

t: Until, when they reach it, their hearing and their eyes and their skins will testify against them of what they used to do.
tr: Hatta itha ma jaooha shahida AAalayhim samAAuhum waabsaruhum wajulooduhum bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: And they will say to their skins, “Why have you testified against us?” They will say, “We were made to speak by God, who has made everything speak; and He created you the first time, and to Him you are returned.
tr: Waqaloo lijuloodihim lima shahidtum AAalayna qaloo antaqana Allahu allathee antaqa kulla shayin wahuwa khalaqakum awwala marratin wailayhi turjaAAoona

t: And you were not covering [i.e., protecting] yourselves, lest your hearing testify against you or your sight or your skins, but you assumed that God does not know much of what you do.
tr: Wama kuntum tastatiroona an yashhada AAalaykum samAAukum wala absarukum wala juloodukum walakin thanantum anna Allaha la yaAAlamu katheeran mimma taAAmaloona

t: And that was your assumption which you assumed about your Lord. It has brought you to ruin, and you have become among the losers.”
tr: Wathalikum thannukumu allathee thanantum birabbikum ardakum faasbahtum mina alkhasireena

t: So [even] if they persevere, the Fire is a residence for them; and if they ask to appease [God], they shall not be of those who are allowed to appease.
tr: Fain yasbiroo faalnnaru mathwan lahum wain yastaAAtiboo fama hum mina almuAAtabeena

t: And We appointed for them companions who made attractive to them what was before them and what was behind them [of sin], and the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect upon them among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
tr: Waqayyadna lahum quranaa fazayyanoo lahum ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wahaqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee omamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena

t: And those who disbelieve say, “Do not listen to this Qur’ān and make noise during [the recitation of] it that you will overcome.”
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo la tasmaAAoo lihatha alqurani wailghaw feehi laAAallakum taghliboona

t: But We will surely cause those who disbelieve to taste a severe punishment, and We will surely recompense them for the worst of what they had been doing.
tr: Falanutheeqanna allatheena kafaroo AAathaban shadeedan walanajziyannahum aswaa allathee kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: That is the recompense of the enemies of God – the Fire. For them therein is the home of eternity as recompense for what they, of Our verses, were rejecting.
tr: Thalika jazao aAAdai Allahi alnnaru lahum feeha daru alkhuldi jazaan bima kanoo biayatina yajhadoona

t: And those who disbelieved will [then] say, “Our Lord, show us those who misled us of the jinn and men [so] we shall put them under our feet so that they will be among the lowest [i.e. most humiliated].”
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo rabbana arina allathayni adallana mina aljinni waalinsi najAAalhuma tahta aqdamina liyakoona mina alasfaleena

t: Indeed, those who have said, “Our Lord is God” and then remained steadfast – the angels will descend upon them, [saying], “Do not fear and do not grieve but receive good tidings of Paradise, which you were promised.
tr: Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo tatanazzalu AAalayhimu almalaikatu alla takhafoo wala tahzanoo waabshiroo bialjannati allatee kuntum tooAAadoona

t: We were your allies in worldly life and [are so] in the Hereafter. And you will have therein whatever your souls desire, and you will have therein whatever you request [or wish]
tr: Nahnu awliyaokum fee alhayati alddunya wafee alakhirati walakum feeha ma tashtahee anfusukum walakum feeha ma taddaAAoona

t: Hospitality from One, Forgiving, Most Merciful.”
tr: Nuzulan min ghafoorin raheemin

t: And who is better in speech than one who invites to God and does righteousness and says, “Indeed, I am of the Muslims.”
tr: Waman ahsanu qawlan mimman daAAa ila Allahi waAAamila salihan waqala innanee mina almuslimeena

t: And not equal are the good deed and the bad. Repel [evil] by that [deed] which is better; and thereupon, the one whom between you and him is enmity [will become] as though he was a devoted friend.
tr: Wala tastawee alhasanatu wala alssayyiatu idfaAA biallatee hiya ahsanu faitha allathee baynaka wabaynahu AAadawatun kaannahu waliyyun hameemun

t: But none is granted it except those who are patient, and none is granted it except one having a great portion [of good].
tr: Wama yulaqqaha illa allatheena sabaroo wama yulaqqaha illa thoo haththin AAatheemin

t: And if there comes to you from Satan an evil suggestion, then seek refuge in God. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing.
tr: Waimma yanzaghannaka mina alshshaytani nazghun faistaAAith biAllahi innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t: And of His signs are the night and day and the sun and moon. Do not prostrate to the sun or to the moon, but prostate to God, who created them, if it should be Him that you worship.
tr: Wamin ayatihi allaylu waalnnaharu waalshshamsu waalqamaru la tasjudoo lilshshamsi wala lilqamari waosjudoo lillahi alathee khalaqahunna in kuntum iyyahu taAAbudoona

t: But if they are arrogant – then those who are near your Lord [i.e., the angels] exalt Him by night and by day, and they do not become weary.
tr: Faini istakbaroo faallatheena AAinda rabbika yusabbihoona lahu biallayli waalnnahari wahum la yasamoona

t: And of His signs is that you see the earth stilled, but when We send down upon it rain, it quivers and grows. Indeed, He who has given it life is the Giver of Life to the dead. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
tr: Wamin ayatihi annaka tara alarda khashiAAatan faitha anzalna AAalayha almaa ihtazzat warabat inna allathee ahyaha lamuhyee almawta innahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: Indeed, those who distort Our verses are not hidden from Us. So, is he who is cast into the Fire better or he who comes secure on the Day of Resurrection? Do whatever you will; indeed, He is Seeing of what you do.
tr: Inna allatheena yulhidoona fee ayatina la yakhfawna AAalayna afaman yulqa fee alnnari khayrun am man yatee aminan yawma alqiyamati iAAmaloo ma shitum innahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun

t: Indeed, those who disbelieve in the Reminder [i.e., the Qur’ān] after it has come to them… And indeed, it is a mighty Book.
tr: Inna allatheena kafaroo bialththikri lamma jaahum wainnahu lakitabun AAazeezun

t: Falsehood cannot approach it from before it or from behind it; [it is] a revelation from a [Lord who is] Wise and Praiseworthy.
tr: La yateehi albatilu min bayni yadayhi wala min khalfihi tanzeelun min hakeemin hameedin

t: Nothing is said to you, [O Muhammad], except what was already said to the messengers before you. Indeed, your Lord is a possessor of forgiveness and a possessor of painful retribution.
tr: Ma yuqalu laka illa ma qad qeela lilrrusuli min qablika inna rabbaka lathoo maghfiratin wathoo AAiqabin aleemin

t: And if We had made it a foreign [i.e., non-Arabic] Qur’ān, they would have said, “Why are its verses not explained in detail [in our language]? Is it a foreign [recitation] and an Arab [messenger]?” Say, “It is, for those who believe, a guidance and cure.” And those who do not believe – in their ears is deafness, and it is upon them blindness. Those are being called from a distant place.
tr: Walaw jaAAalnahu quranan aAAjamiyyan laqaloo lawla fussilat ayatuhu aaAAjamiyyun waAAarabiyyun qul huwa lillatheena amanoo hudan washifaon waallatheena la yuminoona fee athanihim waqrun wahuwa AAalayhim AAaman olaika yunadawna min makanin baAAeedin

t: And We had already given Moses the Book, but it came under disagreement. And if not for a word [i.e., decree] that preceded from your Lord, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed they are in doubt, arousing suspicion.
tr: Walaqad atayna moosa alkitaba faikhtulifa feehi walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika laqudiya baynahum wainnahum lafee shakkin minhu mureebin

t: Whoever does righteousness – it is for his [own] soul; and whoever does evil [does so] against it. And your Lord is not ever unjust to [His] servants.
tr: Man AAamila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa faAAalayha wama rabbuka bithallamin lilAAabeedi

t: To Him [alone] is attributed knowledge of the Hour. And fruits emerge not from their coverings nor does a female conceive or give birth except with His knowledge. And the Day He will call to them, “Where are My ‘partners’?” they will say, “We announce to You that there is [no longer] among us any witness [to that].”
tr: Ilayhi yuraddu AAilmu alssaAAati wama takhruju min thamaratin min akmamiha wama tahmilu min ontha wala tadaAAu illa biAAilmihi wayawma yunadeehim ayna shurakaee qaloo athannaka ma minna min shaheedin

t: And lost from them will be those they were invoking before, and they will be certain that they have no place of escape.
tr: Wadalla AAanhum ma kanoo yadAAoona min qablu wathannoo ma lahum min maheesin

t: The human being is not weary of supplication for good [things], but if evil touches him, he is hopeless and despairing.
tr: La yasamu alinsanu min duAAai alkhayri wain massahu alshsharru fayaoosun qanootun

t: And if We let him taste mercy from Us after an adversity which has touched him, he will surely say, “This is [due] to me, and I do not think the Hour will occur; and [even] if I should be returned to my Lord, indeed, for me there will be with Him the best.” But We will surely inform those who disbelieved about what they did, and We will surely make them taste a massive punishment.
tr: Walain athaqnahu rahmatan minna min baAAdi darraa massathu layaqoolanna hatha lee wama athunnu alssaAAata qaimatan walain rujiAAtu ila rabbee inna lee AAindahu lalhusna falanunabbianna allatheena kafaroo bima AAamiloo walanutheeqannahum min AAathabin ghaleethin

t: And when We bestow favour upon the human being, he turns away and distances himself; but when evil touches him, then he is full of extensive supplication.
tr: Waitha anAAamna AAala alinsani aAArada wanaa bijanibihi waitha massahu alshsharru fathoo duAAain AAareedin

t: Say, “Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from God and you disbelieved in it, who would be more astray than one who is in extreme dissension?”
tr: Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi thumma kafartum bihi man adallu mimman huwa fee shiqaqin baAAeedin

t: We will show them Our signs in the horizons and within themselves until it becomes clear to them that it is the truth. But is it not sufficient concerning your Lord that He is, over all things, a Witness?
tr: Sanureehim ayatina fee alafaqi wafee anfusihim hatta yatabayyana lahum annahu alhaqqu awalam yakfi birabbika annahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

t: Surely, they are in doubt about the meeting with their Lord. Surely He is, of all things, encompassing.
tr: Ala innahum fee miryatin min liqai rabbihim ala innahu bikulli shayin muheetun

t: Hā, Meem.
tr: Hameem

t: ‘Ayn, Seen, Qāf.
tr: AAaynseenqaf

t: Thus has He revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and to those before you - God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Kathalika yoohee ilayka waila allatheena min qablika Allahu alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth, and He is the Most High, the Most Great.
tr: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAaliyyu alAAatheemu

t: The heavens almost break from above them, and the angels exalt [God] with praise of their Lord and ask forgiveness for those on earth. Surely, it is God who is the Forgiving, the Merciful.
tr: Takadu alssamawatu yatafattarna min fawqihinna waalmalaikatu yusabbihoona bihamdi rabbihim wayastaghfiroona liman fee alardi ala inna Allaha huwa alghafooru alrraheemu

t: And those who take as allies other than Him - God is [yet] Guardian over them; and you, [O Muhammad], are not over them a guardian.
tr: Waallatheena ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa Allahu hafeethun AAalayhim wama anta AAalayhim biwakeelin

t: And thus We have revealed to you an Arabic Qur’ān that you may warn the Mother of Cities [i.e., Makkah] and those around it and warn of the Day of Assembly, about which there is no doubt. A party will be in Paradise and a party in the Blaze.
tr: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka quranan AAarabiyyan litunthira omma alqura waman hawlaha watunthira yawma aljamAAi la rayba feehi fareequn fee aljannati wafareequn fee alssaAAeeri

t: And if God willed, He could have made them [of] one religion, but He admits whom He wills into His mercy. And the wrongdoers have not any protector or helper.
tr: Walaw shaa Allahu lajaAAalahum ommatan wahidatan walakin yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimoona ma lahum min waliyyin wala naseerin

t: Or have they taken protectors [or allies] besides him? But God - He is the Protector, and He gives life to the dead, and He is over all things competent.
tr: Ami ittakhathoo min doonihi awliyaa faAllahu huwa alwaliyyu wahuwa yuhyee almawta wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: And in anything over which you disagree - its ruling is [to be referred] to God. [Say], “That is God, my Lord; upon Him I have relied, and to Him I turn back.”
tr: Wama ikhtalaftum feehi min shayin fahukmuhu ila Allahi thalikumu Allahu rabbee AAalayhi tawakkaltu wailayhi oneebu

t: [He is the] Originator of the heavens and the earth. He has made for you from yourselves, mates, and among the cattle, mates; He multiplies you thereby. There is nothing like unto Him, and He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
tr: Fatiru alssamawati waalardi jaAAala lakum min anfusikum azwajan wamina alanAAami azwajan yathraokum feehi laysa kamithlihi shayon wahuwa alssameeAAu albaseeru

t: To Him belong the keys of the heavens and the earth. He extends provision for whom He wills and restricts [it]. Indeed He is, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Lahu maqaleedu alssamawati waalardi yabsutu alrrizqa liman yashao wayaqdiru innahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: He has ordained for you of religion what He enjoined upon Noah and that which We have revealed to you, [O Muhammad], and what We enjoined upon Abraham and Moses and Jesus - to establish the religion and not be divided therein. Difficult for those who associate others with God is that to which you invite them. God chooses for Himself whom He wills and guides to Himself whoever turns back [to Him].
tr: SharaAAa lakum mina alddeeni ma wassa bihi noohan waallathee awhayna ilayka wama wassayna bihi ibraheema wamoosa waAAeesa an aqeemoo alddeena wala tatafarraqoo feehi kabura AAala almushrikeena ma tadAAoohum ilayhi Allahu yajtabee ilayhi man yashao wayahdee ilayhi man yuneebu

t: And they did not become divided until after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. And if not for a word that preceded from your Lord [postponing the penalty] until a specified time, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, those who were granted inheritance of the Book after them are in doubt, arousing suspicion.
tr: Wama tafarraqoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika ila ajalin musamman laqudiya baynahum wainna allatheena oorithoo alkitaba min baAAdihim lafee shakkin minhu mureebin

t: So to that [religion of God] invite, [O Muhammad], Be steadfast as you are commanded and do not follow their inclinations but say, “I have believed in what God has revealed of Book [i.e., the Qur’ān], and I have been commanded to do justice among you. God is our Lord and your Lord. For us are our deeds, and for you your deeds. There is no argument between us and you. God will bring us together, and to Him is the [final] destination.”
tr: Falithalika faodAAu waistaqim kama omirta wala tattabiAA ahwaahum waqul amantu bima anzala Allahu min kitabin waomirtu liaAAdila baynakum Allahu rabbuna warabbukum lana aAAmaluna walakum aAAmalukum la hujjata baynana wabaynakumu Allahu yajmaAAu baynana wailayhi almaseeru

t: And those who argue concerning God after He has been responded to their argument is invalid with their Lord, and upon them is [His] wrath, and for them is a severe punishment.
tr: Waallatheena yuhajjoona fee Allahi min baAAdi ma istujeeba lahu hujjatuhum dahidatun AAinda rabbihim waAAalayhim ghadabun walahum AAathabun shadeedun

t: It is God who has sent down the Book in truth and [also] the balance [i.e., justice]. What will make you realise? Perhaps the Hour is near.
tr: Allahu allathee anzala alkitaba bialhaqqi waalmeezani wama yudreeka laAAalla alssaAAata qareebun

t: Those who do not believe in it seek to hasten it, but those who believe are fearful of it and know that it is the truth. Surely, those who dispute concerning the Hour are in extreme error.
tr: YastaAAjilu biha allatheena la yuminoona biha waallatheena amanoo mushfiqoona minha wayaAAlamoona annaha alhaqqu ala inna allatheena yumaroona fee alssaAAati lafee dalalin baAAeedin

t: God is Subtle [i.e., gentle] with His servants; He gives provisions to whom He wills. And He is the Powerful, the Exalted in Might.
tr: Allahu lateefun biAAibadihi yarzuqu man yashao wahuwa alqawiyyu alAAazeezu

t: Whoever desires the harvest of the Hereafter - We increase for him in his harvest [i.e., reward]. And whoever desires the harvest [i.e., benefits] of this world - We give him thereof, but there is not for him in the Hereafter any share.
tr: Man kana yureedu hartha alakhirati nazid lahu fee harthihi waman kana yureedu hartha alddunya nutihi minha wama lahu fee alakhirati min naseebin

t: Or have they partners [i.e., other deities] who have ordained for them a religion to which God has not consented? But if not for the decisive word, it would have been concluded between them. And indeed, the wrongdoers will have a painful punishment.
tr: Am lahum shurakao sharaAAoo lahum mina alddeeni ma lam yathan bihi Allahu walawla kalimatu alfasli laqudiya baynahum wainna alththalimeena lahum AAathabun aleemun

t: You will see the wrongdoers fearful of what they have earned, and it will [certainly] befall them. And those who have believed and done righteous deeds will be in lush regions of the gardens [in Paradise] having whatever they will in the presence of their Lord. That is what is the great bounty.
tr: Tara alththalimeena mushfiqeena mimma kasaboo wahuwa waqiAAun bihim waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fee rawdati aljannati lahum ma yashaoona AAinda rabbihim thalika huwa alfadlu alkabeeru

t: It is that of which God gives good tidings to His servants who believe and do righteous deeds. Say, [O Muhammad], “I do not ask you for it [i.e., this message] any payment [but] only good will through [i.e., due to] kinship.” And whoever commits a good deed - We will increase for him good therein. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Appreciative.
tr: Thalika allathee yubashshiru Allahu AAibadahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati qul la asalukum AAalayhi ajran illa almawaddata fee alqurba waman yaqtarif hasanatan nazid lahu feeha husnan inna Allaha ghafoorun shakoorun

t: Or do they say, “He has invented about God a lie”? But if God willed, He could seal over your heart. And God eliminates falsehood and establishes the truth by His words. Indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: Am yaqooloona iftara AAala Allahi kathiban fain yashai Allahu yakhtim AAala qalbika wayamhu Allahu albatila wayuhiqqu alhaqqa bikalimatihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

t: And it is He who accepts repentance from his servants and pardons misdeeds, and He knows what you do.
tr: Wahuwa allathee yaqbalu alttawbata AAan AAibadihi wayaAAfoo AAani alssayyiati wayaAAlamu ma tafAAaloona

t: And He answers [the supplication of] those who have believed and done righteous deeds and increases [for] them from His bounty. But the disbelievers will have a severe punishment.
tr: Wayastajeebu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati wayazeeduhum min fadlihi waalkafiroona lahum AAathabun shadeedun

t: And if God had extended [excessively] provision for His servants, they would have committed tyranny throughout the earth. But He sends [it] down in an amount which He wills. Indeed He is, of His servants, Acquainted and Seeing.
tr: Walaw basata Allahu alrrizqa liAAibadihi labaghaw fee alardi walakin yunazzilu biqadarin ma yashao innahu biAAibadihi khabeerun baseerun

t: And it is He who sends down the rain after they had despaired and spreads His mercy. And He is the Protector, the Praiseworthy.
tr: Wahuwa allathee yunazzilu alghaytha min baAAdi ma qanatoo wayanshuru rahmatahu wahuwa alwaliyyu alhameedu

t: And of his signs is the creation of the heavens and earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of creatures. And He, for gathering them when He wills, is competent.
tr: Wamin ayatihi khalqu alssamawati waalardi wama baththa feehima min dabbatin wahuwa AAala jamAAihim itha yashao qadeerun

t: And whatever strikes you of disaster - it is for what your hands have earned; but He pardons much.
tr: Wama asabakum min museebatin fabima kasabat aydeekum wayaAAfoo AAan katheerin

t: And you will not be able to frustrate [i.e., thwart] Him on earth. And you have not besides God any protector or helper.
tr: Wama antum bimuAAjizeena fee alardi wama lakum min dooni Allahi min waliyyin wala naseerin

t: And of His signs are the ships in the sea, like mountains.
tr: Wamin ayatihi aljawari fee albahri kaalaAAlami

t: If He willed, He could still the wind, and they would remain motionless on its surface. Indeed in that are signs for everyone patient and grateful.
tr: In yasha yuskini alrreeha fayathlalna rawakida AAala thahrihi inna fee thalika laayatin likulli sabbarin shakoorin

t: Or He could destroy them for what they earned; but He pardons much.
tr: Aw yoobiqhunna bima kasaboo wayaAAfu AAan katheerin

t: And [that is so] those who dispute concerning Our signs may know that for them there is no place of escape.
tr: WayaAAlama allatheena yujadiloona fee ayatina ma lahum min maheesin

t: So whatever thing you have been given - it is but [for] enjoyment of the worldly life. But what is with God is better and more lasting for those who have believed and upon their Lord rely
tr: Fama ooteetum min shayin famataAAu alhayati alddunya wama AAinda Allahi khayrun waabqa lillatheena amanoo waAAala rabbihim yatawakkaloona

t: And those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, and when they are angry, they forgive,
tr: Waallatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha waitha ma ghadiboo hum yaghfiroona

t: And those who have responded to their lord and established prayer and whose affair is [determined by] consultation among themselves, and from what We have provided them, they spend,
tr: Waallatheena istajaboo lirabbihim waaqamoo alssalata waamruhum shoora baynahum wamimma razaqnahum yunfiqoona

t: And those who, when tyranny strikes them, they defend themselves.
tr: Waallatheena itha asabahumu albaghyu hum yantasiroona

t: And the retribution for an evil act is an evil one like it, but whoever pardons and makes reconciliation - his reward is [due] from God. Indeed, He does not like wrongdoers.
tr: Wajazao sayyiatin sayyiatun mithluha faman AAafa waaslaha faajruhu AAala Allahi innahu la yuhibbu alththalimeena

t: And whoever defends himself after having been wronged - for they are those whom there is no way [of blaming] them.
tr: Walamani intasara baAAda thulmihi faolaika ma AAalayhim min sabeelin

t: The way [of blame] is only against the ones who wrong the people and tyrannize upon the earth without right. Those will have a painful punishment.
tr: Innama alssabeelu AAala allatheena yathlimoona alnnasa wayabghoona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi olaika lahum AAathabun aleemun

t: And whoever is patient and forgives indeed, that is of the matters [requiring] determination.
tr: Walaman sabara waghafara inna thalika lamin AAazmi alomoori

t: And he whom God sends astray - for him there is no protector beyond Him. And you will see the wrongdoers, when they see the punishment, saying, “Is there for return [to the former world] any way?”
tr: Waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min waliyyin min baAAdihi watara alththalimeena lamma raawoo alAAathaba yaqooloona hal ila maraddin min sabeelin

t: And you will see them being exposed to it [i.e., the Fire], humbled from humiliation, looking from [behind] a covert glance. And those who had believed will say, “Indeed, the [true] losers are the ones who lost themselves and their families on the Day of Resurrection. Surely, the wrongdoers are in an enduring punishment.”
tr: Watarahum yuAAradoona AAalayha khashiAAeena mina alththulli yanthuroona min tarfin khafiyyin waqala allatheena amanoo inna alkhasireena allatheena khasiroo anfusahum waahleehim yawma alqiyamati ala inna alththalimeena fee AAathabin muqeemin

t: And there will not be for them any allies to aid them other than God. And whoever God sends astray - for him there is no way.
tr: Wama kana lahum min awliyaa yansuroonahum min dooni Allahi waman yudlili Allahu fama lahu min sabeelin

t: Respond to your Lord before a Day comes from God of which there is no repelling. No refuge will you have that day, nor for you will there be any denial.
tr: Istajeeboo lirabbikum min qabli an yatiya yawmun la maradda lahu mina Allahi ma lakum min maljain yawmaithin wama lakum min nakeerin

t: But if they turn away - then We have not sent you, [O Muhammad], over them as a guardian; upon you is only [the duty to] convey clearly. And indeed, when We let the human being taste mercy from Us, he rejoices in it; but if evil afflicts him for what his hands have put forth, then indeed, the human being is ungrateful.
tr: Fain aAAradoo fama arsalnaka AAalayhim hafeethan in AAalayka illa albalaghu wainna itha athaqna alinsana minna rahmatan fariha biha wain tusibhum sayyiatun bima qaddamat aydeehim fainna alinsana kafoorun

t: To God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth; He creates what he wills. He gives to whom He wills female [children], and He gives to whom He wills males.
tr: Lillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yakhluqu ma yashao yahabu liman yashao inathan wayahabu liman yashao alththukoora

t: Or He makes them [both] males and females, and He renders whom He wills barren. Indeed, He is Knowing and Competent.
tr: Aw yuzawwijuhum thukranan wainathan wayajAAalu man yashao AAaqeeman innahu AAaleemun qadeerun

t: And it is not for any human being that God should speak to him except by revelation or from behind a partition or that He sends a messenger [i.e., angel] to reveal, by His permission, what He wills. Indeed, He is Most High and Wise.
tr: Wama kana libasharin an yukallimahu Allahu illa wahyan aw min warai hijabin aw yursila rasoolan fayoohiya biithnihi ma yashao innahu AAaliyyun hakeemun

t: And thus We have revealed to you an inspiration of Our command [i.e., the Qur’ān]. You did not know what is the Book or [what is] faith, but We have made it a light by which We guide whom We will of Our servants. And indeed, [O Muhammad], you guide to a straight path -
tr: Wakathalika awhayna ilayka roohan min amrina ma kunta tadree ma alkitabu wala aleemanu walakin jaAAalnahu nooran nahdee bihi man nashao min AAibadina wainnaka latahdee ila siratin mustaqeemin

t: The path of God, to whom belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth. Surely, to God do all affairs return.
tr: Sirati Allahi allathee lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ala ila Allahi taseeru alomooru

t: Hā, Meem.
tr: Hameem

t: By the clear Book,
tr: Waalkitabi almubeeni

t: Indeed, We have made it an Arabic Qur’ān that you might understand.
tr: Inna jaAAalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan laAAallakum taAAqiloona

t: And indeed it is, in the Mother of the Book with Us, exalted and full of wisdom.
tr: Wainnahu fee ommi alkitabi ladayna laAAaliyyun hakeemun

t: Then shall We turn the reminder away, disregarding you, because you are a transgressing people?
tr: Afanadribu AAankumu alththikra safhan an kuntum qawman musrifeena

t: And how many a prophet We sent among the former peoples,
tr: Wakam arsalna min nabiyyin fee alawwaleena

t: But there would not come to them a prophet except that they used to ridicule him.
tr: Wama yateehim min nabiyyin illa kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: And We destroyed those stronger than them in power, and the example of the former peoples has preceded.
tr: Faahlakna ashadda minhum batshan wamada mathalu alawwaleena

t: And if you should ask them, “Who has created the heavens and the earth?” they would surely say, “They were created by the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,”
tr: Walain saaltahum man khalaqa alssamawati waalarda layaqoolunna khalaqahunna alAAazeezu alAAaleemu

t: [The one] who has made for you the earth a bed and made for you upon it roads that you might be guided
tr: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wajaAAala lakum feeha subulan laAAallakum tahtadoona

t: And who sends down rain from the sky in measured amounts, and We revive thereby a dead land - thus will you be brought forth -
tr: Waallathee nazzala mina alssamai maan biqadarin faansharna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika tukhrajoona

t: And who created the species, all of them, and has made for you of ships and animals those which you mount
tr: Waallathee khalaqa alazwaja kullaha wajaAAala lakum mina alfulki waalanAAami ma tarkaboona

t: That you may settle yourselves upon their backs and then remember the favour of your Lord when you have settled upon them and say, “Exalted is He who has subjected this to us, and we could not have [otherwise] subdued it.
tr: Litastawoo AAala thuhoorihi thumma tathkuroo niAAmata rabbikum itha istawaytum AAalayhi wataqooloo subhana allathee sakhkhara lana hatha wama kunna lahu muqrineena

t: And indeed we, to our Lord, will [surely] return.”
tr: Wainna ila rabbina lamunqaliboona

t: But they have attributed to Him from His servants a portion. Indeed, the human being is clearly ungrateful.
tr: WajaAAaloo lahu min AAibadihi juzan inna alinsana lakafoorun mubeenun

t: Or has He taken, out of what He has created, daughters and chosen you for [having] sons?
tr: Ami ittakhatha mimma yakhluqu banatin waasfakum bialbaneena

t: And when one of them is given good tidings of that which he attributes to the Most Merciful in comparison [i.e., a daughter], his face becomes dark, and he suppresses grief.
tr: Waitha bushshira ahaduhum bima daraba lilrrahmani mathalan thalla wajhuhu muswaddan wahuwa katheemun

t: Is then the one who is brought up in adornment and is unable to give a clear account in a dispute [to be associated with God]?
tr: Awaman yunashshao fee alhilyati wahuwa fee alkhisami ghayru mubeenin

t: And they have made the angels, who are servants of the Most Merciful, females. Did they witness their creation? Their testimony will be recorded, and they will be questioned.
tr: WajaAAaloo almalaikata allatheena hum AAibadu alrrahmani inathan ashahidoo khalqahum satuktabu shahadatuhum wayusaloona

t: And they said, “If the Most Merciful had willed, we would not have worshipped them.” They have of that no knowledge. They are not but falsifying.
tr: Waqaloo law shaa alrrahmanu ma AAabadnahum ma lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yakhrusoona

t: Or have We given them a book before it [i.e., the Qur’ān] to which they are adhering?
tr: Am ataynahum kitaban min qablihi fahum bihi mustamsikoona

t: Rather, they say, “Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are in their footsteps [rightly] guided.”
tr: Bal qaloo inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muhtadoona

t: And similarly, We did not send before you any warner into a city except that its affluent said, “Indeed, we found our fathers upon a religion, and we are, in their footsteps, following.”
tr: Wakathalika ma arsalna min qablika fee qaryatin min natheerin illa qala mutrafooha inna wajadna abaana AAala ommatin wainna AAala atharihim muqtadoona

t: [Each warner] said, “Even if I brought you better guidance than that [religion] upon which you found your fathers?” They said, “Indeed we, in that with which you were sent, are disbelievers.”
tr: Qala awalaw jitukum biahda mimma wajadtum AAalayhi abaakum qaloo inna bima orsiltum bihi kafiroona

t: So we took retribution from them; then see how was the end of the deniers.
tr: Faintaqamna minhum faonthur kayfa kana AAaqibatu almukaththibeena

t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Abraham said to his father and his people, “Indeed, I am disassociated from that which you worship
tr: Waith qala ibraheemu liabeehi waqawmihi innanee baraon mimma taAAbudoona

t: Except for He who brought me into being; and indeed, He will guide me.”
tr: Illa allathee fataranee fainnahu sayahdeeni

t: And he made it a word remaining among his descendants that they might return [to it].
tr: WajaAAalaha kalimatan baqiyatan fee AAaqibihi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

t: However, I gave enjoyment to these [people of Makkah] and their fathers until there came to them the truth and a clear Messenger.
tr: Bal mattaAAtu haolai waabaahum hatta jaahumu alhaqqu warasoolun mubeenun

t: But when the truth came to them, they said, “This is magic, and indeed we are, concerning it, disbelievers.”
tr: Walamma jaahumu alhaqqu qaloo hatha sihrun wainna bihi kafiroona

t: And they said, “Why was this Qur’ān not sent down upon a great man from [one of] the two cities?”
tr: Waqaloo lawla nuzzila hatha alquranu AAala rajulin mina alqaryatayni AAatheemun

t: Do they distribute the mercy of your Lord? It is We who have apportioned among them their livelihood in the life of this world and have raised some of them above others in degrees [of rank] that they may make use of one another for service. But the mercy of your Lord is better than whatever they accumulate.
tr: Ahum yaqsimoona rahmata rabbika nahnu qasamna baynahum maAAeeshatahum fee alhayati alddunya warafaAAna baAAdahum fawqa baAAdin darajatin liyattakhitha baAAduhum baAAdan sukhriyyan warahmatu rabbika khayrun mimma yajmaAAoona

t: And if it were not that the people would become one community [of disbelievers], We would have made for those who disbelieve in the Most Merciful - for their houses - ceilings and stairways of silver upon which to mount
tr: Walawla an yakoona alnnasu ommatan wahidatan lajaAAalna liman yakfuru bialrrahmani libuyootihim suqufan min fiddatin wamaAAarija AAalayha yathharoona

t: And for their houses - doors and couches [of silver] upon which to recline
tr: Walibuyootihim abwaban wasururan AAalayha yattakioona

t: And gold ornament. But all that is not but the enjoyment of worldly life. And the Hereafter with your Lord is for the righteous.
tr: Wazukhrufan wain kullu thalika lamma mataAAu alhayati alddunya waalakhiratu AAinda rabbika lilmuttaqeena

t: And whoever turns a blind eye to the reminder of the Most Merciful - We appoint for him a devil, and he is to him a companion.
tr: Waman yaAAshu AAan thikri alrrahmani nuqayyid lahu shaytanan fahuwa lahu qareenun

t: And indeed, they prevent them from the way [of guidance] while they think that they are [rightly] guided
tr: Wainnahum layasuddoonahum AAani alssabeeli wayahsaboona annahum muhtadoona

t: Until, when he comes to Us [at Judgement], he says [to his companion], “Oh, I wish there was between me and you the distance between the east and west - how wretched a companion.”
tr: Hatta itha jaana qala ya layta baynee wabaynaka buAAda almashriqayni fabisa alqareenu

t: And never will it benefit you that Day, when you have wronged, that you are [all] sharing in the punishment.
tr: Walan yanfaAAakumu alyawma ith thalamtum annakum fee alAAathabi mushtarikoona

t: Then will you make the deaf hear, [O Muhammad], or guide the blind or he who is in clear error?
tr: Afaanta tusmiAAu alssumma aw tahdee alAAumya waman kana fee dalalin mubeenin

t: And whether [or not] We take you away [in death], indeed, We will take retribution upon them.
tr: Faimma nathhabanna bika fainna minhum muntaqimoona

t: Or whether [or not] We show you that which We have promised them, indeed, We are Perfect in Ability.
tr: Aw nuriyannaka allathee waAAadnahum fainna AAalayhim muqtadiroona

t: So adhere to that which is revealed to you. Indeed, you are on a straight path.
tr: Faistamsik biallathee oohiya ilayka innaka AAala siratin mustaqeemin

t: And indeed, it is a remembrance for you and your people, and you [all] are going to be questioned.
tr: Wainnahu lathikrun laka waliqawmika wasawfa tusaloona

t: And ask those We sent before you of Our messengers; have We made besides the Most Merciful deities to be worshipped?
tr: Waisal man arsalna min qablika min rusulina ajaAAalna min dooni alrrahmani alihatan yuAAbadoona

t: And certainly did We send Moses with Our signs to Pharaoh and his establishment, and he said, “Indeed, I am the messenger of the Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Walaqad arsalna moosa biayatina ila firAAawna wamalaihi faqala innee rasoolu rabbi alAAalameena

t: But when he brought them Our signs, at once they laughed at them.
tr: Falamma jaahum biayatina itha hum minha yadhakoona

t: And We showed them not a sign except that it was greater than its sister, and We seized them with affliction that perhaps they might return [to faith].
tr: Wama nureehim min ayatin illa hiya akbaru min okhtiha waakhathnahum bialAAathabi laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

t: And they said [to Moses], “O magician, invoke for us your Lord by what He has promised you. Indeed, we will be guided.”
tr: Waqaloo ya ayyuha alsahiru odAAu lana rabbaka bima AAahida AAindaka innana lamuhtadoona

t: But when We removed from them the affliction, at once they broke their word.
tr: Falamma kashafna AAanhumu alAAathaba itha hum yankuthoona

t: And Pharaoh called out among his people; he said, “O my people, does not the kingdom of Egypt belong to me, and these rivers flowing beneath me; then do you not see?
tr: Wanada firAAawnu fee qawmihi qala ya qawmi alaysa lee mulku misra wahathihi alanharu tajree min tahtee afala tubsiroona

t: Or am I [not] better than this one [i.e., Moses] who is insignificant and hardly makes himself clear?
tr: Am ana khayrun min hatha allathee huwa maheenun wala yakadu yubeenu

t: Then why have there not been placed upon him bracelets of gold or come with him the angels in conjunction?”
tr: Falawla olqiya AAalayhi aswiratun min thahabin aw jaa maAAahu almalaikatu muqtarineena

t: So he bluffed his people, and they obeyed him. Indeed, they were [themselves] a people defiantly disobedient [of God].
tr: Faistakhaffa qawmahu faataAAoohu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

t: And when they angered Us, We took retribution from them and drowned them all.
tr: Falamma asafoona intaqamna minhum faaghraqnahum ajmaAAeena

t: And We made them a precedent and an example for the later peoples.
tr: FajaAAalnahum salafan wamathalan lilakhireena

t: And when the son of Mary was presented as an example, immediately your people laughed aloud.
tr: Walamma duriba ibnu maryama mathalan itha qawmuka minhu yasiddoona

t: And they said, “Are your gods better, or is he?” They did not present it [i.e., the comparison] except for [mere] argument. But, [in fact], they are a people prone to dispute.
tr: Waqaloo aalihatuna khayrun am huwa ma daraboohu laka illa jadalan bal hum qawmun khasimoona

t: He [i.e., Jesus] was not but a servant upon whom We bestowed favour, and We made him an example for the Children of Israel.
tr: In huwa illa AAabdun anAAamna AAalayhi wajaAAalnahu mathalan libanee israeela

t: And if We willed, We could have made [instead] of you angels succeeding [one another] on the earth.
tr: Walaw nashao lajaAAalna minkum malaikatan fee alardi yakhlufoona

t: And indeed, he [i.e., Jesus] will be [a sign for] knowledge of the Hour, so be not in doubt of it, and follow Me. This is a straight path.
tr: Wainnahu laAAilmun lilssaAAati fala tamtarunna biha waittabiAAooni hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t: And never let Satan prevent you. Indeed, he is to you a clear enemy.
tr: Wala yasuddannakumu alshshaytanu innahu lakum AAaduwwun mubeenun

t: And when Jesus brought clear proofs, he said, “I have come to you with wisdom [i.e., prophethood] and to make clear to you some of that over which you differ, so fear God and obey me.
tr: Walamma jaa AAeesa bialbayyinati qala qad jitukum bialhikmati waliobayyina lakum baAAda allathee takhtalifoona feehi faittaqoo Allaha waateeAAooni

t: Indeed, God is my Lord and your Lord, so worship Him. This is a straight path.”
tr: Inna Allaha huwa rabbee warabbukum faoAAbudoohu hatha siratun mustaqeemun

t: But the denominations from among them differed [and separated], so woe to those who have wronged from the punishment of a painful Day.
tr: Faikhtalafa alahzabu min baynihim fawaylun lillatheena thalamoo min AAathabi yawmin aleemin

t: Are they waiting except for the Hour to come upon them suddenly while they perceive not?
tr: Hal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan wahum la yashAAuroona

t: Close friends, that Day, will be enemies to each other, except for the righteous
tr: Alakhillao yawmaithin baAAduhum libaAAdin AAaduwwun illa almuttaqeena

t: [To whom God will say], “O My servants, no fear will there be concerning you this Day, nor will you grieve,
tr: Ya AAibadi la khawfun AAalaykumu alyawma wala antum tahzanoona

t: [You] who believed in Our verses and were Muslims.
tr: Allatheena amanoo biayatina wakanoo muslimeena

t: Enter Paradise, you and your kinds, delighted.”
tr: Odkhuloo aljannata antum waazwajukum tuhbaroona

t: Circulated among them will be plates and vessels of gold. And therein is whatever the souls desire and [what] delights the eyes, and you will abide therein eternally.
tr: Yutafu AAalayhim bisihafin min thahabin waakwabin wafeeha ma tashtaheehi alanfusu watalaththu alaAAyunu waantum feeha khalidoona

t: And that is Paradise which you are made to inherit for what you used to do.
tr: Watilka aljannatu allatee oorithtumooha bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t: For you therein is much fruit from which you will eat.
tr: Lakum feeha fakihatun katheeratun minha takuloona

t: Indeed, the criminals will be in the punishment of Hell, abiding eternally.
tr: Inna almujrimeena fee AAathabi jahannama khalidoona

t: It will not be allowed to subside for them, and they, therein, are in despair.
tr: La yufattaru AAanhum wahum feehi mublisoona

t: And We did not wrong them, but it was they who were the wrongdoers.
tr: Wama thalamnahum walakin kanoo humu alththalimeena

t: And they will call, “O Mālik, let your Lord put an end to us!” He will say, “Indeed, you will remain.”
tr: Wanadaw ya maliku liyaqdi AAalayna rabbuka qala innakum makithoona

t: We had certainly brought you the truth, but most of you, to the truth, were averse.
tr: Laqad jinakum bialhaqqi walakinna aktharakum lilhaqqi karihoona

t: Or have they devised [some] affair? But indeed, We are devising [a plan].
tr: Am abramoo amran fainna mubrimoona

t: Or do they think that We hear not their secrets and their private conversations? Yes, [We do], and Our messengers [i.e., angels] are with them recording.
tr: Am yahsaboona anna la nasmaAAu sirrahum wanajwahum bala warusuluna ladayhim yaktuboona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “If the Most Merciful had a son, then I would be the first of [his] worshippers.”
tr: Qul in kana lilrrahmani waladun faana awwalu alAAabideena

t: Exalted is the Lord of the heavens and the earth, Lord of the Throne, above what they describe.
tr: Subhana rabbi alssamawati waalardi rabbi alAAarshi AAamma yasifoona

t: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised.
tr: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

t: And it is He [i.e., God] who is [the only] deity in the heaven, and on the earth [the only] deity. And He is the Wise, the Knowing.
tr: Wahuwa allathee fee alssamai ilahun wafee alardi ilahun wahuwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

t: And blessed is He to whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them and with whom is knowledge of the Hour and to whom you will be returned.
tr: Watabaraka allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma waAAindahu AAilmu alssaAAati wailayhi turjaAAoona

t: And those they invoke besides Him do not possess [power of] intercession; but only those who testify to the truth [can benefit], and they know.
tr: Wala yamliku allatheena yadAAoona min doonihi alshshafaAAata illa man shahida bialhaqqi wahum yaAAlamoona

t: And if you asked them who created them, they would surely say, “God.” So how are they deluded?
tr: Walain saaltahum man khalaqahum layaqoolunna Allahu faanna yufakoona

t: And [God acknowledges] his saying, “O my Lord, indeed these are a people who do not believe.”
tr: Waqeelihi yarabbi inna haolai qawmun la yuminoona

t: So turn aside from them and say, “Peace.” But they are going to know.
tr: Faisfah AAanhum waqul salamun fasawfa yaAAlamoona

t: “You, O People of Makkah, are wrong in thinking that the Qur’ān is being composed by Muhammad. This Book by itself bears the clear testimony that it is not the composition of a man but of God, Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Hameem

t: “You are making a wrong estimate of the worth of this Book. You think it is a calamity that has descended on you, whereas the Hour when God, out of sheer mercy, decided to send His Messenger and His Book to you was highly blessed.”
tr: Waalkitabi almubeeni

t: “You are foolishly involved in the misunderstanding that you will fight this Messenger and this Book and will win, whereas the fact is that the Messenger has been raised and the Book sent down in that particular Hour when God decides the destinies, and God’s decisions are not so weak that they may be changed to a person’s liking, nor are they based on ignorance and folly that there may be the likelihood of a mistake or error or weakness in them. They are rather the firm and unalterable decisions of the Ruler of the Universe, Who is All Hearing, All Knowing and All Wise. Therefore, they cannot be treated lightly.
tr: Inna anzalnahu fee laylatin mubarakatin inna kunna munthireena

t: “You yourselves acknowledge that God alone is the Master and Lord of the earth and heavens and of everything in the Universe and also admit that life and death are only in His power, yet you insist on making others your deities, for which the only argument you offer is that, that had been the practice since the time of your forefathers, whereas if a person has the conviction that God alone is the Master, Sustainer and Giver of life and death, he can never entertain the doubt that there can be other gods also beside Him, who can be worthy of worship. If your forefathers had committed this folly, there is no reason why you also should continue committing it blindly. As a matter of fact, their Lord too was only One God, Who is your Lord, and they also should have worshipped only Him, Whom you should worship.”
tr: Feeha yufraqu kullu amrin hakeemin

t: “The only demand of God’s Providence and Mercifulness is not this that He should feed you, but also this that He should arrange guidance for you. For this very guidance He has sent His Messenger and His Book.” After this introduction, the question of the famine that was raging in Makkah has been discussed. As already mentioned, this famine had occurred on the Prophet’s prayer, and he had prayed for it, so that when the calamity befell it would break the stubbornness of the disbelievers and then they would listen to the rebuke. It looked as if this expectation was being fulfilled to some extent, for some of the most stubborn enemies of the Truth, on account of the severity of the famine, had cried out: “O Lord, avert this torment from us and we will believe.” At this, on the one hand, the Prophet has been foretold: “These people will not learn any lesson from such calamities. When they have turned away from the Messenger, whose life, character, works and speech clearly show that he is God’s true Messenger, how will a mere famine help remove their disbelief?” On the other, the unbelievers have been addressed, so as to say: “You lie when you say that you will believe as soon as the torment is removed from you. We shall just remove it to see how sincere you are in your promise. There is a graver disaster about to fall upon you. You need a much more crushing blow: minor misfortunes cannot set you right.” In this very connection, a reference has been made a little below to Pharaoh and his people, implying that those people also had met with precisely the same trial as the chiefs of the disbelieving Quraysh are now afflicted. To them also a similar noble and honourable Messenger had come; they also had seen those express pointers and signs which clearly showed that he had been appointed by God; they also had gone on witnessing one sign after the other but they did not give up their stubbornness, till at last they made up their mind to put an end to the Messenger’s life, and they met their doom, which has since become a lesson for the people forever. After this the theme of the Hereafter has been taken up, which the disbelievers of Makkah vehemently denied. They said: “We have never seen anyone rising back to life after death. Raise our forefathers back to life, if you are true in your claim about the life hereafter.” In response to this, two arguments for the Hereafter have been presented briefly: 1. That the denial of this creed has always proved destructive for the morals. 2. That the universe is not a plaything of a thoughtless deity, but it is a wise system and no work of wisdom is ever vain or useless. Then the disbelievers’ demand to bring their forefathers back to life has been answered, thus: “This cannot be done every day to meet the demand of the individuals, but God has appointed a time when He will resurrect all mankind simultaneously and will subject them to accountability in His Court. If one has to protect oneself there, one should think about it here. For no one will be able to save himself there by his own power, nor by the power of anyone else.” In connection with this Court of God, mention has been made of the fate of those who will be declared as culprits and of the rewards of those who will be declared as successful. The discourse has been concluded with this warning: “This Qur’ān has been revealed in a simple language, in your own tongue, so that you may understand it; yet if you do not understand it and insist on seeing your evil end, you wait; Our Prophet too is waiting. Whatever is to happen, will happen at its own appointed time.” In the Name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful 1. Hā, Meem. 2. By the clear Book, 3. Indeed, We sent it down during a blessed night. Indeed, We have been warning. 4. Therein [i.e., on that night] is made distinct every precise matter - 5. [Every] matter [proceeding] from Us. Indeed, We were to send [a messenger]
tr: Amran min AAindina inna kunna mursileena

t: As mercy from your Lord. Indeed, He is the Hearing, the Knowing,
tr: Rahmatan min rabbika innahu huwa alssameeAAu alAAaleemu

t: Lord of the heavens and the earth and that between them, if you would be certain.
tr: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma in kuntum mooqineena

t: There is no deity except Him; He gives life and causes death. [He is] your Lord and the Lord of your first forefathers.
tr: La ilaha illa huwa yuhyee wayumeetu rabbukum warabbu abaikumu alawwaleena

t: But they are in doubt, amusing themselves.
tr: Bal hum fee shakkin yalAAaboona

t: Then watch for the Day when the sky will bring a visible smoke.
tr: Fairtaqib yawma tatee alssamao bidukhanin mubeenin

t: Covering the people; this is a painful torment.
tr: Yaghsha alnnasa hatha AAathabun aleemun

t: [They will say], “Our Lord, remove from us the torment; indeed, we are Believers.” Ad-Dukhān
tr: Rabbana ikshif AAanna alAAathaba inna muminoona

t: How will there be for them a reminder [at that time]? And there had come to them a clear Messenger.
tr: Anna lahumu alththikra waqad jaahum rasoolun mubeenun

t: Then they turned away from him and said, “[He was] taught [and is] a madman.”
tr: Thumma tawallaw AAanhu waqaloo muAAallamun majnoonun

t: Indeed, We will remove the torment for a little. Indeed, you [disbelievers] will return [to disbelief].
tr: Inna kashifoo alAAathabi qaleelan innakum AAaidoona

t: The Day We will strike with the greatest assault, indeed, We will take retribution.
tr: Yawma nabtishu albatshata alkubra inna muntaqimoona

t: And We had already tried before them the people of Pharaoh, and there came to them a noble messenger [i.e., Moses],
tr: Walaqad fatanna qablahum qawma firAAawna wajaahum rasoolun kareemun

t: [Saying], “Render to me the servants of God. Indeed, I am to you a trustworthy messenger,”
tr: An addoo ilayya AAibada Allahi innee lakum rasoolun ameenun

t: And [saying], “Be not haughty with God. Indeed, I have come to you with clear authority.
tr: Waan la taAAloo AAala Allahi innee ateekum bisultanin mubeenin

t: And indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord, lest you stone me.
tr: Wainnee AAuthtu birabbee warabbikum an tarjumooni

t: But if you do not believe me, then leave me alone.”
tr: Wain lam tuminoo lee faiAAtazilooni

t: And [finally] he called to his Lord that these were a criminal people.
tr: FadaAAa rabbahu anna haolai qawmun mujrimoona

t: [God said], “Then set out with My servants by night. Indeed, you are to be pursued.
tr: Faasri biAAibadee laylan innakum muttabaAAoona

t: And leave the sea in stillness. Indeed, they are an army to be drowned.”
tr: Waotruki albahra rahwan innahum jundun mughraqoona

t: How much they left behind of gardens and springs
tr: Kam tarakoo min jannatin waAAuyoonin

t: And crops and noble sites
tr: WazurooAAin wamaqamin kareemin

t: And comfort wherein they were amused.
tr: WanaAAmatin kanoo feeha fakiheena

t: Thus. And We caused to inherit it another people.
tr: Kathalika waawrathnaha qawman akhareena

t: And the heaven and earth wept not for them, nor were they reprieved.
tr: Fama bakat AAalayhimu alssamao waalardu wama kanoo munthareena

t: And We certainly saved the Children of Israel from the humiliating torment -
tr: Walaqad najjayna banee israeela mina alAAathabi almuheeni

t: From Pharaoh. Indeed, he was a haughty one among the transgressors.
tr: Min firAAawna innahu kana AAaliyan mina almusrifeena

t: And We certainly chose them by knowledge over [all] the worlds.
tr: Walaqadi ikhtarnahum AAala AAilmin AAala alAAalameena

t: And We gave them of signs that in which there was a clear trial.
tr: Waataynahum mina alayati ma feehi balaon mubeenun

t: Indeed, these [disbelievers] are saying,
tr: Inna haolai layaqooloona

t: “There is not but our first death, and we will not be resurrected.
tr: In hiya illa mawtatuna aloola wama nahnu bimunshareena

t: Then bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful.”
tr: Fatoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena

t: Are they better or the people of Tubba’ and those before them? We destroyed them, [for] indeed, they were criminals.
tr: Ahum khayrun am qawmu tubbaAAin waallatheena min qablihim ahlaknahum innahum kanoo mujrimeena

t: And We did not create the heavens and earth and that between them in play.
tr: Wama khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma laAAibeena

t: We did not create them except in truth, but most of them do not know.
tr: Ma khalaqnahuma illa bialhaqqi walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

t: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is the appointed time for them all -
tr: Inna yawma alfasli meeqatuhum ajmaAAeena

t: The Day when no relation will avail a relation at all, nor will they be helped -
tr: Yawma la yughnee mawlan AAan mawlan shayan wala hum yunsaroona

t: Except those on whom God has mercy. Indeed, He is the Exalted in Might, the Merciful.
tr: Illa man rahima Allahu innahu huwa alAAazeezu alrraheemu

t: Indeed, the tree of zaqqūm
tr: Inna shajarata alzzaqqoomi

t: Is food for the sinful.
tr: TaAAamu alatheemi

t: Like murky oil, it boils within bellies
tr: Kaalmuhli yaghlee fee albutooni

t: Like the boiling of scalding water.
tr: Kaghalyi alhameemi

t: [It will be commanded], “Seize him and drag him into the midst of the Hellfire,
tr: Khuthoohu faiAAtiloohu ila sawai aljaheemi

t: Then pour over his head from the torment of scalding water.”
tr: Thumma subboo fawqa rasihi min AAathabi alhameemi

t: [It will be said], “Taste! Indeed, you are the honoured, the noble!
tr: Thuq innaka anta alAAazeezu alkareemu

t: Indeed, this is what you used to dispute.”
tr: Inna hatha ma kuntum bihi tamtaroona

t: Indeed, the righteous will be in a secure place:
tr: Inna almuttaqeena fee maqamin ameenin

t: Within gardens and springs,
tr: Fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

t: Wearing [garments of] fine silk and brocade, facing each other.
tr: Yalbasoona min sundusin waistabraqin mutaqabileena

t: Thus. And We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
tr: Kathalika wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

t: They will call therein for every [kind of] fruit - safe and secure.
tr: YadAAoona feeha bikulli fakihatin amineena

t: They will not taste death therein except the first death, and He will have protected them from the punishment of Hellfire
tr: La yathooqoona feeha almawta illa almawtata aloola wawaqahum AAathaba aljaheemi

t: As bounty from your Lord. That is what is the great attainment.
tr: Fadlan min rabbika thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

t: And indeed, We have eased it [i.e., the Qur’ān] in your tongue that they might be reminded.
tr: Fainnama yassarnahu bilisanika laAAallahum yatathakkaroona

t: So watch, [O Muhammad]; indeed, they are watching [for your end].
tr: Fairtaqib innahum murtaqiboona

t: Hā, Meem.
tr: Hameem

t: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

t: Indeed, within the heavens and earth are signs for the Believers.
tr: Inna fee alssamawati waalardi laayatin lilmumineena

t: And in the creation of yourselves and what He disperses of moving creatures are signs for people who are certain [in faith].
tr: Wafee khalqikum wama yabuththu min dabbatin ayatun liqawmin yooqinoona

t: And [in] the alternation of night and day and [in] what God sends down from the sky of provision [i.e., rain] and gives life thereby to the earth after its lifelessness and [in His] directing of the winds are signs for a people who reason.
tr: Waikhtilafi allayli waalnnahari wama anzala Allahu mina alssamai min rizqin faahya bihi alarda baAAda mawtiha watasreefi alrriyahi ayatun liqawmin yaAAqiloona

t: These are the verses of God which We recite to you in truth. Then in what statement after God and His verses will they believe?
tr: Tilka ayatu Allahi natlooha AAalayka bialhaqqi fabiayyi hadeethin baAAda Allahi waayatihi yuminoona

t: Woe to every sinful liar
tr: Waylun likulli affakin atheemin

t: Who hears the verses of God recited to him, then persists arrogantly as if he had not heard them. So give him tidings of a painful punishment.
tr: YasmaAAu ayati Allahi tutla AAalayhi thumma yusirru mustakbiran kaan lam yasmaAAha fabashshirhu biAAathabin aleemin

t: And when he knows anything of Our verses, he takes them in ridicule. Those will have a humiliating punishment.
tr: Waitha AAalima min ayatina shayan ittakhathaha huzuwan olaika lahum AAathabun muheenun

t: Before them is Hell, and what they had earned will not avail them at all nor allies. And they will have a great punishment.
tr: Min waraihim jahannamu wala yughnee AAanhum ma kasaboo shayan wala ma ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi awliyaa walahum AAathabun AAatheemun

t: This [Qur’ān] is guidance. And those who have disbelieved in the verses of their Lord will have a painful punishment of foul nature.
tr: Hatha hudan waallatheena kafaroo biayati rabbihim lahum AAathabun min rijzin aleemin

t: It is God who subjected to you the sea so that ships may sail upon it by His command and that you may seek of His bounty; and perhaps you will be grateful.
tr: Allahu allathee sakhkhara lakumu albahra litajriya alfulku feehi biamrihi walitabtaghoo min fadlihi walaAAallakum tashkuroona

t: And He has subjected to you whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth - all from Him. Indeed in that are signs for a people who give thought.
tr: Wasakhkhara lakum ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi jameeAAan minhu inna fee thalika laayatin liqawmin yatafakkaroona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], to those who have believed that they [should] forgive those who expect not the days of God [i.e., of His retribution] so that He may recompense a people for what they used to earn.
tr: Qul lillatheena amanoo yaghfiroo lillatheena la yarjoona ayyama Allahi liyajziya qawman bima kanoo yaksiboona

t: Whoever does a good deed - it is for himself; and whoever does evil - it is against it [i.e., the self or soul]. Then to your Lord you will be returned.
tr: Man AAamila salihan falinafsihi waman asaa faAAalayha thumma ila rabbikum turjaAAoona

t: And We did certainly give the Children of Israel the Book and judgement and prophethood, and We provided them with good things and preferred them over the worlds.
tr: Walaqad atayna banee israeela alkitaba waalhukma waalnnubuwwata warazaqnahum mina alttayyibati wafaddalnahum AAala alAAalameena

t: And We gave them clear proofs of the matter [of religion]. And they did not differ except after knowledge had come to them - out of jealous animosity between themselves. Indeed, your Lord will judge between them on the Day of Resurrection concerning that over which they used to differ.
tr: Waataynahum bayyinatin mina alamri fama ikhtalafoo illa min baAAdi ma jaahumu alAAilmu baghyan baynahum inna rabbaka yaqdee baynahum yawma alqiyamati feema kanoo feehi yakhtalifoona

t: Then We put you, [O Muhammad], on an ordained way concerning the matter [of religion]; so follow it and do not follow the inclinations of those who do not know.
tr: Thumma jaAAalnaka AAala shareeAAatin mina alamri faittabiAAha wala tattabiAA ahwaa allatheena la yaAAlamoona

t: Indeed, they will never avail you against God at all. And indeed, the wrongdoers are allies of one another; but God is the protector of the righteous.
tr: Innahum lan yughnoo AAanka mina Allahi shayan wainna alththalimeena baAAduhum awliyao baAAdin waAllahu waliyyu almuttaqeena

t: This [Qur’ān] is enlightenment for mankind and guidance and mercy for a people who are certain [in faith].
tr: Hatha basairu lilnnasi wahudan warahmatun liqawmin yooqinoona

t: Or do those who commit evils think We will make them like those who have believed and done righteous deeds - [make them] equal in their life and their death? Evil is that which they judge [i.e., assume].
tr: Am hasiba allatheena ijtarahoo alssayyiati an najAAalahum kaallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati sawaan mahyahum wamamatuhum saa ma yahkumoona

t: And God created the heavens and earth in truth and so that every soul may be recompensed for what it has earned, and they will not be wronged.
tr: Wakhalaqa Allahu alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi walitujza kullu nafsin bima kasabat wahum la yuthlamoona

t: Have you seen he who has taken as his god his [own] desire, and God has sent him astray due to knowledge and has set a seal upon his hearing and his heart and put over his vision a veil? So who will guide him after God? Then will you not be reminded?
tr: Afaraayta mani ittakhatha ilahahu hawahu waadallahu Allahu AAala AAilmin wakhatama AAala samAAihi waqalbihi wajaAAala AAala basarihi ghishawatan faman yahdeehi min baAAdi Allahi afala tathakkaroona

t: And they say, “There is not but our worldly life; we die and live, and nothing destroys us except time.” And they have of that no knowledge; they are only assuming.
