tr: Waqaloo ma hiya illa hayatuna alddunya namootu wanahya wama yuhlikuna illa alddahru wama lahum bithalika min AAilmin in hum illa yathunnoona

t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, their argument is only that they say, “Bring [back] our forefathers, if you should be truthful.”
tr: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin ma kana hujjatahum illa an qaloo itoo biabaina in kuntum sadiqeena

t: Say, “God causes you to live, then causes you to die; then He will assemble you for the Day of Resurrection, about which there is no doubt, but most of the people do not know.”
tr: Quli Allahu yuhyeekum thumma yumeetukum thumma yajmaAAukum ila yawmi alqiyamati la rayba feehi walakinna akthara alnnasi la yaAAlamoona

t: And to God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And the Day the Hour appears - that Day the falsifiers will lose.
tr: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi wayawma taqoomu alssaAAatu yawmaithin yakhsaru almubtiloona

t: And you will see every nation kneeling [from fear]. Every nation will be called to its record [and told], “Today you will be recompensed for what you used to do.
tr: Watara kulla ommatin jathiyatan kullu ommatin tudAAa ila kitabiha alyawma tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: This, Our record, speaks about you in truth. Indeed, We were having transcribed whatever you used to do.”
tr: Hatha kitabuna yantiqu AAalaykum bialhaqqi inna kunna nastansikhu ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: So as for those who believed and did righteous deeds, their Lord will admit them into His mercy. That is what is the clear attainment.
tr: Faamma allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati fayudkhiluhum rabbuhum fee rahmatihi thalika huwa alfawzu almubeenu

t: But as for those who disbelieved, [it will be said], “Were not Our verses recited to you, but you were arrogant and became a people of criminals?
tr: Waamma allatheena kafaroo afalam takun ayatee tutla AAalaykum faistakbartum wakuntum qawman mujrimeena

t: And when it was said, ‘Indeed, the promise of God is true and the Hour [is coming] - no doubt about it,’ you said, ‘We know not what is the Hour. We assume only assumption, and we are not convinced.’ ”
tr: Waitha qeela inna waAAda Allahi haqqun waalssaAAatu la rayba feeha qultum ma nadree ma alssaAAatu in nathunnu illa thannan wama nahnu bimustayqineena

t: And the evil consequences of what they did will appear to them, and they will be enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Wabada lahum sayyiatu ma AAamiloo wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: And it will be said, "Today We will forget you as you forgot the meeting of this Day of yours, and your refuge is the Fire, and for you there are no helpers.
tr: Waqeela alyawma nansakum kama naseetum liqaa yawmikum hatha wamawakumu alnnaru wama lakum min nasireena

t: That is because you took the verses of God in ridicule, and worldly life deluded you.” So that Day they will not be removed from it, nor will they be asked to appease [God].
tr: Thalikum biannakumu ittakhathtum ayati Allahi huzuwan wagharratkumu alhayatu alddunya faalyawma la yukhrajoona minha wala hum yustaAAtaboona

t: Then, to God belongs all praise - Lord of the heavens and Lord of the earth, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Falillahi alhamdu rabbi alssamawati warabbi alardi rabbi alAAalameena

t: And to Him belongs [all] grandeur within the heavens and the earth, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Walahu alkibriyao fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: Hā, Meem.
tr: Hameem

t: The revelation of the Book is from God, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Tanzeelu alkitabi mina Allahi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

t: We did not create the heavens and earth and what is between them except in truth and [for] a specified term. But those who disbelieve, from that of which they are warned, are turning away.
tr: Ma khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma illa bialhaqqi waajalin musamman waallatheena kafaroo AAamma onthiroo muAAridoona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Have you considered that which you invoke besides God? Show me what they have created of the earth; or did they have partnership in [creation of] the heavens? Bring me a Book [revealed] before this or a [remaining] trace of knowledge, if you should be truthful.”
tr: Qul araaytum ma tadAAoona min dooni Allahi aroonee matha khalaqoo mina alardi am lahum shirkun fee alssamawati eetoonee bikitabin min qabli hatha aw atharatin min AAilmin in kuntum sadiqeena

t: And who is more astray than he who invokes besides God those who will not respond to him until the Day of Resurrection [i.e., never], and they, of their invocation, are unaware.
tr: Waman adallu mimman yadAAoo min dooni Allahi man la yastajeebu lahu ila yawmi alqiyamati wahum AAan duAAaihim ghafiloona

t: And when the people are gathered [that Day], they [who were invoked] will be enemies to them, and they will be deniers of their worship.
tr: Waitha hushira alnnasu kanoo lahum aAAdaan wakanoo biAAibadatihim kafireena

t: And when Our verses are recited to them as clear evidences, those who disbelieve say of the truth when it has come to them, “This is obvious magic.”
tr: Waitha tutla AAalayhim ayatuna bayyinatin qala allatheena kafaroo lilhaqqi lamma jaahum hatha sihrun mubeenun

t: Or do they say, “He has invented it”? Say, “If I have invented it, you will not possess for me [the power of protection] from God at all. He is most knowing of that in which you are involved. Sufficient is He as Witness between me and you, and He is the Forgiving the Merciful.”
tr: Am yaqooloona iftarahu qul ini iftaraytuhu fala tamlikoona lee mina Allahi shayan huwa aAAlamu bima tufeedoona feehi kafa bihi shaheedan baynee wabaynakum wahuwa alghafooru alrraheemu

t: Say, “I am not unprecedented among the messengers, nor do I know what will be done with me or with you. I only follow that which is revealed to me, and I am not but a clear warner.”
tr: Qul ma kuntu bidAAan mina alrrusuli wama adree ma yufAAalu bee wala bikum in attabiAAu illa ma yooha ilayya wama ana illa natheerun mubeenun

t: Say, “Have you considered: if it [i.e., the Qur’ān] was from God, and you disbelieved in it while a witness from the Children of Israel has testified to something similar and believed while you were arrogant...?" Indeed, God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
tr: Qul araaytum in kana min AAindi Allahi wakafartum bihi washahida shahidun min banee israeela AAala mithlihi faamana waistakbartum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena

t: And those who disbelieve say of those who believe, “If it had [truly] been good, they would not have preceded us to it.” And when they are not guided by it, they will say, “This is an ancient fabrication.”
tr: Waqala allatheena kafaroo lillatheena amanoo law kana khayran ma sabaqoona ilayhi waith lam yahtadoo bihi fasayaqooloona hatha ifkun qadeemun

t: And before it was the Book of Moses to lead and as a mercy. And this is a Book confirming it in the Arabic tongue to warn those who have wronged and as good tidings to those who strive for excellence.
tr: Wamin qablihi kitabu moosa imaman warahmatan wahatha kitabun musaddiqun lisanan AAarabiyyan liyunthira allatheena thalamoo wabushra lilmuhsineena

t: Indeed, those who have said, “Our Lord is God,” and then remained steadfast on a right course - there will be no fear concerning them, nor will they grieve.
tr: Inna allatheena qaloo rabbuna Allahu thumma istaqamoo fala khawfun AAalayhim wala hum yahzanoona

t: Those are the companions of Paradise, abiding eternally therein as reward for what they used to do.
tr: Olaika ashabu aljannati khalideena feeha jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: And We have enjoined upon the human being, regarding his parents the best [treatment]. His mother carried him with hardship and gave birth to him with hardship, and his gestation and weaning [period] is thirty months. [He grows] until, when he reaches maturity and reaches [the age of] forty years, he says, “My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favour which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to work righteousness of which You will approve and make righteous for me my offspring. Indeed, I have repented to You, and indeed, I am of the Muslims.”
tr: Wawassayna alinsana biwalidayhi ihsanan hamalathu ommuhu kurhan wawadaAAathu kurhan wahamluhu wafisaluhu thalathoona shahran hatta itha balagha ashuddahu wabalagha arbaAAeena sanatan qala rabbi awziAAnee an ashkura niAAmataka allatee anAAamta AAalayya waAAala walidayya waan aAAmala salihan tardahu waaslih lee fee thurriyyatee innee tubtu ilayka wainnee mina almuslimeena

t: Those are the ones from whom We will accept the best of what they did and overlook their misdeeds, [their being] among the companions of Paradise. [That is] the promise of truth which they had been promised.
tr: Olaika allatheena nataqabbalu AAanhum ahsana ma AAamiloo wanatajawazu AAan sayyiatihim fee ashabi aljannati waAAda alssidqi allathee kanoo yooAAadoona

t: But one who says to his parents, “uff to you; do you promise me that I will be brought forth [from the earth] when generations before me have already passed on [into oblivion]?” while they call to God for help [and to their son], “Woe to you! Believe! Indeed, the promise of God is true.” But he says, “This is not but legends of the former peoples” -
tr: Waallathee qala liwalidayhi offin lakuma ataAAidaninee an okhraja waqad khalati alquroonu min qablee wahuma yastagheethani Allaha waylaka amin inna waAAda Allahi haqqun fayaqoolu ma hatha illa asateeru alawwaleena

t: Those are the ones upon whom the word [i.e., decree] has come into effect, [who will be] among nations which had passed on before them of jinn and men. Indeed, they [all] were losers.
tr: Olaika allatheena haqqa AAalayhimu alqawlu fee umamin qad khalat min qablihim mina aljinni waalinsi innahum kanoo khasireena

t: And for all there are degrees [of reward and punishment] for what they have done, and [it is] so that He may fully compensate them for their deeds, and they will not be wronged.
tr: Walikullin darajatun mimma AAamiloo waliyuwaffiyahum aAAmalahum wahum la yuthlamoona

t: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], “You exhausted your pleasures during your worldly life and enjoyed them, so this Day you will be awarded the punishment of [extreme] humiliation because you were arrogant upon the earth without right and because you were defiantly disobedient.”
tr: Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari athhabtum tayyibatikum fee hayatikumu alddunya waistamtaAAtum biha faalyawma tujzawna AAathaba alhooni bima kuntum tastakbiroona fee alardi bighayri alhaqqi wabima kuntum tafsuqoona

t: And mention, [O Muhammad], the brother of ‘Aad, when he warned his people in [the region of] al-Ahqāf - and warners had already passed on before him and after him - [saying], “Do not worship except God. Indeed, I fear for you the punishment of a terrible day.”
tr: Waothkur akha AAadin ith anthara qawmahu bialahqafi waqad khalati alnnuthuru min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi alla taAAbudoo illa Allaha innee akhafu AAalaykum AAathaba yawmin AAatheemin

t: They said, “Have you come to delude us away from our gods? Then bring us what you promise us, if you should be of the truthful.”
tr: Qaloo ajitana litafikana AAan alihatina fatina bima taAAiduna in kunta mina alssadiqeena

t: He said, “Knowledge [of its time] is only with God, and I convey to you that with which I was sent; but I see you [to be] a people behaving ignorantly.”
tr: Qala innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi waoballighukum ma orsiltu bihi walakinnee arakum qawman tajhaloona

t: And when they saw it as a cloud approaching their valleys, they said, “This is a cloud bringing us rain!” Rather, it is that for which you sought to hasten: a wind, within it a painful punishment,
tr: Falamma raawhu AAaridan mustaqbila awdiyatihim qaloo hatha AAaridun mumtiruna bal huwa ma istaAAjaltum bihi reehun feeha AAathabun aleemun

t: Destroying everything by command of its Lord. And they became so that nothing was seen [of them] except their dwellings. Thus do We recompense the criminal people.
tr: Tudammiru kulla shayin biamri rabbiha faasbahoo la yura illa masakinuhum kathalika najzee alqawma almujrimeena

t: And We had certainly established them in such as We have not established you, and We made for them hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]. But their hearing and vision and hearts availed them not from anything [of the punishment] when they were [continually] rejecting the signs of God; and they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Walaqad makkannahum feema in makkannakum feehi wajaAAalna lahum samAAan waabsaran waafidatan fama aghna AAanhum samAAuhum wala absaruhum wala afidatuhum min shayin ith kanoo yajhadoona biayati Allahi wahaqa bihim ma kanoo bihi yastahzioona

t: And We have already destroyed what surrounds you of [those] cities, and We have diversified the signs [or verses] that perhaps they might return [from disbelief].
tr: Walaqad ahlakna ma hawlakum mina alqura wasarrafna alayati laAAallahum yarjiAAoona

t: Then why did those they took besides God as deities by which to approach [Him] not aid them? But they had strayed [i.e., departed] from them. And that was their falsehood and what they were inventing.
tr: Falawla nasarahumu allatheena ittakhathoo min dooni Allahi qurbanan alihatan bal dalloo AAanhum wathalika ifkuhum wama kanoo yaftaroona

t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when We directed to you a few of the jinn, listening to the Qur’ān. And when they attended it, they said, “Listen quietly.” And when it was concluded, they went back to their people as warners.
tr: Waith sarafna ilayka nafaran mina aljinni yastamiAAoona alqurana falamma hadaroohu qaloo ansitoo falamma qudiya wallaw ila qawmihim munthireena

t: They said, “O our people, indeed we have heard a [recited] Book revealed after Moses confirming what was before it which guides to the truth and to a straight path.
tr: Qaloo ya qawmana inna samiAAna kitaban onzila min baAAdi moosa musaddiqan lima bayna yadayhi yahdee ila alhaqqi waila tareeqin mustaqeemin

t: O our people, respond to the Caller [i.e., Messenger] of God and believe in him; He [i.e., God] will forgive for you your sins and protect you from a painful punishment.
tr: Ya qawmana ajeeboo daAAiya Allahi waaminoo bihi yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayujirkum min AAathabin aleemin

t: But he who does not respond to the Caller of God cannot frustrate [His Plan] on earth, and he will not have besides Him any protectors. Those are in manifest error.”
tr: Waman la yujib daAAiya Allahi falaysa bimuAAjizin fee alardi walaysa lahu min doonihi awliyaa olaika fee dalalin mubeenin

t: Do they not see that God, who created the heavens and earth and did not fail in their creation, is able to give life to the dead? Yes. Indeed, He is over all things competent.
tr: Awalam yaraw anna Allaha allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda walam yaAAya bikhalqihinna biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta bala innahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: And the Day those who disbelieved are exposed to the Fire [it will be said], “Is this not the truth?” They will say, “Yes, by our Lord.” He will say, “Then taste the punishment because you used to disbelieve.”
tr: Wayawma yuAAradu allatheena kafaroo AAala alnnari alaysa hatha bialhaqqi qaloo bala warabbina qala fathooqoo alAAathaba bima kuntum takfuroona

t: So be patient, [O Muhammad], as were those of determination among the messengers and do not seek to hasten for them. It will be - on the Day they see that which they are promised - as though they had not remained [in the world] except an hour of a day. [This is] notification. And will [any] be destroyed except the defiantly disobedient people?
tr: Faisbir kama sabara oloo alAAazmi mina alrrusuli wala tastaAAjil lahum kaannahum yawma yarawna ma yooAAadoona lam yalbathoo illa saAAatan min naharin balaghun fahal yuhlaku illa alqawmu alfasiqoona

t: Those who disbelieve and prevent [people] from the way of God - He will make their actions go astray.
tr: Allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi adalla aAAmalahum

t: And those who believe and do righteous deeds and believe in what has been sent down upon Muhammad - and it is the truth from their Lord - He will remove from them their misdeeds and amend their condition.
tr: Waallatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati waamanoo bima nuzzila AAala muhammadin wahuwa alhaqqu min rabbihim kaffara AAanhum sayyiatihim waaslaha balahum

t: That is because those who disbelieve follow falsehood, and those who believe follow the truth from their Lord. Thus does God present to the people their comparisons.
tr: Thalika bianna allatheena kafaroo ittabaAAoo albatila waanna allatheena amanoo ittabaAAoo alhaqqa min rabbihim kathalika yadribu Allahu lilnnasi amthalahum

t: So when you meet those who disbelieve [in battle], strike [their] necks until, when you have inflicted slaughter upon them, then secure their bonds, and either [confer] favour afterwards or ransom [them] until the war lays down its burdens. That [is the command]. And if God had willed, He could have taken vengeance upon them [Himself], but [He ordered armed struggle] to test some of you by means of others. And those who are killed in the cause of God - never will He waste their deeds.
tr: Faitha laqeetumu allatheena kafaroo fadarba alrriqabi hatta itha athkhantumoohum fashuddoo alwathaqa faimma mannan baAAdu waimma fidaan hatta tadaAAa alharbu awzaraha thalika walaw yashao Allahu laintasara minhum walakin liyabluwa baAAdakum bibaAAdin waallatheena qutiloo fee sabeeli Allahi falan yudilla aAAmalahum

t: He will guide them and amend their condition
tr: Sayahdeehim wayuslihu balahum

t: And admit them to Paradise, which He has made known to them.
tr: Wayudkhiluhumu aljannata AAarrafaha lahum

t: O you who have believed, if you support God, He will support you and plant firmly your feet.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in tansuroo Allaha yansurkum wayuthabbit aqdamakum

t: But those who disbelieve - for them is misery, and He will make their actions go astray.
tr: Waallatheena kafaroo fataAAsan lahum waadalla aAAmalahum

t: That is because they disliked what God revealed, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
tr: Thalika biannahum karihoo ma anzala Allahu faahbata aAAmalahum

t: Have they not travelled through the land and seen how was the end of those before them? God destroyed [everything] over them, and for the disbelievers is something comparable.
tr: Afalam yaseeroo fee alardi fayanthuroo kayfa kana AAaqibatu allatheena min qablihim dammara Allahu AAalayhim walilkafireena amthaluha

t: That is because God is the protector of those who have believed and because the disbelievers have no protector.
tr: Thalika bianna Allaha mawla allatheena amanoo waanna alkafireena la mawla lahum

t: Indeed, God will admit those who have believed and done righteous deeds to gardens beneath which rivers flow, but those who disbelieve enjoy themselves and eat as grazing livestock eat, and the Fire will be a residence for them.
tr: Inna Allaha yudkhilu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waallatheena kafaroo yatamattaAAoona wayakuloona kama takulu alanAAamu waalnnaru mathwan lahum

t: And how many a city was stronger than your city [i.e., Makkah] which drove you out? We destroyed them; and there was no helper for them.
tr: Wakaayyin min qaryatin hiya ashaddu quwwatan min qaryatika allatee akhrajatka ahlaknahum fala nasira lahum

t: So is he who is on clear evidence from his Lord like him to whom the evil of his work has been made attractive and they follow their [own] desires?
tr: Afaman kana AAala bayyinatin min rabbihi kaman zuyyina lahu sooo AAamalihi waittabaAAoo ahwaahum

t: Is the description of Paradise, which the righteous are promised, wherein are rivers of water unaltered, rivers of milk the taste of which never changes, rivers of wine delicious to those who drink, and rivers of purified honey, in which they will have from all [kinds of] fruits and forgiveness from their Lord, like [that of] those who abide eternally in the Fire and are given to drink scalding water that will sever their intestines?
tr: Mathalu aljannati allatee wuAAida almuttaqoona feeha anharun min main ghayri asinin waanharun min labanin lam yataghayyar taAAmuhu waanharun min khamrin laththatin lilshsharibeena waanharun min AAasalin musaffan walahum feeha min kulli alththamarati wamaghfiratun min rabbihim kaman huwa khalidun fee alnnari wasuqoo maan hameeman faqattaAAa amAAaahum

t: And among them, [O Muhammad], are those who listen to you, until when they depart from you, they say to those who were given knowledge, “What has he said just now?” Those are the ones of whom God has sealed over their hearts and who have followed their [own] desires.
tr: Waminhum man yastamiAAu ilayka hatta itha kharajoo min AAindika qaloo lillatheena ootoo alAAilma matha qala anifan olaika allatheena tabaAAa Allahu AAala quloobihim waittabaAAoo ahwaahum

t: And those who are guided - He increases them in guidance and gives them their righteousness.
tr: Waallatheena ihtadaw zadahum hudan waatahum taqwahum

t: Then do they await except that the Hour should come upon them unexpectedly? But already there have come [some of] its indications. Then how [i.e., what good] to them, when it has come, will be their remembrance?
tr: Fahal yanthuroona illa alssaAAata an tatiyahum baghtatan faqad jaa ashratuha faanna lahum itha jaathum thikrahum

t: So know, [O Muhammad], that there is no deity except God and ask forgiveness for your sin and for the believing men and believing women. And God knows of your movement and your resting place.
tr: FaiAAlam annahu la ilaha illa Allahu waistaghfir lithanbika walilmumineena waalmuminati waAllahu yaAAlamu mutaqallabakum wamathwakum

t: Those who believe say, “Why has a sūrah not been sent down?” But when a precise sūrah is revealed and fighting is mentioned therein, you see those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] looking at you with a look of one overcome by death. And more appropriate for them [would have been]
tr: Wayaqoolu allatheena amanoo lawla nuzzilat sooratun faitha onzilat sooratun muhkamatun wathukira feeha alqitalu raayta allatheena fee quloobihim maradun yanthuroona ilayka nathara almaghshiyyi AAalayhi mina almawti faawla lahum

t: Obedience and good words. And when the matter [of fighting] was determined, if they had been true to God, it would have been better for them.
tr: TaAAatun waqawlun maAAroofun faitha AAazama alamru falaw sadaqoo Allaha lakana khayran lahum

t: So would you perhaps, if you turned away, cause corruption on earth and sever your [ties of] relationship?
tr: Fahal AAasaytum in tawallaytum an tufsidoo fee alardi watuqattiAAoo arhamakum

t: Those [who do so] are the ones that God has cursed, so He deafened them and blinded their vision.
tr: Olaika allatheena laAAanahumu Allahu faasammahum waaAAma absarahum

t: Then do they not reflect upon the Qur’ān, or are there locks upon [their] hearts?
tr: Afala yatadabbaroona alqurana am AAala quloobin aqfaluha

t: Indeed, those who reverted back [to disbelief] after guidance had become clear to them - Satan enticed them and prolonged hope for them.
tr: Inna allatheena irtaddoo AAala adbarihim min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda alshshaytanu sawwala lahum waamla lahum

t: That is because they said to those who disliked what God sent down, “We will obey you in part of the matter.” And God knows what they conceal.
tr: Thalika biannahum qaloo lillatheena karihoo ma nazzala Allahu sanuteeAAukum fee baAAdi alamri waAllahu yaAAlamu israrahum

t: Then how [will it be] when the angels take them in death, striking their faces and their backs?
tr: Fakayfa itha tawaffathumu almalaikatu yadriboona wujoohahum waadbarahum

t: That is because they followed what angered God and disliked [what earns] His pleasure, so He rendered worthless their deeds.
tr: Thalika biannahumu ittabaAAoo ma askhata Allaha wakarihoo ridwanahu faahbata aAAmalahum

t: Or do those in whose hearts is disease think that God would never expose their [feelings of] hatred?
tr: Am hasiba allatheena fee quloobihim maradun an lan yukhrija Allahu adghanahum

t: And if We willed, We could show them to you, and you would know them by their mark; but you will surely know them by the tone of [their] speech. And God knows your deeds.
tr: Walaw nashao laaraynakahum falaAAaraftahum biseemahum walataAArifannahum fee lahni alqawli waAllahu yaAAlamu aAAmalakum

t: And We will surely test you until We make evident those who strive among you [for the cause of God] and the patient, and We will test your affairs.
tr: Walanabluwannakum hatta naAAlama almujahideena minkum waalssabireena wanabluwa akhbarakum

t: Indeed, those who disbelieved and prevented [people] from the path of God and opposed the Messenger after guidance had become clear to them never will they harm God at all, and He will render worthless their deeds.
tr: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi washaqqoo alrrasoola min baAAdi ma tabayyana lahumu alhuda lan yaduroo Allaha shayan wasayuhbitu aAAmalahum

t: O you who have believed, obey God and obey the Messenger and do not invalidate your deeds.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola wala tubtiloo aAAmalakum

t: Indeed, those who disbelieved and prevented [people] from the path of God and then died while they were disbelievers - never will God forgive them.
tr: Inna allatheena kafaroo wasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi thumma matoo wahum kuffarun falan yaghfira Allahu lahum

t: So do not weaken and call for peace while you are superior; and God is with you and will never deprive you of [the reward of] your deeds.
tr: Fala tahinoo watadAAoo ila alssalmi waantumu alaAAlawna waAllahu maAAakum walan yatirakum aAAmalakum

t: [This] worldly life is only amusement and diversion. And if you believe and fear God, He will give you your rewards and not ask you for your properties.
tr: Innama alhayatu alddunya laAAibun walahwun wain tuminoo watattaqoo yutikum ojoorakum wala yasalkum amwalakum

t: Were He to ask you of it and press you, you would withhold, and He would expose your malevolence.
tr: In yasalkumooha fayuhfikum tabkhaloo wayukhrij adghanakum

t: Here you are - those invited to spend in the cause of God - but among you are those who withhold [out of greed]. And whoever withholds only withholds [benefit] from himself; and God is the Free of need, while you are the needy. And if you turn away [i.e., refuse], He will replace you with another people; then they will not be the likes of you.
tr: Haantum haolai tudAAawna litunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi faminkum man yabkhalu waman yabkhal fainnama yabkhalu AAan nafsihi waAllahu alghaniyyu waantumu alfuqarao wain tatawallaw yastabdil qawman ghayrakum thumma la yakoonoo amthalakum

t: Indeed, We have given you, [O Muhammad], a clear conquest
tr: Inna fatahna laka fathan mubeenan

t: That God may forgive for you what preceded of your sin [i.e., errors] and what will follow and complete His favour upon you and guide you to a straight path
tr: Liyaghfira laka Allahu ma taqaddama min thanbika wama taakhkhara wayutimma niAAmatahu AAalayka wayahdiyaka siratan mustaqeeman

t: And [that] God may aid you with a mighty victory.
tr: Wayansuraka Allahu nasran AAazeezan

t: It is He who sent down tranquillity into the hearts of the Believers that they would increase in faith along with their [present] faith. And to God belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth, and ever is God Knowing and Wise.
tr: Huwa allathee anzala alssakeenata fee quloobi almumineena liyazdadoo eemanan maAAa eemanihim walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAaleeman hakeeman

t: [And] that He may admit the believing men and the believing women to gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein eternally and remove from them their misdeeds - and ever is that, in the sight of God, a great attainment -
tr: Liyudkhila almumineena waalmuminati jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wayukaffira AAanhum sayyiatihim wakana thalika AAinda Allahi fawzan AAatheeman

t: And [that] He may punish the hypocrite men and hypocrite women, and the polytheist men and polytheist women those who assume about God an assumption of evil nature. Upon them is a misfortune of evil nature; and God has become angry with them and has cursed them and prepared for them Hell, and evil it is as a destination.
tr: WayuAAaththiba almunafiqeena waalmunafiqati waalmushrikeena waalmushrikati alththanneena biAllahi thanna alssawi AAalayhim dairatu alssawi waghadiba Allahu AAalayhim walaAAanahum waaAAadda lahum jahannama wasaat maseeran

t: And to God belong the soldiers of the heavens and the earth. And ever is God Exalted in Might and Wise.
tr: Walillahi junoodu alssamawati waalardi wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman

t: Indeed, We have sent you as a witness and a bringer of good tidings and a warner
tr: Inna arsalnaka shahidan wamubashshiran wanatheeran

t: That you [people] may believe in God and His Messenger and honour him and respect him [i.e., the Prophet] and exalt Him [i.e., God] morning and afternoon.
tr: Lituminoo biAllahi warasoolihi watuAAazziroohu watuwaqqiroohu watusabbihoohu bukratan waaseelan

t: Indeed, those who pledge allegiance to you, [O Muhammad] - they are actually pledging allegiance to God. The hand of God is over their hands. So he who breaks his word only breaks it to the detriment of himself. And he who fulfills that which he has promised God - He will give him a great reward.
tr: Inna allatheena yubayiAAoonaka innama yubayiAAoona Allaha yadu Allahi fawqa aydeehim faman nakatha fainnama yankuthu AAala nafsihi waman awfa bima AAahada AAalayhu Allaha fasayuteehi ajran AAatheeman

t: Those who remained behind of the bedouins will say to you, “Our properties and our families occupied us, so ask forgiveness for us.” They say with their tongues what is not within their hearts. Say, “Then who could prevent God at all if He intended for you harm or intended for you benefit? Rather, ever is God, with what you do, Acquainted.
tr: Sayaqoolu laka almukhallafoona mina alaAArabi shaghalatna amwaluna waahloona faistaghfir lana yaqooloona bialsinatihim ma laysa fee quloobihim qul faman yamliku lakum mina Allahi shayan in arada bikum darran aw arada bikum nafAAan bal kana Allahu bima taAAmaloona khabeeran

t: But you thought that the Messenger and the believers would never return to their families, ever, and that was made pleasing in your hearts. And you assumed an assumption of evil and became a people ruined.”
tr: Bal thanantum an lan yanqaliba alrrasoolu waalmuminoona ila ahleehim abadan wazuyyina thalika fee quloobikum wathanantum thanna alssawi wakuntum qawman booran

t: And whoever has not believed in God and His Messenger - then indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers a Blaze.
tr: Waman lam yumin biAllahi warasoolihi fainna aAAtadna lilkafireena saAAeeran

t: And to God belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. He forgives whom He wills and punishes whom He wills. And ever is God Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Walillahi mulku alssamawati waalardi yaghfiru liman yashao wayuAAaththibu man yashao wakana Allahu ghafooran raheeman

t: Those who remained behind will say when you set out toward the war booty to take it, “Let us follow you.” They wish to change the words of God. Say, “Never will you follow us. Thus did God say before.” So they will say, “Rather, you envy us.” But [in fact] they were not understanding except a little.
tr: Sayaqoolu almukhallafoona itha intalaqtum ila maghanima litakhuthooha tharoona nattabiAAkum yureedoona an yubaddiloo kalama Allahi qul lan tattabiAAoona kathalikum qala Allahu min qablu fasayaqooloona bal tahsudoonana bal kanoo la yafqahoona illa qaleelan

t: Say to those who remained behind of the bedouins, “You will be called to [face] a people of great military might; you may fight them, or they will submit. So if you obey, God will give you a good reward; but if you turn away as you turned away before, He will punish you with a painful punishment.”
tr: Qul lilmukhallafeena mina alaAArabi satudAAawna ila qawmin olee basin shadeedin tuqatiloonahum aw yuslimoona fain tuteeAAoo yutikumu Allahu ajran hasanan wain tatawallaw kama tawallaytum min qablu yuAAaththibkum AAathaban aleeman

t: There is not upon the blind any guilt or upon the lame any guilt or upon the ill any guilt [for remaining behind]. And whoever obeys God and His Messenger - He will admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow; but whoever turns away - He will punish him with a painful punishment.
tr: Laysa AAala alaAAma harajun wala AAala alaAAraji harajun wala AAala almareedi harajun waman yutiAAi Allaha warasoolahu yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu waman yatawalla yuAAaththibhu AAathaban aleeman

t: Certainly was God pleased with the Believers when they pledged allegiance to you, [O Muhammad], under the tree, and He knew what was in their hearts, so He sent down tranquillity upon them and rewarded them with an imminent conquest
tr: Laqad radiya Allahu AAani almumineena ith yubayiAAoonaka tahta alshshajarati faAAalima ma fee quloobihim faanzala alsakeenata AAalayhim waathabahum fathan qareeban

t: And much war booty which they will take. And ever is God Exalted in Might and Wise.
tr: Wamaghanima katheeratan yakhuthoonaha wakana Allahu AAazeezan hakeeman

t: God has promised you much booty that you will take [in the future] and has hastened for you this [victory] and withheld the hands of people from you - that it may be a sign for the Believers and [that] He may guide you to a straight path.
tr: WaAAadakumu Allahu maghanima katheeratan takhuthoonaha faAAajjala lakum hathihi wakaffa aydiya alnnasi AAankum walitakoona ayatan lilmumineena wayahdiyakum siratan mustaqeeman

t: And [He promises] other [victories] that you were [so far] unable to [realize] which God has already encompassed. And ever is God, over all things, competent.
tr: Waokhra lam taqdiroo AAalayha qad ahata Allahu biha wakana Allahu AAala kulli shayin qadeeran

t: And if those [Makkans] who disbelieve had fought you, they would have turned their backs [in flight]. Then they would not find a protector or a helper.
tr: Walaw qatalakumu allatheena kafaroo lawallawoo aladbara thumma la yajidoona waliyyan wala naseeran

t: [This is] the established way of God which has occurred before. And never will you find in the way of God any change.
tr: Sunnata Allahi allatee qad khalat min qablu walan tajida lisunnati Allahi tabdeelan

t: And it is He who withheld their hands from you and your hands from them within [the area of] Makkah after He caused you to overcome them. And ever is God of what you do, Seeing.
tr: Wahuwa allathee kaffa aydiyahum AAankum waaydiyakum AAanhum bibatni makkata min baAAdi an athfarakum AAalayhim wakana Allahu bima taAAmaloona baseeran

t: They are the ones who disbelieved and obstructed you from al-Masjid al-Harām while the offering was prevented from reaching its place of sacrifice. And if not for believing men and believing women whom you did not know - that you might trample [i.e., kill] them and there would befall you because of them dishonour without [your] knowledge - [you would have been permitted to enter Makkah]. [This was so] that God might admit to His mercy whom He willed. If they had been apart [from them], We would have punished those who disbelieved among them with painful punishment
tr: Humu allatheena kafaroo wasaddookum AAani almasjidi alharami waalhadya maAAkoofan an yablugha mahillahu walawla rijalun muminoona wanisaon muminatun lam taAAlamoohum an tataoohum fatuseebakum minhum maAAarratun bighayri AAilmin liyudkhila Allahu fee rahmatihi man yashao law tazayyaloo laAAaththabna allatheena kafaroo minhum AAathaban aleeman

t: When those who disbelieved had put into their hearts fury - the fury of the time of ignorance. But God sent down His tranquillity upon His Messenger and upon the believers and imposed upon them the word of righteousness, and they were more deserving of it and worthy of it. And ever is God, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Ith jaAAala allatheena kafaroo fee quloobihimu alhamiyyata hamiyyata aljahiliyyati faanzala Allahu sakeenatahu AAala rasoolihi waAAala almumineena waalzamahum kalimata alttaqwa wakanoo ahaqqa biha waahlaha wakana Allahu bikulli shayin AAaleeman

t: Certainly has God showed to His Messenger the vision [i.e., dream] in truth. You will surely enter al-Masjid al- Harām, if God wills, in safety, with your heads shaved and [hair] shortened, not fearing [anyone]. He knew what you did not know and has arranged before that a conquest near [at hand].
tr: Laqad sadaqa Allahu rasoolahu alrruya bialhaqqi latadkhulunna almasjida alharama in shaa Allahu amineena muhalliqeena ruoosakum wamuqassireena la takhafoona faAAalima ma lam taAAlamoo fajaAAala min dooni thalika fathan qareeban

t: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion. And sufficient is God as Witness.
tr: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi wakafa biAllahi shaheedan

t: Muhammad is the Messenger of God; and those with him are fierce against the disbelievers, merciful among themselves. You see them bowing and prostrating [in prayer], seeking bounty from God and [His] pleasure. Their mark [i.e., sign] is on their faces [i.e., foreheads] from the trace of prostration. That is their description in the Torah. And their description in the Gospel is as a plant which produces its offshoots and strengthens them so they grow firm and stand upon their stalks, delighting the sowers - so that by them He may infuriate the disbelievers. God has promised those who believe and do righteous deeds among them forgiveness and a great reward.
tr: Muhammadun rasoolu Allahi waallatheena maAAahu ashiddao AAala alkuffari ruhamao baynahum tarahum rukkaAAan sujjadan yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan seemahum fee wujoohihim min athari alssujoodi thalika mathaluhum fee alttawrati wamathaluhum fee alinjeeli kazarAAin akhraja shatahu faazarahu faistaghlatha faistawa AAala sooqihi yuAAjibu alzzurraAAa liyagheetha bihimu alkuffara waAAada Allahu allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati minhum maghfiratan waajran AAatheeman

t: O you who have believed, do not put [yourselves] before God and His Messenger but fear God. Indeed, God is Hearing and Knowing.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tuqaddimoo bayna yadayi Allahi warasoolihi waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha sameeAAun AAaleemun

t: O you who have believed, do not raise your voices above the voice of the Prophet or be loud to him in speech like the loudness of some of you to others, lest your deeds become worthless while you perceive not.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tarfaAAoo aswatakum fawqa sawti alnnabiyyi wala tajharoo lahu bialqawli kajahri baAAdikum libaAAdin an tahbata aAAmalukum waantum la tashAAuroona

t: Indeed, those who lower their voices before the Messenger of God - they are the ones whose hearts God has tested for righteousness. For them is forgiveness and great reward.
tr: Inna allatheena yaghuddoona aswatahum AAinda rasooli Allahi olaika allatheena imtahana Allahu quloobahum lilttaqwa lahum maghfiratun waajrun AAatheemun

t: Indeed, those who call you, [O Muhammad], from behind the chambers - most of them do not use reason.
tr: Inna allatheena yunadoonaka min warai alhujurati aktharuhum la yaAAqiloona

t: And if they had been patient until you [could] come out to them, it would have been better for them. But God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Walaw annahum sabaroo hatta takhruja ilayhim lakana khayran lahum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

t: O you who have believed, if there comes to you a disobedient one with information, investigate, lest you harm a people out of ignorance and become, over what you have done, regretful.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo in jaakum fasiqun binabain fatabayyanoo an tuseeboo qawman bijahalatin fatusbihoo AAala ma faAAaltum nadimeena

t: And know that among you is the Messenger of God. If he were to obey you in much of the matter, you would be in difficulty, but God has endeared to you the faith and has made it pleasing in your hearts and has made hateful to you disbelief, defiance and disobedience. Those are the [rightly] guided.
tr: WaiAAlamoo anna feekum rasoola Allahi law yuteeAAukum fee katheerin mina alamri laAAanittum walakinna Allaha habbaba ilaykumu aleemana wazayyanahu fee quloobikum wakarraha ilaykumu alkufra waalfusooqa waalAAisyana olaika humu alrrashidoona

t: [It is] as bounty from God and favour. And God is Knowing and Wise.
tr: Fadlan mina Allahi waniAAmatan waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

t: And if two factions among the Believers should fight, then make settlement between the two. But if one of them oppresses the other, then fight against the one that oppresses until it returns to the ordinance of God. And if it returns, then make settlement between them in justice and act justly. Indeed, God loves those who act justly.
tr: Wain taifatani mina almumineena iqtataloo faaslihoo baynahuma fain baghat ihdahuma AAala alokhra faqatiloo allatee tabghee hatta tafeea ila amri Allahi fain faat faaslihoo baynahuma bialAAadli waaqsitoo inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena

t: The Believers are but brothers, so make settlement between your brothers. And fear God that you may receive mercy.
tr: Innama almuminoona ikhwatun faaslihoo bayna akhawaykum waittaqoo Allaha laAAallakum turhamoona

t: O you who have believed, let not a people ridicule [another] people; perhaps they may be better than them; nor let women ridicule [other] women; perhaps they may be better than them. And do not insult one another and do not call each other by [offensive] nicknames. Wretched is the name [i.e., mention] of disobedience after [one’s] faith. And whoever does not repent then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la yaskhar qawmun min qawmin AAasa an yakoonoo khayran minhum wala nisaon min nisain AAasa an yakunna khayran minhunna wala talmizoo anfusakum wala tanabazoo bialalqabi bisa alismu alfusooqu baAAda aleemani waman lam yatub faolaika humu alththalimoona

t: O you who have believed, avoid much [negative] assumption. Indeed, some assumption is sin. And do not spy or backbite each other. Would one of you like to eat the flesh of his brother when dead? You would detest it. And fear God; indeed, God is Accepting of repentance and Merciful.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ijtaniboo katheeran mina alththanni inna baAAda alththanni ithmun wala tajassasoo wala yaghtab baAAdukum baAAdan ayuhibbu ahadukum an yakula lahma akheehi maytan fakarihtumoohu waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha tawwabun raheemun

t: O mankind, indeed We have created you from male and female and made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another. Indeed, the most noble of you in the sight of God is the most righteous of you. Indeed, God is Knowing and Acquainted.
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnasu inna khalaqnakum min thakarin waontha wajaAAalnakum shuAAooban waqabaila litaAAarafoo inna akramakum AAinda Allahi atqakum inna Allaha AAaleemun khabeerun

t: The bedouins say, “We have believed.” Say, “You have not [yet] believed; but say [instead], ‘We have submitted,’ for faith has not yet entered your hearts. And if you obey God and His Messenger, He will not deprive you from your deeds of anything. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.”
tr: Qalati alaAArabu amanna qul lam tuminoo walakin qooloo aslamna walamma yadkhuli aleemanu fee quloobikum wain tuteeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu la yalitkum min aAAmalikum shayan inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: The Believers are only the ones who have believed in God and His Messenger and then doubt not but strive with their properties and their lives in the cause of God. It is those who are the truthful.
tr: Innama almuminoona allatheena amanoo biAllahi warasoolihi thumma lam yartaboo wajahadoo biamwalihim waanfusihim fee sabeeli Allahi olaika humu alssadiqoona

t: Say, “Do you presume to inform God of your religion while God knows whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and God is Knowing of all things?”
tr: Qul atuAAallimoona Allaha bideenikum waAllahu yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: They consider it a favour to you that they have accepted Islām. Say, “Do not consider your Islām a favour to me. Rather, God has conferred favour upon you that He has guided you to the faith, if you should be truthful.”
tr: Yamunnoona AAalayka an aslamoo qul la tamunnoo AAalayya islamakum bali Allahu yamunnu AAalaykum an hadakum lileemani in kuntum sadiqeena

t: Indeed, God knows the unseen [aspects] of the heavens and the earth. And God is Seeing of what you do.
tr: Inna Allaha yaAAlamu ghayba alssamawati waalardi waAllahu baseerun bima taAAmaloona

t: Qāf. By the honoured Qur’ān…
tr: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi

t: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, “This is an amazing thing.
tr: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun

t: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant [i.e., unlikely] return.”
tr: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun

t: We know what the earth diminishes [i.e., consumes] of them, and with Us is a retaining record.
tr: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun

t: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition.
tr: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin

t: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts?
tr: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin

t: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind,
tr: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin

t: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to God].
tr: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin

t: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest
tr: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi

t: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers –
tr: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun

t: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the emergence [i.e., resurrection].
tr: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju

t: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamūd
tr: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu

t: And ‘Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers [i.e., people] of Lot
tr: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin

t: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba’. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled.
tr: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi

t: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation.
tr: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin

t: And We have already created the human being and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein
tr: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi

t: When the two receivers [i.e., recording angels] receive, seated on the right and on the left.
tr: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun

t: He [i.e., man] does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record].
tr: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun

t: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid.
tr: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu

t: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat.
tr: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi

t: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness.
tr: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun

t: [It will be said], “You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp.”
tr: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun

t: And his companion, [the angel], will say, “This [record] is what is with me, prepared.”
tr: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun

t: [God will say], “Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever,
tr: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin

t: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter,
tr: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin

t: Who made [as equal] with God another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment.”
tr: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi

t: His [devil] companion will say, “Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error.”
tr: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin

t: [God] will say, “Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the threat [i.e., warning].
tr: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi

t: The word [i.e., decree] will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants.”
tr: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi

t: On the Day We will say to Hell, “Have you been filled?” and it will say, “Are there some more,”
tr: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin

t: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far,
tr: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin

t: [It will be said], “This is what you were promised - for every returner [to God] and keeper [of His covenant]
tr: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin

t: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance].
tr: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin

t: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity.”
tr: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi

t: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more.
tr: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun

t: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape?
tr: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin

t: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind].
tr: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun

t: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness.
tr: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin

t: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [God] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting,
tr: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi

t: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration [i.e., prayer].
tr: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi

t: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near -
tr: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin

t: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves].
tr: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji

t: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination
tr: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru

t: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us.
tr: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun

t: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them, a compeller over them. But remind by the Qur’ān whoever fears My threat.
tr: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi

t: By those [winds] scattering [dust] dispersing [it]
tr: Waalththariyati tharwan

t: And those [clouds] carrying a load [of water]
tr: Faalhamilati wiqran

t: And those [ships] sailing with ease
tr: Faaljariyati yusran

t: And those [angels] apportioning [each] matter,
tr: Faalmuqassimati amran

t: Indeed, what you are promised is true.
tr: Innama tooAAadoona lasadiqun

t: And indeed, the recompense is to occur.
tr: Wainna alddeena lawaqiAAun

t: By the heaven containing pathways,
tr: Waalssamai thati alhubuki

t: Indeed, you are in differing speech.
tr: Innakum lafee qawlin mukhtalifin

t: Deluded away from it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is he who is deluded.
tr: Yufaku AAanhu man ofika

t: Destroyed are the falsifiers
tr: Qutila alkharrasoona

t: Who are within a flood [of confusion] and heedless.
tr: Allatheena hum fee ghamratin sahoona

t: They ask, “When is the Day of Recompense?”
tr: Yasaloona ayyana yawmu alddeeni

t: [It is] the Day they will be tormented over the Fire
tr: Yawma hum AAala alnnari yuftanoona

t: [And will be told], “Taste your torment. This is that for which you sought to hasten.”
tr: Thooqoo fitnatakum hatha allathee kuntum bihi tastaAAjiloona

t: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and springs,
tr: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin waAAuyoonin

t: Accepting what their Lord has given them. Indeed, they were before that of those who strove for excellence.
tr: Akhitheena ma atahum rabbuhum innahum kanoo qabla thalika muhsineena

t: They used to sleep but little of the night,
tr: Kanoo qaleelan mina allayli ma yahjaAAoona

t: And in the hours before dawn they would ask forgiveness,
tr: Wabialashari hum yastaghfiroona

t: And from their properties was [given] the right of the [needy] petitioner and the deprived.
tr: Wafee amwalihim haqqun lilssaili waalmahroomi

t: And on the earth are signs for the certain [in faith]
tr: Wafee alardi ayatun lilmooqineena

t: And in yourselves. Then will you not see?
tr: Wafee anfusikum afala tubsiroona

t: And in the heaven is your provision and whatever you are promised.
tr: Wafee alssamai rizqukum wama tooAAadoona

t: Then by the Lord of the heaven and earth, indeed, it is truth - just as [sure as] it is that you are speaking.
tr: Fawarabbi alssamai waalardi innahu lahaqqun mithla ma annakum tantiqoona

t: Has there reached you the story of the honoured guests of Abraham? -
tr: Hal ataka hadeethu dayfi ibraheema almukrameena

t: When they entered upon him and said, “[We greet you with] peace.” He answered, “[And upon you] peace; [you are] a people unknown.”
tr: Ith dakhaloo AAalayhi faqaloo salaman qala salamun qawmun munkaroona

t: Then he went to his family and came with a fat [roasted] calf
tr: Faragha ila ahlihi fajaa biAAijlin sameenin

t: And placed it near them; he said, “Will you not eat?”
tr: Faqarrabahu ilayhim qala ala takuloona

t: And he felt from them apprehension. They said, “Fear not,” and gave him good tidings of a learned boy.
tr: Faawjasa minhum kheefatan qaloo la takhaf wabashsharoohu bighulamin AAaleemin

t: And his wife approached with a cry [of alarm] and struck her face and said, “[I am] a barren old woman!”
tr: Faaqbalati imraatuhu fee sarratin fasakkat wajhaha waqalat AAajoozun AAaqeemun

t: They said, “Thus has said your Lord; indeed, He is the Wise, the Knowing.”
tr: Qaloo kathaliki qala rabbuki innahu huwa alhakeemu alAAaleemu

t: [Abraham] said, “Then what is your business [here], O messengers?”
tr: Qala fama khatbukum ayyuha almursaloona

t: They said, “Indeed, we have been sent to a people of criminals
tr: Qaloo inna orsilna ila qawmin mujrimeena

t: To send down upon them stones of clay,
tr: Linursila AAalayhim hijaratan min teenin

t: Marked in the presence of your Lord for the transgressors.”
tr: Musawwamatan AAinda rabbika lilmusrifeena

t: So We brought out whoever was in them [i.e., the cities] of the Believers.
tr: Faakhrajna man kana feeha mina almumineena

t: And We found not within them other than a [single] house of Muslims.
tr: Fama wajadna feeha ghayra baytin mina almuslimeena

t: And We left therein a sign for those who fear the painful punishment.
tr: Watarakna feeha ayatan lillatheena yakhafoona alAAathaba alaleema

t: And in Moses [was a sign], when We sent him to Pharaoh with clear authority.
tr: Wafee moosa ith arsalnahu ila firAAawna bisultanin mubeenin

t: But he turned away with his supporters and said, “A magician or a madman.”
tr: Fatawalla biruknihi waqala sahirun aw majnoonun

t: So We took him and his soldiers and cast them into the sea, and he was blameworthy.
tr: Faakhathnahu wajunoodahu fanabathnahum fee alyammi wahuwa muleemun

t: And in ‘Aad [was a sign], when We sent against them the barren wind.
tr: Wafee AAadin ith arsalna AAalayhimu alrreeha alAAaqeema

t: It left nothing of what it came upon but that it made it like disintegrated ruins.
tr: Ma tatharu min shayin atat AAalayhi illa jaAAalathu kaalrrameemi

t: And in Thamūd, when it was said to them, “Enjoy yourselves for a time.”
tr: Wafee thamooda ith qeela lahum tamattaAAoo hatta heenin

t: But they were insolent toward the command of their Lord, so the thunderbolt seized them while they were looking on.
tr: FaAAataw AAan amri rabbihim faakhathathumu alssaAAiqatu wahum yanthuroona

t: And they were unable to arise, nor could they defend themselves.
tr: Fama istataAAoo min qiyamin wama kanoo muntasireena

t: And [We destroyed] the people of Noah before; indeed, they were a people defiantly disobedient.
tr: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo qawman fasiqeena

t: And the heaven We constructed with strength, and indeed, We are [its] expander.
tr: Waalssamaa banaynaha biaydin wainna lamoosiAAoona

t: And the earth We have spread out, and excellent is the preparer.
tr: Waalarda farashnaha faniAAma almahidoona

t: And of all things We created two mates [i.e., counterparts]; perhaps you will remember.
tr: Wamin kulli shayin khalaqna zawjayni laAAallakum tathakkaroona

t: So flee to God. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
tr: Fafirroo ila Allahi innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

t: And do not make [as equal] with God another deity. Indeed, I am to you from Him a clear warner.
tr: Wala tajAAaloo maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara innee lakum minhu natheerun mubeenun

t: Similarly, there came not to those before them any messenger except that they said, “A magician or a madman.”
tr: Kathalika ma ata allatheena min qablihim min rasoolin illa qaloo sahirun aw majnoonun

t: Did they suggest it to them? Rather, they [themselves] are a transgressing people.
tr: Atawasaw bihi bal hum qawmun taghoona

t: So leave them, [O Muhammad], for you are not to be blamed.
tr: Fatawalla AAanhum fama anta bimaloomin

t: And remind, for indeed, the reminder benefits the Believers.
tr: Wathakkir fainna alththikra tanfaAAu almumineena

t: And I did not create the jinn and mankind except to worship Me.
tr: Wama khalaqtu aljinna waalinsa illa liyaAAbudooni

t: I do not want from them any provision, nor do I want them to feed Me.
tr: Ma oreedu minhum min rizqin wama oreedu an yutAAimooni

t: Indeed, it is God who is the [continual] Provider, the firm possessor of strength.
tr: Inna Allaha huwa alrrazzaqu thoo alquwwati almateenu

t: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a portion [of punishment] like the portion of their companions [i.e., predecessors], so let them not ask Me to hasten.
tr: Fainna lillatheena thalamoo thanooban mithla thanoobi ashabihim fala yastaAAjiloona

t: And woe to those who have disbelieved from their Day which they are promised.
tr: Fawaylun lillatheena kafaroo min yawmihimu allathee yooAAadoona

t: By the mount
tr: Waalttoori

t: And [by] a Book inscribed
tr: Wakitabin mastoorin

t: In parchment spread open
tr: Fee raqqin manshoorin

t: And [by] the frequented House
tr: Waalbayti almaAAmoori

t: And [by] the ceiling [i.e., heaven] raised high
tr: Waalssaqfi almarfooAAi

t: And [by] the sea filled [with fire],
tr: Waalbahri almasjoori

t: Indeed, the punishment of your Lord will occur.
tr: Inna AAathaba rabbika lawaqiAAun

t: Of it there is no preventer.
tr: Ma lahu min dafiAAin

t: On the Day the heaven will sway with circular motion
tr: Yawma tamooru alssamao mawran

t: And the mountains will pass on, departing -
tr: Wataseeru aljibalu sayran

t: Then woe, that Day, to the deniers,
tr: Fawaylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: Who are in [empty] discourse amusing themselves.
tr: Allatheena hum fee khawdin yalAAaboona

t: The Day they are thrust toward the fire of Hell with a [violent] thrust, [its angels will say],
tr: Yawma yudaAAAAoona ila nari jahannama daAAAAan

t: “This is the Fire which you used to deny.
tr: Hathihi alnnaru allatee kuntum biha tukaththiboona

t: Then is this magic, or do you not see?
tr: Afasihrun hatha am antum la tubsiroona

t: [Enter to] burn therein; then be patient or impatient - it is all the same for you. You are only being recompensed [for] what you used to do.”
tr: Islawha faisbiroo aw la tasbiroo sawaon AAalaykum innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: Indeed, the righteous will be in gardens and pleasure,
tr: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaAAeemin

t: Enjoying what their Lord has given them, and their Lord protected them from the punishment of Hellfire.
tr: Fakiheena bima atahum rabbuhum wawaqahum rabbuhum AAathaba aljaheemi

t: [They will be told], “Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do.”
tr: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t: They will be reclining on thrones lined up, and We will marry them to fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes.
tr: Muttakieena AAala sururin masfoofatin wazawwajnahum bihoorin AAeenin

t: And those who believed and whose descendants followed them in faith - We will join with them their descendants, and We will not deprive them of anything of their deeds. Every person, for what he earned, is retained.
tr: Waallatheena amanoo waittabaAAathum thurriyyatuhum bieemanin alhaqna bihim thurriyyatahum wama alatnahum min AAamalihim min shayin kullu imriin bima kasaba raheenun

t: And We will provide them with fruit and meat from whatever they desire.
tr: Waamdadnahum bifakihatin walahmin mimma yashtahoona

t: They will exchange with one another a cup [of wine] wherein [results] no ill speech or commission of sin.
tr: YatanazaAAoona feeha kasan la laghwun feeha wala tatheemun

t: There will circulate among them [servant] boys [especially] for them, as if they were pearls well-protected.
tr: Wayatoofu AAalayhim ghilmanun lahum kaannahum luluon maknoonun

t: And they will approach one another, inquiring of each other.
tr: Waaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatasaaloona

t: They will say, “Indeed, we were previously among our people fearful [of displeasing God].
tr: Qaloo inna kunna qablu fee ahlina mushfiqeena

t: So God conferred favour upon us and protected us from the punishment of the Scorching Fire.
tr: Famanna Allahu AAalayna wawaqana AAathaba alssamoomi

t: Indeed, we used to supplicate Him before. Indeed, it is He who is the Beneficent, the Merciful.”
tr: Inna kunna min qablu nadAAoohu innahu huwa albarru alrraheemu

t: So remind, [O Muhammad], for you are not, by the favour of your Lord, a soothsayer or a madman.
tr: Fathakkir fama anta biniAAmati rabbika bikahin wala majnoonin

t: Or do they say [of you], “A poet for whom we await a misfortune of time”?
tr: Am yaqooloona shaAAirun natarabbasu bihi rayba almanooni

t: Say, “Wait, for indeed I am, with you, among the waiters.”
tr: Qul tarabbasoo fainnee maAAakum mina almutarabbiseena

t: Or do their minds command them to [say] this, or are they a transgressing people?
tr: Am tamuruhum ahlamuhum bihatha am hum qawmun taghoona

t: Or do they say, “He has made it up”? Rather, they do not believe.
tr: Am yaqooloona taqawwalahu bal la yuminoona

t: Then let them produce a statement like it, if they should be truthful.
tr: Falyatoo bihadeethin mithlihi in kanoo sadiqeena

t: Or were they created by nothing, or were they the creators [of themselves]?
tr: Am khuliqoo min ghayri shayin am humu alkhaliqoona

t: Or did they create the heavens and the earth? Rather, they are not certain.
tr: Am khalaqoo alssamawati waalarda bal la yooqinoona

t: Or have they the depositories [containing the provision] of your Lord? Or are they the controllers [of them]?
tr: Am AAindahum khazainu rabbika am humu almusaytiroona

t: Or have they a stairway [into the heaven] upon which they listen? Then let their listener produce a clear authority [i.e., proof].
tr: Am lahum sullamun yastamiAAoona feehi falyati mustamiAAuhum bisultanin mubeenin

t: Or has He daughters while you have sons?
tr: Am lahu albanatu walakumu albanoona

t: Or do you, [O Muhammad], ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
tr: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

t: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
tr: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona

t: Or do they intend a plan? But those who disbelieve - they are the object of a plan.
tr: Am yureedoona kaydan faallatheena kafaroo humu almakeedoona

t: Or have they a deity other than God? Exalted is God above whatever they associate with Him.
tr: Am lahum ilahun ghayru Allahi subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona

t: And if they were to see a fragment from the sky falling, they would say, “[It is merely] clouds heaped up.”
tr: Wain yaraw kisfan mina alssamai saqitan yaqooloo sahabun markoomun

t: So leave them until they meet their Day in which they will be struck insensible -
tr: Fatharhum hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee feehi yusAAaqoona

t: The Day their plan will not avail them at all, nor will they be helped.
tr: Yawma la yughnee AAanhum kayduhum shayan wala hum yunsaroona

t: And indeed, for those who have wronged is a punishment before that, but most of them do not know.
tr: Wainna lillatheena thalamoo AAathaban doona thalika walakinna aktharahum la yaAAlamoona

t: And be patient, [O Muhammad], for the decision of your Lord, for indeed, you are in Our eyes [i.e., sight]. And exalt [God] with praise of your Lord when you arise
tr: Waisbir lihukmi rabbika fainnaka biaAAyunina wasabbih bihamdi rabbika heena taqoomu

t: And in a part of the night exalt Him and after [the setting of] the stars.
tr: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waidbara alnnujoomi

t: By the star when it descends,
tr: Waalnnajmi itha hawa

t: Your companion [i.e., Muhammad] has not strayed, nor has he erred,
tr: Ma dalla sahibukum wama ghawa

t: Nor does he speak from [his own] inclination.
tr: Wama yantiqu AAani alhawa

t: It is not but a revelation revealed,
tr: In huwa illa wahyun yooha

t: Taught to him by one intense in strength [i.e., Gabriel] -
tr: AAallamahu shadeedu alquwa

t: One of soundness. And he rose to [his] true form
tr: Thoo mirratin faistawa

t: While he was in the higher [part of the] horizon.
tr: Wahuwa bialofuqi alaAAla

t: Then he approached and descended
tr: Thumma dana fatadalla

t: And was at a distance of two bow lengths or nearer.
tr: Fakana qaba qawsayni aw adna

t: And he revealed to His Servant what he revealed [i.e., conveyed].
tr: Faawha ila AAabdihi ma awha

t: The heart did not lie [about] what it saw.
tr: Ma kathaba alfuadu ma raa

t: So will you dispute with him over what he saw?
tr: Afatumaroonahu AAala ma yara

t: And he certainly saw him in another descent
tr: Walaqad raahu nazlatan okhra

t: At the Lote Tree of the Utmost Boundary -
tr: AAinda sidrati almuntaha

t: Near it is the Garden of Refuge [i.e., Paradise] -
tr: AAindaha jannatu almawa

t: When there covered the Lote Tree that which covered [it].
tr: Ith yaghsha alssidrata ma yaghsha

t: The sight [of the Prophet] did not swerve, nor did it transgress [its limit].
tr: Ma zagha albasaru wama tagha

t: He certainly saw of the greatest signs of his Lord.
tr: Laqad raa min ayati rabbihi alkubra

t: So have you considered al-Lāt and al- ‘Uzzā?
tr: Afaraaytumu allata waalAAuzza

t: And Manāt, the third - the other one?
tr: Wamanata alththalithata alokhra

t: Is the male for you and for Him the female?
tr: Alakumu alththakaru walahu alontha

t: That, then, is an unjust division.
tr: Tilka ithan qismatun deeza

t: They are not but [mere] names you have named them - you and your forefathers - for which God has sent down no authority. They follow not except assumption and what [their] souls desire, and there has already come to them from their Lord guidance.
tr: In hiya illa asmaon sammaytumooha antum waabaokum ma anzala Allahu biha min sultanin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wama tahwa alanfusu walaqad jaahum min rabbihimu alhuda

t: Or is there for the human being whatever he wishes?
tr: Am lilinsani ma tamanna

t: Rather, to God belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
tr: Falillahi alakhiratu waaloola

t: And how many angels there are in the heavens whose intercession will not avail at all except [only] after God has permitted [it] to whom He wills and approves.
tr: Wakam min malakin fee alssamawati la tughnee shafaAAatuhum shayan illa min baAAdi an yathana Allahu liman yashao wayarda

t: Indeed, those who do not believe in the Hereafter name the angels female names,
tr: Inna allatheena la yuminoona bialakhirati layusammoona almalaikata tasmiyata alontha

t: And they have thereof no knowledge. They follow not except assumption, and indeed, assumption avails not against the truth at all.
tr: Wama lahum bihi min AAilmin in yattabiAAoona illa alththanna wainna alththanna la yughnee mina alhaqqi shayan

t: So turn away from whoever turns his back on Our message and desires not except the worldly life.
tr: FaaAArid AAan man tawalla AAan thikrina walam yurid illa alhayata alddunya

t: That is their sum of knowledge. Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who strays from His way, and He is most knowing of who is guided.
tr: Thalika mablaghuhum mina alAAilmi inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bimani ihtada

t: And to God belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is in the earth that He may recompense those who do evil with [the penalty of] what they have done and recompense those who strive for excellence with the excellent [reward] -
tr: Walillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi liyajziya allatheena asaoo bima AAamiloo wayajziya allatheena ahsanoo bialhusna

t: Those who avoid the major sins and immoralities, only [committing] slight ones. Indeed, your Lord is vast in forgiveness. He was most knowing of you when He produced you from the earth and when you were fetuses in the wombs of your mothers. So do not claim yourselves to be pure; He is most knowing of who fears Him.
tr: Allatheena yajtaniboona kabaira alithmi waalfawahisha illa allamama inna rabbaka wasiAAu almaghfirati huwa aAAlamu bikum ith anshaakum mina alardi waith antum ajinnatun fee butooni ommahatikum fala tuzakkoo anfusakum huwa aAAlamu bimani ittaqa

t: Have you seen the one who turned away
tr: Afaraayta allathee tawalla

t: And gave a little and [then] refrained?
tr: WaaAAta qaleelan waakda

t: Does he have knowledge of the unseen, so he sees?
tr: aAAindahu AAilmu alghaybi fahuwa yara

t: Or has he not been informed of what was in the scriptures of Moses
tr: Am lam yunabba bima fee suhufi moosa

t: And [of] Abraham, who fulfilled [his obligations] -
tr: Waibraheema allathee waffa

t: That no bearer of burdens will bear the burden of another
tr: Alla taziru waziratun wizra okhra

t: And that there is not for the human being except that [good] for which he strives
tr: Waan laysa lilinsani illa ma saAAa

t: And that his effort is going to be seen -
tr: Waanna saAAyahu sawfa yura

t: Then he will be recompensed for it with the fullest recompense
tr: Thumma yujzahu aljazaa alawfa

t: And that to your Lord is the finality
tr: Waanna ila rabbika almuntaha

t: And that it is He who makes [one] laugh and weep
tr: Waannahu huwa adhaka waabka

t: And that it is He who causes death and gives life
tr: Waannahu huwa amata waahya

t: And that He creates the two mates - the male and female -
tr: Waannahu khalaqa alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha

t: From a sperm-drop when it is emitted
tr: Min nutfatin itha tumna

t: And that [incumbent] upon Him is the other [i.e., next] creation
tr: Waanna AAalayhi alnnashata alokhra

t: And that it is He who enriches and suffices
tr: Waannahu huwa aghna waaqna

t: And that it is He who is the Lord of Sirius
tr: Waannahu huwa rabbu alshshiAAra

t: And that He destroyed the first [people of] ‘Aad
tr: Waannahu ahlaka AAadan aloola

t: And Thamūd - and He did not spare [them] -
tr: Wathamooda fama abqa

t: And the people of Noah before. Indeed, it was they who were [even] more unjust and oppressing.
tr: Waqawma noohin min qablu innahum kanoo hum athlama waatgha

t: And the overturned towns He hurled down
tr: Waalmutafikata ahwa

t: And covered them by that which He covered.
tr: Faghashshaha ma ghashsha

t: Then which of the favours of your Lord do you doubt?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbika tatamara

t: This [Prophet] is a warner from [i.e., like] the former warners.
tr: Hatha natheerun mina alnnuthuri aloola

t: The Approaching Day has approached.
tr: Azifati alazifatu

t: Of it, [from those] besides God, there is no remover.
tr: Laysa laha min dooni Allahi kashifatun

t: Then at this statement do you wonder?
tr: Afamin hatha alhadeethi taAAjaboona

t: And you laugh and do not weep
tr: Watadhakoona wala tabkoona

t: While you are proudly sporting?
tr: Waantum samidoona

t: So prostrate to God and worship [Him].
tr: Faosjudoo lillahi waoAAbudoo

t: The Hour has come near, and the moon has split [in two].
tr: Iqtarabati alssaAAatu wainshaqqa alqamaru

t: And if they see a sign [i.e., miracle], they turn away and say, “Passing magic.”
tr: Wain yaraw ayatan yuAAridoo wayaqooloo sihrun mustamirrun

t: And they denied and followed their inclinations. But for every matter is a [time of] settlement.
tr: Wakaththaboo waittabaAAoo ahwaahum wakullu amrin mustaqirrun

t: And there has already come to them of information that in which there is deterrence -
tr: Walaqad jaahum mina alanbai ma feehi muzdajarun

t: Extensive wisdom - but warning does not avail [them].
tr: Hikmatun balighatun fama tughnee alnnuthuru

t: So leave them, [O Muhammad]. The Day the Caller calls to something horrific,
tr: Fatawalla AAanhum yawma yadAAu alddaAAi ila shayin nukurin

t: Their eyes humbled, they will emerge from the graves as if they were locusts spreading,
tr: KhushshaAAan absaruhum yakhrujoona mina alajdathi kaannahum jaradun muntashirun

t: Racing ahead toward the Caller. The disbelievers will say, “This is a difficult Day.”
tr: MuhtiAAeena ila alddaAAi yaqoolu alkafiroona hatha yawmun AAasirun

t: The people of Noah denied before them, and they denied Our servant and said, “A madman,” and he was repelled.
tr: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin fakaththaboo AAabdana waqaloo majnoonun waizdujira

t: So he invoked his Lord, “Indeed, I am overpowered, so help.”
tr: FadaAAa rabbahu annee maghloobun faintasir

t: Then We opened the gates of the heaven with rain pouring down
tr: Fafatahna abwaba alssamai bimain munhamirin

t: And caused the earth to burst with springs, and the waters met for a matter already predestined.
tr: Wafajjarna alarda AAuyoonan failtaqa almao AAala amrin qad qudira

t: And We carried him on a [construction of] planks and nails,
tr: Wahamalnahu AAala thati alwahin wadusurin

t: Sailing under Our observation as reward for he who had been denied.
tr: Tajree biaAAyunina jazaan liman kana kufira

t: And We left it as a sign, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad taraknaha ayatan fahal min muddakirin

t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t: ‘Aad denied; and how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr: Kaththabat AAadun fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t: Indeed, We sent upon them a screaming wind on a day of continuous misfortune,
tr: Inna arsalna AAalayhim reehan sarsaran fee yawmi nahsin mustamirrin

t: Extracting the people as if they were trunks of palm trees uprooted.
tr: TanziAAu alnnasa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin munqaAAirin

t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t: Thamūd denied the warning
tr: Kaththabat thamoodu bialnnuthuri

t: And said, “Is it one human being among us that we should follow? Indeed, we would then be in error and madness.
tr: Faqaloo abasharan minna wahidan nattabiAAuhu inna ithan lafee dalalin wasuAAurin

t: Has the message been sent down upon him from among us? Rather, he is an insolent liar.”
tr: Aolqiya alththikru AAalayhi min baynina bal huwa kaththabun ashirun

t: They will know tomorrow who is the insolent liar.
tr: SayaAAlamoona ghadan mani alkaththabu alashiru

t: Indeed, We are sending the she-camel as trial for them, so watch them and be patient.
tr: Inna mursiloo alnnaqati fitnatan lahum fairtaqibhum waistabir

t: And inform them that the water is shared between them, each [day of] drink attended [by turn].
tr: Wanabbihum anna almaa qismatun baynahum kullu shirbin muhtadarun

t: But they called their companion, and he dared and hamstrung [her].
tr: Fanadaw sahibahum fataAAata faAAaqara

t: And how [severe] were My punishment and warning.
tr: Fakayfa kana AAathabee wanuthuri

t: Indeed, We sent upon them one shriek [i.e., blast from the sky], and they became like the dry twig fragments of an [animal] pen.
tr: Inna arsalna AAalayhim sayhatan wahidatan fakanoo kahasheemi almuhtathiri

t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t: The people of Lot denied the warning.
tr: Kaththabat qawmu lootin bialnnuthuri

t: Indeed, We sent upon them a storm of stones, except the family of Lot - We saved them before dawn
tr: Inna arsalna AAalayhim hasiban illa ala lootin najjaynahum bisaharin

t: As favour from Us. Thus do We reward he who is grateful.
tr: NiAAmatan min AAindina kathalika najzee man shakara

t: And he had already warned them of Our assault, but they disputed the warning.
tr: Walaqad antharahum batshatana fatamaraw bialnnuthuri

t: And they had demanded from him his guests, but We obliterated their eyes, [saying], “Taste My punishment and warning.”
tr: Walaqad rawadoohu AAan dayfihi fatamasna aAAyunahum fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

t: And there came upon them by morning an abiding punishment.
tr: Walaqad sabbahahum bukratan AAathabun mustaqirrun

t: So taste My punishment and warning.
tr: Fathooqoo AAathabee wanuthuri

t: And We have certainly made the Qur’ān easy for remembrance, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad yassarna alqurana lilththikri fahal min muddakirin

t: And there certainly came to the people of Pharaoh warning.
tr: Walaqad jaa ala firAAawna alnnuthuru

t: They denied Our signs, all of them, so We seized them with a seizure of one Exalted in Might and Perfect in Ability.
tr: Kaththaboo biayatina kulliha faakhathnahum akhtha AAazeezin muqtadirin
