t: Are your disbelievers better than those [former ones], or have you immunity in the scriptures?
tr: Akuffarukum khayrun min olaikum am lakum baraatun fee alzzuburi

t: Or do they say, “We are an assembly supporting [each other]”?
tr: Am yaqooloona nahnu jameeAAun muntasirun

t: [Their] assembly will be defeated, and they will turn their backs [in retreat].
tr: Sayuhzamu aljamAAu wayuwalloona alddubura

t: But the Hour is their appointment [for due punishment], and the Hour is more disastrous and more bitter.
tr: Bali alssaAAatu mawAAiduhum waalssaAAatu adha waamarru

t: Indeed, the criminals are in error and madness.
tr: Inna almujrimeena fee dalalin wasuAAurin

t: The Day they are dragged into the Fire on their faces [it will be said], “Taste the touch of Saqar.”
tr: Yawma yushaboona fee alnnari AAala wujoohihim thooqoo massa saqara

t: Indeed, all things We created with predestination.
tr: Inna kulla shayin khalaqnahu biqadarin

t: And Our command is but one, like a glance of the eye.
tr: Wama amruna illa wahidatun kalamhin bialbasari

t: And We have already destroyed your kinds, so is there any who will remember?
tr: Walaqad ahlakna ashyaAAakum fahal min muddakirin

t: And everything they did is in written records.
tr: Wakullu shayin faAAaloohu fee alzzuburi

t: And every small and great [thing] is inscribed.
tr: Wakullu sagheerin wakabeerin mustatarun

t: Indeed, the righteous will be among gardens and rivers,
tr: Inna almuttaqeena fee jannatin wanaharin

t: In a seat of honour near a Sovereign, Perfect in Ability.
tr: Fee maqAAadi sidqin AAinda maleekin muqtadirin

t: The Most Merciful
tr: Alrrahmanu

t: Taught the Qur’ān,
tr: AAallama alqurana

t: Created the human being,
tr: Khalaqa alinsana

t: [And] taught him eloquence.
tr: AAallamahu albayana

t: The sun and the moon [move] by precise calculation,
tr: Alshshamsu waalqamaru bihusbanin

t: And the stars and trees prostrate.
tr: Waalnnajmu waalshshajaru yasjudani

t: And the heaven He raised and imposed the balance
tr: Waalssamaa rafaAAaha wawadaAAa almeezana

t: That you not transgress within the balance.
tr: Alla tatghaw fee almeezani

t: And establish weight in justice and do not make deficient the balance.
tr: Waaqeemoo alwazna bialqisti wala tukhsiroo almeezana

t: And the earth He laid [out] for the creatures.
tr: Waalarda wadaAAaha lilanami

t: Therein is fruit and palm trees having sheaths [of dates]
tr: Feeha fakihatun waalnnakhlu thatu alakmami

t: And grain having husks and scented plants.
tr: Waalhabbu thoo alAAasfi waalrrayhani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: He created the human being from clay like [that of] pottery.
tr: Khalaqa alinsana min salsalin kaalfakhkhari

t: And He created the jinn from a smokeless flame of fire.
tr: Wakhalaqa aljanna min marijin min narin

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: [He is] Lord of the two sunrises and Lord of the two sunsets.
tr: Rabbu almashriqayni warabbu almaghribayni

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: He released the two seas, meeting [side by side];
tr: Maraja albahrayni yaltaqiyani

t: Between them is a barrier [so] neither of them transgresses.
tr: Baynahuma barzakhun la yabghiyani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: From both of them emerge pearl and coral.
tr: Yakhruju minhuma alluluo waalmarjanu

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: And to Him belong the ships [with sails] elevated in the sea like mountains.
tr: Walahu aljawari almunshaatu fee albahri kaalaAAlami

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Everyone upon it [i.e., the earth] will perish,
tr: Kullu man AAalayha fanin

t: And there will remain the Face of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honour. jinn
tr: Wayabqa wajhu rabbika thoo aljalali waalikrami

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Whoever is within the heavens and earth asks Him; every day He is in [i.e., bringing about] a matter.
tr: Yasaluhu man fee alssamawati waalardi kulla yawmin huwa fee shanin

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: We will attend to you, O prominent beings.
tr: Sanafrughu lakum ayyuha alththaqalani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: O company of jinn and mankind, if you are able to pass beyond the regions of the heavens and the earth, then pass. You will not pass except by authority [from God].
tr: Ya maAAshara aljinni waalinsi ini istataAAtum an tanfuthoo min aqtari alssamawati waalardi faonfuthoo la tanfuthoona illa bisultanin

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: There will be sent upon you a flame of fire and smoke, and you will not defend yourselves.
tr: Yursalu AAalaykuma shuwathun min narin wanuhasun fala tantasirani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: And when the heaven is split open and becomes rose-coloured like oil -
tr: Faitha inshaqqati alssamao fakanat wardatan kaalddihani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? -
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Then on that Day none will be asked about his sin among men or jinn.
tr: Fayawmaithin la yusalu AAan thanbihi insun wala jannun

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: The criminals will be known by their marks, and they will be seized by the forelocks and the feet.
tr: YuAArafu almujrimoona biseemahum fayukhathu bialnnawasee waalaqdami

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: This is Hell, which the criminals deny.
tr: Hathihi jahannamu allatee yukaththibu biha almujrimoona

t: They will go around between it and scalding water, heated [to the utmost degree].
tr: Yatoofoona baynaha wabayna hameemin anin

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: But for he who has feared the position of his Lord are two gardens -
tr: Waliman khafa maqama rabbihi jannatani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? -
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Having [spreading] branches.
tr: Thawata afnanin

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: In both of them are two springs, flowing.
tr: Feehima AAaynani tajriyani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: In both of them are of every fruit, two kinds.
tr: Feehima min kulli fakihatin zawjani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: [They are] reclining on beds whose linings are of silk brocade, and the fruit of the two gardens is hanging low.
tr: Muttakieena AAala furushin batainuha min istabraqin wajana aljannatayni danin

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: In them are women limiting [their] glances, untouched before them by man or jinnī -
tr: Feehinna qasiratu alttarfi lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? -
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: As if they were rubies and coral.
tr: Kaannahunna alyaqootu waalmarjanu

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Is the reward for excellence [anything] but excellence?
tr: Hal jazao alihsani illa alihsanu

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: And below them both [in excellence] are two [other] gardens -
tr: Wamin doonihima jannatani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? -
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Dark green [in colour].
tr: Mudhammatani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: In both of them are two springs, spouting.
tr: Feehima AAaynani naddakhatani

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: In both of them are fruit and palm trees and pomegranates.
tr: Feehima fakihatun wanakhlun warummanun

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: In them are good and beautiful women -
tr: Feehinna khayratun hisanun

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? -
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Fair ones reserved in pavilions -
tr: Hoorun maqsooratun fee alkhiyami

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? -
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Untouched before them by man or jinnī -
tr: Lam yatmithhunna insun qablahum wala jannun

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny? -
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Reclining on green cushions and beautiful fine carpets.
tr: Muttakieena AAala rafrafin khudrin waAAabqariyyin hisanin

t: So which of the favours of your Lord would you deny?
tr: Fabiayyi alai rabbikuma tukaththibani

t: Blessed is the name of your Lord, Owner of Majesty and Honour.
tr: Tabaraka ismu rabbika thee aljalali waalikrami

t: The foremost in rank and position;
tr: Itha waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu

t: The common righteous people; 3. Those who denied the Hereafter and persisted in disbelief and polytheism and major sins till the last. How these three classes of the people will be rewarded and punished has been described in detail in v. 7- 56. Then, in v. 57-74 arguments have been given, one after the other, to prove the truth of the two basic doctrines of Islām, which the disbelievers were refusing to accept; the doctrines of Monotheism and the Hereafter. In these arguments, apart from everything else that exists in the earth and heavens, man’s attention has been drawn to his own body and to the food that he eats and to the water that he drinks and to the fire on which he cooks his food, and he has been invited to ponder the question: What right do you have to behave independently of, or serve any other than, the God Whose creative power has brought you into being, and Whose provisions sustain you? And how can you entertain the idea that after having once brought you into existence He has become so helpless and powerless that He cannot recreate you once again even if he wills to? Then, in v. 75-82 their suspicions in respect of the Qur’ān have been refuted and they have been made to realise how fortunate they are that instead of deriving any benefit from the great blessing that the Qur’ān is, they are treating it with inadequate attention and have set only this share of theirs in it that they deny it. If one seriously considers this matchless argument that has been presented in two brief sentences about the truth of the Qur’ān, one will find in it the same kind of firm and stable system as exists among the stars and planets of the Universe - and the same is the proof of the fact that its Author is the same Being Who has created the Universe. Then the disbelievers have been told that this Book is inscribed in that Writ of Destiny which is beyond the reach of the creatures, as if to say “You think it is brought down by the devils to Muhammad, whereas none but the pure angels has any access to the means by which it reaches Muhammad from the wellguarded Tablet.” In conclusion, man has been warned, as if to say: “You may brag and boast as you like and may shut your eyes to the truths in your arrogance of independence, but death is enough to open your eyes. At death you become helpless: you cannot save your own parents; you cannot save your children; you cannot save your religious guided and beloved leaders. They all die in front of your very eyes while you look on helplessly. If there is no supreme power ruling over you, and this assumption is correct that you are all in all in the world, and there is no God, then why don’t you restore to the dying person his soul? Just as you are helpless in this, so it is also beyond your power to stop God from calling the people to account and measure out rewards and punishments to them. You may or may not believe it, but every dying person will surely see his own end after death. If he belongs to those nearest to God, he will see the good end meant for them if he be from among the righteous, he will see the end prepared for the righteous; and if he be from among the deniers of the truth, he will see the end destined for the criminals. In the Name of God, the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful 1. When the Inevitable Event takes place, 2. There is, at its occurrence, no denial.
tr: Laysa liwaqAAatiha kathibatun

t: It will bring down [some] and raise up [others].
tr: Khafidatun rafiAAatun

t: When the earth is shaken with convulsion
tr: Itha rujjati alardu rajjan

t: And the mountains are broken down, crumbling
tr: Wabussati aljibalu bassan

t: And become dust dispersing.
tr: Fakanat habaan munbaththan

t: And you become [of] three kinds:
tr: Wakuntum azwajan thalathatan

t: Then the companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
tr: Faashabu almaymanati ma ashabu almaymanati

t: And the companions of the left - what are companions of the left?
tr: Waashabu almashamati ma ashabu almashamati

t: And the forerunners, the forerunners -
tr: Waalssabiqoona alssabiqoona

t: Those are the ones brought near [to God]
tr: Olaika almuqarraboona

t: In the Gardens of Pleasure,
tr: Fee jannati alnnaAAeemi

t: A [large] company of the former peoples
tr: Thullatun mina alawwaleena

t: And a few of the later peoples,
tr: Waqaleelun mina alakhireena

t: On thrones woven [with ornament],
tr: AAala sururin mawdoonatin

t: Reclining on them, facing each other.
tr: Muttakieena AAalayha mutaqabileena

t: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal
tr: Yatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona

t: With vessels, pitchers and a cup [of wine] from a flowing spring -
tr: Biakwabin waabareeqa wakasin min maAAeenin

t: No headache will they have therefrom, nor will they be intoxicated -
tr: La yusaddaAAoona AAanha wala yunzifoona

t: And fruit of what they select
tr: Wafakihatin mimma yatakhayyaroona

t: And the meat of fowl, from whatever they desire.
tr: Walahmi tayrin mimma yashtahoona

t: And [for them are] fair women with large, [beautiful] eyes,
tr: Wahoorun AAeenun

t: The likenesses of pearls well-protected,
tr: Kaamthali allului almaknooni

t: As reward for what they used to do.
tr: Jazaan bima kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: They will not hear therein ill speech or commission of sin -
tr: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala tatheeman

t: Only a saying: “Peace, peace.”
tr: Illa qeelan salaman salaman

t: The companions of the right - what are the companions of the right?
tr: Waashabu alyameeni ma ashabu alyameeni

t: [They will be] among lote trees with thorns removed
tr: Fee sidrin makhdoodin

t: And [banana] trees layered [with fruit]
tr: Watalhin mandoodin

t: And shade extended
tr: Wathillin mamdoodin

t: And water poured out
tr: Wamain maskoobin

t: And fruit, abundant [and varied],
tr: Wafakihatin katheeratin

t: Neither limited [to season] nor forbidden,
tr: La maqtooAAatin wala mamnooAAatin

t: And [upon] beds raised high.
tr: Wafurushin marfooAAatin

t: Indeed, We have produced them [i.e., the women of Paradise] in a [new] creation
tr: Inna anshanahunna inshaan

t: And made them virgins,
tr: FajaAAalnahunna abkaran

t: Devoted [to their husbands] and of equal age,
tr: AAuruban atraban

t: For the companions of the right [who are]
tr: Liashabi alyameeni

t: A company of the former peoples
tr: Thullatun mina alawwaleena

t: And a company of the later peoples.
tr: Wathullatun mina alakhireena

t: And the companions of the left - what are the companions of the left?
tr: Waashabu alshshimali ma ashabu alshshimali

t: [They will be] in scorching fire and scalding water
tr: Fee samoomin wahameemin

t: And a shade of black smoke,
tr: Wathillin min yahmoomin

t: Neither cool nor beneficial.
tr: La baridin wala kareemin

t: Indeed they were, before that, indulging in affluence,
tr: Innahum kanoo qabla thalika mutrafeena

t: And they used to persist in the great violation,
tr: Wakanoo yusirroona AAala alhinthi alAAatheemi

t: And they used to say, “When we die and become dust and bones, are we indeed to be resurrected?
tr: Wakanoo yaqooloona aitha mitna wakunna turaban waAAithaman ainna lamabAAoothoona

t: And our forefathers [as well]?”
tr: Awa abaona alawwaloona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Indeed, the former and the later peoples
tr: Qul inna alawwaleena waalakhireena

t: Are to be gathered together for the appointment of a known Day.”
tr: LamajmooAAoona ila meeqati yawmin maAAloomin

t: Then indeed you, O those astray [who are] deniers,
tr: Thumma innakum ayyuha alddalloona almukaththiboona

t: Will be eating from trees of zaqqūm
tr: Laakiloona min shajarin min zaqqoomin

t: And filling with it your bellies
tr: Famalioona minha albutoona

t: And drinking on top of it from scalding water
tr: Fashariboona AAalayhi mina alhameemi

t: And will drink as the drinking of thirsty camels.
tr: Fashariboona shurba alheemi

t: That is their hospitality on the Day of Recompense.
tr: Hatha nuzuluhum yawma alddeeni

t: We have created you, so why do you not believe?
tr: Nahnu khalaqnakum falawla tusaddiqoona

t: Have you seen that which you emit?
tr: Afaraaytum ma tumnoona

t: Is it you who creates it, or are We the Creator?
tr: Aantum takhluqoonahu am nahnu alkhaliqoona

t: We have decreed death among you, and We are not to be outdone
tr: Nahnu qaddarna baynakumu almawta wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

t: In that We will change your likenesses and produce you in that [form] which you do not know.
tr: AAala an nubaddila amthalakum wanunshiakum fee ma la taAAlamoona

t: And you have already known the first creation, so will you not remember?
tr: Walaqad AAalimtumu alnnashata aloola falawla tathakkaroona

t: And have you seen that [seed] which you sow?
tr: Afaraaytum ma tahruthoona

t: Is it you who makes it grow, or are We the grower?
tr: Aantum tazraAAoonahu am nahnu alzzariAAoona

t: If We willed, We could make it [dry] debris, and you would remain in wonder,
tr: Law nashao lajaAAalnahu hutaman fathaltum tafakkahoona

t: [Saying], “Indeed, we are [now] in debt;
tr: Inna lamughramoona

t: Rather, we have been deprived.”
tr: Bal nahnu mahroomoona

t: And have you seen the water that you drink?
tr: Afaraaytumu almaa allathee tashraboona

t: Is it you who brought it down from the clouds, or is it We who bring it down?
tr: Aantum anzaltumoohu mina almuzni am nahnu almunziloona

t: If We willed, We could make it bitter, so why are you not grateful?
tr: Law nashao jaAAalnahu ojajan falawla tashkuroona

t: And have you seen the fire that you ignite?
tr: Afaraaytumu alnnara allatee tooroona

t: Is it you who produced its tree, or are We the producer?
tr: Aantum anshatum shajarataha am nahnu almunshioona

t: We have made it a reminder and provision for the travellers,
tr: Nahnu jaAAalnaha tathkiratan wamataAAan lilmuqweena

t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

t: Then I swear by the setting of the stars,
tr: Fala oqsimu bimawaqiAAi alnnujoomi

t: And indeed, it is an oath - if you could know - [most] great.
tr: Wainnahu laqasamun law taAAlamoona AAatheemun

t: Indeed, it is a noble Qur’ān
tr: Innahu laquranun kareemun

t: In a Register well-protected;
tr: Fee kitabin maknoonin

t: None touch it except the purified [i.e., the angels].
tr: La yamassuhu illa almutahharoona

t: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena

t: Then is it to this statement that you are indifferent
tr: Afabihatha alhadeethi antum mudhinoona

t: And make [the thanks for] your provision that you deny [the Provider]?
tr: WatajAAaloona rizqakum annakum tukaththiboona

t: Then why, when it [i.e., the soul at death] reaches the throat
tr: Falawla itha balaghati alhulqooma

t: And you are at that time looking on -
tr: Waantum heenaithin tanthuroona

t: And We are nearer to him than you, but you do not see -
tr: Wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi minkum walakin la tubsiroona

t: Then why do you not, if you are not to be recompensed,
tr: Falawla in kuntum ghayra madeeneena

t: Bring it back, if you should be truthful?
tr: TarjiAAoonaha in kuntum sadiqeena

t: And if he [i.e., the deceased] was of those brought near [to God],
tr: Faamma in kana mina almuqarrabeena

t: Then [for him is] rest and bounty and a garden of pleasure.
tr: Farawhun warayhanun wajannatu naAAeemin

t: And if he was of the companions of the right,
tr: Waamma in kana min ashabi alyameeni

t: Then [the angels will say], “Peace for you; [you are] from the companions of the right.”
tr: Fasalamun laka min ashabi alyameeni

t: But if he was of the deniers [who were] astray,
tr: Waamma in kana mina almukaththibeena alddalleena

t: Then [for him is] hospitality of scalding water
tr: Fanuzulun min hameemin

t: And burning in Hellfire.
tr: Watasliyatu jaheemin

t: Indeed, this is the true certainty,
tr: Inna hatha lahuwa haqqu alyaqeeni

t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

t: Whatever is in the heavens and earth exalts God, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. He gives life and causes death, and He is over all things competent.
tr: Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi yuhyee wayumeetu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: He is the First and the Last, the Manifest and the Hidden, and He is, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Huwa alawwalu waalakhiru waalththahiru waalbatinu wahuwa bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: It is He who created the heavens and earth in six days and then established Himself above the Throne. He knows what penetrates into the earth and what emerges from it and what descends from the heaven and what ascends therein; and He is with you wherever you are. And God, of what you do, is Seeing.
tr: Huwa allathee khalaqa alssamawati waalarda fee sittati ayyamin thumma istawa AAala alAAarshi yaAAlamu ma yaliju fee alardi wama yakhruju minha wama yanzilu mina alssamai wama yaAAruju feeha wahuwa maAAakum ayna ma kuntum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun

t: His is the dominion of the heavens and earth. And to God are returned [all] matters.
tr: Lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waila Allahi turjaAAu alomooru

t: He causes the night to enter the day and causes the day to enter the night, and He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: Yooliju allayla fee alnnahari wayooliju alnnahara fee allayi wahuwa AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

t: Believe in God and His Messenger and spend out of that in which He has made you successors. For those who have believed among you and spent, there will be a great reward.
tr: Aminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waanfiqoo mimma jaAAalakum mustakhlafeena feehi faallatheena amanoo minkum waanfaqoo lahum ajrun kabeerun

t: And why do you not believe in God while the Messenger invites you to your covenant, if you should [truly] be Believers?
tr: Wama lakum la tuminoona biAllahi waalrrasoolu yadAAookum lituminoo birabbikum waqad akhatha meethaqakum in kuntum mumineena

t: It is He who sends down upon His Servant [Muhammad] verses of clear evidence that He may bring you out from darknesses into the light. And indeed, God is to you Kind and Merciful.
tr: Huwa allathee yunazzilu AAala AAabdihi ayatin bayyinatin liyukhrijakum mina alththulumati ila alnnoori wainna Allaha bikum laraoofun raheemun

t: And why do you not spend in the cause of God while to God belongs the heritage of the heavens and the earth? Not equal among you are those who spent before the conquest [of Makkah] and fought [and those who did so after it]. Those are greater in degree than they who spent afterwards and fought. But to all God has promised the best [reward]. And God, with what you do, is Acquainted.
tr: Wama lakum alla tunfiqoo fee sabeeli Allahi walillahi meerathu alssamawati waalardi la yastawee minkum man anfaqa min qabli alfathi waqatala olaika aAAthamu darajatan mina allatheena anfaqoo min baAAdu waqataloo wakullan waAAada Allahu alhusna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun

t: Who is it that would loan God a goodly loan so He will multiply it for him and he will have a noble reward?
tr: Man tha allathee yuqridu Allaha qardan hasanan fayudaAAifahu lahu walahu ajrun kareemun

t: On the Day you see the believing men and believing women, their light proceeding before them and on their right, [it will be said], “Your good tidings today are [of] gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein you will abide eternally.” That is what is the great attainment.
tr: Yawma tara almumineena waalmuminati yasAAa nooruhum bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim bushrakumu alyawma jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha thalika huwa alfawzu alAAatheemu

t: On the [same] Day the hypocrite men and hypocrite women will say to those who believed, “Wait for us that we may acquire some of your light.” It will be said, “Go back behind you and seek light.” And a wall will be placed between them with a door, its interior containing mercy, but on the outside of it is torment.
tr: Yawma yaqoolu almunafiqoona waalmunafiqatu lillatheena amanoo onthuroona naqtabis min noorikum qeela irjiAAoo waraakum failtamisoo nooran faduriba baynahum bisoorin lahu babun batinuhu feehi alrrahmatu wathahiruhu min qibalihi alAAathabu

t: They [i.e., the hypocrites] will call to them [i.e., the Believers], “Were we not with you?” They will say, “Yes, but you afflicted yourselves and awaited [misfortune for us] and doubted, and wishful thinking deluded you until there came the command of God. And the Deceiver [i.e., Satan] deceived you concerning God.
tr: Yunadoonahum alam nakun maAAakum qaloo bala walakinnakum fatantum anfusakum watarabbastum wairtabtum wagharratkumu alamaniyyu hatta jaa amru Allahi wagharrakum biAllahi algharooru

t: So today no ransom will be taken from you or from those who disbelieved. Your refuge is the Fire. It is most worthy of you, and wretched is the destination.
tr: Faalyawma la yukhathu minkum fidyatun wala mina allatheena kafaroo mawakumu alnnaru hiya mawlakum wabisa almaseeru

t: Has the time not come for those who have believed that their hearts should become humbly submissive at the remembrance of God and what has come down of the truth? And let them not be like those who were given the Book before, and a long period passed over them, so their hearts hardened; and many of them are defiantly disobedient.
tr: Alam yani lillatheena amanoo an takhshaAAa quloobuhum lithikri Allahi wama nazala mina alhaqqi wala yakoonoo kaallatheena ootoo alkitaba min qablu fatala AAalayhimu alamadu faqasat quloobuhum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona

t: Know that God gives life to the earth after its lifelessness. We have made clear to you the signs; perhaps you will understand.
tr: IAAlamoo anna Allaha yuhyee alarda baAAda mawtiha qad bayyanna lakumu alayati laAAallakum taAAqiloona

t: Indeed, the men who practice charity and the women who practice charity and [they who] have loaned God a goodly loan - it will be multiplied for them, and they will have a noble reward.
tr: Inna almussaddiqeena waalmussaddiqati waaqradoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAafu lahum walahum ajrun kareemun

t: And those who have believed in God and His messengers - those are [in the ranks of] the supporters of truth and the martyrs, with their Lord. For them is their reward and their light. But those who have disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of Hellfire.
tr: Waallatheena amanoo biAllahi warusulihi olaika humu alssiddeeqoona waalshshuhadao AAinda rabbihim lahum ajruhum wanooruhum waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu aljaheemi

t: Know that the life of this world is but amusement and diversion and adornment and boasting to one another and competition in increase of wealth and children - like the example of a rain whose [resulting] plant growth pleases the tillers; then it dries and you see it turned yellow; then it becomes [scattered] debris. And in the Hereafter is severe punishment and forgiveness from God and [His] pleasure. And what is the worldly life except the enjoyment of delusion.
tr: IAAlamoo annama alhayatu alddunya laAAibun walahwun wazeenatun watafakhurun baynakum watakathurun fee alamwali waalawladi kamathali ghaythin aAAjaba alkuffara nabatuhu thumma yaheeju fatarahu musfarran thumma yakoonu hutaman wafee alakhirati AAathabun shadeedun wamaghfiratun mina Allahi waridwanun wama alhayatu alddunya illa mataAAu alghuroori

t: Race [i.e., compete] toward forgiveness from your Lord and a Garden whose width is like the width of the heavens and earth, prepared for those who believed in God and His messengers. That is the bounty of God which He gives to whom He wills, and God is the possessor of great bounty.
tr: Sabiqoo ila maghfiratin min rabbikum wajannatin AAarduha kaAAardi alssamai waalardi oAAiddat lillatheena amanoo biAllahi warusulihi thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi

t: No disaster strikes upon the earth or among yourselves except that it is in a register before We bring it into being - indeed that, for God, is easy –
tr: Ma asaba min museebatin fee alardi wala fee anfusikum illa fee kitabin min qabli an nabraaha inna thalika AAala Allahi yaseerun

t: In order that you not despair over what has eluded you and not exult [in pride] over what He has given you. And God does not like everyone self-deluded and boastful -
tr: Likayla tasaw AAala ma fatakum wala tafrahoo bima atakum waAllahu la yuhibbu kulla mukhtalin fakhoorin

t: [Those] who are stingy and enjoin upon people stinginess. And whoever turns away - then indeed, God is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
tr: Allatheena yabkhaloona wayamuroona alnnasa bialbukhli waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghaniyyu alhameedu

t: We have already sent Our messengers with clear evidences and sent down with them the Book and the balance that the people may maintain [their affairs] in justice. And We sent down [i.e., created] iron, wherein is great military might and benefits for the people, and so that God may make evident those who support Him and His messengers unseen. Indeed, God is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
tr: Laqad arsalna rusulana bialbayyinati waanzalna maAAahumu alkitaba waalmeezana liyaqooma alnnasu bialqisti waanzalna alhadeeda feehi basun shadeedun wamanafiAAu lilnnasi waliyaAAlama Allahu man yansuruhu warusulahu bialghaybi inna Allaha qawiyyun AAazeezun

t: And We have already sent Noah and Abraham and placed in their descendants prophethood and the Book; and among them is he who is guided, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
tr: Walaqad arsalna noohan waibraheema wajaAAalna fee thurriyyatihima alnnubuwwata waalkitaba faminhum muhtadin wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona

t: Then We sent in succession on their footsteps Our messengers, and We followed [them] with Jesus, the son of Mary, and gave him the Gospel. And We placed in the hearts of those who followed him compassion and mercy and monasticism, which they innovated; We did not prescribe it for them except [that they did so] seeking the pleasure of God. But they did not observe it with due observance. So We gave the ones who believed among them their reward, but many of them are defiantly disobedient.
tr: Thumma qaffayna AAala atharihim birusulina waqaffayna biAAeesa ibni maryama waataynahu alinjeela wajaAAalna fee quloobi allatheena ittabaAAoohu rafatan warahmatan warahbaniyyatan ibtadaAAooha ma katabnaha AAalayhim illa ibtighaa ridwani Allahi fama raAAawha haqqa riAAayatiha faatayna allatheena amanoo minhum ajrahum wakatheerun minhum fasiqoona

t: O you who have believed, fear God and believe in His Messenger; He will [then] give you a double portion of His mercy and make for you a light by which you will walk and forgive you; and God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waaminoo birasoolihi yutikum kiflayni min rahmatihi wayajAAal lakum nooran tamshoona bihi wayaghfir lakum waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

t: [This is] so that the People of the Book may know that they are not able [to obtain] anything from the bounty of God and that [all] bounty is in the hand of God; He gives it to whom He wills. And God is the possessor of great bounty.
tr: Lialla yaAAlama ahlu alkitabi alla yaqdiroona AAala shayin min fadli Allahi waanna alfadla biyadi Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi

t: Certainly has God heard the speech of the one who argues with you, [O Muhammad], concerning her husband and directs her complaint to God. And God hears your dialogue; indeed, God is Hearing and Seeing.
tr: Qad samiAAa Allahu qawla allatee tujadiluka fee zawjiha watashtakee ila Allahi waAllahu yasmaAAu tahawurakuma inna Allaha sameeAAun baseerun

t: Those who pronounce thihār among you [to separate] from their wives - they are not [consequently] their mothers. Their mothers are none but those who gave birth to them. And indeed, what they say is detestable and false. But indeed, God is Pardoning and Forgiving.
tr: Allatheena yuthahiroona minkum min nisaihim ma hunna ommahatihim in ommahatuhum illa allaee waladnahum wainnahum layaqooloona munkaran mina alqawli wazooran wainna Allaha laAAafuwwun ghafoorun

t: And those who pronounce thihār from their wives and then [wish to] go back on what they said - then [there must be] the freeing of a slave before they touch one another. That is what you are admonished thereby; and God is Acquainted with what you do.
tr: Waallatheena yuthahiroona min nisaihim thumma yaAAoodoona lima qaloo fatahreeru raqabatin min qabli an yatamassa thalikum tooAAathoona bihi waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun

t: And he who does not find [a slave] then a fast for two months consecutively before they touch one another; and he who is unable - then the feeding of sixty poor persons. This is so you would believe in God and His Messenger; and those are the limits [set by] God. And for the disbelievers is a painful punishment.
tr: Faman lam yajid fasiyamu shahrayni mutatabiAAayni min qabli an yatamassa faman lam yastatiAA faitAAamu sitteena miskeenan thalika lituminoo biAllahi warasoolihi watilka hudoodu Allahi walilkafireena AAathabun aleemun

t: Indeed, those who oppose God and His Messenger are abased as those before them were abased. And We have certainly sent down verses of clear evidence. And for the disbelievers is a humiliating punishment.
tr: Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu kubitoo kama kubita allatheena min qablihim waqad anzalna ayatin bayyinatin walilkafireena AAathabun muheenun

t: On the Day when God will resurrect them all and inform them of what they did. God had enumerated it, while they forgot it; and God is, over all things, Witness.
tr: Yawma yabAAathuhumu Allahu jameeAAan fayunabbiohum bima AAamiloo ahsahu Allahu wanasoohu waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

t: Have you not considered that God knows what is in the heavens and what is on the earth? There is in no private conversation three but that He is the fourth of them, nor are there five but that He is the sixth of them - and no less than that and no more except that He is with them [in knowledge] wherever they are. Then He will inform them of what they did, on the Day of Resurrection. Indeed God is, of all things, Knowing.
tr: Alam tara anna Allaha yaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi ma yakoonu min najwa thalathatin illa huwa rabiAAuhum wala khamsatin illa huwa sadisuhum wala adna min thalika wala akthara illa huwa maAAahum ayna ma kanoo thumma yunabbiohum bima AAamiloo yawma alqiyamati inna Allaha bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: Have you not considered those who were forbidden from secret conversations, then they return to that which they were forbidden and converse among themselves about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger? And when they come to you, they greet you with that [word] by which God does not greet you and say among themselves, “Why does God not punish us for what we say?” Sufficient for them is Hell, which they will [enter to] burn, and wretched is the destination.
tr: Alam tara ila allatheena nuhoo AAani alnnajwa thumma yaAAoodoona lima nuhoo AAanhu wayatanajawna bialithmi waalAAudwani wamaAAsiyati alrrasooli waitha jaooka hayyawka bima lam yuhayyika bihi Allahu wayaqooloona fee anfusihim lawla yuAAaththibuna Allahu bima naqoolu hasbuhum jahannamu yaslawnaha fabisa almaseeru

t: O you who have believed, when you talk secretly, do not speak about sin and aggression and disobedience to the Messenger but converse about righteousness and piety. And fear God, to whom you will be gathered.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha tanajaytum fala tatanajaw bialithmi waalAAudwani wamaAAsiyati alrrasooli watanajaw bialbirri waalttaqwa waittaqoo Allaha allathee ilayhi tuhsharoona

t: Secret conversation is only from Satan that he may grieve those who have believed, but he will not harm them at all except by permission of God. And upon God let the Believers rely.
tr: Innama alnnajwa mina alshshaytani liyahzuna allatheena amanoo walaysa bidarrihim shayan illa biithni Allahi waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona

t: O you who have believed, when you are told, “Space yourselves” in assemblies, then make space; God will make space for you. And when you are told, “Arise,” then arise; God will raise those who have believed among you and those who were given knowledge, by degrees. And God is Acquainted with what you do.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha qeela lakum tafassahoo fee almajalisi faifsahoo yafsahi Allahu lakum waitha qeela onshuzoo faonshuzoo yarfaAAi Allahu allatheena amanoo minkum waallatheena ootoo alAAilma darajatin waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun

t: O you who have believed, when you [wish to] privately consult the Messenger, present before your consultation a charity. That is better for you and purer. But if you find not [the means] - then indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha najaytumu alrrasoola faqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatan thalika khayrun lakum waatharu fain lam tajidoo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: Are you worried to give charity in advance before your private consultation? Since you did not, and God has forgiven you, then [at least] establish prayer and give zakāh and obey God and His Messenger. And God is Acquainted with what you do.
tr: Aashfaqtum an tuqaddimoo bayna yaday najwakum sadaqatin faith lam tafAAaloo wataba Allahu AAalaykum faaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waateeAAoo Allaha warasoolahu waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona

t: Have you not considered those who make allies of a people with whom God has become angry? They are neither of you nor of them, and they swear to untruth while they know [they are lying].
tr: Alam tara ila allatheena tawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu AAalayhim ma hum minkum wala minhum wayahlifoona AAala alkathibi wahum yaAAlamoona

t: God has prepared for them a severe punishment. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
tr: aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: They took their [false] oaths as a cover, so they prevented [people] from the way of God, and for them is a humiliating punishment.
tr: Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi falahum AAathabun muheenun

t: Never will their wealth or their children avail them against God at all. Those are the companions of the Fire; they will abide therein eternally
tr: Lan tughniya AAanhum amwaluhum wala awladuhum mina Allahi shayan olaika ashabu alnnari hum feeha khalidoona

t: On the Day God will resurrect them all, and they will swear to Him as they swear to you and think that they are [standing] on something. Surely, it is they who are the liars.
tr: Yawma yabAAathuhumu Allahu jameeAAan fayahlifoona lahu kama yahlifoona lakum wayahsaboona annahum AAala shayin ala innahum humu alkathiboona

t: Satan has gained control over them, so he made them forget the remembrance of God. Those are the party of Satan. Surely, the party of Satan - they will be the losers.
tr: Istahwatha AAalayhimu alshshaytanu faansahum thikra Allahi olaika hizbu alshshaytani ala inna hizba alshshaytani humu alkhasiroona

t: Indeed, the ones who oppose God and His Messenger - those will be among the most humiliated.
tr: Inna allatheena yuhaddoona Allaha warasoolahu olaika fee alathalleena

t: God has written [i.e., decreed], “I will surely prevail, I and My messengers.” Indeed, God is Powerful and Exalted in Might.
tr: Kataba Allahu laaghlibanna ana warusulee inna Allaha qawiyyun AAazeezun

t: You will not find a people who believe in God and the Last Day having affection for those who oppose God and His Messenger, even if they were their fathers or their sons or their brothers or their kindred. Those - He has decreed within their hearts faith and supported them with spirit from Him. And We will admit them to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they abide eternally. God is pleased with them, and they are pleased with Him - those are the party of God. Surely, the party of God - they are the successful.
tr: La tajidu qawman yuminoona biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri yuwaddoona man hadda Allaha warasoolahu walaw kanoo abaahum aw abnaahum aw ikhwanahum aw AAasheeratahum olaika kataba fee quloobihimu aleemana waayyadahum biroohin minhu wayudkhiluhum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu olaika hizbu Allahi ala inna hizba Allahi humu almuflihoona

t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts God, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: It is He who expelled the ones who disbelieved among the People of the Book from their homes at the first gathering. You did not think they would leave, and they thought that their fortresses would protect them from God; but [the decree of] God came upon them from where they had not expected, and He cast terror into their hearts [so] they destroyed their houses by their [own] hands and the hands of the Believers. So take warning, O people of vision.
tr: Huwa allathee akhraja allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi min diyarihim liawwali alhashri ma thanantum an yakhrujoo wathannoo annahum maniAAatuhum husoonuhum mina Allahi faatahumu Allahu min haythu lam yahtasiboo waqathafa fee quloobihimu alrruAAba yukhriboona buyootahum biaydeehim waaydee almumineena faiAAtabiroo ya olee alabsari

t: And if not that God had decreed for them exile, He would have punished them in this world, and for them in the Hereafter is the punishment of the Fire.
tr: Walawla an kataba Allahu AAalayhimu aljalaa laAAaththabahum fee alddunya walahum fee alakhirati AAathabu alnnari

t: That is because they opposed God and His Messenger. And whoever opposes God - then indeed, God is severe in retribution.
tr: Thalika biannahum shaqqoo Allaha warasoolahu waman yushaqqi Allaha fainna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi

t: Whatever you have cut down of [their] palm trees or left standing on their trunks - it was by permission of God and so He would disgrace the defiantly disobedient.
tr: Ma qataAAtum min leenatin aw taraktumooha qaimatan AAala osooliha fabiithni Allahi waliyukhziya alfasiqeena

t: And what God restored [of property] to His Messenger from them - you did not spur for it [in an expedition] any horses or camels, but God gives His messengers power over whom He wills, and God is over all things competent.
tr: Wama afaa Allahu AAala rasoolihi minhum fama awjaftum AAalayhi min khaylin wala rikabin walakinna Allaha yusallitu rusulahu AAala man yashao waAllahu AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: And what God restored to His Messenger from the people of the towns - it is for God and for the Messenger and for [his] near relatives and orphans and the [stranded] traveller - so that it will not be a perpetual distribution among the rich from among you. And whatever the Messenger has given you take; and what he has forbidden you refrain from. And fear God; indeed, God is severe in retribution.
tr: Ma afaa Allahu AAala rasoolihi min ahli alqura falillahi walilrrasooli walithee alqurba waalyatama waalmasakeeni waibni alssabeeli kay la yakoona doolatan bayna alaghniyai minkum wama atakumu alrrasoolu fakhuthoohu wama nahakum AAanhu faintahoo waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha shadeedu alAAiqabi

t: For the poor emigrants who were expelled from their homes and their properties, seeking bounty from God and [His] pleasure and supporting God and His Messenger, [there is also a share]. Those are the truthful.
tr: Lilfuqarai almuhajireena allatheena okhrijoo min diyarihim waamwalihim yabtaghoona fadlan mina Allahi waridwanan wayansuroona Allaha warasoolahu olaika humu alssadiqoona

t: And [also for] those who were settled in the home [i.e., al-Madīnah] and [adopted] the faith before them. They love those who emigrated to them and find not any want in their breasts of what they [i.e., the emigrants] were given but give [them] preference over themselves, even though they are in privation. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
tr: Waallatheena tabawwaoo alddara waaleemana min qablihim yuhibboona man hajara ilayhim wala yajidoona fee sudoorihim hajatan mimma ootoo wayuthiroona AAala anfusihim walaw kana bihim khasasatun waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona

t: And [there is a share for] those who came after them, saying, “Our Lord, forgive us and our brothers who preceded us in faith and put not in our hearts [any] resentment toward those who have believed. Our Lord, indeed You are Kind and Merciful.”
tr: Waallatheena jaoo min baAAdihim yaqooloona rabbana ighfir lana waliikhwanina allatheena sabaqoona bialeemani wala tajAAal fee quloobina ghillan lillatheena amanoo rabbana innaka raoofun raheemun

t: Have you not considered those who practice hypocrisy, saying to their brothers [i.e., associates] who have disbelieved among the People of the Book, “If you are expelled, we will surely leave with you, and we will not obey, in regard to you, anyone - ever; and if you are fought, we will surely aid you.” But God testifies that they are liars.
tr: Alam tara ila allatheena nafaqoo yaqooloona liikhwanihimu allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi lain okhrijtum lanakhrujanna maAAakum wala nuteeAAu feekum ahadan abadan wain qootiltum lanansurannakum waAllahu yashhadu innahum lakathiboona

t: If they are expelled, they will not leave with them, and if they are fought, they will not aid them. And [even] if they should aid them, they will surely turn their backs; then [thereafter] they will not be helped.
tr: Lain okhrijoo la yakhrujoona maAAahum walain qootiloo la yansuroonahum walain nasaroohum layuwallunna aladbara thumma la yunsaroona

t: You [Believers] are more feared within their breasts than God. That is because they are a people who do not understand.
tr: Laantum ashaddu rahbatan fee sudoorihim mina Allahi thalika biannahum qawmun la yafqahoona

t: They will not fight you all except within fortified cities or from behind walls. Their violence [i.e., enmity] among themselves is severe. You think they are together, but their hearts are diverse. That is because they are a people who do not reason.
tr: La yuqatiloonakum jameeAAan illa fee quran muhassanatin aw min warai judurin basuhum baynahum shadeedun tahsabuhum jameeAAan waquloobuhum shatta thalika biannahum qawmun la yaAAqiloona

t: [Theirs is] like the example of those shortly before them: they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
tr: Kamathali allatheena min qablihim qareeban thaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun

t: [The hypocrites are] like the example of Satan when he says to the human being, “Disbelieve.” But when he disbelieves, he says, “Indeed, I am disassociated from you. Indeed, I fear God, Lord of the worlds.”
tr: Kamathali alshshaytani ith qala lilinsani okfur falamma kafara qala innee bareeon minka innee akhafu Allaha rabba alAAalameena

t: So the outcome for both of them is that they will be in the Fire, abiding eternally therein. And that is the recompense of the wrongdoers.
tr: Fakana AAaqibatahuma annahuma fee alnnari khalidayni feeha wathalika jazao alththalimeena

t: O you who have believed, fear God. And let every soul look to what it has put forth for tomorrow - and fear God. Indeed, God is Acquainted with what you do.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo ittaqoo Allaha waltanthur nafsun ma qaddamat lighadin waittaqoo Allaha inna Allaha khabeerun bima taAAmaloona

t: And be not like those who forgot God, so He made them forget themselves. Those are the defiantly disobedient.
tr: Wala takoonoo kaallatheena nasoo Allaha faansahum anfusahum olaika humu alfasiqoona

t: Not equal are the companions of the Fire and the companions of Paradise. The companions of Paradise - they are the attainers [of success].
tr: La yastawee ashabu alnnari waashabu aljannati ashabu aljannati humu alfaizoona

t: If We had sent down this Qur’ān upon a mountain, you would have seen it humbled and split asunder from fear of God. And these examples We present to the people that perhaps they will give thought.
tr: Law anzalna hatha alqurana AAala jabalin laraaytahu khashiAAan mutasaddiAAan min khashyati Allahi watilka alamthalu nadribuha lilnnasi laAAallahum yatafakkaroona

t: He is God, other than whom there is no deity, Knower of the unseen and the witnessed. He is the Most Compassionate, the Most Merciful.
tr: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati huwa alrrahmanu alrraheemu

t: He is God, other than whom there is no deity, the Sovereign, the Holy, the All- Perfect, the Granter of Security, the Overseer, the Exalted in Might, the Compeller, the Superior. Exalted is God above whatever they associate with Him.
tr: Huwa Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa almaliku alquddoosu alssalamu almuminu almuhayminu alAAazeezu aljabbaru almutakabbiru subhana Allahi AAamma yushrikoona

t: He is God, the Creator, the Inventor, the Fashioner; to Him belong the best names. Whatever is in the heavens and earth is exalting Him. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Huwa Allahu alkhaliqu albario almusawwiru lahu alasmao alhusna yusabbihu lahu ma fee alssamawati waalardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: O you who have believed, do not take My enemies and your enemies as allies, extending to them affection while they have disbelieved in what came to you of the truth, having driven out the Prophet and yourselves [only] because you believe in God, your Lord. If you have come out for jihād [i.e., fighting or striving] in My cause and seeking means to My pleasure, [take them not as friends]. You secretly have love for them, but I am most knowing of what you have concealed and what you have declared. And whoever does it among you has certainly strayed from the soundness of the way.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tattakhithoo AAaduwwee waAAaduwwakum awliyaa tulqoona ilayhim bialmawaddati waqad kafaroo bima jaakum mina alhaqqi yukhrijoona alrrasoola waiyyakum an tuminoo biAllahi rabbikum in kuntum kharajtum jihadan fee sabeelee waibtighaa mardatee tusirroona ilayhim bialmawaddati waana aAAlamu bima akhfaytum wama aAAlantum waman yafAAalhu minkum faqad dalla sawaa alssabeeli

t: If they gain dominance over you, they would be [i.e., behave] to you as enemies and extend against you their hands and their tongues with evil, and they wish you would disbelieve.
tr: In yathqafookum yakoonoo lakam aAAdaan wayabsutoo ilaykum aydiyahum waalsinatahum bialssooi wawaddoo law takfuroona

t: Never will your relatives or your children benefit you; the Day of Resurrection He will judge between you. And God, of what you do, is Seeing.
tr: Lan tanfaAAakum arhamukum wala awladukum yawma alqiyamati yafsilu baynakum waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun

t: There has already been for you an excellent model in Abraham and those with him, when they said to their people, “Indeed, we are disassociated from you and from whatever you worship other than God. We have denied you, and there has appeared between us and you animosity and hatred forever until you believe in God alone,” - except for the saying of Abraham to his father, “I will surely ask forgiveness for you, but I have not [power to do] for you anything against God. Our Lord, upon You we have relied, and to You we have returned, and to You is the destination.
tr: Qad kanat lakum oswatun hasanatun fee ibraheema waallatheena maAAahu ith qaloo liqawmihim inna buraao minkum wamimma taAAbudoona min dooni Allahi kafarna bikum wabada baynana wabaynakumu alAAadawatu waalbaghdao abadan hatta tuminoo biAllahi wahdahu illa qawla ibraheema liabeehi laastaghfiranna laka wama amliku laka mina Allahi min shayin rabbana AAalayka tawakkalna wailayka anabna wailayka almaseeru

t: Our Lord, make us not [objects of] torment for the disbelievers and forgive us, our Lord. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.”
tr: Rabbana la tajAAalna fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo waighfir lana rabbana innaka anta alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: There has certainly been for you in them an excellent model for anyone whose hope is in God and the Last Day. And whoever turns away - then indeed, God is the Free of need, the Praiseworthy.
tr: Laqad kana lakum feehim oswatun hasanatun liman kana yarjoo Allaha waalyawma alakhira waman yatawalla fainna Allaha huwa alghanniyyu alhameedu

t: Perhaps God will put, between you and those to whom you have been enemies among them, affection. And God is competent, and God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: AAasa Allahu an yajAAala baynakum wabayna allatheena AAadaytum minhum mawaddatan waAllahu qadeerun waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun

t: God does not forbid you from those who do not fight you because of religion and do not expel you from your homes - from being righteous toward them and acting justly toward them. Indeed, God loves those who act justly.
tr: La yanhakumu Allahu AAani allatheena lam yuqatilookum fee alddeeni walam yukhrijookum min diyarikum an tabarroohum watuqsitoo ilayhim inna Allaha yuhibbu almuqsiteena

t: God only forbids you from those who fight you because of religion and expel you from your homes and aid in your expulsion - [forbids] that you make allies of them. And whoever makes allies of them, then it is those who are the wrongdoers.
tr: Innama yanhakumu Allahu AAani allatheena qatalookum fee alddeeni waakhrajookum min diyarikum wathaharoo AAala ikhrajikum an tawallawhum waman yatawallahum faolaika humu alththalimoona

t: O you who have believed, when the believing women come to you as emigrants, examine [i.e., test] them. God is most knowing as to their faith. And if you know them to be Believers, then do not return them to the disbelievers; they are not lawful [wives] for them, nor are they lawful [husbands] for them. But give them [i.e., the disbelievers] what they have spent. And there is no blame upon you if you marry them when you have given them their due compensation [i.e., mahr]. And hold not to marriage bonds with disbelieving women, but ask for what you have spent and let them [i.e., the disbelievers] ask for what they have spent. That is the judgement of God; He judges between you. And God is Knowing and Wise.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha jaakumu almuminatu muhajiratin faimtahinoohunna Allahu aAAlamu bieemanihinna fain AAalimtumoohunna muminatin fala tarjiAAoohunna ila alkuffari la hunna hillun lahum wala hum yahilloona lahunna waatoohum ma anfaqoo wala junaha AAalaykum an tankihoohunna itha ataytumoohunna ojoorahunna wala tumsikoo biAAisami alkawafiri waisaloo ma anfaqtum walyasaloo ma anfaqoo thalikum hukmu Allahi yahkumu baynakum waAllahu AAaleemun hakeemun

t: And if you have lost any of your wives to the disbelievers and you subsequently obtain [something], then give those whose wives have gone the equivalent of what they had spent. And fear God, in whom you are Believers.
tr: Wain fatakum shayon min azwajikum ila alkuffari faAAaqabtum faatoo allatheena thahabat azwajuhum mithla ma anfaqoo waittaqoo Allaha allathee antum bihi muminoona

t: O Prophet, when the believing women come to you pledging to you that they will not associate anything with God, nor will they steal, nor will they commit unlawful sexual intercourse, nor will they kill their children, nor will they bring forth a slander they have invented between their arms and legs, nor will they disobey you in what is right - then accept their pledge and ask forgiveness for them of God. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha jaaka almuminatu yubayiAAnaka AAala an la yushrikna biAllahi shayan wala yasriqna wala yazneena wala yaqtulna awladahunna wala yateena bibuhtanin yaftareenahu bayna aydeehinna waarjulihinna wala yaAAseenaka fee maAAroofin fabayiAAhunna waistaghfir lahunna Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: O you who have believed, do not make allies of a people with whom God has become angry. They have despaired of the Hereafter just as the disbelievers have despaired of the companions of the graves.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tatawallaw qawman ghadiba Allahu AAalayhim qad yaisoo mina alakhirati kama yaisa alkuffaru min ashabi alquboori

t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth exalts God, and He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Sabbaha lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: O you who have believed, why do you say what you do not do?
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo lima taqooloona ma la tafAAaloona

t: It is most hateful in the sight of God that you say what you do not do.
tr: Kabura maqtan AAinda Allahi an taqooloo ma la tafAAaloona

t: Indeed, God loves those who fight in His cause in a row as though they are a [single] structure joined firmly.
tr: Inna Allaha yuhibbu allatheena yuqatiloona fee sabeelihi saffan kaannahum bunyanun marsoosun

t: And [mention, O Muhammad], when Moses said to his people, “O my people, why do you harm me while you certainly know that I am the messenger of God to you?” And when they deviated, God caused their hearts to deviate. And God does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
tr: Waith qala moosa liqawmihi ya qawmi lima tuthoonanee waqad taAAlamoona annee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum falamma zaghoo azagha Allahu quloobahum waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena

t: And [mention] when Jesus, the son of Mary, said, “O children of Israel, indeed I am the messenger of God to you confirming what came before me of the Torah and bringing good tidings of a messenger to come after me, whose name is Ahmad.” But when he came to them with clear evidences, they said, “This is obvious magic.”
tr: Waith qala AAeesa ibnu maryama ya banee israeela innee rasoolu Allahi ilaykum musaddiqan lima bayna yadayya mina alttawrati wamubashshiran birasoolin yatee min baAAdee ismuhu ahmadu falamma jaahum bialbayyinati qaloo hatha sihrun mubeenun

t: And who is more unjust than one who invents about God untruth while he is being invited to Islām. And God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
tr: Waman athlamu mimmani iftara AAala Allahi alkathiba wahuwa yudAAa ila alislami waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena

t: They want to extinguish the light of God with their mouths, but God will perfect His light, although the disbelievers dislike it.
tr: Yureedoona liyutfioo noora Allahi biafwahihim waAllahu mutimmu noorihi walaw kariha alkafiroona

t: It is He who sent His Messenger with guidance and the religion of truth to manifest it over all religion, although those who associate others with God dislike it.
tr: Huwa allathee arsala rasoolahu bialhuda wadeeni alhaqqi liyuthhirahu AAala alddeeni kullihi walaw kariha almushrikoona

t: O you who have believed, shall I guide you to a transaction that will save you from a painful punishment?
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo hal adullukum AAala tijaratin tunjeekum min AAathabin aleemin

t: [It is that] you believe in God and His Messenger and strive in the cause of God with your wealth and your lives. That is best for you, if you should know.
tr: Tuminoona biAllahi warasoolihi watujahidoona fee sabeeli Allahi biamwalikum waanfusikum thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona

t: He will forgive for you your sins and admit you to gardens beneath which rivers flow and pleasant dwellings in gardens of perpetual residence. That is the great attainment.
tr: Yaghfir lakum thunoobakum wayudkhilkum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu wamasakina tayyibatan fee jannati AAadnin thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu

t: And [you will obtain] another [favour] that you love - victory from God and an imminent conquest; and give good tidings to the Believers.
tr: Waokhra tuhibboonaha nasrun mina Allahi wafathun qarreebun wabashshiri almumineena

t: O you who have believed, be supporters of God, as when Jesus, the son of Mary, said to the disciples, “Who are my supporters for God?” The disciples said, “We are supporters of God.” And a faction of the Children of Israel believed and a faction disbelieved. So We supported those who believed against their enemy, and they became dominant.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo koonoo ansara Allahi kama qala AAeesa ibnu maryama lilhawariyyeena man ansaree ila Allahi qala alhawariyyoona nahnu ansaru Allahi faamanat taifatun min banee israeela wakafarat taifatun faayyadna allatheena amanoo AAala AAaduwwihim faasbahoo thahireena

t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting God, the Sovereign, the Pure, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi almaliki alquddoosi alAAazeezi alhakeemi

t: It is He who has sent among the unlettered a Messenger from themselves reciting to them His verses and purifying them and teaching them the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and wisdom [i.e., the sunnah] - although they were before in clear error -
tr: Huwa allathee baAAatha fee alommiyyeena rasoolan minhum yatloo AAalayhim ayatihi wayuzakkeehim wayuAAallimuhumu alkitaba waalhikmata wain kanoo min qablu lafee dalalin mubeenin

t: And [to] others of them who have not yet joined them. And He is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Waakhareena minhum lamma yalhaqoo bihim wahuwa alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: That is the bounty of God, which He gives to whom He wills, and God is the possessor of great bounty.
tr: Thalika fadlu Allahi yuteehi man yashao waAllahu thoo alfadli alAAatheemi

t: The example of those who were entrusted with the Torah and then did not take it on is like that of a donkey who carries volumes [of books]. Wretched is the example of the people who deny the signs of God. And God does not guide the wrongdoing people.
tr: Mathalu allatheena hummiloo alttawrata thumma lam yahmilooha kamathali alhimari yahmilu asfaran bisa mathalu alqawmi allatheena kaththaboo biayati Allahi waAllahu la yahdee alqawma alththalimeena

t: Say, “O you who are Jews, if you claim that you are allies of God, excluding the [other] people, then wish for death, if you should be truthful.”
tr: Qul ya ayyuha allatheena hadoo in zaAAamtum annakum awliyao lillahi min dooni alnnasi fatamannawoo almawta in kuntum sadiqeena

t: But they will not wish for it, ever, because of what their hands have put forth. And God is Knowing of the wrongdoers.
tr: Wala yatamannawnahu abadan bima qaddamat aydeehim waAllahu AAaleemun bialththalimeena

t: Say, “Indeed, the death from which you flee - indeed, it will meet you. Then you will be returned to the Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, and He will inform you about what you used to do.”
tr: Qul inna almawta allathee tafirroona minhu fainnahu mulaqeekum thumma turaddoona ila AAalimi alghaybi waalshshahadati fayunabbiokum bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t: O you who have believed, when [the adhān] is called for the prayer on the day of Jumu’ah [Friday], then proceed to the remembrance of God and leave trade. That is better for you, if you only knew.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo itha noodiya lilssalati min yawmi aljumuAAati faisAAaw ila thikri Allahi watharoo albayAAa thalikum khayrun lakum in kuntum taAAlamoona

t: And when the prayer has been concluded, disperse within the land and seek from the bounty of God, and remember God often that you may succeed.
tr: Faitha qudiyati alssalatu faintashiroo fee alardi waibtaghoo min fadli Allahi waothkuroo Allaha katheeran laAAallakum tuflihoona

t: But [on one occasion] when they saw a transaction or a diversion, [O Muhammad], they rushed to it and left you standing. Say, “What is with God is better than diversion and trade, and God is the best of providers.”
tr: Waitha raaw tijaratan aw lahwan infaddoo ilayha watarakooka qaiman qul ma AAinda Allahi khayrun mina allahwi wamina alttijarati waAllahu khayru alrraziqeena

t: When the hypocrites come to you, [O Muhammad], they say, “We testify that you are the Messenger of God.” And God knows that you are His Messenger, and God testifies that the hypocrites are liars.
tr: Itha jaaka almunafiqoona qaloo nashhadu innaka larasoolu Allahi waAllahu yaAAlamu innaka larasooluhu waAllahu yashhadu inna almunafiqeena lakathiboona

t: They have taken their oaths as a cover, so they prevented [people] from the way of God. Indeed, it was evil that they were doing.
tr: Ittakhathoo aymanahum junnatan fasaddoo AAan sabeeli Allahi innahum saa ma kanoo yaAAmaloona

t: That is because they believed, and then they disbelieved; so their hearts were sealed over, and they do not understand.
tr: Thalika biannahum amanoo thumma kafaroo fatubiAAa AAala quloobihim fahum la yafqahoona

t: And when you see them, their forms please you, and if they speak, you listen to their speech. [They are] as if they were pieces of wood propped up - they think that every shout is against them. They are the enemy, so beware of them. May God destroy them; how are they deluded?
tr: Waitha raaytahum tuAAjibuka ajsamuhum wain yaqooloo tasmaAA liqawlihim kaannahum khushubun musannadatun yahsaboona kulla sayhatin AAalayhim humu alAAaduwwu faihtharhum qatalahumu Allahu anna yufakoona

t: And when it is said to them, “Come, the Messenger of God will ask forgiveness for you,” they turn their heads aside and you see them evading while they are arrogant.
tr: Waitha qeela lahum taAAalaw yastaghfir lakum rasoolu Allahi lawwaw ruoosahum waraaytahum yasuddoona wahum mustakbiroona

t: It is all the same for them whether you ask forgiveness for them or do not ask forgiveness for them; never will God forgive them. Indeed, God does not guide the defiantly disobedient people.
tr: Sawaon AAalayhim astaghfarta lahum am lam tastaghfir lahum lan yaghfira Allahu lahum inna Allaha la yahdee alqawma alfasiqeena

t: They are the ones who say, “Do not spend on those who are with the Messenger of God until they disband.” And to God belongs the depositories of the heavens and the earth, but the hypocrites do not understand.
tr: Humu allatheena yaqooloona la tunfiqoo AAala man AAinda rasooli Allahi hatta yanfaddoo walillahi khazainu alssamawati waalardi walakinna almunafiqeena la yafqahoona

t: They say, “If we return to al-Madīnah, the more honoured will surely expel therefrom the low [i.e., inferior].” And to God belongs [all] honour, and to His Messenger, and to the Believers, but the hypocrites do not know.
tr: Yaqooloona lain rajaAAna ila almadeenati layukhrijanna alaAAazzu minha alathalla walillahi alAAizzatu walirasoolihi walilmumineena walakinna almunafiqeena la yaAAlamoona

t: O you who have believed, let not your wealth and your children divert you from remembrance of God. And whoever does that - then those are the losers.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo la tulhikum amwalukum wala awladukum AAan thikri Allahi waman yafAAal thalika faolaika humu alkhasiroona

t: And spend [in the way of God] from what We have provided you before death approaches one of you and he says, “My Lord, if only You would delay me for a brief term so I would give charity and be among the righteous.”
tr: Waanfiqoo min ma razaqnakum min qabli an yatiya ahadakumu almawtu fayaqoola rabbi lawla akhkhartanee ila ajalin qareebin faassaddaqa waakun mina alssaliheena

t: But never will God delay a soul when its time has come. And God is Acquainted with what you do.
tr: Walan yuakhkhira Allahu nafsan itha jaa ajaluha waAllahu khabeerun bima taAAmaloona

t: Whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth is exalting God. To Him belongs dominion, and to Him belongs all praise, and He is over all things competent.
tr: Yusabbihu lillahi ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi lahu almulku walahu alhamdu wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: It is He who created you, and among you is the disbeliever, and among you is the Believer. And God, of what you do, is Seeing.
tr: Huwa allathee khalaqakum faminkum kafirun waminkum muminun waAllahu bima taAAmaloona baseerun

t: He created the heavens and earth in truth and formed you and perfected your forms; and to Him is the [final] destination.
tr: Khalaqa alssamawati waalarda bialhaqqi wasawwarakum faahsana suwarakum wailayhi almaseeru

t: He knows what is within the heavens and earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare. And God is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: YaAAlamu ma fee alssamawati waalardi wayaAAlamu ma tusirroona wama tuAAlinoona waAllahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

t: Has there not come to you the news of those who disbelieved before? So they tasted the bad consequence of their affair, and they will have a painful punishment.
tr: Alam yatikum nabao allatheena kafaroo min qablu fathaqoo wabala amrihim walahum AAathabun aleemun

t: That is because their messengers used to come to them with clear evidences, but they said, “Shall human beings guide us?” and disbelieved and turned away. And God dispensed [with them]; and God is Free of need and Praiseworthy.
tr: Thalika biannahu kanat tateehim rusuluhum bialbayyinati faqaloo abasharun yahdoonana fakafaroo watawallaw waistaghna Allahu waAllahu ghaniyyun hameedun

t: Those who disbelieve have claimed that they will never be resurrected. Say, “Yes, by my Lord, you will surely be resurrected; then you will surely be informed of what you did. And that, for God, is easy.”
tr: ZaAAama allatheena kafaroo an lan yubAAathoo qul bala warabbee latubAAathunna thumma latunabbaonna bima AAamiltum wathalika AAala Allahi yaseerun

t: So believe in God and His Messenger and the light [i.e., the Qur’ān] which We have sent down. And God is Acquainted with what you do.
tr: Faaminoo biAllahi warasoolihi waalnnoori allathee anzalna waAllahu bima taAAmaloona khabeerun

t: The Day He will assemble you for the Day of Assembly - that is the Day of Mutual Deprivation. And whoever believes in God and does righteousness - He will remove from him his misdeeds and admit him to gardens beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever. That is the great attainment.
tr: Yawma yajmaAAukum liyawmi aljamAAi thalika yawmu alttaghabuni waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan thalika alfawzu alAAatheemu

t: But the ones who disbelieved and denied Our verses - those are the companions of the Fire, abiding eternally therein; and wretched is the destination.
tr: Waallatheena kafaroo wakaththaboo biayatina olaika ashabu alnnari khalideena feeha wabisa almaseeru

t: No disaster strikes except by permission of God. And whoever believes in God - He will guide his heart. And God is Knowing of all things.
tr: Ma asaba min museebatin illa biithni Allahi waman yumin biAllahi yahdi qalbahu waAllahu bikulli shayin AAaleemun

t: And obey God and obey the Messenger; but if you turn away - then upon Our Messenger is only to convey clearly.
tr: WaateeAAoo Allaha waateeAAoo alrrasoola fain tawallaytum fainnama AAala rasoolina albalaghu almubeenu

t: God - there is no deity except Him. And upon God let the Believers rely.
tr: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa waAAala Allahi falyatawakkali almuminoona

t: O you who have believed, indeed, among your wives and your children are enemies to you, so beware of them. But if you pardon and overlook and forgive - then indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo inna min azwajikum waawladikum AAaduwwan lakum faihtharoohum wain taAAfoo watasfahoo wataghfiroo fainna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: Your wealth and your children are but a trial, and God has with Him a great reward.
tr: Innama amwalukum waawladukum fitnatun waAllahu AAindahu ajrun AAatheemun

t: So fear God as much as you are able and listen and obey and spend [in the way of God]; it is better for your selves. And whoever is protected from the stinginess of his soul - it is those who will be the successful.
tr: Faittaqoo Allaha ma istataAAtum waismaAAoo waateeAAoo waanfiqoo khayran lianfusikum waman yooqa shuhha nafsihi faolaika humu almuflihoona

t: If you loan God a goodly loan, He will multiply it for you and forgive you. And God is Most Appreciative and Forbearing,
tr: In tuqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan yudaAAifhu lakum wayaghfir lakum waAllahu shakoorun haleemun

t: Knower of the unseen and the witnessed, the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: AAalimu alghaybi waalshshahadati alAAazeezu alhakeemu

t: O Prophet, when you [Muslims] divorce women, divorce them for [the commencement of] their waiting period and keep count of the waiting period, and fear God, your Lord. Do not turn them out of their [husbands’] houses, nor should they [themselves] leave [during that period] unless they are committing a clear immorality. And those are the limits [set by] God. And whoever transgresses the limits of God has certainly wronged himself. You know not; perhaps God will bring about after that a [different] matter.
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu itha tallaqtumu alnnisaa fatalliqoohunna liAAiddatihinna waahsoo alAAiddata waittaqoo Allaha rabbakum la tukhrijoohunna min buyootihinna wala yakhrujna illa an yateena bifahishatin mubayyinatin watilka hudoodu Allahi waman yataAAadda hudooda Allahi faqad thalama nafsahu la tadree laAAalla Allaha yuhdithu baAAda thalika amran

t: And when they have [nearly] fulfilled their term, either retain them according to acceptable terms or part with them according to acceptable terms. And bring to witness two just men from among you and establish the testimony for [the acceptance of] God. That is instructed to whoever should believe in God and the Last day. And whoever fears God - He will make for him a way out
tr: Faitha balaghna ajalahunna faamsikoohunna bimaAAroofin aw fariqoohunna bimaAAroofin waashhidoo thaway AAadlin minkum waaqeemoo alshshahadata lillahi thalikum yooAAathu bihi man kana yuminu biAllahi waalyawmi alakhiri waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu makhrajan

t: And will provide for him from where he does not expect. And whoever relies upon God - then He is sufficient for him. Indeed, God will accomplish His purpose. God has already set for everything a [decreed] extent.
tr: Wayarzuqhu min haythu la yahtasibu waman yatawakkal AAala Allahi fahuwa hasbuhu inna Allaha balighu amrihi qad jaAAala Allahu likulli shayin qadran

t: And those who no longer expect menstruation among your women - if months, and [also for] those who have not menstruated. And for those who are pregnant, their term is until they give birth. And whoever fears God - He will make for him of his matter ease.
tr: Waallaee yaisna mina almaheedi min nisaikum ini irtabtum faAAiddatuhunna thalathatu ashhurin waallaee lam yahidna waolatu alahmali ajaluhunna an yadaAAna hamlahunna waman yattaqi Allaha yajAAal lahu min amrihi yusran

t: That is the command of God, which He has sent down to you; and whoever fears God - He will remove for him his misdeeds and make great for him his reward.
tr: Thalika amru Allahi anzalahu ilaykum waman yattaqi Allaha yukaffir AAanhu sayyiatihi wayuAAthim lahu ajran

t: Lodge them [in a section] of where you dwell out of your means and do not harm them in order to oppress them. And if they should be pregnant, then spend on them until they give birth. And if they breastfeed for you, then give them their payment and confer among yourselves in the acceptable way; but if you are in discord, then there may breastfeed for him [i.e., the father] another woman.
tr: Askinoohunna min haythu sakantum min wujdikum wala tudarroohunna litudayyiqoo AAalayhinna wain kunna olati hamlin faanfiqoo AAalayhinna hatta yadaAAna hamlahunna fain ardaAAna lakum faatoohunna ojoorahunna watamiroo baynakum bimaAAroofin wain taAAasartum fasaturdiAAu lahu okhra

t: Let a man of wealth spend from his wealth, and he whose provision is limited - let him spend from what God has given him. God does not burden any soul except [according to] what He has given it. God will bring about, after hardship, ease [i.e., relief].
tr: Liyunfiq thoo saAAatin min saAAatihi waman qudira AAalayhi rizquhu falyunfiq mimma atahu Allahu la yukallifu Allahu nafsan illa ma ataha sayajAAalu Allahu baAAda AAusrin yusran

t: And how many a city was insolent toward the command of its Lord and His messengers, so We took it to severe account and punished it with a terrible punishment.
tr: Wakaayyin min qaryatin AAatat AAan amri rabbiha warusulihi fahasabnaha hisaban shadeedan waAAaththabnaha AAathaban nukran

t: And it tasted the bad consequence of its affair [i.e., rebellion], and the outcome of its affair was loss.
tr: Fathaqat wabala amriha wakana AAaqibatu amriha khusran

t: God has prepared for them a severe punishment; so fear God, O you of understanding who have believed. God has sent down to you a Reminder [i.e., the Qur’ān].
tr: aAAadda Allahu lahum AAathaban shadeedan faittaqoo Allaha ya olee alalbabi allatheena amanoo qad anzala Allahu ilaykum thikran

t: [He sent] a Messenger [i.e., Muhammad] reciting to you the distinct verses of God that He may bring out those who believe and do righteous deeds from darknesses into the light. And whoever believes in God and does righteousness - He will admit him into gardens beneath which rivers flow to abide therein forever. God will have perfected for him a provision.
tr: Rasoolan yatloo AAalaykum ayati Allahi mubayyinatin liyukhrija allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati mina alththulumati ila alnnoori waman yumin biAllahi wayaAAmal salihan yudkhilhu jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan qad ahsana Allahu lahu rizqan

t: It is God who has created seven heavens and of the earth, the like of them. [His] command descends among them so you may know that God is over all things competent and that God has encompassed all things in knowledge.
tr: Allahu allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin wamina alardi mithlahunna yatanazzalu alamru baynahunna litaAAlamoo anna Allaha AAala kulli shayin qadeerun waanna Allaha qad ahata bikulli shayin AAilman

t: O Prophet, why do you prohibit [yourself from] what God has made lawful for you, seeking to please your wives? And God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu lima tuharrimu ma ahalla Allahu laka tabtaghee mardata azwajika waAllahu ghafoorun raheemun
