t: God has already ordained for you [Muslims] the dissolution of your oaths. And God is your protector, and He is the Knowing, the Wise.
tr: Qad farada Allahu lakum tahillata aymanikum waAllahu mawlakum wahuwa alAAaleemu alhakeemu

t: And when the Prophet told something in confidence to one of his wives. She then disclosed it [to another wife] and God made this known to him, he confirmed part of it and ignored a part. When he confronted her about it, she said, “Who told you this?” He said, “I was informed by the Knowing, the Acquainted.”
tr: Waith asarra alnnabiyyu ila baAAdi azwajihi hadeethan falamma nabbaat bihi waathharahu Allahu AAalayhi AAarrafa baAAdahu waaAArada AAan baAAdin falamma nabbaaha bihi qalat man anbaaka hatha qala nabbaaniya alAAaleemu alkhabeeru

t: If you two [wives] repent to God, [it is best], for your hearts have deviated. But if you cooperate against him - then indeed God is his protector, and Gabriel and the righteous of the Believers and the angels, moreover, are [his] assistants.
tr: In tatooba ila Allahi faqad saghat quloobukuma wain tathahara AAalayhi fainna Allaha huwa mawlahu wajibreelu wasalihu almumineena waalmalaikatu baAAda thalika thaheerun

t: Perhaps his Lord, if he divorced you [all], would substitute for him wives better than you - submitting [to God], believing, devoutly obedient, repentant, worshipping, and oft-fasting - [ones] previously married and virgins.
tr: AAasa rabbuhu in tallaqakunna an yubdilahu azwajan khayran minkunna muslimatin muminatin qanitatin taibatin AAabidatin saihatin thayyibatin waabkaran

t: O you who have believed, protect yourselves and your families from a Fire whose fuel is people and stones, over which are [appointed] angels, harsh and He commands them but do what they are commanded.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo qoo anfusakum waahleekum naran waqooduha alnnasu waalhijaratu AAalayha malaikatun ghilathun shidadun la yaAAsoona Allaha ma amarahum wayafAAaloona ma yumaroona

t: O you who have disbelieved, make no excuses that Day. You will only be recompensed for what you used to do.
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena kafaroo la taAAtathiroo alyawma innama tujzawna ma kuntum taAAmaloona

t: O you who have believed, repent to God with sincere repentance. Perhaps your Lord will remove from you your misdeeds and admit you into gardens beneath which rivers flow [on] the Day when God will not disgrace the Prophet and those who believed with him. Their light will proceed before them and on their right; they will say, “Our Lord, perfect for us our light and forgive us. Indeed, You are over all things competent.”
tr: Ya ayyuha allatheena amanoo tooboo ila Allahi tawbatan nasoohan AAasa rabbukum an yukaffira AAankum sayyiatikum wayudkhilakum jannatin tajree min tahtiha alanharu yawma la yukhzee Allahu alnnabiyya waallatheena amanoo maAAahu nooruhum yasAAa bayna aydeehim wabiaymanihim yaqooloona rabbana atmim lana noorana waighfir lana innaka AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: O Prophet, strive against the disbelievers and the hypocrites and be harsh upon them. And their refuge is Hell, and wretched is the destination.
tr: Ya ayyuha alnnabiyyu jahidi alkuffara waalmunafiqeena waoghluth AAalayhim wamawahum jahannamu wabisa almaseeru

t: God presents an example of those who disbelieved: the wife of Noah and the wife of Lot. They were under two of Our righteous servants but betrayed them, so they [i.e., those prophets] did not avail them from God at all, and it was said, “Enter the Fire with those who enter.”
tr: Daraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena kafaroo imraata noohin waimraata lootin kanata tahta AAabdayni min AAibadina salihayni fakhanatahuma falam yughniya AAanhuma mina Allahi shayan waqeela odkhula alnnara maAAa alddakhileena

t: And God presents an example of those who believed: the wife of Pharaoh, when she said, “My Lord, build for me near You a house in Paradise and save me from Pharaoh and his deeds and save me from the wrongdoing people.”
tr: Wadaraba Allahu mathalan lillatheena amanoo imraata firAAawna ith qalat rabbi ibni lee AAindaka baytan fee aljannati wanajjinee min firAAawna waAAamalihi wanajjinee mina alqawmi alththalimeena

t: And [the example of] Mary, the daughter of ‘Imrān, who guarded her chastity, so We blew into [her garment] through Our angel [i.e., Gabriel], and she believed in the words of her Lord and His Books and was of the devoutly obedient.
tr: Wamaryama ibnata AAimrana allatee ahsanat farjaha fanafakhna feehi min roohina wasaddaqat bikalimati rabbiha wakutubihi wakanat mina alqaniteena

t: Blessed is He in whose hand is dominion, and He is over all things competent -
tr: Tabaraka allathee biyadihi almulku wahuwa AAala kulli shayin qadeerun

t: [He] who created death and life to test you [as to] which of you is best in deed - and He is the Exalted in Might, the Forgiving -
tr: Allathee khalaqa almawta waalhayata liyabluwakum ayyukum ahsanu AAamalan wahuwa alAAazeezu alghafooru

t: [And] who created seven heavens in layers. You do not see in the creation of the Most Merciful any inconsistency. So return [your] vision [to the sky]; do you see any breaks?
tr: Allathee khalaqa sabAAa samawatin tibaqan ma tara fee khalqi alrrahmani min tafawutin fairjiAAi albasara hal tara min futoorin

t: Then return [your] vision twice again. [Your] vision will return to you humbled while it is fatigued.
tr: Thumma irjiAAi albasara karratayni yanqalib ilayka albasaru khasian wahuwa haseerun

t: And We have certainly beautified the nearest heaven with lamps [i.e., stars] and have made [from] them what is thrown at the devils and have prepared for them the punishment of the Blaze.
tr: Walaqad zayyanna alssamaa alddunya bimasabeeha wajaAAalnaha rujooman lilshshayateeni waaAAtadna lahum AAathaba alssaAAeeri

t: And for those who disbelieved in their Lord is the punishment of Hell, and wretched is the destination.
tr: Walillatheena kafaroo birabbihim AAathabu jahannama wabisa almaseeru

t: When they are thrown into it, they hear from it a [dreadful] inhaling while it boils up.
tr: Itha olqoo feeha samiAAoo laha shaheeqan wahiya tafooru

t: It almost bursts with rage. Every time a company is thrown into it, its keepers ask them, “Did there not come to you a warner?”
tr: Takadu tamayyazu mina alghaythi kullama olqiya feeha fawjun saalahum khazanatuha alam yatikum natheerun

t: They will say, “Yes, a warner had come to us, but we denied and said, ‘God has not sent down anything. You are not but in great error.’ ”
tr: Qaloo bala qad jaana natheerun fakaththabna waqulna ma nazzala Allahu min shayin in antum illa fee dalalin kabeerin

t: And they will say, “If only we had been listening or reasoning, we would not be among the companions of the Blaze.”
tr: Waqaloo law kunna nasmaAAu aw naAAqilu ma kunna fee ashabi alssaAAeeri

t: And they will admit their sin, so [it is] alienation for the companions of the Blaze.
tr: FaiAAtarafoo bithanbihim fasuhqan liashabi alssaAAeeri

t: Indeed, those who fear their Lord unseen will have forgiveness and great reward.
tr: Inna allatheena yakhshawna rabbahum bialghaybi lahum maghfiratun waajrun kabeerun

t: And conceal your speech or publicize it; indeed, He is Knowing of that within the breasts.
tr: Waasirroo qawlakum awi ijharoo bihi innahu AAaleemun bithati alssudoori

t: Does He who created not know, while He is the Subtle, the Acquainted?
tr: Ala yaAAlamu man khalaqa wahuwa allateefu alkhabeeru

t: It is He who made the earth tame for you - so walk among its slopes and eat of His provision - and to Him is the resurrection.
tr: Huwa allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda thaloolan faimshoo fee manakibiha wakuloo min rizqihi wailayhi alnnushooru

t: Do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not cause the earth to swallow you and suddenly it would sway?
tr: Aamintum man fee alssamai an yakhsifa bikumu alarda faitha hiya tamooru

t: Or do you feel secure that He who [holds authority] in the heaven would not send against you a storm of stones? Then you would know how [severe] was My warning.
tr: Am amintum man fee alssamai an yursila AAalaykum hasiban fasataAAlamoona kayfa natheeri

t: And already had those before them denied, and how [terrible] was My reproach.
tr: Walaqad kaththaba allatheena min qablihim fakayfa kana nakeeri

t: Do they not see the birds above them with wings outspread and [sometimes] folded in? None holds them [aloft] except the Most Merciful. Indeed He is, of all things, Seeing.
tr: Awalam yaraw ila alttayri fawqahum saffatin wayaqbidna ma yumsikuhunna illa alrrahmanu innahu bikulli shayin baseerun

t: Or who is it that could be an army for you to aid you other than the Most Merciful? The disbelievers are not but in delusion.
tr: Amman hatha allathee huwa jundun lakum yansurukum min dooni alrrahmani ini alkafiroona illa fee ghuroorin

t: Or who is it that could provide for you if He withheld His provision? But they have persisted in insolence and aversion.
tr: Amman hatha allathee yarzuqukum in amsaka rizqahu bal lajjoo fee AAutuwwin wanufoorin

t: Then is one who walks fallen on his face better guided or one who walks erect on a straight path?
tr: Afaman yamshee mukibban AAala wajhihi ahda amman yamshee sawiyyan AAala siratin mustaqeemin

t: Say, “It is He who has produced you and made for you hearing and vision and hearts [i.e., intellect]; little are you grateful.”
tr: Qul huwa allathee anshaakum wajaAAala lakumu alssamAAa waalabsara waalafidata qaleelan ma tashkuroona

t: Say, “It is He who has multiplied you throughout the earth, and to Him you will be gathered.”
tr: Qul huwa allathee tharaakum fee alardi wailayhi tuhsharoona

t: And they say, “When is this promise, if you should be truthful?”
tr: Wayaqooloona mata hatha alwaAAdu in kuntum sadiqeena

t: Say, “The knowledge is only with God, and I am only a clear warner.”
tr: Qul innama alAAilmu AAinda Allahi wainnama ana natheerun mubeenun

t: But when they see it approaching, the faces of those who disbelieve will be distressed, and it will be said, “This is that for which you used to call.”
tr: Falamma raawhu zulfatan seeat wujoohu allatheena kafaroo waqeela hatha allathee kuntum bihi taddaAAoona

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “Have you considered: whether God should cause my death and those with me or have mercy upon us, who can protect the disbelievers from a painful punishment?”
tr: Qul araaytum in ahlakaniya Allahu waman maAAiya aw rahimana faman yujeeru alkafireena min AAathabin aleemin

t: Say, “He is the Most Merciful; we have believed in Him, and upon Him we have relied. And you will [come to] know who it is that is in clear error.”
tr: Qul huwa alrrahmanu amanna bihi waAAalayhi tawakkalna fasataAAlamoona man huwa fee dalalin mubeenin

t: Say, “Have you considered: if your water was to become sunken [into the earth], then who could bring you flowing water?”
tr: Qul araaytum in asbaha maokum ghawran faman yateekum bimain maAAeenin

t: Nūn. By the pen and what they inscribe,
tr: Noon waalqalami wama yasturoona

t: You are not, [O Muhammad], by the favour of your Lord, a madman.
tr: Ma anta biniAAmati rabbika bimajnoonin

t: And indeed, for you is a reward uninterrupted.
tr: Wainna laka laajran ghayra mamnoonin

t: And indeed, you are of a great moral character.
tr: Wainnaka laAAala khuluqin AAatheemin

t: So you will see and they will see
tr: Fasatubsiru wayubsiroona

t: Which of you is the afflicted [by a devil].
tr: Biayyikumu almaftoonu

t: Indeed, your Lord is most knowing of who has gone astray from His way, and He is most knowing of the [rightly] guided.
tr: Inna rabbaka huwa aAAlamu biman dalla AAan sabeelihi wahuwa aAAlamu bialmuhtadeena

t: Then do not obey the deniers.
tr: Fala tutiAAi almukaththibeena

t: They wish that you would soften [in your position], so they would soften [toward you].
tr: Waddoo law tudhinu fayudhinoona

t: And do not obey every worthless habitual swearer
tr: Wala tutiAA kulla hallafin maheenin

t: [And] scorner, going about with malicious gossip -
tr: Hammazin mashshain binameemin

t: A preventer of good, transgressing and sinful,
tr: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin atheemin

t: Cruel, moreover, and an illegitimate pretender.
tr: AAutullin baAAda thalika zaneemin

t: Because he is a possessor of wealth and children,
tr: An kana tha malin wabaneena

t: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “Legends of the former peoples.”
tr: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

t: We will brand him upon the snout.
tr: Sanasimuhu AAala alkhurtoomi

t: Indeed, We have tried them as We tried the companions of the garden, when they swore to cut its fruit in the [early] morning
tr: Inna balawnahum kama balawna ashaba aljannati ith aqsamoo layasrimunnaha musbiheena

t: Without making exception.
tr: Wala yastathnoona

t: So there came upon it [i.e., the garden] an affliction from your Lord while they were asleep.
tr: Fatafa AAalayha taifun min rabbika wahum naimoona

t: And it became as though reaped.
tr: Faasbahat kaalssareemi

t: And they called one another at morning,
tr: Fatanadaw musbiheena

t: [Saying], “Go early to your crop if you would cut the fruit.”
tr: Ani ighdoo AAala harthikum in kuntum sarimeena

t: So they set out, while lowering their voices,
tr: Faintalaqoo wahum yatakhafatoona

t: [Saying], “There will surely not enter it today upon you [any] poor person.”
tr: An la yadkhulannaha alyawma AAalaykum miskeenun

t: And they went early in determination, [assuming themselves] able.
tr: Waghadaw AAala hardin qadireena

t: But when they saw it, they said, “Indeed, we are lost;
tr: Falamma raawha qaloo inna ladalloona

t: Rather, we have been deprived.”
tr: Bal nahnu mahroomoona

t: The most moderate of them said, “Did I not say to you, ‘Why do you not exalt [God]?’ ”
tr: Qala awsatuhum alam aqul lakum lawla tusabbihoona

t: They said, “Exalted is our Lord! Indeed, we were wrongdoers.”
tr: Qaloo subhana rabbina inna kunna thalimeena

t: Then they approached one another, blaming each other.
tr: Faaqbala baAAduhum AAala baAAdin yatalawamoona

t: They said, “O woe to us; indeed we were transgressors.
tr: Qaloo ya waylana inna kunna tagheena

t: Perhaps our Lord will substitute for us [one] better than it. Indeed, we are toward our Lord desirous.”
tr: AAasa rabbuna an yubdilana khayran minha inna ila rabbina raghiboona

t: Such is the punishment [of this world]. And the punishment of the Hereafter is greater, if they only knew.
tr: Kathalika alAAathabu walaAAathabu alakhirati akbaru law kanoo yaAAlamoona

t: Indeed, for the righteous with their Lord are the Gardens of Pleasure.
tr: Inna lilmuttaqeena AAinda rabbihim jannati alnnaAAeemi

t: Then will We treat the Muslims like the criminals?
tr: AfanajAAalu almuslimeena kaalmujrimeena

t: What is [the matter] with you? How do you judge?
tr: Ma lakum kayfa tahkumoona

t: Or do you have a Book in which you learn
tr: Am lakum kitabun feehi tadrusoona

t: That indeed for you is whatever you choose?
tr: Inna lakum feehi lama takhayyaroona

t: Or do you have oaths [binding] upon Us, extending until the Day of Resurrection, that indeed for you is whatever you judge?
tr: Am lakum aymanun AAalayna balighatun ila yawmi alqiyamati inna lakum lama tahkumoona

t: Ask them which of them, for that [claim], is responsible.
tr: Salhum ayyuhum bithalika zaAAeemun

t: Or do they have partners? Then let them bring their partners, if they should be truthful.
tr: Am lahum shurakao falyatoo bishurakaihim in kanoo sadiqeena

t: The Day the shin will be uncovered and they are invited to prostration but they [i.e., the disbelievers] will not be able,
tr: Yawma yukshafu AAan saqin wayudAAawna ila alssujoodi fala yastateeAAoona

t: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. And they used to be invited to prostration while they were sound.
tr: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun waqad kanoo yudAAawna ila alssujoodi wahum salimoona

t: So leave Me, [O Muhammad], with [the matter of] whoever denies this statement [i.e., the Qur’ān]. We will progressively lead them [to punishment] from where they do not know.
tr: Fatharnee waman yukaththibu bihatha alhadeethi sanastadrijuhum min haythu la yaAAlamoona

t: And I will give them time. Indeed, My plan is firm.
tr: Waomlee lahum inna kaydee mateenun

t: Or do you ask of them a payment, so they are by debt burdened down?
tr: Am tasaluhum ajran fahum min maghramin muthqaloona

t: Or have they [knowledge of] the unseen, so they write [it] down?
tr: Am AAindahumu alghaybu fahum yaktuboona

t: Then be patient for the decision of your Lord, [O Muhammad], and be not like the companion of the fish [i.e., Jonah] when he called out while he was distressed.
tr: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala takun kasahibi alhooti ith nada wahuwa makthoomun

t: If not that a favour [i.e., mercy] from his Lord overtook him, he would have been thrown onto the naked shore while he was censured.
tr: Lawla an tadarakahu niAAmatun min rabbihi lanubitha bialAAarai wahuwa mathmoomun

t: And his Lord chose him and made him of the righteous.
tr: Faijtabahu rabbuhu fajaAAalahu mina alssaliheena

t: And indeed, those who disbelieve would almost make you slip with their eyes [i.e., looks] when they hear the message, and they say, “Indeed, he is mad.”
tr: Wain yakadu allatheena kafaroo layuzliqoonaka biabsarihim lamma samiAAoo alththikra wayaqooloona innahu lamajnoonun

t: But it is not except a reminder to the worlds.
tr: Wama huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

t: The Inevitable Reality -
tr: Alhaqqatu

t: What is the Inevitable Reality?
tr: Ma alhaqqatu

t: And what can make you know what is the Inevitable Reality?
tr: Wama adraka ma alhaqqatu

t: Thamūd and ‘Aad denied the Striking Calamity [i.e., the Resurrection].
tr: Kaththabat thamoodu waAAadun bialqariAAati

t: So as for Thamūd, they were destroyed by the overpowering [blast].
tr: Faamma thamoodu faohlikoo bialttaghiyati

t: And as for ‘Aad, they were destroyed by a screaming, violent wind
tr: Waamma AAadun faohlikoo bireehin sarsarin AAatiyatin

t: Which He [i.e., God] imposed upon them for seven nights and eight days in succession, so you would see the people therein fallen as if they were hollow trunks of palm trees.
tr: Sakhkharaha AAalayhim sabAAa layalin wathamaniyata ayyamin husooman fatara alqawma feeha sarAAa kaannahum aAAjazu nakhlin khawiyatun

t: Then do you see of them any remains?
tr: Fahal tara lahum min baqiyatin

t: And there came Pharaoh and those before him and the overturned cities with sin.
tr: Wajaa firAAawnu waman qablahu waalmutafikatu bialkhatiati

t: And they disobeyed the messenger of their Lord, so He seized them with a seizure exceeding [in severity].
tr: FaAAasaw rasoola rabbihim faakhathahum akhthatan rabiyatan

t: Indeed, when the water overflowed, We carried you [i.e., your ancestors] in the sailing ship
tr: Inna lamma tagha almao hamalnakum fee aljariyati

t: That We might make it for you a reminder and [that] a conscious ear would be conscious of it.
tr: LinajAAalaha lakum tathkiratan wataAAiyaha othunun waAAiyatun

t: Then when the Horn is blown with one blast
tr: Faitha nufikha fee alssoori nafkhatun wahidatun

t: And the earth and the mountains are lifted and levelled with one blow [i.e., stroke] -
tr: Wahumilati alardu waaljibalu fadukkata dakkatan wahidatan

t: Then on that Day, the Occurrence [i.e., Resurrection] will occur,
tr: Fayawmaithin waqaAAati alwaqiAAatu

t: And the heaven will split [open], for that Day it is infirm.
tr: Wainshaqqati alssamao fahiya yawmaithin wahiyatun

t: And the angels are at its edges. And there will bear the Throne of your Lord above them, that Day, eight [of them].
tr: Waalmalaku AAala arjaiha wayahmilu AAarsha rabbika fawqahum yawmaithin thamaniyatun

t: That Day, you will be exhibited [for judgement]; not hidden among you is anything concealed.
tr: Yawmaithin tuAAradoona la takhfa minkum khafiyatun

t: So as for he who is given his record in his right hand, he will say, “Here, read my record!
tr: Faamma man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi fayaqoolu haomu iqraoo kitabiyah

t: Indeed, I was certain that I would be meeting my account.”
tr: Innee thanantu annee mulaqin hisabiyah

t: So he will be in a pleasant life -
tr: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin

t: In an elevated garden,
tr: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin

t: Its [fruit] to be picked hanging near.
tr: Qutoofuha daniyatun

t: [They will be told], “Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you put forth in the days past.”
tr: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima aslaftum fee alayyami alkhaliyati

t: But as for he who is given his record in his left hand, he will say, “Oh, I wish I had not been given my record
tr: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu bishimalihi fayaqoolu ya laytanee lam oota kitabiyah

t: And had not known what is my account.
tr: Walam adri ma hisabiyah

t: I wish it [i.e., my death] had been the decisive one.
tr: Ya laytaha kanati alqadiyatu

t: My wealth has not availed me.
tr: Ma aghna AAannee maliyah

t: Gone from me is my authority.”
tr: Halaka AAannee sultaniyah

t: [God will say], “Seize him and shackle him.
tr: Khuthoohu faghulloohu

t: Then into Hellfire drive him.
tr: Thumma aljaheema salloohu

t: Then into a chain whose length is seventy cubits insert him.”
tr: Thumma fee silsilatin tharAAuha sabAAoona thiraAAan faoslukoohu

t: Indeed, he did not used to believe in God, the Most Great,
tr: Innahu kana la yuminu biAllahi alAAatheemi

t: Nor did he encourage the feeding of the poor.
tr: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni

t: So there is not for him here this Day any devoted friend
tr: Falaysa lahu alyawma hahuna hameemun

t: Nor any food except from the discharge of wounds;
tr: Wala taAAamun illa min ghisleenin

t: None will eat it except the sinners.
tr: La yakuluhu illa alkhatioona

t: So I swear by what you see
tr: Fala oqsimu bima tubsiroona

t: And what you do not see
tr: Wama la tubsiroona

t: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is the word of a noble Messenger.
tr: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin

t: And it is not the word of a poet; little do you believe.
tr: Wama huwa biqawli shaAAirin qaleelan ma tuminoona

t: Nor the word of a soothsayer; little do you remember.
tr: Wala biqawli kahinin qaleelan ma tathakkaroona

t: [It is] a revelation from the Lord of the worlds.
tr: Tanzeelun min rabbi alAAalameena

t: And if he [i.e., Muhammad] had made up about Us some [false] sayings,
tr: Walaw taqawwala AAalayna baAAda alaqaweeli

t: We would have seized him by the right hand;
tr: Laakhathna minhu bialyameeni

t: Then We would have cut from him the aorta.
tr: Thumma laqataAAna minhu alwateena

t: And there is no one of you who could prevent [Us] from him.
tr: Fama minkum min ahadin AAanhu hajizeena

t: And indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder for the righteous.
tr: Wainnahu latathkiratun lilmuttaqeena

t: And indeed, We know that among you are deniers.
tr: Wainna lanaAAlamu anna minkum mukaththibeena

t: And indeed, it will be [a cause of] regret upon the disbelievers.
tr: Wainnahu lahasratun AAala alkafireena

t: And indeed, it is the truth of certainty.
tr: Wainnahu lahaqqu alyaqeeni

t: So exalt the name of your Lord, the Most Great.
tr: Fasabbih biismi rabbika alAAatheemi

t: A supplicant asked for a punishment bound to happen
tr: Saala sailun biAAathabin waqiAAin

t: To the disbelievers; of it there is no preventer.
tr: Lilkafireena laysa lahu dafiAAun

t: [It is] from God, owner of the ways of ascent.
tr: Mina Allahi thee almaAAariji

t: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] will ascend to Him during a Day the extent of which is fifty thousand years.
tr: TaAAruju almalaikatu waalrroohu ilayhi fee yawmin kana miqdaruhu khamseena alfa sanatin

t: So be patient with gracious patience.
tr: Faisbir sabran jameelan

t: Indeed, they see it [as] distant,
tr: Innahum yarawnahu baAAeedan

t: But We see it [as] near.
tr: Wanarahu qareeban

t: On the Day the sky will be like murky oil,
tr: Yawma takoonu alssamao kaalmuhli

t: And the mountains will be like wool,
tr: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni

t: And no friend will ask [anything of] a friend,
tr: Wala yasalu hameemun hameeman

t: They will be shown each other. The criminal will wish that he could be ransomed from the punishment of that Day by his children
tr: Yubassaroonahum yawaddu almujrimu law yaftadee min AAathabi yawmiithin bibaneehi

t: And his wife and his brother
tr: Wasahibatihi waakheehi

t: And his nearest kindred who shelter him
tr: Wafaseelatihi allatee tuweehi

t: And whoever is on earth entirely [so] then it could save him.
tr: Waman fee alardi jameeAAan thumma yunjeehi

t: No! Indeed, it is the Flame [of Hell],
tr: Kalla innaha latha

t: A remover of exteriors.
tr: NazzaAAatan lilshshawa

t: It invites he who turned his back [on truth] and went away [from obedience]
tr: TadAAoo man adbara watawalla

t: And collected [wealth] and hoarded.
tr: WajamaAAa faawAAa

t: Indeed, the human being was created anxious:
tr: Inna alinsana khuliqa halooAAan

t: When evil touches him, impatient,
tr: Itha massahu alshsharru jazooAAan

t: And when good touches him, withholding [of it],
tr: Waitha massahu alkhayru manooAAan

t: Except the observers of prayer -
tr: Illa almusalleena

t: Those who are constant in their prayer
tr: Allatheena hum AAala salatihim daimoona

t: And those within whose wealth is a known right
tr: Waallatheena fee amwalihim haqqun maAAloomun

t: For the petitioner and the deprived -
tr: Lilssaili waalmahroomi

t: And those who believe in the Day of Recompense
tr: Waallatheena yusaddiqoona biyawmi alddeeni

t: And those who are fearful of the punishment of their Lord -
tr: Waallatheena hum min AAathabi rabbihim mushfiqoona

t: Indeed, the punishment of their Lord is not that from which one is safe -
tr: Inna AAathaba rabbihim ghayru mamoonin

t: And those who guard their private parts
tr: Waallatheena hum lifuroojihim hafithoona

t: Except from their wives or those their right hands possess, for indeed, they are not to be blamed -
tr: Illa AAala azwajihim aw ma malakat aymanuhum fainnahum ghayru maloomeena

t: But whoever seeks beyond that, then they are the transgressors -
tr: Famani ibtagha waraa thalika faolaika humu alAAadoona

t: And those who are to their trusts and promises attentive
tr: Waallatheena hum liamanatihim waAAahdihim raAAoona

t: And those who are in their testimonies upright
tr: Waallatheena hum bishahadatihim qaimoona

t: And those who [carefully] maintain their prayer:
tr: Waallatheena hum AAala salatihim yuhafithoona

t: They will be in gardens, honoured.
tr: Olaika fee jannatin mukramoona

t: So what is [the matter] with those who disbelieve, hastening [from] before you, [O Muhammad],
tr: Famali allatheena kafaroo qibalaka muhtiAAeena

t: [To sit] on [your] right and [your] left in separate groups?
tr: AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali AAizeena

t: Does every person among them aspire to enter a garden of pleasure?
tr: AyatmaAAu kullu imriin minhum an yudkhala jannata naAAeemin

t: No! Indeed, We have created them from that which they know.
tr: Kalla inna khalaqnahum mimma yaAAlamoona

t: So I swear by the Lord of [all] risings and settings that indeed We are able
tr: Fala oqsimu birabbi almashariqi waalmagharibi inna laqadiroona

t: To replace them with better than them; and We are not to be outdone.
tr: AAala an nubaddila khayran minhum wama nahnu bimasbooqeena

t: So leave them to converse vainly and amuse themselves until they meet their Day which they are promised –
tr: Fatharhum yakhoodoo wayalAAaboo hatta yulaqoo yawmahumu allathee yooAAadoona

t: The Day they will emerge from the graves rapidly as if they were, toward an erected idol, rushing.
tr: Yawma yakhrujoona mina alajdathi siraAAan kaannahum ila nusubin yoofidoona

t: Their eyes humbled, humiliation will cover them. That is the Day which they had been promised.
tr: KhashiAAatan absaruhum tarhaquhum thillatun thalika alyawmu allathee kanoo yooAAadoona

t: Indeed, We sent Noah to his people, [saying], “Warn your people before there comes to them a painful punishment.”
tr: Inna arsalna noohan ila qawmihi an anthir qawmaka min qabli an yatiyahum AAathabun aleemun

t: He said, “O my people, indeed I am to you a clear warner,
tr: Qala ya qawmi innee lakum natheerun mubeenun

t: [Saying], ‘Worship God, fear Him and obey me.
tr: Ani oAAbudoo Allaha waittaqoohu waateeAAooni

t: He [i.e., God] will forgive you of your sins and delay you for a specified term. Indeed, the time [set by] God, when it comes, will not be delayed, if you only knew.’ ”
tr: Yaghfir lakum min thunoobikum wayuakhkhirkum ila ajalin musamman inna ajala Allahi itha jaa la yuakhkharu law kuntum taAAlamoona

t: He said, “My Lord, indeed I invited my people [to truth] night and day.
tr: Qala rabbi innee daAAawtu qawmee laylan wanaharan

t: But my invitation increased them not except in flight [i.e., aversion].
tr: Falam yazidhum duAAaee illa firaran

t: And indeed, every time I invited them that You may forgive them, they put their fingers in their ears, covered themselves with their garments, persisted, and were arrogant with [great] arrogance.
tr: Wainnee kullama daAAawtuhum litaghfira lahum jaAAaloo asabiAAahum fee athanihim waistaghshaw thiyabahum waasarroo waistakbaroo istikbaran

t: Then I invited them publicly.
tr: Thumma innee daAAawtuhum jiharan

t: Then I announced to them and [also] confided to them secretly
tr: Thumma innee aAAlantu lahum waasrartu lahum israran

t: And said, ‘Ask forgiveness of your Lord. Indeed, He is ever a Perpetual Forgiver.
tr: Faqultu istaghfiroo rabbakum innahu kana ghaffaran

t: He will send [rain from] the sky upon you in [continuing] showers
tr: Yursili alssamaa AAalaykum midraran

t: And give you increase in wealth and children and provide for you gardens and provide for you rivers.
tr: Wayumdidkum biamwalin wabaneena wayajAAal lakum jannatin wayajAAal lakum anharan

t: What is [the matter] with you that you do not attribute to God [due] grandeur
tr: Ma lakum la tarjoona lillahi waqaran

t: While He has created you in stages?
tr: Waqad khalaqakum atwaran

t: Do you not consider how God has created seven heavens in layers
tr: Alam taraw kayfa khalaqa Allahu sabAAa samawatin tibaqan

t: And made the moon therein a [reflected] light and made the sun a burning lamp?
tr: WajaAAala alqamara feehinna nooran wajaAAala alshshamsa sirajan

t: And God has caused you to grow from the earth a [progressive] growth.
tr: WaAllahu anbatakum mina alardi nabatan

t: Then He will return you into it and extract you [another] extraction.
tr: Thumma yuAAeedukum feeha wayukhrijukum ikhrajan

t: And God has made for you the earth an expanse
tr: WaAllahu jaAAala lakumu alarda bisatan

t: That you may follow therein roads of passage.’ ”
tr: Litaslukoo minha subulan fijajan

t: Noah said, “My Lord, indeed they have disobeyed me and followed him whose wealth and children will not increase him except in loss.
tr: Qala noohun rabbi innahum AAasawnee waittabaAAoo man lam yazidhu maluhu wawaladuhu illa khasaran

t: And they conspired an immense conspiracy.
tr: Wamakaroo makran kubbaran

t: And said, ‘Never leave your gods and never leave Wadd or Suwā’ or Yaghūth and Ya’ūq and Nasr.’
tr: Waqaloo la tatharunna alihatakum wala tatharunna waddan wala suwaAAan wala yaghootha wayaAAooqa wanasran

t: And already they have misled many. And, [my Lord], do not increase the wrongdoers except in error.”
tr: Waqad adalloo katheeran wala tazidi alththalimeena illa dalalan

t: Because of their sins they were drowned and put into the Fire, and they found not for themselves besides God [any] helpers.
tr: Mimma khateeatihim oghriqoo faodkhiloo naran falam yajidoo lahum min dooni Allahi ansaran

t: And Noah said, “My Lord, do not leave upon the earth from among the disbelievers an inhabitant.
tr: Waqala noohun rabbi la tathar AAala alardi mina alkafireena dayyaran

t: Indeed, if You leave them, they will mislead Your servants and not beget except [every] wicked one and [confirmed] disbeliever.
tr: Innaka in tatharhum yudilloo AAibadaka wala yalidoo illa fajiran kaffaran

t: My Lord, forgive me and my parents and whoever enters my house a Believer and the believing men and believing women. And do not increase the wrongdoers except in destruction.”
tr: Rabbi ighfir lee waliwalidayya waliman dakhala baytiya muminan walilmumineena waalmuminati wala tazidi alththalimeena illa tabaran

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “It has been revealed to me that a group of the jinn listened and said, ‘Indeed, we have heard an amazing Qur’ān [i.e., recitation].
tr: Qul oohiya ilayya annahu istamaAAa nafarun mina aljinni faqaloo inna samiAAna quranan AAajaban

t: It guides to the right course, and we have believed in it. And we will never associate with our Lord anyone.
tr: Yahdee ila alrrushdi faamanna bihi walan nushrika birabbina ahadan

t: And [it teaches] that exalted is the nobleness of our Lord; He has not taken a wife or a son
tr: Waannahu taAAala jaddu rabbina ma ittakhatha sahibatan wala waladan

t: And that our foolish one [i.e., Iblees] has been saying about God an excessive transgression.
tr: Waannahu kana yaqoolu safeehuna AAala Allahi shatatan

t: And we had thought that mankind and the jinn would never speak about God a lie.
tr: Waanna thananna an lan taqoola alinsu waaljinnu AAala Allahi kathiban

t: And there were men from mankind who sought refuge in men from the jinn, so they [only] increased them in burden [i.e., sin].
tr: Waannahu kana rijalun mina alinsi yaAAoothoona birijalin mina aljinni fazadoohum rahaqan

t: And they had thought, as you thought, that God would never send anyone [as a messenger].
tr: Waannahum thannoo kama thanantum an lan yabAAatha Allahu ahadan

t: And we have sought [to reach] the heaven but found it filled with powerful guards and burning flames.
tr: Waanna lamasna alssamaa fawajadnaha muliat harasan shadeedan washuhuban

t: And we used to sit therein in positions for hearing, but whoever listens now will find a burning flame lying in wait for him.
tr: Waanna kunna naqAAudu minha maqaAAida lilssamAAi faman yastamiAAi alana yajid lahu shihaban rasadan

t: And we do not know [therefore] whether evil is intended for those on earth or whether their Lord intends for them a right course.
tr: Waanna la nadree asharrun oreeda biman fee alardi am arada bihim rabbuhum rashadan

t: And among us are the righteous, and among us are [others] not so; we were [of] divided ways.
tr: Waanna minna alssalihoona waminna doona thalika kunna taraiqa qidadan

t: And we have become certain that we can never frustrate God on earth, nor can we frustrate [i.e., escape] Him by flight.
tr: Wanna thananna an lan nuAAjiza Allaha fee alardi walan nuAAjizahu haraban

t: And when we heard the guidance [i.e., the Qur’ān], we believed in it. And whoever believes in his Lord will not fear deprivation or burden.
tr: Waanna lamma samiAAna alhuda amanna bihi faman yumin birabbihi fala yakhafu bakhsan wala rahaqan

t: And among us are Muslims [in submission to God], and among us are the unjust. And whoever has become Muslim - those have sought out the right course.
tr: Waanna minna almuslimoona waminna alqasitoona faman aslama faolaika taharraw rashadan

t: But as for the unjust, they will be, for Hell, firewood.’
tr: Waama alqasitoona fakanoo lijahannama hataban

t: And [God revealed] that if they had remained steadfast on the way, We would have given them abundant rain [i.e., provision]
tr: Waallawi istaqamoo AAala alttareeqati laasqaynahum maan ghadaqan

t: So We might test them therein. And whoever turns away from the remembrance of his Lord He will put into arduous punishment.
tr: Linaftinahum feehi waman yuAArid AAan thikri rabbihi yaslukhu AAathaban saAAadan

t: And [He revealed] that the masjids are for God, so do not invoke with God anyone.
tr: Waanna almasajida lillahi fala tadAAoo maAAa Allahi ahadan

t: And that when the Servant [i.e., Prophet] of God stood up supplicating Him, they almost swarm all over him.”
tr: Waannahu lamma qama AAabdu Allahi yadAAoohu kadoo yakoonoona AAalayhi libadan

t: Say, [O Muhammad], “I only invoke my Lord and do not associate with Him anyone.”
tr: Qul innama adAAoo rabbee wala oshriku bihi ahadan

t: Say, “Indeed, I possess no power to do you harm or to guide you right.”
tr: Qul innee la amliku lakum darran wala rashadan

t: Say, “Indeed, no one can ever protect me from God, nor will I find in other than Him a refuge.
tr: Qul innee lan yujeeranee mina Allahi ahadun walan ajida min doonihi multahadan

t: Except to convey [what I receive] from God, and His messages.” And whoever disobeys God and His Messenger - then indeed, for him is the fire of Hell; they will abide therein forever.
tr: Illa balaghan mina Allahi warisalatihi waman yaAAsi Allaha warasoolahu fainna lahu nara jahannama khalideena feeha abadan

t: [The disbelievers continue] until, when they see that which they are promised, then they will know who is weaker in helpers and less in number.
tr: Hatta itha raaw ma yooAAadoona fasayaAAlamoona man adAAafu nasiran waaqallu AAadadan

t: Say, “I do not know if what you are promised is near or if my Lord will grant for it a [long] period.”
tr: Qul in adree aqareebun ma tooAAadoona am yajAAalu lahu rabbee amadan

t: [He is] Knower of the unseen, and He does not disclose His [knowledge of the] unseen to anyone
tr: AAalimu alghaybi fala yuthhiru AAala ghaybihi ahadan

t: Except whom He has approved of messengers, and indeed, He sends before him [i.e., each messenger] and behind him observers
tr: Illa mani irtada min rasoolin fainnahu yasluku min bayni yadayhi wamin khalfihi rasadan

t: That he [i.e., Muhammad] may know that they have conveyed the messages of their Lord; and He has encompassed whatever is with them and He keeps account of everything in numbers.
tr: LiyaAAlama an qad ablaghoo risalati rabbihim waahata bima ladayhim waahsa kulla shayin AAadadan

t: O you who is enwrapped,
tr: Ya ayyuha almuzzammilu

t: Arise [to pray] the night, except for a little -
tr: Qumi allayla illa qaleelan

t: Half of it - or subtract from it a little
tr: Nisfahu awi onqus minhu qaleelan

t: Or add to it, and recite the Qur’ān with measured recitation.
tr: Aw zid AAalayhi warattili alqurana tarteelan

t: Indeed, We will cast upon you a heavy word.
tr: Inna sanulqee AAalayka qawlan thaqeelan

t: Indeed, the hours of the night are more effective for concurrence [of heart and tongue] and more suitable for words.
tr: Inna nashiata allayli hiya ashaddu watan waaqwamu qeelan

t: Indeed, for you in the daytime, is lengthy activities.
tr: Inna laka fee alnnahari sabhan taweelan

t: And remember the name of your Lord and devote yourself to Him with [complete] devotion.
tr: Waothkuri isma rabbika watabattal ilayhi tabteelan

t: [He is] the Lord of the East and the West; there is no deity except Him, so take Him as Disposer of [your] affairs.
tr: Rabbu almashriqi waalmaghribi la ilaha illa huwa faittakhithhu wakeelan

t: And be patient over what they say and avoid them with gracious avoidance.
tr: Waisbir AAala ma yaqooloona waohjurhum hajran jameelan

t: And leave Me with [the matter of] the deniers, those of ease [in life], and allow them respite a little.
tr: Watharnee waalmukaththibeena olee alnnaAAmati wamahhilhum qaleelan

t: Indeed, with Us [for them] are shackles and burning fire
tr: Inna ladayna ankalan wajaheeman

t: And food that chokes and a painful punishment -
tr: WataAAaman tha ghussatin waAAathaban aleeman

t: On the Day the earth and the mountains will convulse and the mountains will become a heap of sand pouring down.
tr: Yawma tarjufu alardu waaljibalu wakanati aljibalu katheeban maheelan

t: Indeed, We have sent to you a Messenger as a witness upon you just as We sent to Pharaoh a messenger.
tr: Inna arsalna ilaykum rasoolan shahidan AAalaykum kama arsalna ila firAAawna rasoolan

t: But Pharaoh disobeyed the messenger, so We seized him with a ruinous seizure.
tr: FaAAasa firAAawnu alrrasoola faakhathnahu akhthan wabeelan

t: Then how can you fear, if you disbelieve, a Day that will make the children white-haired?
tr: Fakayfa tattaqoona in kafartum yawman yajAAalu alwildana sheeban

t: The heaven will break apart therefrom; ever is His promise fulfilled.
tr: Alssamao munfatirun bihi kana waAAduhu mafAAoolan

t: Indeed, this is a reminder, so whoever wills may take to his Lord a way.
tr: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

t: Indeed, your Lord knows, [O Muhammad], that you stand [in prayer] almost two thirds of the night or half of it or a third of it, and [so do] a group of those with you. And God determines [the extent of] the night and the day. He has known that you [Muslims] will not be able to do it and has turned to you in forgiveness, so recite what is easy [for you] of the Qur’ān. He has known that there will be among you those who are ill and others traveling throughout the land seeking [something] of the bounty of God and others fighting for the cause of God. So recite what is easy from it and establish prayer and give zakāh and loan God a goodly loan. And whatever good you put forward for yourselves - you will find it with God. It is better and greater in reward. And seek forgiveness of God. Indeed, God is Forgiving and Merciful.
tr: Inna rabbaka yaAAlamu annaka taqoomu adna min thuluthayi allayli wanisfahu wathuluthahu wataifatun mina allatheena maAAaka waAllahu yuqaddiru allayla waalnnahara AAalima an lan tuhsoohu fataba AAalaykum faiqraoo ma tayassara mina alqurani AAalima an sayakoonu minkum marda waakharoona yadriboona fee alardi yabtaghoona min fadli Allahi waakharoona yuqatiloona fee sabeeli Allahi faiqraoo ma tayassara minhu waaqeemoo alssalata waatoo alzzakata waaqridoo Allaha qardan hasanan wama tuqaddimoo lianfusikum min khayrin tajidoohu AAinda Allahi huwa khayran waaAAthama ajran waistaghfiroo Allaha inna Allaha ghafoorun raheemun

t: O you who covers himself [with a garment],
tr: Ya ayyuha almuddaththiru

t: Arise and warn
tr: Qum faanthir

t: And your Lord glorify
tr: Warabbaka fakabbir

t: And your clothing purify
tr: Wathiyabaka fatahhir

t: And uncleanliness avoid
tr: Waalrrujza faohjur

t: And do not confer favour to acquire more
tr: Wala tamnun tastakthiru

t: But for your Lord be patient.
tr: Walirabbika faisbir

t: And when the trumpet is blown,
tr: Faitha nuqira fee alnnaqoori

t: That Day will be a difficult day
tr: Fathalika yawmaithin yawmun AAaseerun

t: For the disbelievers - not easy.
tr: AAala alkafireena ghayru yaseerin

t: Leave Me with the one I created alone
tr: Tharnee waman khalaqtu waheedan

t: And to whom I granted extensive wealth
tr: WajaAAaltu lahu malan mamdoodan

t: And children present [with him]
tr: Wabaneena shuhoodan

t: And spread [everything] before him, easing [his life].
tr: Wamahhadtu lahu tamheedan

t: Then he desires that I should add more.
tr: Thumma yatmaAAu an azeeda

t: No! Indeed, he has been toward Our verses obstinate.
tr: Kalla innahu kana liayatina AAaneedan

t: I will cover him with arduous torment.
tr: Saorhiquhu saAAoodan

t: Indeed, he thought and deliberated.
tr: Innahu fakkara waqaddara

t: So may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
tr: Faqutila kayfa qaddara

t: Then may he be destroyed [for] how he deliberated.
tr: Thumma qutila kayfa qaddara

t: Then he considered [again];
tr: Thumma nathara

t: Then he frowned and scowled;
tr: Thumma AAabasa wabasara

t: Then he turned back and was arrogant
tr: Thumma adbara waistakbara

t: And said, “This is not but magic imitated [from others].
tr: Faqala in hatha illa sihrun yutharu

t: This is not but the word of a human being.”
tr: In hatha illa qawlu albashari

t: I will drive him into Saqar.
tr: Saosleehi saqara

t: And what can make you know what is Saqar?
tr: Wama adraka ma saqaru

t: It lets nothing remain and leaves nothing [unburned],
tr: La tubqee wala tatharu

t: Altering [i.e., blackening] the skins.
tr: Lawwahatun lilbashari

t: Over it are nineteen [angels].
tr: AAalayha tisAAata AAashara

t: And We have not made the keepers of the Fire except angels. And We have not made their number except as a trial for those who disbelieve - that those who were given the Book will be convinced and those who have believed will increase in faith and those who were given the Book and the Believers will not doubt and that those in whose hearts is disease [i.e., hypocrisy] and the disbelievers will say, “What does God intend by this as an example?” Thus does God leave astray whom He wills and guides whom He wills. And none knows the soldiers of your Lord except Him. And it [i.e., mention of the Fire] is not but a reminder to humanity.
tr: Wama jaAAalna ashaba alnnari illa malaikatan wama jaAAalna AAiddatahum illa fitnatan lillatheena kafaroo liyastayqina allatheena ootoo alkitaba wayazdada allatheena amanoo eemanan wala yartaba allatheena ootoo alkitaba waalmuminoona waliyaqoola allatheena fee quloobihim maradun waalkafiroona matha arada Allahu bihatha mathalan kathalika yudillu Allahu man yashao wayahdee man yashao wama yaAAlamu junooda rabbika illa huwa wama hiya illa thikra lilbashari

t: No! By the moon
tr: Kalla waalqamari

t: And [by] the night when it departs
tr: Waallayli ith adbara

t: And [by] the morning when it brightens,
tr: Waalssubhi itha asfara

t: Indeed, it [i.e., the Fire] is of the greatest [afflictions]
tr: Innaha laihda alkubari

t: As a warning to humanity -
tr: Natheeran lilbashari

t: To whoever wills among you to proceed or stay behind.
tr: Liman shaa minkum an yataqaddama aw yataakhkhara

t: Every soul, for what it has earned, will be retained
tr: Kullu nafsin bima kasabat raheenatun

t: Except the companions of the right,
tr: Illa ashaba alyameeni

t: [Who will be] in gardens, questioning each other
tr: Fee jannatin yatasaaloona

t: About the criminals,
tr: AAani almujrimeena

t: [And asking them], “What put you into Saqar?”
tr: Ma salakakum fee saqara

t: They will say, “We were not of those who prayed,
tr: Qaloo lam naku mina almusalleena

t: Nor did we used to feed the poor.
tr: Walam naku nutAAimu almiskeena

t: And we used to enter into vain discourse with those who engaged [in it],
tr: Wakunna nakhoodu maAAa alkhaideena

t: And we used to deny the Day of Recompense
tr: Wakunna nukaththibu biyawmi alddeeni

t: Until there came to us the certainty [i.e., death].”
tr: Hatta atana alyaqeenu

t: So there will not benefit them the intercession of [any] intercessors.
tr: Fama tanfaAAuhum shafaAAatu alshshafiAAeena

t: Then what is [the matter] with them that they are, from the reminder, turning away
tr: Fama lahum AAani alttathkirati muAArideena

t: As if they were alarmed donkeys
tr: Kaannahum humurun mustanfiratun

t: Fleeing from a lion?
tr: Farrat min qaswaratin

t: Rather, every person among them desires that he would be given scriptures spread about.
tr: Bal yureedu kullu imriin minhum an yuta suhufan munashsharatan

t: No! But they do not fear the Hereafter.
tr: Kalla bal la yakhafoona alakhirata

t: No! Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a reminder
tr: Kalla innahu tathkiratun

t: Then whoever wills will remember it.
tr: Faman shaa thakarahu

t: And they will not remember except that God wills. He is worthy of fear and adequate for [granting] forgiveness.
tr: Wama yathkuroona illa an yashaa Allahu huwa ahlu alttaqwa waahlu almaghfirati

t: I swear by the Day of Resurrection
tr: La oqsimu biyawmi alqiyamati

t: And I swear by the reproaching soul [to the certainty of resurrection].
tr: Wala oqsimu bialnnafsi allawwamati

t: Does the human being think that We will not assemble his bones?
tr: Ayahsabu alinsanu allan najmaAAa AAithamahu

t: Yes. [We are] Able [even] to proportion his fingertips.
tr: Bala qadireena AAala an nusawwiya bananahu

t: But the human being desires to continue in sin.
tr: Bal yureedu alinsanu liyafjura amamahu

t: He asks, "When is the Day of Resurrection?”
tr: Yasalu ayyana yawmu alqiyamati

t: So when vision is dazzled
tr: Faitha bariqa albasaru

t: And the moon darkens
tr: Wakhasafa alqamaru

t: And the sun and the moon are joined,
tr: WajumiAAa alshshamsu waalqamaru

t: The human being will say on that Day, “Where is the [place of] escape?”
tr: Yaqoolu alinsanu yawmaithin ayna almafarru

t: No! There is no refuge.
tr: Kalla la wazara

t: To your Lord, that Day, is the [place of] permanence.
tr: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almustaqarru

t: The human being will be informed that Day of what he sent ahead and kept back.
tr: Yunabbao alinsanu yawmaithin bima qaddama waakhkhara

t: Rather, the human being, against himself, will be a witness,
tr: Bali alinsanu AAala nafsihi baseeratun

t: Even if he presents his excuses.
tr: Walaw alqa maAAatheerahu

t: Move not your tongue with it, [O Muhammad], to hasten with it [i.e., recitation of the Qur’ān].
tr: La tuharrik bihi lisanaka litaAAjala bihi

t: Indeed, upon Us is its collection [in your heart] and [to make possible] its recitation.
tr: Inna AAalayna jamAAahu waquranahu

t: So when We have recited it [through Gabriel], then follow its recitation.
tr: Faitha qaranahu faittabiAA quranahu

t: Then upon Us is its clarification [to you].
tr: Thumma inna AAalayna bayanahu

t: No! But you [i.e., mankind] love the immediate
tr: Kalla bal tuhibboona alAAajilata

t: And leave [i.e., neglect] the Hereafter.
tr: Watatharoona alakhirata

t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be radiant,
tr: Wujoohun yawmaithin nadiratun

t: Looking at their Lord.
tr: Ila rabbiha nathiratun

t: And [some] faces, that Day, will be contorted,
tr: Wawujoohun yawmaithin basiratun

t: Expecting that there will be done to them [something] backbreaking.
tr: Tathunnu an yufAAala biha faqiratun

t: No! When it [i.e., the soul] has reached the collar bones
tr: Kalla itha balaghati alttaraqiya

t: And it is said, “Who will cure [him]?”
tr: Waqeela man raqin

t: And he [i.e., the dying one] is certain that it is the [time of] separation
tr: Wathanna annahu alfiraqu

t: And the leg is wound about the leg,
tr: Wailtaffati alssaqu bialssaqi

t: To your Lord, that Day, will be the procession.
tr: Ila rabbika yawmaithin almasaqu

t: And he [i.e., the disbeliever] had not believed, nor had he prayed.
tr: Fala saddaqa wala salla

t: But [instead], he denied and turned away.
tr: Walakin kaththaba watawalla

t: And then he went to his people, swaggering [in pride].
tr: Thumma thahaba ila ahlihi yatamatta

t: Woe to you, and woe!
tr: Awla laka faawla

t: Then woe to you, and woe!
tr: Thumma awla laka faawla

t: Does the human being think that he will be left neglected?
tr: Ayahsabu alinsanu an yutraka sudan

t: Had he not been a sperm-drop from semen emitted?
tr: Alam yaku nutfatan min manayyin yumna

t: Then he was a clinging clot, and [God] created [his form] and proportioned [him]
tr: Thumma kana AAalaqatan fakhalaqa fasawwa

t: And made of it two sexes, the male and the female.
tr: FajaAAala minhu alzzawjayni alththakara waalontha

t: Is not that [Creator] Able to give life to the dead?
tr: Alaysa thalika biqadirin AAala an yuhyiya almawta

t: Has there [not] come upon the human being a period of time when he was not a thing [even] mentioned?
tr: Hal ata AAala alinsani heenun mina alddahri lam yakun shayan mathkooran

t: Indeed, We created the human being from a sperm-drop mixture that We may try him; and We made him hearing and seeing.
tr: Inna khalaqna alinsana min nutfatin amshajin nabtaleehi fajaAAalnahu sameeAAan baseeran

t: Indeed, We guided him to the way, be he grateful or be he ungrateful.
tr: Inna hadaynahu alssabeela imma shakiran waimma kafooran

t: Indeed, We have prepared for the disbelievers chains and shackles and a blaze.
tr: Inna aAAtadna lilkafireena salasila waaghlalan wasaAAeeran

t: Indeed, the righteous will drink from a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of Kāfūr,
tr: Inna alabrara yashraboona min kasin kana mizajuha kafooran

t: A spring of which the [righteous] servants of God will drink; they will make it gush forth in force [and abundance].
tr: AAaynan yashrabu biha AAibadu Allahi yufajjiroonaha tafjeeran

t: They [are those who] fulfill [their] vows and fear a Day whose evil will be widespread.
tr: Yoofoona bialnnathri wayakhafoona yawman kana sharruhu mustateeran

t: And they give food in spite of love for it to the needy, the orphan, and the captive,
tr: WayutAAimona alttaAAama AAala hubbihi miskeenan wayateeman waaseeran

t: [Saying], “We feed you only for the countenance [i.e., approval] of God. We wish not from you reward or gratitude.
tr: Innama nutAAimukum liwajhi Allahi la nureedu minkum jazaan wala shukooran

t: Indeed, We fear from our Lord a Day austere and distressful.”
tr: Inna nakhafu min rabbina yawman AAaboosan qamtareeran

t: So God will protect them from the evil of that Day and give them radiance and happiness
tr: Fawaqahumu Allahu sharra thalika alyawmi walaqqahum nadratan wasurooran

t: And will reward them for what they patiently endured [with] a garden [in Paradise] and silk [garments].
tr: Wajazahum bima sabaroo jannatan wahareeran

t: [They will be] reclining therein on adorned couches. They will not see therein any [burning] sun or [freezing] cold.
tr: Muttakieena feeha AAala alaraiki la yarawna feeha shamsan wala zamhareeran

t: And near above them are its shades, and its [fruit] to be picked will be lowered in compliance.
tr: Wadaniyatan AAalayhim thilaluha wathullilat qutoofuha tathleelan

t: And there will be circulated among them vessels of silver and cups having been [created] clear [as glass],
tr: Wayutafu AAalayhim bianiyatin min fiddatin waakwabin kanat qawareera

t: Clear glasses [made] from silver of which they have determined the measure.
tr: Qawareera min fiddatin qaddarooha taqdeeran

t: And they will be given to drink a cup [of wine] whose mixture is of ginger
tr: Wayusqawna feeha kasan kana mizajuha zanjabeelan

t: [From] a fountain within it [i.e., Paradise] named Salsabeel.
tr: AAaynan feeha tusamma salsabeelan

t: There will circulate among them young boys made eternal. When you see them, you would think them [as beautiful as] scattered pearls.
tr: Wayatoofu AAalayhim wildanun mukhalladoona itha raaytahum hasibtahum luluan manthooran

t: And when you look there [in Paradise], you will see pleasure and great dominion.
tr: Waitha raayta thamma raayta naAAeeman wamulkan kabeeran

t: Upon them [i.e., the inhabitants] will be green garments of fine silk and brocade. And they will be adorned with bracelets of silver, and their Lord will give them a purifying drink.
tr: AAaliyahum thiyabu sundusin khudrun waistabraqun wahulloo asawira min fiddatin wasaqahum rabbuhum sharaban tahooran

t: [And it will be said], “Indeed, this is for you a reward, and your effort has been appreciated.”
tr: Inna hatha kana lakum jazaan wakana saAAyukum mashkooran

t: Indeed, it is We who have sent down to you, [O Muhammad], the Qur’ān progressively.
tr: Inna nahnu nazzalna AAalayka alqurana tanzeelan

t: So be patient for the decision of your Lord and do not obey from among them a sinner or ungrateful [disbeliever].
tr: Faisbir lihukmi rabbika wala tutiAA minhum athiman aw kafooran

t: And mention the name of your Lord [in prayer] morning and evening
tr: Waothkuri isma rabbika bukratan waaseelan

t: And during the night prostrate to Him and exalt [i.e., praise] Him a long [part of the] night.
tr: Wamina allayli faosjud lahu wasabbihhu laylan taweelan

t: Indeed, these [disbelievers] love the immediate and leave behind them a grave Day.
tr: Inna haolai yuhibboona alAAajilata wayatharoona waraahum yawman thaqeelan

t: We have created them and strengthened their forms, and when We will, We can change their likenesses with [complete] alteration.
tr: Nahnu khalaqnahum washadadna asrahum waitha shina baddalna amthalahum tabdeelan

t: Indeed, this is a reminder, so he who wills may take to his Lord a way.
tr: Inna hathihi tathkiratun faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi sabeelan

t: And you do not will except that God wills. Indeed, God is ever Knowing and Wise.
tr: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu inna Allaha kana AAaleeman hakeeman

t: He admits whom He wills into His mercy; but the wrongdoers - He has prepared for them a painful punishment.
tr: Yudkhilu man yashao fee rahmatihi waalththalimeena aAAadda lahum AAathaban aleeman

t: By those [winds] sent forth in gusts
tr: Waalmursalati AAurfan

t: And the winds that blow violently
tr: FaalAAasifati AAasfan

t: And [by] the winds that spread [clouds]
tr: Waalnnashirati nashran

t: And those [angels] who bring criterion
tr: Faalfariqati farqan

t: And those [angels] who deliver a message
tr: Faalmulqiyati thikran

t: As justification or warning,
tr: AAuthran aw nuthran

t: Indeed, what you are promised is to occur.
tr: Innama tooAAadoona lawaqiAAun

t: So when the stars are obliterated
tr: Faitha alnnujoomu tumisat

t: And when the heaven is opened
tr: Waitha alssamao furijat

t: And when the mountains are blown away
tr: Waitha aljibalu nusifat

t: And when the messengers’ time has come...
tr: Waitha alrrusulu oqqitat

t: For what Day was it postponed?
tr: Liayyi yawmin ojjilat

t: For the Day of Judgement.
tr: Liyawmi alfasli

t: And what can make you know what is the Day of Judgement?
tr: Wama adraka ma yawmu alfasli

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: Did We not destroy the former peoples?
tr: Alam nuhliki alawwaleena

t: Then We will follow them with the later ones.
tr: Thumma nutbiAAuhumu alakhireena

t: Thus do We deal with the criminals.
tr: Kathalika nafAAalu bialmujrimeena

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: Did We not create you from a liquid disdained?
tr: Alam nakhluqkum min main maheenin

t: And We placed it in a firm lodging [i.e., the womb]
tr: FajaAAalnahu fee qararin makeenin

t: For a known extent.
tr: Ila qadarin maAAloomin

t: And We determined [it], and excellent [are We] to determine.
tr: Faqadarna faniAAma alqadiroona

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: Have We not made the earth a container
tr: Alam najAAali alarda kifatan

t: Of the living and the dead?
tr: Ahyaan waamwatan

t: And We placed therein lofty, firmly set mountains and have given you to drink sweet water.
tr: WajaAAalna feeha rawasiya shamikhatin waasqaynakum maan furatan

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: [They will be told], “Proceed to that which you used to deny.
tr: Intaliqoo ila ma kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

t: Proceed to a shadow [of smoke] having three columns
tr: Intaliqoo ila thillin thee thalathi shuAAabin

t: [But having] no cool shade and availing not against the flame.”
tr: La thaleelin wala yughnee mina allahabi

t: Indeed, it throws sparks [as huge] as a fortress,
tr: Innaha tarmee bishararin kaalqasri

t: As if they were yellowish [black] camels.
tr: Kaannahu jimalatun sufrun

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: This is a Day they will not speak,
tr: Hatha yawmu la yantiqoona

t: Nor will it be permitted for them to make an excuse.
tr: Wala yuthanu lahum fayaAAtathiroona

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: This is the Day of Judgement; We will have assembled you and the former peoples.
tr: Hatha yawmu alfasli jamaAAnakum waalawwaleena

t: So if you have a plan, then plan against Me.
tr: Fain kana lakum kaydun fakeedooni

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: Indeed, the righteous will be among shades and springs
tr: Inna almuttaqeena fee thilalin waAAuyoonin

t: And fruits from whatever they desire,
tr: Wafawakiha mimma yashtahoona

t: [Being told], “Eat and drink in satisfaction for what you used to do.”
tr: Kuloo waishraboo haneean bima kuntum taAAmaloona

t: Indeed, We thus reward those who strive for excellence.
tr: Inna kathalika najzee almuhsineena

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: [O disbelievers], eat and enjoy yourselves a little; indeed, you are criminals.
tr: Kuloo watamattaAAoo qaleelan innakum mujrimoona

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: And when it is said to them, “Bow [in prayer],” they do not bow.
tr: Waitha qeela lahumu irkaAAoo la yarkaAAoona

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers.
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: Then in what statement after it [i.e., the Qur’ān] will they believe?
tr: Fabiayyi hadeethin baAAdahu yuminoona

t: About what are they asking one another?
tr: AAamma yatasaaloona

t: About the great news -
tr: AAani alnnabai alAAatheemi

t: That over which they are in disagreement.
tr: Allathee hum feehi mukhtalifoona

t: No! They are going to know.
tr: Kalla sayaAAlamoona

t: Then, no! They are going to know.
tr: Thumma kalla sayaAAlamoona

t: Have We not made the earth a resting place?
tr: Alam najAAali alarda mihadan

t: And the mountains as stakes?
tr: Waaljibala awtadan

t: And We created you in pairs
tr: Wakhalaqnakum azwajan

t: And made your sleep [a means for] rest
tr: WajaAAalna nawmakum subatan

t: And made the night as clothing
tr: WajaAAalna allayla libasan

t: And made the day for livelihood
tr: WajaAAalna alnnahara maAAashan

t: And constructed above you seven strong [heavens]
tr: Wabanayna fawqakum sabAAan shidadan

t: And made [therein] a burning lamp
tr: WajaAAalna sirajan wahhajan

t: And sent down, from the rain clouds, pouring water
tr: Waanzalna mina almuAAsirati maan thajjajan

t: That We may bring forth thereby grain and vegetation
tr: Linukhrija bihi habban wanabatan

t: And gardens of entwined growth.
tr: Wajannatin alfafan

t: Indeed, the Day of Judgement is an appointed time -
tr: Inna yawma alfasli kana meeqatan

t: The Day the Horn is blown and you will come forth in multitudes
tr: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori fatatoona afwajan

t: And the heaven is opened and will become gateways
tr: Wafutihati alssamao fakanat abwaban

t: And the mountains are removed and will be [but] a mirage.
tr: Wasuyyirati aljibalu fakanat saraban

t: Indeed, Hell has been lying in wait
tr: Inna jahannama kanat mirsadan

t: For the transgressors, a place of return,
tr: Lilttagheena maaban

t: In which they will remain for ages [unending].
tr: Labitheena feeha ahqaban

t: They will not taste therein [any] coolness or drink
tr: La yathooqoona feeha bardan wala sharaban

t: Except scalding water and [foul] purulence -
tr: Illa hameeman waghassaqan

t: An appropriate recompense.
tr: Jazaan wifaqan

t: Indeed, they were not expecting an account
tr: Innahum kanoo la yarjoona hisaban

t: And denied Our verses with [emphatic] denial.
tr: Wakaththaboo biayatina kiththaban

t: But all things We have enumerated in writing.
tr: Wakulla shayin ahsaynahu kitaban

t: “So taste [the penalty], and never will We increase you except in torment.”
tr: Fathooqoo falan nazeedakum illa AAathaban

t: Indeed, for the righteous is attainment -
tr: Inna lilmuttaqeena mafazan

t: Gardens and grapevines
tr: Hadaiqa waaAAnaban

t: And full-breasted [companions] of equal age
tr: WakawaAAiba atraban

t: And a full cup.
tr: Wakasan dihaqan

t: No ill speech will they hear therein or any falsehood -
tr: La yasmaAAoona feeha laghwan wala kiththaban

t: [As] reward from your Lord, [a generous] gift [made due by] account,
tr: Jazaan min rabbika AAataan hisaban

t: [From] the Lord of the heavens and the earth and whatever is between them, the Most Merciful. They possess not from Him [authority for] speech.
tr: Rabbi alssamawati waalardi wama baynahuma alrrahmani la yamlikoona minhu khitaban

t: The Day that the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] and the angels will stand in rows, they will not speak except for one whom the Most Merciful permits, and he will say what is correct.
tr: Yawma yaqoomu alrroohu waalmalaikatu saffan la yatakallamoona illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waqala sawaban

t: That is the True [i.e., certain] Day; so he who wills may take to his Lord a [way of] return.
tr: Thalika alyawmu alhaqqu faman shaa ittakhatha ila rabbihi maaban

t: Indeed, We have warned you of a near punishment on the Day when a man will observe what his hands have put forth and the disbeliever will say, “Oh, I wish that I were dust!”
tr: Inna antharnakum AAathaban qareeban yawma yanthuru almaro ma qaddamat yadahu wayaqoolu alkafiru ya laytanee kuntu turaban

t: By those [angels] who extract with violence
tr: WaalnnaziAAati gharqan

t: And [by] those who remove with ease
tr: Waalnnashitati nashtan

t: And [by] those who glide [as if] swimming
tr: Waalssabihati sabhan

t: And those who race each other in a race
tr: Faalssabiqati sabqan

t: And those who arrange [each] matter,
tr: Faalmudabbirati amran

t: On the Day the blast [of the Horn] will convulse [creation],
tr: Yawma tarjufu alrrajifatu

t: There will follow it the subsequent [one].
tr: TatbaAAuha alrradifatu

t: Hearts, that Day, will tremble,
tr: Quloobun yawmaithin wajifatun

t: Their eyes humbled.
tr: Absaruha khashiAAatun

t: They are [presently] saying, “Will we indeed be returned to [our] former state [of life]?
tr: Yaqooloona ainna lamardoodoona fee alhafirati

t: Even if we should be decayed bones?”
tr: Aitha kunna AAithaman nakhiratan

t: They say, “That, then, would be a losing return.”
tr: Qaloo tilka ithan karratun khasiratun

t: Indeed, it will be but one shout,
tr: Fainnama hiya zajratun wahidatun

t: And suddenly they will be [alert] upon the earth’s surface.
tr: Faitha hum bialssahirati

t: Has there reached you the story of Moses? -
tr: Hal ataka hadeethu moosa

t: When his Lord called to him in the sacred valley of Tuwā,
tr: Ith nadahu rabbuhu bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

t: “Go to Pharaoh. Indeed, he has transgressed.
tr: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha

t: And say to him, ‘Would you [be willing to] purify yourself
tr: Faqul hal laka ila an tazakka

t: And let me guide you to your Lord so you would fear [Him]?’ ”
tr: Waahdiyaka ila rabbika fatakhsha

t: And he showed him the greatest sign,
tr: Faarahu alayata alkubra

t: But he [i.e., Pharaoh] denied and disobeyed.
tr: Fakaththaba waAAasa

t: Then he turned his back, striving [i.e., plotting].
tr: Thumma adbara yasAAa

t: And he gathered [his people] and called out
tr: Fahashara fanada

t: And said, “I am your most exalted lord.”
tr: Faqala ana rabbukumu alaAAla

t: So God seized him in exemplary punishment for the last and the first [transgression].
tr: Faakhathahu Allahu nakala alakhirati waaloola

t: Indeed in that is a lesson [i.e., warning] for whoever would fear [God].
tr: Inna fee thalika laAAibratan liman yakhsha

t: Are you a more difficult creation or is the heaven? He [i.e., God] constructed it.
tr: Aantum ashaddu khalqan ami alssamao banaha

t: He raised its ceiling and proportioned it.
tr: RafaAAa samkaha fasawwaha

t: And He darkened its night and extracted its brightness.
tr: Waaghtasha laylaha waakhraja duhaha

t: And after that He spread the earth.
tr: Waalarda baAAda thalika dahaha

t: He extracted from it its water and its pasture,
tr: Akhraja minha maaha wamarAAaha

t: And the mountains He set firmly
tr: Waaljibala arsaha

t: As enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
tr: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum

t: But when there comes the greatest Overwhelming Calamity -
tr: Faitha jaati alttammatu alkubra

t: The Day when the human being will remember that for which he strove,
tr: Yawma yatathakkaru alinsanu ma saAAa

t: And Hellfire will be exposed for [all] those who see -
tr: Waburrizati aljaheemu liman yara

t: So as for he who transgressed
tr: Faamma man tagha

t: And preferred the life of the world,
tr: Waathara alhayata alddunya

t: Then indeed, Hellfire will be [his] refuge.
tr: Fainna aljaheema hiya almawa

t: But as for he who feared the position of his Lord and prevented the soul from [unlawful] inclination,
tr: Waama man khafa maqama rabbihi wanaha alnnafsa AAani alhawa

t: Then indeed, Paradise will be [his] refuge.
tr: Fainna aljannata hiya almawa

t: They ask you, [O Muhammad], about the Hour: when is its arrival?
tr: Yasaloonaka AAani alssaAAati ayyana mursaha

t: In what [position] are you that you should mention it?
tr: Feema anta min thikraha

t: To your Lord is its finality.
tr: Ila rabbika muntahaha

t: You are only a warner for those who fear it.
tr: Innama anta munthiru man yakhshaha

t: It will be, on the Day they see it, as though they had not remained [in the world] except for an afternoon or a morning thereof.
tr: Kaannahum yawma yarawnaha lam yalbathoo illa AAashiyyatan aw duhaha

t: He [i.e., the Prophet] frowned and turned away
tr: AAabasa watawalla

t: Because there came to him the blind man, [interrupting].
tr: An jaahu alaAAma

t: But what would make you perceive, [O Muhammad], that perhaps he might be purified
tr: Wama yudreeka laAAallahu yazzakka

t: Or be reminded and the remembrance would benefit him?
tr: Aw yaththakkaru fatanfaAAahu alththikra

t: As for he who thinks himself without need,
tr: Amma mani istaghna

t: To him you give attention.
tr: Faanta lahu tasadda

t: And not upon you [is any blame] if he will not be purified.
tr: Wama AAalayka alla yazzakka

t: But as for he who came to you striving [for knowledge]
tr: Waamma man jaaka yasAAa

t: While he fears [God],
tr: Wahuwa yakhsha

t: From him you are distracted.
tr: Faanta AAanhu talahha

t: No! Indeed, they [i.e., these verses] are a reminder;
tr: Kalla innaha tathkiratun

t: So whoever wills may remember it.
tr: Faman shaa thakarahu

t: [It is recorded] in honoured sheets,
tr: Fee suhufin mukarramatin

t: Exalted and purified,
tr: MarfooAAatin mutahharatin

t: [Carried] by the hands of messengerangels,
tr: Biaydee safaratin

t: Noble and dutiful.
tr: Kiramin bararatin

t: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] is the human being; how disbelieving is he.
tr: Qutila alinsanu ma akfarahu

t: From what thing [i.e., substance] did He create him?
tr: Min ayyi shayin khalaqahu

t: From a sperm-drop He created him and destined for him;
tr: Min nutfatin khalaqahu faqaddarahu

t: Then He eased the way for him;
tr: Thumma alssabeela yassarahu

t: Then He causes his death and provides a grave for him.
tr: Thumma amatahu faaqbarahu

t: Then when He wills, He will resurrect him.
tr: Thumma itha shaa ansharahu

t: No! He [i.e., man] has not yet accomplished what He commanded him.
tr: Kalla lamma yaqdi ma amarahu

t: Then let the human being look at his food -
tr: Falyanthuri alinsanu ila taAAamihi

t: How We poured down water in torrents,
tr: Anna sababna almaa sabban

t: Then We broke open the earth, splitting [it with sprouts],
tr: Thumma shaqaqna alarda shaqqan

t: And caused to grow within it grain
tr: Faanbatna feeha habban

t: And grapes and herbage
tr: WaAAinaban waqadban

t: And olive and palm trees
tr: Wazaytoonan wanakhlan

t: And gardens of dense shrubbery
tr: Wahadaiqa ghulban

t: And fruit and grass -
tr: Wafakihatan waabban

t: [As] enjoyment [i.e., provision] for you and your grazing livestock.
tr: MataAAan lakum walianAAamikum

t: But when there comes the Deafening Blast
tr: Faitha jaati alssakhkhatu

t: On the Day a man will flee from his brother
tr: Yawma yafirru almaro min akheehi

t: And his mother and his father
tr: Waommihi waabeehi

t: And his wife and his children,
tr: Wasahibatihi wabaneehi

t: For every man, that Day, will be a matter adequate for him.
tr: Likulli imriin minhum yawmaithin shanun yughneehi

t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be bright -
tr: Wujoohun yawmaithin musfiratun

t: Laughing, rejoicing at good news.
tr: Dahikatun mustabshiratun

t: And [other] faces, that Day, will have upon them dust.
tr: Wawujoohun yawmaithin AAalayha ghabaratun

t: Blackness will cover them.
tr: Tarhaquha qataratun

t: Those are the disbelievers, the wicked ones.
tr: Olaika humu alkafaratu alfajaratu

t: When the sun is wrapped up [in darkness]
tr: Itha alshshamsu kuwwirat

t: And when the stars fall, dispersing,
tr: Waitha alnnujoomu inkadarat

t: And when the mountains are removed
tr: Waitha aljibalu suyyirat

t: And when full-term she-camels are neglected
tr: Waitha alAAisharu AAuttilat

t: And when the wild beasts are gathered
tr: Waitha alwuhooshu hushirat

t: And when the seas are filled with flame
tr: Waitha albiharu sujjirat

t: And when the souls are paired
tr: Waitha alnnufoosu zuwwijat

t: And when the girl [who was] buried alive is asked
tr: Waitha almawoodatu suilat

t: For what sin she was killed
tr: Biayyi thanbin qutilat

t: And when the pages are spread [i.e., made public]
tr: Waitha alssuhufu nushirat

t: And when the sky is stripped away
tr: Waitha alssamao kushitat

t: And when Hellfire is set ablaze
tr: Waitha aljaheemu suAAAAirat

t: And when Paradise is brought near,
tr: Waitha aljannatu ozlifat

t: A soul will [then] know what it has brought [with it].
tr: AAalimat nafsun ma ahdarat

t: So I swear by the retreating stars -
tr: Fala oqsimu bialkhunnasi

t: Those that run [their courses] and disappear [i.e., set] -
tr: Aljawari alkunnasi

t: And by the night as it closes in
tr: Waallayli itha AAasAAasa

t: And by the dawn when it breathes [i.e., stirs]
tr: Waalssubhi itha tanaffasa

t: [That] indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a word [conveyed by] a noble messenger [i.e., Gabriel]
tr: Innahu laqawlu rasoolin kareemin

t: [Who is] possessed of power and with the Owner of the Throne, secure [in position],
tr: Thee quwwatin AAinda thee alAAarshi makeenin

t: Obeyed there [in the heavens] and trustworthy.
tr: MutaAAin thamma ameenin

t: And your companion [i.e., Prophet Muhammad] is not [at all] mad.
tr: Wama sahibukum bimajnoonin

t: And he has already seen him [i.e., Gabriel] in the clear horizon.
tr: Walaqad raahu bialofuqi almubeeni

t: And he [i.e., Muhammad] is not a withholder of [knowledge of] the unseen.
tr: Wama huwa AAala alghaybi bidaneenin

t: And it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is not the word of a devil, expelled [from the heavens].
tr: Wama huwa biqawli shaytanin rajeemin

t: So where are you going?
tr: Faayna tathhaboona

t: It is not except a reminder to the worlds
tr: In huwa illa thikrun lilAAalameena

t: For whoever wills among you to go straight.
tr: Liman shaa minkum an yastaqeema

t: And you do not will except that God wills - Lord of the worlds.
tr: Wama tashaoona illa an yashaa Allahu rabbu alAAalameena

t: When the sky breaks apart
tr: Itha alssamao infatarat

t: And when the stars fall, scattering,
tr: Waitha alkawakibu intatharat

t: And when the seas are erupted
tr: Waitha albiharu fujjirat

t: And when the [contents of] graves are scattered [i.e., exposed],
tr: Waitha alqubooru buAAthirat

t: A soul will [then] know what it has put forth and kept back.
tr: AAalimat nafsun ma qaddamat waakhkharat

t: O human being, what has deceived you concerning your Lord, the Generous,
tr: Ya ayyuha alinsanu ma gharraka birabbika alkareemi

t: Who created you, proportioned you, and balanced you?
tr: Allathee khalaqaka fasawwaka faAAadalaka

t: In whatever form He willed has He assembled you.
tr: Fee ayyi sooratin ma shaa rakkabaka

t: No! But you deny the Recompense.
tr: Kalla bal tukaththiboona bialddeeni

t: And indeed, [appointed] over you are keepers,
tr: Wainna AAalaykum lahafitheena

t: Noble and recording;
tr: Kiraman katibeena

t: They know whatever you do.
tr: YaAAlamoona ma tafAAaloona

t: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure,
tr: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin

t: And indeed, the wicked will be in Hellfire.
tr: Wainna alfujjara lafee jaheemin

t: They will [enter to] burn therein on the Day of Recompense,
tr: Yaslawnaha yawma alddeeni

t: And never therefrom will they be absent.
tr: Wama hum AAanha bighaibeena

t: And what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
tr: Wama adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

t: Then, what can make you know what is the Day of Recompense?
tr: Thumma ma adraka ma yawmu alddeeni

t: It is the Day when a soul will not possess for another soul [power to do] a thing; and the command, that Day, is [entirely] with God.
tr: Yawma la tamliku nafsun linafsin shayan waalamru yawmaithin lillahi

t: Woe to those who give less [than due],
tr: Waylun lilmutaffifeena

t: Who, when they take a measure from people, take in full.
tr: Allatheena itha iktaloo AAala alnnasi yastawfoona

t: But if they give by measure or by weight to them, they cause loss.
tr: Waitha kaloohum aw wazanoohum yukhsiroona

t: Do they not think that they will be resurrected
tr: Ala yathunnu olaika annahum mabAAoothoona

t: For a tremendous Day -
tr: Liyawmin AAatheemin

t: The Day when mankind will stand before the Lord of the worlds?
tr: Yawma yaqoomu alnnasu lirabbi alAAalameena

t: No! Indeed, the record of the wicked is in sijjeen.
tr: Kalla inna kitaba alfujjari lafee sijjeenin

t: And what can make you know what is sijjeen?
tr: Wama adraka ma sijjeenun

t: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed.
tr: Kitabun marqoomun

t: Woe, that Day, to the deniers,
tr: Waylun yawmaithin lilmukaththibeena

t: Who deny the Day of Recompense.
tr: Allatheena yukaththiboona biyawmi alddeeni

t: And none deny it except every sinful transgressor.
tr: Wama yukaththibu bihi illa kullu muAAtadin atheemin

t: When Our verses are recited to him, he says, “Legends of the former peoples.”
tr: Itha tutla AAalayhi ayatuna qala asateeru alawwaleena

t: No! Rather, the stain has covered their hearts of that which they were earning.
tr: Kalla bal rana AAala quloobihim ma kanoo yaksiboona

t: No! Indeed, from their Lord, that Day, they will be partitioned.
tr: Kalla innahum AAan rabbihim yawmaithin lamahjooboona

t: Then indeed, they will [enter and] burn in Hellfire.
tr: Thumma innahum lasaloo aljaheemi

t: Then it will be said [to them], “This is what you used to deny.”
tr: Thumma yuqalu hatha allathee kuntum bihi tukaththiboona

t: No! Indeed, the record of the righteous is in ‘illiyyūn.
tr: Kalla inna kitaba alabrari lafee AAilliyyeena

t: And what can make you know what is ‘illiyyūn?
tr: Wama adraka ma AAilliyyoona

t: It is [their destination recorded in] a register inscribed
tr: Kitabun marqoomun

t: Which is witnessed by those brought near [to God].
tr: Yashhaduhu almuqarraboona

t: Indeed, the righteous will be in pleasure
tr: Inna alabrara lafee naAAeemin

t: On adorned couches, observing.
tr: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona

t: You will recognize in their faces the radiance of pleasure.
tr: TaAArifu fee wujoohihim nadrata alnnaAAeemi

t: They will be given to drink [pure] wine [which was] sealed.
tr: Yusqawna min raheeqin makhtoomin

t: The last of it is musk. So for this let the competitors compete.
tr: Khitamuhu miskun wafee thalika falyatanafasi almutanafisoona

t: And its mixture is of Tasneem,
tr: Wamizajuhu min tasneemin

t: A spring from which those near [to God] drink.
tr: AAaynan yashrabu biha almuqarraboona

t: Indeed, those who committed crimes used to laugh at those who believed.
tr: Inna allatheena ajramoo kanoo mina allatheena amanoo yadhakoona

t: And when they passed by them, they would exchange derisive glances.
tr: Waitha marroo bihim yataghamazoona

t: And when they returned to their people, they would return jesting.
tr: Waitha inqalaboo ila ahlihimu inqalaboo fakiheena

t: And when they saw them, they would say, “Indeed, those are truly lost.”
tr: Waitha raawhum qaloo inna haolai ladalloona

t: But they had not been sent as guardians over them.
tr: Wama orsiloo AAalayhim hafitheena

t: So Today those who believed are laughing at the disbelievers,
tr: Faalyawma allatheena amanoo mina alkuffari yadhakoona

t: On adorned couches, observing.
tr: AAala alaraiki yanthuroona

t: Have the disbelievers [not] been rewarded [this Day] for what they used to do?
tr: Hal thuwwiba alkuffaru ma kanoo yafAAaloona

t: When the sky has split [open]
tr: Itha alssamao inshaqqat

t: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so]
tr: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat

t: And when the earth has been extended
tr: Waitha alardu muddat

t: And has cast out that within it and relinquished [it]
tr: Waalqat ma feeha watakhallat
