t: And has listened [i.e., responded] to its Lord and was obligated [to do so] -
tr: Waathinat lirabbiha wahuqqat

t: O human being, indeed you are labouring toward your Lord with [great] exertion and will meet it.
tr: Ya ayyuha alinsanu innaka kadihun ila rabbika kadhan famulaqeehi

t: Then as for he who is given his record in his right hand,
tr: Faama man ootiya kitabahu biyameenihi

t: He will be judged with an easy account
tr: Fasawfa yuhasabu hisaban yaseeran

t: And return to his people in happiness.
tr: Wayanqalibu ila ahlihi masrooran

t: But as for he who is given his record behind his back,
tr: Waamma man ootiya kitabahu waraa thahrihi

t: He will cry out for destruction
tr: Fasawfa yadAAoo thubooran

t: And [enter to] burn in a Blaze.
tr: Wayasla saAAeeran

t: Indeed, he had [once] been among his people in happiness;
tr: Innahu kana fee ahlihi masrooran

t: Indeed, he had thought he would never return [to God].
tr: Innahu thanna an lan yahoora

t: But yes! Indeed, his Lord was ever, of him, Seeing.
tr: Bala inna rabbahu kana bihi baseeran

t: So I swear by the twilight glow
tr: Fala oqsimu bialshshafaqi

t: And [by] the night and what it envelops
tr: Waallayli wama wasaqa

t: And [by] the moon when it becomes full
tr: Waalqamari itha ittasaqa

t: [That] you will surely embark upon [i.e., experience] state after state.
tr: Latarkabunna tabaqan AAan tabaqin

t: So what is [the matter] with them [that] they do not believe,
tr: Fama lahum la yuminoona

t: And when the Qur’ān is recited to them, they do not prostrate [to God]?
tr: Waitha quria AAalayhimu alquranu la yasjudoona

t: But those who have disbelieved deny,
tr: Bali allatheena kafaroo yukaththiboona

t: And God is most knowing of what they keep within themselves.
tr: WaAllahu aAAlamu bima yooAAoona

t: So give them tidings of a painful punishment,
tr: Fabashshirhum biAAathabin aleemin

t: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds. For them is a reward uninterrupted.
tr: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

t: By the sky containing great stars
tr: Waalssamai thati alburooji

t: And [by] the promised Day
tr: Waalyawmi almawAAoodi

t: And [by] the witness and what is witnessed,
tr: Washahidin wamashhoodin

t: Destroyed [i.e., cursed] were the companions of the trench
tr: Qutila ashabu alukhdoodi

t: [Containing] the fire full of fuel,
tr: Alnnari thati alwaqoodi

t: When they were sitting near it
tr: Ith hum AAalayha quAAoodun

t: And they, to what they were doing against the Believers, were witnesses.
tr: Wahum AAala ma yafAAaloona bialmumineena shuhoodun

t: And they resented them not except because they believed in God, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy,
tr: Wama naqamoo minhum illa an yuminoo biAllahi alAAazeezi alhameedi

t: To whom belongs the dominion of the heavens and the earth. And God, over all things, is Witness.
tr: Allathee lahu mulku alssamawati waalardi waAllahu AAala kulli shayin shaheedun

t: Indeed, those who have tortured the believing men and believing women and then have not repented will have the punishment of Hell, and they will have the punishment of the Burning Fire.
tr: Inna allatheena fatanoo almumineena waalmuminati thumma lam yatooboo falahum AAathabu jahannama walahum AAathabu alhareeqi

t: Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds will have gardens beneath which rivers flow. That is the great attainment.
tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati lahum jannatun tajree min tahtiha alanharu thalika alfawzu alkabeeru

t: Indeed, the assault [i.e., vengeance] of your Lord is severe.
tr: Inna batsha rabbika lashadeedun

t: Indeed, it is He who originates [creation] and repeats.
tr: Innahu huwa yubdio wayuAAeedu

t: And He is the Forgiving, the Affectionate,
tr: Wahuwa alghafooru alwadoodu

t: Honourable Owner of the Throne,
tr: Thoo alAAarshi almajeedi

t: Effecter of what He intends.
tr: FaAAAAalun lima yureedu

t: Has there reached you the story of the soldiers -
tr: Hal ataka hadeethu aljunoodi

t: [Those of] Pharaoh and Thamūd?
tr: FirAAawna wathamooda

t: But they who disbelieve are in [persistent] denial,
tr: Bali allatheena kafaroo fee taktheebin

t: While God encompasses them from behind.
tr: WaAllahu min waraihim muheetun

t: But this is an honoured Qur’ān
tr: Bal huwa quranun majeedun

t: [Inscribed] in a Preserved Slate.
tr: Fee lawhin mahfoothin

t: By the sky and the night comer -
tr: Waalssamai waalttariqi

t: And what can make you know what is the night comer?
tr: Wama adraka ma alttariqu

t: It is the piercing star -
tr: Alnnajmu alththaqibu

t: There is no soul but that it has over it a protector.
tr: In kullu nafsin lamma AAalayha hafithun

t: So let the human being observe from what he was created.
tr: Falyanthuri alinsanu mimma khuliqa

t: He was created from a fluid, ejected,
tr: Khuliqa min main dafiqin

t: Emerging from between the backbone and the ribs.
tr: Yakhruju min bayni alssulbi waalttaraibi

t: Indeed, He [i.e., God], to return him [to life], is Able.
tr: Innahu AAala rajAAihi laqadirun

t: The Day when secrets will be put on trial,
tr: Yawma tubla alssarairu

t: Then he [i.e., man] will have no power or any helper.
tr: Fama lahu min quwwatin wala nasirin

t: By the sky which returns [rain]
tr: Waalssamai thati alrrajAAi

t: And [by] the earth which cracks open,
tr: Waalardi thati alssadAAi

t: Indeed, it [i.e., the Qur’ān] is a decisive statement,
tr: Innahu laqawlun faslun

t: And it is not amusement.
tr: Wama huwa bialhazli

t: Indeed, they are planning a plan,
tr: Innahum yakeedoona kaydan

t: But I am planning a plan.
tr: Waakeedu kaydan

t: So allow time for the disbelievers. Leave them awhile.
tr: Famahhili alkafireena amhilhum ruwaydan

t: Exalt the name of your Lord, the Most High,
tr: Sabbihi isma rabbika alaAAla

t: Who created and proportioned
tr: Allathee khalaqa fasawwa

t: And who destined and [then] guided
tr: Waallathee qaddara fahada

t: And who brings out the pasture
tr: Waallathee akhraja almarAAa

t: And [then] makes it black stubble.
tr: FajaAAalahu ghuthaan ahwa

t: We will make you recite, [O Muhammad], and you will not forget,
tr: Sanuqrioka fala tansa

t: Except what God should will. Indeed, He knows what is declared and what is hidden.
tr: Illa ma shaa Allahu innahu yaAAlamu aljahra wama yakhfa

t: And We will ease you toward ease.
tr: Wanuyassiruka lilyusra

t: So remind, if the reminder should benefit;
tr: Fathakkir in nafaAAati alththikra

t: He who fears [God] will be reminded.
tr: Sayaththakkaru man yakhsha

t: But the wretched one will avoid it -
tr: Wayatajannabuha alashqa

t: [He] who will [enter and] burn in the greatest Fire,
tr: Allathee yasla alnnara alkubra

t: Neither dying therein nor living.
tr: Thumma la yamootu feeha wala yahya

t: He has certainly succeeded who purifies himself
tr: Qad aflaha man tazakka

t: And mentions the name of his Lord and prays.
tr: Wathakara isma rabbihi fasalla

t: But you prefer the worldly life,
tr: Bal tuthiroona alhayata alddunya

t: While the Hereafter is better and more enduring.
tr: Waalakhiratu khayrun waabqa

t: Indeed, this is in the former scriptures,
tr: Inna hatha lafee alssuhufi aloola

t: The scriptures of Abraham and Moses.
tr: Suhufi ibraheema wamoosa

t: Has there reached you the report of the Overwhelming [event]?
tr: Hal ataka hadeethu alghashiyati

t: [Some] faces, that Day, will be humbled,
tr: Wujoohun yawmaithin khashiAAatun

t: Working [hard] and exhausted.
tr: AAamilatun nasibatun

t: They will [enter to] burn in an intensely hot Fire.
tr: Tasla naran hamiyatan

t: They will be given drink from a boiling spring.
tr: Tusqa min AAaynin aniyatin

t: For them there will be no food except from a poisonous, thorny plant
tr: Laysa lahum taAAamun illa min dareeAAin

t: Which neither nourishes nor avails against hunger.
tr: La yusminu wala yughnee min jooAAin

t: [Other] faces, that Day, will show pleasure.
tr: Wujoohun yawmaithin naAAimatun

t: With their effort [they are] satisfied
tr: LisaAAyiha radiyatun

t: In an elevated garden,
tr: Fee jannatin AAaliyatin

t: Wherein they will hear no unsuitable speech.
tr: La tasmaAAu feeha laghiyatan

t: Within it is a flowing spring.
tr: Feeha AAaynun jariyatun

t: Within it are couches raised high
tr: Feeha sururun marfooAAatun

t: And cups put in place
tr: Waakwabun mawdooAAatun

t: And cushions lined up
tr: Wanamariqu masfoofatun

t: And carpets spread around.
tr: Wazarabiyyu mabthoothatun

t: Then do they not look at the camels how they are created?
tr: Afala yanthuroona ila alibili kayfa khuliqat

t: And at the sky - how it is raised?
tr: Waila alssamai kayfa rufiAAat

t: And at the mountains - how they are erected?
tr: Waila aljibali kayfa nusibat

t: And at the earth - how it is spread out?
tr: Waila alardi kayfa sutihat

t: So remind, [O Muhammad]; you are only a reminder.
tr: Fathakkir innama anta muthakkirun

t: You are not over them a controller.
tr: Lasta AAalayhim bimusaytirin

t: However, he who turns away and disbelieves -
tr: Illa man tawalla wakafara

t: Then God will punish him with the greatest punishment.
tr: FayuAAaththibuhu Allahu alAAathaba alakbara

t: Indeed, to Us is their return.
tr: Inna ilayna iyabahum

t: Then indeed, upon Us is their account.
tr: Thumma inna AAalayna hisabahum

t: By the dawn
tr: Waalfajri

t: And [by] ten nights
tr: Walayalin AAashrin

t: And [by] the even [number] and the odd
tr: WaalshshafAAi waalwatri

t: And [by] the night when it passes,
tr: Waallayli itha yasri

t: Is there [not] in [all] that an oath [sufficient] for one of perception?
tr: Hal fee thalika qasamun lithee hijrin

t: Have you not considered how your Lord dealt with ‘Aad -
tr: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biAAadin

t: [With] Iram - who had lofty pillars,
tr: Irama thati alAAimadi

t: The likes of whom had never been created in the land?
tr: Allatee lam yukhlaq mithluha fee albiladi

t: And [with] Thamūd, who carved out the rocks in the valley?
tr: Wathamooda allatheena jaboo alssakhra bialwadi

t: And [with] Pharaoh, owner of the stakes? -
tr: WafirAAawna thee alawtadi

t: [All of] whom oppressed within the lands
tr: Allatheena taghaw fee albiladi

t: And increased therein the corruption.
tr: Faaktharoo feeha alfasada

t: So your Lord poured upon them a scourge of punishment.
tr: Fasabba AAalayhim rabbuka sawta AAathabin

t: Indeed, your Lord is in observation.
tr: Inna rabbaka labialmirsadi

t: And as for the human being, when his Lord tries him and [thus] is generous to him and favours him, he says, “My Lord has honoured me.”
tr: Faamma alinsanu itha ma ibtalahu rabbuhu faakramahu wanaAAAAamahu fayaqoolu rabbee akramani

t: But when He tries him and restricts his provision, he says, “My Lord has humiliated me.”
tr: Waamma itha ma ibtalahu faqadara AAalayhi rizqahu fayaqoolu rabbee ahanani

t: No! But you do not honour the orphan
tr: Kalla bal la tukrimoona alyateema

t: And you do not encourage one another to feed the poor.
tr: Wala tahaddoona AAala taAAami almiskeeni

t: And you consume inheritance, devouring [it] altogether,
tr: Watakuloona altturatha aklan lamman

t: And you love wealth with immense love.
tr: Watuhibboona almala hubban jamman

t: No! When the earth has been levelled pounded and crushed -
tr: Kalla itha dukkati alardu dakkan dakkan

t: And your Lord has come and the angels, rank upon rank,
tr: Wajaa rabbuka waalmalaku saffan saffan

t: And brought [within view], that Day, is Hell - that Day, the human being will remember, but how [i.e., what good] to him will be the remembrance?
tr: Wajeea yawmaithin bijahannama yawmaithin yatathakkaru alinsanu waanna lahu alththikra

t: He will say, “Oh, I wish I had sent ahead [some good] for my life.”
tr: Yaqoolu ya laytanee qaddamtu lihayatee

t: So on that Day, none will punish [as severely] as His punishment,
tr: Fayawmaithin la yuAAaththibu AAathabahu ahadun

t: And none will bind [as severely] as His binding [of the evildoers].
tr: Wala yoothiqu wathaqahu ahadun

t: [To the righteous it will be said], “O reassured soul,
tr: Ya ayyatuha alnnafsu almutmainnatu

t: Return to your Lord, well-pleased and pleasing [to Him],
tr: IrjiAAee ila rabbiki radiyatan mardiyyatan

t: And enter among My [righteous] servants
tr: Faodkhulee fee AAibadee

t: And enter My Paradise.”
tr: Waodkhulee jannatee

t: I swear by this city, [i.e., Makkah] -
tr: La oqsimu bihatha albaladi

t: And you, [O Muhammad], are free of restriction in this city -
tr: Waanta hillun bihatha albaladi

t: And [by] the father and that which was born [of him],
tr: Wawalidin wama walada

t: We have certainly created the human being into hardship.
tr: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee kabadin

t: Does he think that never will anyone overcome him?
tr: Ayahsabu an lan yaqdira AAalayhi ahadun

t: He says, “I have spent wealth in abundance.”
tr: Yaqoolu ahlaktu malan lubadan

t: Does he think that no one has seen him?
tr: Ayahsabu an lam yarahu ahadun

t: Have We not made for him two eyes?
tr: Alam najAAal lahu AAaynayni

t: And a tongue and two lips?
tr: Walisanan washafatayni

t: And have shown him the two ways?
tr: Wahadaynahu alnnajdayni

t: But he has not broken through the difficult pass.
tr: Fala iqtahama alAAaqabata

t: And what can make you know what is [breaking through] the difficult pass?
tr: Wama adraka ma alAAaqabatu

t: It is the freeing of a slave
tr: Fakku raqabatin

t: Or feeding on a day of severe hunger
tr: Aw itAAamun fee yawmin thee masghabatin

t: An orphan of near relationship
tr: Yateeman tha maqrabatin

t: Or a needy person in misery
tr: Aw miskeenan tha matrabatin

t: And then being among those who believed and advised one another to patience and advised one another to compassion.
tr: Thumma kana mina allatheena amanoo watawasaw bialssabri watawasaw bialmarhamati

t: Those are the companions of the right.
tr: Olaika ashabu almaymanati

t: But they who disbelieved in Our signs those are the companions of the left.
tr: Waallatheena kafaroo biayatina hum ashabu almashamati

t: Over them will be fire closed in.
tr: AAalayhim narun musadatun

t: By the sun and its brightness
tr: Waalshshamsi waduhaha

t: And [by] the moon when it follows it
tr: Waalqamari itha talaha

t: And [by] the day when it displays it
tr: Waalnnahari itha jallaha

t: And [by] the night when it covers [i.e., conceals] it
tr: Waallayli itha yaghshaha

t: And [by] the sky and He who constructed it
tr: Waalssamai wama banaha

t: And [by] the earth and He who spread it
tr: Waalardi wama tahaha

t: And [by] the soul and He who proportioned it
tr: Wanafsin wama sawwaha

t: And inspired it [with discernment of] its wickedness and its righteousness,
tr: Faalhamaha fujooraha wataqwaha

t: He has succeeded who purifies it,
tr: Qad aflaha man zakkaha

t: And he has failed who instils it [with corruption].
tr: Waqad khaba man dassaha

t: Thamūd denied [their prophet] by reason of their transgression,
tr: Kaththabat thamoodu bitaghwaha

t: When the most wretched of them was sent forth.
tr: Ithi inbaAAatha ashqaha

t: And the messenger of God [i.e., Sālih] said to them, “[Do not harm] the shecamel of God or [prevent her from] her drink.”
tr: Faqala lahum rasoolu Allahi naqata Allahi wasuqyaha

t: But they denied him and hamstrung her. So their Lord brought down upon them destruction for their sin and made it equal [upon all of them].
tr: Fakaththaboohu faAAaqarooha fadamdama AAalayhim rabbuhum bithanbihim fasawwaha

t: And He does not fear the consequences.
tr: Wala yakhafu AAuqbaha

t: By the night when it covers
tr: Waallayli itha yaghsha

t: And [by] the day when it appears
tr: Waalnnahari itha tajalla

t: And [by] He who created the male and female,
tr: Wama khalaqa alththakara waalontha

t: Indeed, your efforts are diverse.
tr: Inna saAAyakum lashatta

t: As for he who gives and fears God
tr: Faamma man aAAta waittaqa

t: And believes in the best [reward],
tr: Wasaddaqa bialhusna

t: We will ease him toward ease.
tr: Fasanuyassiruhu lilyusra

t: But as for he who withholds and considers himself free of need
tr: Waamma man bakhila waistaghna

t: And denies the best [reward],
tr: Wakaththaba bialhusna

t: We will ease him toward difficulty.
tr: Fasanuyassiruhu lilAAusra

t: And what will his wealth avail him when he falls?
tr: Wama yughnee AAanhu maluhu itha taradda

t: Indeed, [incumbent] upon Us is guidance.
tr: Inna AAalayna lalhuda

t: And indeed, to Us belongs the Hereafter and the first [life].
tr: Wainna lana lalakhirata waaloola

t: So I have warned you of a Fire which is blazing.
tr: Faanthartukum naran talaththa

t: None will [enter to] burn therein except the most wretched one
tr: La yaslaha illa alashqa

t: Who had denied and turned away.
tr: Allathee kaththaba watawalla

t: But the righteous one will avoid it -
tr: Wasayujannabuha alatqa

t: [He] who gives [from] his wealth to purify himself
tr: Allathee yutee malahu yatazakka

t: And not [giving] for anyone who has [done him] a favour to be rewarded
tr: Wama liahadin AAindahu min niAAmatin tujza

t: But only seeking the countenance of his Lord, Most High.
tr: Illa ibtighaa wajhi rabbihi alaAAla

t: And he is going to be satisfied.
tr: Walasawfa yarda

t: By the morning brightness
tr: Waaldduha

t: And [by] the night when it covers with darkness,
tr: Waallayli itha saja

t: Your Lord has not taken leave of you, [O Muhammad], nor has He detested [you].
tr: Ma waddaAAaka rabbuka wama qala

t: And the Hereafter is better for you than the first [life].
tr: Walalakhiratu khayrun laka mina aloola

t: And your Lord is going to give you, and you will be satisfied.
tr: Walasawfa yuAAteeka rabbuka fatarda

t: Did He not find you an orphan and give [you] refuge?
tr: Alam yajidka yateeman faawa

t: And He found you lost and guided [you],
tr: Wawajadaka dallan fahada

t: And He found you poor and made [you] self-sufficient.
tr: Wawajadaka AAailan faaghna

t: So as for the orphan, do not oppress [him].
tr: Faamma alyateema fala taqhar

t: And as for the petitioner, do not repel [him].
tr: Waamma alssaila fala tanhar

t: And as for the favour of your Lord, speak of it.
tr: Waamma biniAAmati rabbika fahaddith

t: Did We not expand for you, [O Muhammad], your breast?
tr: Alam nashrah laka sadraka

t: And We removed from you your burden
tr: WawadaAAna AAanka wizraka

t: Which had weighed upon your back
tr: Allathee anqada thahraka

t: And raised high for you your repute.
tr: WarafaAAna laka thikraka

t: For indeed, with hardship [will be] ease [i.e., relief].
tr: Fainna maAAa alAAusri yusran

t: Indeed, with hardship [will be] ease.
tr: Inna maAAa alAAusri yusran

t: So when you have finished [your duties], then stand up [for worship].
tr: Faitha faraghta fainsab

t: And to your Lord direct [your] longing.
tr: Waila rabbika fairghab

t: By the fig and the olive
tr: Waaltteeni waalzzaytooni

t: And [by] Mount Sinai
tr: Watoori seeneena

t: And [by] this secure city [i.e., Makkah],
tr: Wahatha albaladi alameeni

t: We have certainly created the human being in the best of stature;
tr: Laqad khalaqna alinsana fee ahsani taqweemin

t: Then We return him to the lowest of the low,
tr: Thumma radadnahu asfala safileena

t: Except for those who believe and do righteous deeds, for they will have a reward uninterrupted.
tr: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati falahum ajrun ghayru mamnoonin

t: So what yet causes you to deny the Recompense?
tr: Fama yukaththibuka baAAdu bialddeeni

t: Is not God the most just of judges?
tr: Alaysa Allahu biahkami alhakimeena

t: Recite in the name of your Lord who created -
tr: Iqra biismi rabbika allathee khalaqa

t: Created the human being from a clinging substance.
tr: Khalaqa alinsana min AAalaqin

t: Recite, and your Lord is the most Generous -
tr: Iqra warabbuka alakramu

t: Who taught by the pen -
tr: Allathee AAallama bialqalami

t: Taught the human being that which he knew not.
tr: AAallama alinsana ma lam yaAAlam

t: No! [But] indeed, the human being transgresses
tr: Kalla inna alinsana layatgha

t: Because he sees himself self-sufficient.
tr: An raahu istaghna

t: Indeed, to your Lord is the return.
tr: Inna ila rabbika alrrujAAa

t: Have you seen the one who forbids
tr: Araayta allathee yanha

t: A servant when he prays?
tr: AAabdan itha salla

t: Have you seen if he is upon guidance
tr: Araayta in kana AAala alhuda

t: Or enjoins righteousness?
tr: Aw amara bialttaqwa

t: Have you seen if he denies and turns away -
tr: Araayta in kaththaba watawalla

t: Does he not know that God sees?
tr: Alam yaAAlam bianna Allaha yara

t: No! If he does not desist, We will surely drag him by the forelock -
tr: Kalla lain lam yantahi lanasfaAAan bialnnasiyati

t: A lying, sinning forelock.
tr: Nasiyatin kathibatin khatiatin

t: Then let him call his associates;
tr: FalyadAAu nadiyahu

t: We will call the angels of Hell.
tr: SanadAAu alzzabaniyata

t: No! Do not obey him. But prostrate and draw near [to God].
tr: Kalla la tutiAAhu waosjud waiqtarib

t: Indeed, We sent it [i.e., the Qur’ān] down during the Night of Decree.
tr: Inna anzalnahu fee laylati alqadri

t: And what can make you know what is the Night of Decree?
tr: Wama adraka ma laylatu alqadri

t: The Night of Decree is better than a thousand months.
tr: Laylatu alqadri khayrun min alfi shahrin

t: The angels and the Spirit [i.e., Gabriel] descend therein by permission of their Lord for every matter.
tr: Tanazzalu almalaikatu waalrroohu feeha biithni rabbihim min kulli amrin

t: Peace it is until the emergence of dawn.
tr: Salamun hiya hatta matlaAAi alfajri

t: Those who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the polytheists were not to be parted [from misbelief] until there came to them clear evidence -
tr: Lam yakuni allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena munfakkeena hatta tatiyahumu albayyinatu

t: A Messenger from God, reciting purified scriptures
tr: Rasoolun mina Allahi yatloo suhufan mutahharatan

t: Within which are correct writings [i.e., rulings and laws].
tr: Feeha kutubun qayyimatun

t: Nor did those who were given the Book become divided until after there had come to them clear evidence.
tr: Wama tafarraqa allatheena ootoo alkitaba illa min baAAdi ma jaathumu albayyinatu

t: And they were not commanded except to worship God, [being] sincere to Him in religion, inclining to truth, and to establish prayer and to give zakāh. And that is the correct religion.
tr: Wama omiroo illa liyaAAbudoo Allaha mukhliseena lahu alddeena hunafaa wayuqeemoo alssalata wayutoo alzzakata wathalika deenu alqayyimati

t: Indeed, they who disbelieved among the People of the Book and the polytheists will be in the fire of Hell, abiding eternally therein. Those are the worst of creatures.
tr: Inna allatheena kafaroo min ahli alkitabi waalmushrikeena fee nari jahannama khalideena feeha olaika hum sharru albariyyati

t: Indeed, they who have believed and done righteous deeds - those are the best of creatures.
tr: Inna allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati olaika hum khayru albariyyati

t: Their reward with God will be gardens of perpetual residence beneath which rivers flow, wherein they will abide forever, God being pleased with them and they with Him. That is for whoever has feared his Lord.
tr: Jazaohum AAinda rabbihim jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha abadan radiya Allahu AAanhum waradoo AAanhu thalika liman khashiya rabbahu

t: When the earth is shaken with its [final] earthquake
tr: Itha zulzilati alardu zilzalaha

t: And the earth discharges its burdens
tr: Waakhrajati alardu athqalaha

t: And the human being says, “What is [wrong] with it?” -
tr: Waqala alinsanu ma laha

t: That Day, it will report its news
tr: Yawmaithin tuhaddithu akhbaraha

t: Because your Lord has inspired [i.e., commanded] it.
tr: Bianna rabbaka awha laha

t: That Day, the people will depart separated [into categories] to be shown [the result of] their deeds.
tr: Yawmaithin yasduru alnnasu ashtatan liyuraw aAAmalahum

t: So whoever does an atom’s weight of good will see it,
tr: Faman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin khayran yarahu

t: And whoever does an atom’s weight of evil will see it.
tr: Waman yaAAmal mithqala tharratin sharran yarahu

t: By the racers, panting,
tr: WaalAAadiyati dabhan

t: And the producers of sparks [when] striking
tr: Faalmooriyati qadhan

t: And the chargers at dawn,
tr: Faalmugheerati subhan

t: Stirring up thereby [clouds of] dust,
tr: Faatharna bihi naqAAan

t: Arriving thereby in the centre collectively,
tr: Fawasatna bihi jamAAan

t: Indeed the human being, to his Lord, is ungrateful.
tr: Inna alinsana lirabbihi lakanoodun

t: And indeed, he is to that a witness.
tr: Wainnahu AAala thalika lashaheedun

t: And indeed he is, in love of wealth, intense.
tr: Wainnahu lihubbi alkhayri lashadeedun

t: But does he not know that when the contents of the graves are scattered
tr: Afala yaAAlamu itha buAAthira ma fee alquboori

t: And that within the breasts is obtained,
tr: Wahussila ma fee alssudoori

t: Indeed, their Lord with them, that Day, is [fully] Acquainted.
tr: Inna rabbahum bihim yawmaithin lakhabeerun

t: The Striking Calamity -
tr: AlqariAAatu

t: What is the Striking Calamity?
tr: Ma alqariAAatu

t: And what can make you know what is the Striking Calamity?
tr: Wama adraka ma alqariAAatu

t: It is the Day when people will be like moths, dispersed,
tr: Yawma yakoonu alnnasu kaalfarashi almabthoothi

t: And the mountains will be like wool, fluffed up.
tr: Watakoonu aljibalu kaalAAihni almanfooshi

t: Then as for one whose scales are heavy [with good deeds],
tr: Faamma man thaqulat mawazeenuhu

t: He will be in a pleasant life.
tr: Fahuwa fee AAeeshatin radiyatin

t: But as for one whose scales are light,
tr: Waamma man khaffat mawazeenuhu

t: His refuge will be an abyss.
tr: Faommuhu hawiyatun

t: And what can make you know what that is?
tr: Wama adraka ma hiyah

t: It is a Fire, intensely hot.
tr: Narun hamiyatun

t: Competition for more distracted you
tr: Alhakumu alttakathuru

t: Until you visit the graves.
tr: Hatta zurtumu almaqabira

t: No! You are going to know.
tr: Kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

t: Then, no! You are going to know.
tr: Thumma kalla sawfa taAAlamoona

t: No! If you only knew with knowledge of certainty...
tr: Kalla law taAAlamoona AAilma alyaqeeni

t: You will surely see the Hellfire.
tr: Latarawunna aljaheema

t: Then you will surely see it with the eye of certainty.
tr: Thumma latarawunnaha AAayna alyaqeeni

t: Then you will surely be asked that Day about the blessings.
tr: Thumma latusalunna yawmaithin AAani alnnaAAeemi

t: By time,
tr: WaalAAasri

t: Indeed, the human being is in loss,
tr: Inna alinsana lafee khusrin

t: Except for those who have believed and done righteous deeds and advised each other to truth and advised each other to patience.
tr: Illa allatheena amanoo waAAamiloo alssalihati watawasaw bialhaqqi watawasaw bialssabri

t: Woe to every scorner and mocker
tr: Waylun likulli humazatin lumazatin

t: Who collects wealth and [continuously] counts it.
tr: Allathee jamaAAa malan waAAaddadahu

t: He thinks that his wealth will make him immortal.
tr: Yahsabu anna malahu akhladahu

t: No! He will surely be thrown into the Crusher.
tr: Kalla layunbathanna fee alhutamati

t: And what can make you know what is the Crusher?
tr: Wama adraka ma alhutamatu

t: It is the fire of God, [eternally] fuelled,
tr: Naru Allahi almooqadatu

t: Which mounts directed at the hearts.
tr: Allatee tattaliAAu AAala alafidati

t: Indeed, it [i.e., Hellfire] will be closed down upon them
tr: lnnaha AAalayhim musadatun

t: In extended columns.
tr: Fee AAamadin mumaddadatin

t: Have you not considered, [O Muhammad], how your Lord dealt with the companions of the elephant?
tr: Alam tara kayfa faAAala rabbuka biashabi alfeeli

t: Did He not make their plan into misguidance?
tr: Alam yajAAal kaydahum fee tadleelin

t: And He sent against them birds in flocks,
tr: Waarsala AAalayhim tayran ababeela

t: Striking them with stones of hard clay,
tr: Tarmeehim bihijaratin min sijjeelin

t: And He made them like eaten straw. Al-Fīl: Ka’bāh
tr: FajaAAalahum kaAAasfin makoolin

t: For the accustomed security of the Quraysh -
tr: Lieelafi qurayshin

t: Their accustomed security [in] the caravan of winter and summer -
tr: Eelafihim rihlata alshshitai waalssayfi

t: Let them worship the Lord of this House,
tr: FalyaAAbudoo rabba hatha albayti

t: Who has fed them, [saving them] from hunger and made them safe, [saving them] from fear.
tr: Allathee atAAamahum min jooAAin waamanahum min khawfin

t: Have you seen the one who denies the Recompense?
tr: Araayta allathee yukaththibu bialddeeni

t: For that is the one who drives away the orphan
tr: Fathalika allathee yaduAAAAu alyateema

t: And does not encourage the feeding of the poor.
tr: Wala yahuddu AAala taAAami almiskeeni

t: So woe to those who pray
tr: Fawaylun lilmusalleena

t: [But] who are heedless of their prayer -
tr: Allatheena hum AAan salatihim sahoona

t: Those who make show [of their deeds]
tr: Allatheena hum yuraoona

t: And withhold [simple] assistance.
tr: WayamnaAAoona almaAAoona

t: Indeed, We have granted you, [O Muhammad], al-Kawthar.
tr: Inna aAAtaynaka alkawthara

t: So pray to your Lord and sacrifice [to Him alone].
tr: Fasalli lirabbika wainhar

t: Indeed, your enemy is the one cut off.
tr: Inna shaniaka huwa alabtaru

t: Say, “O disbelievers,
tr: Qul ya ayyuha alkafiroona

t: I do not worship what you worship.
tr: La aAAbudu ma taAAbudoona

t: Nor are you worshippers of what I worship.
tr: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

t: Nor will I be a worshipper of what you worship.
tr: Wala ana AAabidun ma AAabadtum

t: Nor will you be worshippers of what I worship.
tr: Wala antum AAabidoona ma aAAbudu

t: For you is your religion, and for me is my religion.”
tr: Lakum deenukum waliya deeni

t: When the victory of God has come and the conquest,
tr: Itha jaa nasru Allahi waalfathu

t: And you see the people entering into the religion of God in multitudes,
tr: Waraayta alnnasa yadkhuloona fee deeni Allahi afwajan

t: Then exalt [Him] with praise of your Lord and ask forgiveness of Him. Indeed, He is ever Accepting of repentance.
tr: Fasabbih bihamdi rabbika waistaghfirhu innahu kana tawwaban

t: May the hands of Abū Lahab be ruined, and ruined is he.
tr: Tabbat yada abee lahabin watabba

t: His wealth will not avail him or that which he gained.
tr: Ma aghna AAanhu maluhu wama kasaba

t: He will [enter to] burn in a Fire of [blazing] flame
tr: Sayasla naran thata lahabin

t: And his wife [as well] - the carrier of firewood.
tr: Waimraatuhu hammalata alhatabi

t: Around her neck is a rope of [twisted] fibre.
tr: Fee jeediha hablun min masadin

t: Say, “He is God, [who is] One,
tr: Qul huwa Allahu ahadun

t: God, the Self-sufficient.
tr: Allahu alssamadu

t: He neither begets nor is born,
tr: Lam yalid walam yooladu

t: Nor is there to Him any equivalent.”
tr: Walam yakun lahu kufuwan ahadun

t: Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of daybreak
tr: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alfalaqi

t: From the evil of that which He created
tr: Min sharri ma khalaqa

t: And from the evil of darkness when it settles
tr: Wamin sharri ghasiqin itha waqaba

t: And from the evil of the blowers in knots
tr: Wamin sharri alnnaffathati fee alAAuqadi

t: And from the evil of an envier when he envies.”
tr: Wamin sharri hasidin itha hasada

t: Say, “I seek refuge in the Lord of mankind,
tr: Qul aAAoothu birabbi alnnasi

t: The Sovereign of mankind,
tr: Maliki alnnasi

t: The God of mankind,
tr: Ilahi alnnasi

t: From the evil of the retreating whisperer -
tr: Min sharri alwaswasi alkhannasi

t: Who whispers [evil] into the breasts of mankind -
tr: Allathee yuwaswisu fee sudoori alnnasi

t: From among the jinn and mankind.”
tr: Mina aljinnati wa alnnasm
